column4: OPS-13 Field installer (developer tool, portable bundle and GUI)
column5: h3. Links *Features:* Deploy & OS image, Network & NetBird *Blocked by:* OPS-03, OPS-04, OPS-08, OPS-09, OPS-12, API-05, API-10 *Relates to:* PLAT-07, PLAT-09 *Implements:* OD-57, OD-76, OD-77, OD-75, EP-10, REQ-21 *Project / folder:* {{deploy/install-scurebox.ps1}}, {{deploy/make-installer.ps1}}, {{deploy/installer/}} *Goal:* Take a release from a PC to a working unit, either by SSH update or by flashing the eMMC, with a progress bar and a final health check that only reports success when the unit runs the new version. A portable, password-gated bundle (CLI plus WPF GUI) lets non-developers do the same on any Windows 10/11 PC with no SDK or Python. *Depends on:* OPS-03, OPS-04, OPS-08, OPS-09, OPS-12. Api ({{/api/system/version}}, {{/api/state}} with {{hwSource}} and {{internetOk}}). Application-Platform (device unlock challenge: Supervisor ChallengeSolve). *Files to create:* {{deploy/install-scurebox.ps1}}; {{deploy/make-installer.ps1}}; {{deploy/installer/Install-sCureBox.ps1}}; {{Install-sCureBox-GUI.ps1}}; {{Install-sCureBox.cmd}}; {{sCureBox Installer.cmd}}; {{README.txt}}. *Public contract:* * {{install-scurebox.ps1}} parameters: ** {{-Mode auto|deploy|flash}} (default auto), {{-Target }} (named Target because {{$Host}} is read-only in PowerShell; default is a lab IP) ** {{-User scure}}, {{-Key}}, {{-Payload}}, {{-BaseImage}}, {{-DiskNumber}}, {{-Port 3001}} ** {{-SkipBuild}}, {{-SkipTests}}, {{-NoKiosk}}, {{-Reboot}}, {{-Force}}, {{-InstallKey}} ** {{-NetbirdSetupKey}} | {{-NetbirdSetupKeyFile}}, {{-NoNetbird}}, {{-Yes}}, {{-ImageOnly}} * {{make-installer.ps1 [-Payload] [-SkipBuild] [-SkipTests] [-Password] [-NoPassword] [-OutDir]}} writes {{deploy/out/sCureBox-Installer-/}} and {{.zip}}. The bundle holds {{Install-sCureBox.ps1}}, {{.cmd}}, {{-GUI.ps1}}, {{sCureBox Installer.cmd}}, {{README.txt}}, {{payload/scurebox--linux-arm64.tar.gz}} and optionally {{access.json}}. The version comes from the tarball name. * {{access.json}} = {{{"salt": base64(16 random bytes), "hash": lowercase hex SHA-256(UTF-8 ":")}}}. The password itself is never stored. * {{Install-sCureBox.ps1}} parameters: ** {{-Target}}, {{-User scure}}, {{-UnitPassword}} (default = the fixed device default; secret, see OPEN QUESTION in OPS-12), {{-Key}}, {{-Payload}}, {{-Port 3001}} ** {{-InstallKey}}, {{-NoKiosk}}, {{-Reboot}}, {{-Force}} ** {{-NetbirdSetupKey}} | {{-NetbirdSetupKeyFile}}, {{-NoNetbird}}, {{-NetbirdLogin}}, {{-NetbirdLoginOnly}}, {{-Password}} (the installer gate) ** Env {{SCUREBOX_INSTALLER_PASSWORD}} is an alternative to {{-Password}}. ** Exit 1 on any failure ({{[install] ERROR: …}}). * GUI env: {{SCUREBOX_NO_ELEVATE}} (skip the UAC request), {{SCUREBOX_REPO}} (source tree for the Flash tab). Parameters {{-BundleDir}}, {{-RepoDir}}, {{-ShowNextSteps}}. * {{.cmd}} launchers: {{Install-sCureBox.cmd}} runs the CLI with {{-ExecutionPolicy Bypass}} and pauses. {{sCureBox Installer.cmd}} starts the GUI with a hidden window. *Behaviour & rules:* # Phases use weighted progress ({{Write-Progress}}): Preflight 5, Build 35, Version check 5, Deploy 45 or Build image 25 + Flash 25, Verify 10. # Auto mode picks deploy when TCP 22 or {{/api/system/version}} answers on the target. Otherwise it picks flash when a CM5 gadget disk is present. Otherwise it fails. # Version check: when the unit already reports the same {{appVersion}} and {{-Force}} is not given, warn and stop with no changes. # Deploy: ** Optionally append {{~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub}} (or {{id_rsa.pub}}; the bundle generates an ed25519 key if none exists) to the unit's {{~/.ssh/authorized_keys}}. ** scp the tarball to {{/tmp}}. Remotely: extract, {{chmod +x deploy/install.sh}}, run {{sudo ./deploy/install.sh }}. Opts: {{--no-kiosk}}, {{--reboot}}, {{--no-netbird}} or {{--netbird-key K}}. ** The developer tool tries {{sudo -n}} first and falls back to interactive {{sudo}}. ** The bundle sends the device password over stdin to {{sudo -S -p ''}} and strips non-printable characters on the unit, because Windows PowerShell adds a CR or BOM. The remote command contains no double quotes (PowerShell 5.1 does not escape them for ssh.exe). ** The bundle feeds ssh and scp the password through a temporary {{SSH_ASKPASS}} .cmd file ({{SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force}}, {{DISPLAY}} set), deleted at the end. ssh options: {{StrictHostKeyChecking=no}}, {{UserKnownHostsFile=NUL}}, {{LogLevel=ERROR}}, {{ConnectTimeout=10}}. Units are reflashed often and get new host keys. ** The bundle reads {{deploy/install.sh}} out of the tarball and passes NetBird flags only when it contains {{netbird-key}} (releases from 1.0.18 on). ** With {{-Reboot}}, ssh exit 255 is treated as the expected reboot. ** The boot config changed when the output has "scurebox fragment|Touch Display 2 profile|Plymouth theme". If it changed and there was no reboot, advise a reboot. # Verify: poll {{/api/system/version}} every 4 s for up to 180 s until {{appVersion}} equals the new version and {{/api/state}} answers. Then print version, commit, os, kernel and eMMC. Read {{netbird status}} over SSH and print Connected, IP and FQDN. # NetBird web login ({{-NetbirdLogin}}, no key): a base64-encoded bash script is piped over SSH and run with sudo. It: ** sets the unit clock from the PC epoch when it is off by more than 300 s; ** installs NetBird with {{netbird-enroll.sh --install-only}} when it is missing (exit 75 = no internet); ** exits 0 with {{ALREADY_CONNECTED}} when connected; ** checks {{curl https://api.netbird.io}} (exit 75 when unreachable); ** prints {{LOGIN_START}}, then runs {{timeout 600 netbird up --no-browser --hostname -}}; ** prints {{CONNECTED}} on success, or exits 4. The PC opens in the browser the first https URL that appears after {{LOGIN_START}} and is not a {{[netbird]}} line. # Flash mode: ** {{-ImageOnly}}: write the image unchanged; an {{.xz}} is decompressed with {{unxz.py}} into {{deploy\image\out}}, and that copy is deleted after a successful flash. ** Otherwise {{patch-display.py --probe}} decides. {{factory}}: run patch-display to {{-display.img}} and flash it as it is. {{rpios}}: build-image.py, with the NetBird key passed through a temporary file that is deleted afterwards. {{unknown}}: refuse before the eMMC is touched. ** After the flash, print the next steps: remove the jumper, connect, power on. # GUI (WPF, dark tokens: bg {{#0a0a0a}}, card {{#111}}, accent {{#0ea5e9}}, window 760x980): ** Asks for admin once at start; declining keeps the tool usable without Flash. ** Three mode pills: Update unit / Flash new unit / Unlock code. One Install / Go button, a progress bar, a status line and a coloured log. ** Child processes are run through a compiled C# {{ProcessPump}}: the output lines go into a ConcurrentQueue that a 150 ms DispatcherTimer drains (PowerShell script blocks cannot run on thread-pool threads). ** Update tab: target address, "Enroll in NetBird" checkbox plus key file or pasted key, Reboot checkbox. With NetBird checked and no key, it uses {{-NetbirdLogin}}. ** NetBird key auto-discovery, first usable file with at least 20 characters: {{\netbird-setup-key.txt}}, then {{%USERPROFILE%\.scurebox\netbird-setup-key.txt}}, then {{%TEMP%\netbird-setup-key.txt}}. A pasted key is saved to the user store. ** Flash tab: *** Enabled only when {{deploy\install-scurebox.ps1}} and Python are present (that is, run from the repo or with {{-RepoDir}}). *** Pre-start checklist: jumper, USB-C, network with internet, power, and a "red LED dim" confirmation button that must be pressed before flashing. *** A background runspace polls every 2.5 s: **** the USB state (ready = gadget disk, boot = boot-ROM device, none, error); **** after a flash: whether the USB disk or ROM is still present; **** {{http://scurebox.local:3001/api/state}} and the AAAA fe80 address with each interface zone, for {{hwSource}}, {{internetOk}} and {{/api/system/version}}. *** It drives a "Next steps" tracker: jumper removed; machine IO board seen ({{hwSource == "io_controller"}}); API up; internet; NetBird Connect button. *** The Flash tab always calls {{install-scurebox.ps1 -Mode flash -BaseImage -ImageOnly -Yes}} (since 1.0.96). ** Unlock tab: a 4-digit challenge is turned into a 6-digit code. The code is HMAC-SHA256 over UTF-8 {{"||"}} with context "" and step 0, followed by RFC 4226 dynamic truncation mod 10^6, printed with 6 digits. The 32-byte HMAC secret is embedded in the GUI as base64 and must equal the device's Supervisor secret. SECRET: do not copy it; supply it from secure configuration. The installer password gate also protects this tab. ** The gate password is checked against {{access.json}}: next to the GUI, or else {{%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\sCureBox Installer\access.json}}. It is passed to the CLI through {{SCUREBOX_INSTALLER_PASSWORD}}, never on the command line. The CLI allows 3 tries. *Configuration:* {{access.json}}; NetBird key files; {{SCUREBOX_*}} env vars above. *Acceptance criteria:* * Updating a unit already on the version prints "already runs … -Force" and changes nothing. * A successful update prints {{SUCCESS - sCureBox is running on and answering /api/state}}. * A wrong gate password three times exits 1. * The bundle zip contains no NetBird key and no plain password. * The Flash tab refuses an image that is neither rpios nor factory. *Tests:* manual. No automated tests exist for these scripts. *Reference (source):* {{deploy/install-scurebox.ps1}}, {{deploy/make-installer.ps1}}, {{deploy/installer/*}} ---

column4: OPS-14 Windows PC demo installer (simulator)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Simulator, Deploy & OS image
*Blocked by:* OPS-02, UI-01
*Relates to:* HW-15, HW-16
*Implements:* REQ-16

*Project / folder:* {{deploy/make-demo-installer.ps1}}; consumes {{src/SCureBox.Ui}} ({{DemoWinExe}}, {{Hosting/DemoMode.cs}})
*Goal:* A single setup {{.exe}} that installs the native UI with the simulated firmware on any Windows 10/11 x64 PC, with no .NET and no admin rights. It is used for demos and training.
*Depends on:* OPS-02. Native UI (DemoMode marker, {{DemoWinExe}} property in {{SCureBox.Ui.csproj}}).
*Files to create:* {{deploy/make-demo-installer.ps1}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{make-demo-installer.ps1 [-SkipTests]}} writes {{deploy/out/sCureBox-Demo-Setup-<version>.exe}}. The work folder is {{deploy/out/demo-installer-<version>/}} and contains {{app/}}, {{payload.zip}}, {{install.ps1}} and {{demo.sed}}.
* Publish: {{dotnet publish src/SCureBox.Ui/SCureBox.Ui.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=false -p:DebugType=none -p:UseAppHost=true -p:DemoWinExe=true}}. {{DemoWinExe=true}} switches {{OutputType}} to WinExe, so no console window opens.
* Marker {{app/demo.mode}} (any text) plus {{app/VERSION}}. With the marker present, {{DemoMode}} sets each of these variables only when it is not already set:
** {{SCURE_SIMULATE=1}}, {{SCURE_UI_WINDOW=1}}, {{SCURE_UI_SIZE=1600x1000}}
** {{PORT=3011}}, {{ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://127.0.0.1:3011}}
** {{SCURE_DATA_DIR=%LOCALAPPDATA%\sCureBox Demo\data}}
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Runs {{dotnet test SCureBox.sln}} unless {{-SkipTests}} is given.
# {{install.ps1}} (UTF-8 with BOM) runs after IExpress has unpacked the package. It:
** kills only a running {{scurebox-ui}} whose path is the install folder;
** replaces {{%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\sCureBox Demo}} and extracts {{payload.zip}} into it;
** writes {{uninstall.ps1}};
** creates a Desktop shortcut and a Start Menu folder with the app shortcut (description "sCureBox - PC demo (simulator)") and "Uninstall sCureBox Demo";
** registers {{HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\sCureBox Demo}} with DisplayName, DisplayVersion (from VERSION), Publisher "sCure", InstallLocation, UninstallString and NoModify = 1;
** starts the app. Any error is shown in a MessageBox and exits 1.
# {{uninstall.ps1 [-Data keep|delete|ask]}}: kills the app, removes the shortcuts and the registry key, asks before deleting {{%LOCALAPPDATA%\sCureBox Demo}} (with {{ask}}), and deletes the install folder from a detached process after 2 s.
# IExpress SED: {{PackagePurpose=InstallApp}}, hidden windows, {{UseLongFileName=1}}, {{RebootMode=N}}, {{FriendlyName=sCureBox Demo Setup}}, {{AppLaunched=powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File install.ps1}}, files {{payload.zip}} and {{install.ps1}}. Run {{iexpress.exe /N /Q /M demo.sed}}. It returns at once, so wait up to 300 s until the exe is larger than 1 MB and its size has not changed for 3 s.
*Configuration:* none.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Running the exe as a normal user installs the demo and starts it.
* The window shows the simulator at 1600x1000.
* {{http://127.0.0.1:3011/api/state}} shows {{hwSource: "simulation"}}.
* Settings > Apps lists "sCureBox Demo".
* The uninstaller removes everything except the data, unless asked to delete it.
*Tests:* {{tests/SCureBox.Ui.Tests/DemoModeTests.cs}} (marker → environment); manual install.
*Reference (source):* {{deploy/make-demo-installer.ps1}}, {{src/SCureBox.Ui/SCureBox.Ui.csproj}}, {{src/SCureBox.Ui/Hosting/DemoMode.cs}}

---

column4: OPS-15 Origin application package (.tgz for the factory A/B image)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Deploy & OS image, Cloud sync & Origin, Safety & watchdog, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* OPS-02, OPS-07, HW-08, PLAT-07
*Relates to:* DVT-05, DVT-06, HW-14, PLAT-01
*Implements:* OD-75, OD-77, OD-69, OD-74, REQ-21

*Project / folder:* {{deploy/package-origin-app.ps1}} (canonical), {{deploy/package-origin-app.sh}}, {{deploy/origin-app/}}
*Goal:* Package sCureBox as an application for the Origin supervisor on the factory image (read-only root, .NET 10 runtime installed, labwc session). The firmware with the native UI and the output watchdog become supervisor-managed services, with persistent state in {{/opt/data}}.
*Depends on:* OPS-02, OPS-07. Hardware ({{native/linux-arm64}}: prebuilt {{pio_rgb}}, {{pio_servo}}, {{lib/libusbtc08.so}}). Application-Platform ({{SCURE_SUPERVISOR_URL}}, default {{http://127.0.0.1:8080}}). Dvt-Hdt (DVT runner from the sibling sCure-A repo).
*Files to create:* {{deploy/package-origin-app.ps1}}, {{deploy/package-origin-app.sh}}, {{deploy/origin-app/run.sh}}, {{run-watchdog.sh}}, {{run-dvt-runner.sh}}.
*Public contract:*
* Output {{deploy/out/scurebox-<v>-origin-app.tgz}}, staged in {{origin-app-<v>/}}. Archive root:
** {{manifest.json}}
** {{SHA256SUMS}}: one {{"<sha256 lowercase>  <relative/path>"}} line per file of {{main/}} plus {{manifest.json}}, sorted by path, LF line endings
** {{main/}}
* {{main/}} holds:
** the framework-dependent publish of SCureBox.Api and SCureBox.Ui ({{-c Release -r linux-arm64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=false -p:DebugType=none -p:UseAppHost=false -p:RollForward=Major}})
** {{keys/scure-update.pub}}, {{VERSION}}, {{GITINFO}}
** {{native/linux-arm64/*}} (when {{pio_rgb}} exists)
** {{dvt-runner/runner/dvt-runner.cjs}}, {{dvt-runner/web/{dvt-tool.html,dvt-catalog.js,dvt-criteria.js,dvt-auto.js}}}, {{dvt-runner/VERSION}}, all copied from {{../sCure-A/DVT/}}. If sCure-A is missing, a warning is printed and the runner is left out.
** {{run.sh}}, {{run-watchdog.sh}}, {{run-dvt-runner.sh}}, with LF line endings and no BOM.
* {{manifest.json}} (ps1):
```
{"id":"scurebox","name":"sCureBox","version":"<v>","services":[
 {"name":"scurebox-main","type":"simple","user":"root","exec":["/bin/sh","main/run.sh"]},
 {"name":"scurebox-watchdog","type":"simple","user":"root","exec":["/bin/sh","main/run-watchdog.sh"]},
 {"name":"scurebox-dvt-runner","type":"simple","exec":["/bin/sh","main/run-dvt-runner.sh"]}]}
```
  The {{.sh}} variant produces only main and watchdog, without {{user}} keys, and leaves out the native helpers and the runner. OPEN QUESTION: whether to keep the {{.sh}} variant in sync with the ps1. The ps1 is the one in use.
* Install on a device: {{scp <tgz> origin@<device>:/tmp/}}, then {{POST http://<device>:8080/api/application/install}} with body {{{"path":"/tmp/<tgz>"}}}. The supervisor checks SHA256SUMS. Installing does not restart the app; the operator restarts it through the firmware's {{/api/system/reboot}}.
* {{SCURE_STATE_DIR}} (default {{/opt/data/scurebox}}) is the persistent root.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Services run through {{/bin/sh}}, because tar on Windows cannot set the executable bit.
# Main and watchdog run as root. The Origin image keeps {{/dev/gpiochip*}}, {{/dev/gpiomem*}} and {{/dev/pio0}} root-only. Running as {{origin}} made the firmware fall back to simulation and stopped the watchdog from cutting the SSRs.
# {{run.sh}}:
** cd to its own directory;
** {{mkdir $DATA/data}}; seed {{$DATA/components.json}} once from {{config/components.json}} (never replaced by an update);
** copy {{native/linux-arm64/pio_*}} to {{$DATA/native/}}, {{chmod 755}}, export {{SCURE_NATIVE_DIR}};
** prepend {{native/linux-arm64/lib}} to {{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}};
** export {{SCURE_DATA_DIR=$DATA/data}}, {{SCURE_COMPONENTS}}, {{ASPNETCORE_URLS}} (default {{http://*:3001}}), {{PORT=3001}}, {{DOTNET_gcServer=0}}, {{DOTNET_TieredPGO=1}}, {{DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1}}, {{SCURE_HEARTBEAT_FILE=/dev/shm/scurebox-heartbeat}}, {{SCURE_UI_WINDOW=1}}, {{SCURE_UI_FULLSCREEN=1}}, {{SCURE_UI_HIDE_CURSOR=1}};
** source {{$DATA/ui.env}} when it exists (per-machine overrides), then {{SCURE_UI_RENDER}} defaults to {{gles}};
** set {{WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0}} when {{${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/0}/wayland-0}} is a socket; set {{DISPLAY}} from the first {{/tmp/.X11-unix/X<n>}};
** echo the display env, set {{DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major}}, find dotnet on PATH or {{/usr/share/dotnet/dotnet}}, set {{DOTNET_ROOT}} from its resolved directory;
** {{exec dotnet ./scurebox-ui.dll "$@"}}.
# {{run-watchdog.sh}}: the same data and components seeding, {{SCURE_HEARTBEAT_FILE=/dev/shm/scurebox-heartbeat}} (the {{origin}} user cannot write {{/run}}; tmpfs, so no eMMC wear), {{DOTNET_gcServer=0}}, then {{exec dotnet ./scurebox.dll --watchdog --timeout 20}}.
# {{run-dvt-runner.sh}}: config {{$DATA/dvt-runner.json}} (mode 600, holds portalUrl, key, machine, unit, machineApi, resultsFile …; secret, per machine). If the runner file, {{node}} or the config is missing, print "not configured … idle" and {{exec sleep infinity}}, so the supervisor does not restart it in a loop. Otherwise {{exec node dvt-runner/runner/dvt-runner.cjs <cfg>}}.
# Unless {{-SkipTests}} is given, run {{dotnet test}} first. Write GITINFO. Create the tar with {{%SystemRoot%\System32\tar.exe -czf <tgz> -C <stage> manifest.json SHA256SUMS main}}.
*Configuration:* {{/opt/data/scurebox/ui.env}} (e.g. {{SCURE_UI_RENDER=software|gles}}); {{/opt/data/scurebox/dvt-runner.json}}.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{sha256sum --strict -c SHA256SUMS}} passes inside the extracted package.
* The supervisor accepts the install. After a restart the native UI shows full-screen, {{/api/state}} reports {{hwSource: "io_controller"}} (not simulation), and the watchdog is running.
* {{components.json}} and the data survive a version update.
*Tests:* manual on an Origin unit. The {{.sh}} variant self-checks SHA256SUMS after packing.
*Reference (source):* {{deploy/package-origin-app.ps1}}, {{deploy/package-origin-app.sh}}, {{deploy/origin-app/*}}, {{src/SCureBox.Hardware/native/linux-arm64/README.txt}}

---

column5: -r linux-arm64 --self-contained false, UseAppHost=false, RollForward=Major; copy native/linux-arm64/* when pio_rgb exists; dotnet test first unless -SkipTests.

column4: OPS-15.3 Generate manifest.json (scurebox-main, scurebox-watchdog as root, scurebox-dvt-runner) and sorted LF SHA256SUMS

column4: OPS-17 QA tool (shared test table, headless runner, browser tool, run-all)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* QA & tests, API host & infrastructure, Simulator
*Blocked by:* OPS-01, API-04, API-05, API-06, API-07, API-08, API-09, API-10, API-11, API-12, UI-08
*Blocks:* OPS-18
*Relates to:* API-13
*Implements:* EP-03, EP-12, OD-62, OD-63, REQ-24, REQ-25

*Project / folder:* {{qa/}}
*Goal:* One table of API contract tests (about 125 rows in 15 categories) that runs headless in CI-like runs ({{run-qa.mjs}}) and interactively in a browser ({{qa-tool.html}}) against any live firmware: simulation on the PC or the real machine. {{run-all.ps1}} chains build, unit and integration tests, a simulated API server, the headless QA and the native UI QA into one PASS/FAIL result.
*Depends on:* OPS-01. Api (every endpoint under test), Native UI ({{/api/ui/route|navigate|screenshot|tap|swipe}}).
*Files to create:* {{qa/qa-tests.js}}, {{qa/run-qa.mjs}}, {{qa/qa-tool.html}}, {{qa/run-all.ps1}}, {{qa/README.md}}. {{qa/last-qa-report.json}} is generated by {{run-all.ps1}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{qa-tests.js}}: a plain script with no dependencies. It defines {{globalThis.SCURE_QA = {CATEGORIES, CHECKS, runTest, STATE_KEYS}}} and {{globalThis.SCURE_QA_TESTS = CATEGORIES}}.
* Record: {{{id, name, desc, endpoint?, method?, body?, expect?|expectArray?|check?, code?, url?, timeout?, reason?, route?}}}.
** {{expect:'ok'}} → {{ok === true}}.
** {{expect:'<field>'}} → the field exists.
** {{expectArray}} → the body is an array.
** {{check:'<name>'}} → {{CHECKS[name](ctx,test,res)}} returns {{{status:'pass'|'fail'|'warn'|'skip', msg}}}.
** {{url}} → a static asset fetched without the {{/api}} prefix.
** No endpoint and no url → the check makes its own calls.
* {{runTest}} returns {{{status,msg,ms}}}. A timeout gives {{fail 'timeout'}}. {{ctx = {apiUrl, fetch, timeoutMs:10000}}}. Run ids {{qa-test-run}} and {{qa-recipe-run}}.
* {{STATE_KEYS}} (all must be in {{/api/state}}): chamberTemp, targetTemp, internetOk, offlineMode, doorClosed, doorAborted, isHeating, isCooling, coolingMode, uvOn, uvIntensity, uvWavelength, uvOutputs, ventOn, damperOpen, damperDriver, fans, fanRpm, fanRpmEach, fanOverride, stripMode, uiAlerts, ledTemps, uvSensors, nitrogenActive, n2Pressure, n2LinePressure, bofaOn, bofaConnected, bofaDutyPercent, bofaPowered, bofaDetected, atTemp, heaterPwm, heaterOut, coolingRate, coolingFanPwm, faults, sensors, fanHealth, ledHealth, ledChecksEnabled, alerts, alertDetails, hwSource, counters, cloudSync, nfcEnabled, nfcReader, recipe. Fans: FAN_HEATER, FAN_DOOR, FAN_RIGHT, FAN_LEFT, FAN_BACK, FAN_COOLING.
* Categories, in order: connectivity, state, cure, chamber, hardware, diagnostics, data, system, network, nfc, dev, dvt, recipe, static, performance, native_ui. The README lists the categories without dvt and native_ui. The table is the source of truth.
* {{node qa/run-qa.mjs [--api http://localhost:3001] [--category <id>] [--json out.json] [--quiet]}}.
** Node 18 or newer, no dependencies. It loads {{qa-tests.js}} with {{createRequire}}.
** Connectivity gate: {{GET /api/state}} with a 5 s timeout. If it fails, exit 1.
** Tests run in order with a 50 ms pause between them.
** Coloured output on a TTY. Exit 1 when any test fails (warn and skip do not count). Exit 2 for bad arguments.
** The JSON report is {{{api, date, seconds, summary:{pass,fail,warn,skip}, results:[{category,id,name,status,msg,ms}]}}}.
* {{qa-tool.html}} (title "sCureBox QA Tool"):
** Loads {{qa-tests.js}} from the same folder and shows a banner when it cannot.
** API URL input (default {{http://localhost:3001}}, remembered in localStorage {{scure-qa-api}}); Connect shows the server version and hwSource.
** Run All, Stop, Run per category and per row. Tiles for Total, Pass, Fail, Warn, Skip, plus a progress bar and a log.
** Export report opens a textarea modal with Copy and Download.
** Works from {{file://}}, because the API's CORS is open.
* {{run-all.ps1 [-Port 3111] [-SkipBuild] [-SkipTests] [-HangTimeout '3m'] [-ExcludeTests <names>] [-SkipUi]}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{run-all.ps1}} steps:
** {{dotnet build SCureBox.sln -nologo -v q}}. A failure stops the run with exit 1.
** {{dotnet test}} for Domain, Hardware, Application and Api tests ({{--no-build --blame-hang --blame-hang-timeout <HangTimeout>}}). The Ui.Tests project is not in this list.
** Start {{src/SCureBox.Api/bin/Debug/net10.0/scurebox.dll}} with dotnet. Env: {{SCURE_SIMULATE=1}}, {{SCURE_SIM_TC08=1}}, {{SCURE_DATA_DIR=<temp scurebox-qa-<guid>>}}, {{SCURE_UI_DIR=<repo>/ui/dist}}, {{PORT=<Port>}}, {{ASPNETCORE_URLS=''}}, {{DOTNET_ROOT}}. stdout and stderr go to files.
** Wait up to 90 s (180 × 0.5 s) for a {{/api/state}} body containing {{"hwSource"}}.
** Run {{node run-qa.mjs --api http://127.0.0.1:<Port> --json <tmp>}}, copy the report to {{qa/last-qa-report.json}}, stop the server and show the last 20 stderr lines.
** Native UI stage (unless {{-SkipUi}}, and only when {{src/SCureBox.Ui/bin/Debug/net10.0/scurebox-ui.dll}} exists): run it with {{SCURE_UI_WINDOW=1}} on Port+1. Wait up to 120 s for {{/api/ui/route}} to contain {{"route"}}, then sleep 8 s for the boot screen. Run {{--category native_ui}}.
** Print an ordered summary (PASS green, SKIPPED yellow, others red), then {{OVERALL: PASS}} (exit 0) or {{FAIL}} (exit 1).
# Rows that are never executed (marked skip): {{system/reboot}}, {{system/shutdown}}, {{network/static}}. {{system/datetime}} with a valid value only runs when {{/api/system/version.os}} matches /windows/i.
# Tests that change outputs leave the machine idle: every cure sequence ends with {{cure/stop}}, the recipe run is aborted, the fans go back to 0, the LED calibration is restored. On the real machine the door test opens the door magnet.
# Performance thresholds: median of 5 {{/api/state}} calls < 200 ms passes, < 500 ms warns. Presets and user materials in parallel: < 500 ms passes, < 1500 ms warns.
# Representative expectations to keep:
** cure rejections: heat 99 → 7001, heat 10 → 7001, intensity 5 → 7002, mode turbo → 7003, cool 15 → 7001, wavelength 500 refused without a code;
** {{cure/stop}} is always ok;
** recipe second start → 6015;
** network diagnostics: unknown tool → 9080, shell-injection address → 9085;
** NFC without a reader → 9052;
** USB exports pass when they answer 9081 (no drive);
** update manifest: 404 with 9081/9086/9087, or {{{version, sha256}}};
** {{cloud/config}} without a key → 400;
** LED calibration factor 2.0 → 400; LED power 101 → 400;
** in simulation: {{n2LinePressure 6}}, {{n2Pressure {mpa 0.6, bar 6, mode analog_voltage}}}.
*Configuration:* {{--api}} / API URL; the env above for run-all.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File qa\run-all.ps1}} prints OVERALL: PASS on a clean checkout.
* {{node qa/run-qa.mjs --api http://127.0.0.1:3111}} gives 0 failures against a simulated server. The stored report shows 96 pass, 0 fail, 8 skip; that is an older run and the count grows with the table.
* Opening {{qa-tool.html}} from disk connects and runs.
*Tests:* this ticket is the test harness. It is verified by running it against a simulated server.
*Reference (source):* {{qa/*}}, {{docs/03-ui-and-qa.md}}

---

column4: OPS-18 Test strategy across tests/* (projects, conventions, how they run)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* QA & tests, Simulator
*Blocked by:* OPS-01, OPS-17, API-01, UI-01, HW-01, HW-02, HW-13, HW-15
*Relates to:* API-13, PLAT-03, PLAT-01
*Implements:* EP-03, REQ-24

*Project / folder:* {{tests/SCureBox.Domain.Tests}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Hardware.Tests}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Application.Tests}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Ui.Tests}}, plus the non-.NET tests ({{pwa/tests}}, {{deploy/image/test_patch_display.py}}, {{qa/}})
*Goal:* Define how the automated tests are organised and run, so that every layer is proven by itself and together, with no hardware, before any release. Each area writes its own test cases; this ticket fixes the projects, frameworks, fixtures and conventions they share.
*Depends on:* OPS-01, OPS-17. All src areas.
*Files to create:* the five test {{.csproj}} files plus the shared fixtures named below. Test classes come from each area's tickets.
*Public contract:*
* Domain, Hardware, Application and Api tests:
** Packages: {{Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.11.0}}, {{xunit 2.9.3}}, {{xunit.runner.visualstudio 4.0.1}}, {{coverlet.collector 10.1.0}}, {{Microsoft.Extensions.TimeProvider.Testing 10.11.0}}. Api also uses {{Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing 10.0.13}}.
** {{IsPackable=false}}, {{IsTestProject=true}}.
** Project references: Domain → Domain; Hardware → Hardware; Application → Application + Hardware; Api → Api.
* Ui.Tests:
** {{OutputType=Exe}}, {{NoWarn xUnit1051}}.
** Packages: {{xunit.v3 3.2.2}}, {{xunit.runner.visualstudio 3.1.5}}, {{Avalonia.Headless.XUnit 12.1.4}}, {{Microsoft.Extensions.TimeProvider.Testing 10.11.0}}, {{Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.11.0}}.
** References SCureBox.Ui. The Ui project grants {{InternalsVisibleTo SCureBox.Ui.Tests}}.
* Counts at 1.0.152 ({{[Fact]}}/{{[Theory]}}/{{[AvaloniaFact]}} attributes): Domain 163, Hardware 66, Application 294, Api 55, Ui 238.
* Run everything: {{dotnet test SCureBox.sln -nologo -v q}}. publish.ps1, package-origin-app.* and make-demo-installer.ps1 run this before building, unless {{-SkipTests}} is given.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Layer split:
** Domain: pure logic with a fake {{TimeProvider}}. Areas: Control evaluators, PI/delta-sigma, recipe state machine, Programs validator/CSV/estimator/error registry, Sensors math.
** Hardware: drivers against fake I2C and GPIO in {{Fakes/}} (FakeI2cBus, FakeGpioPins, FakeRgbDriver, FakeServoDriver, I2cWrite), plus HardwareConfig, the simulated system and the safety cut.
** Application: process loops, supervision, persistence, platform and reports, with {{Fakes/}} (FakeHardwareSystem, FakeHardwareConfig, FakeSystemService, ProcessRig, TimePump) and {{Persistence/TempDataDir}}.
** Api: integration tests with {{WebApplicationFactory<Program>}}.
** Ui: headless Avalonia.
# Api fixture {{ApiFixture : WebApplicationFactory<Program>}}:
** The static constructor sets env {{SCURE_SIMULATE=1}}, {{SCURE_SIM_TC08=1}}, {{SCURE_SIM_METER=1}} and clears {{SCURE_SIM_NFC}}.
** Per class: a fresh {{SCURE_DATA_DIR}} under {{%TEMP%/scurebox-api-tests/<guid>}} (deleted on dispose), {{SCURE_UI_DIR}} = the repo {{ui/dist}} (or a missing dir), {{DATABASE_URL=""}}.
** Helpers: {{GetAsync}}, {{PostAsync(path, body?)}}, {{PostRawAsync}}, {{StateAsync}}, {{WaitStateAsync(predicate, timeout)}}, {{ApiResponse{Status, Ok, Message, Body, Json, ContentType}}}.
** Static UI tests return early when {{ui/dist/index.html}} is missing.
# Ui fixture {{UiHostFixture}}:
** Builds the real host with {{ScureApiHost.Build(args, …)}}. Args: {{--SCURE_SIMULATE=1 --SCURE_SIM_TC08=1 --SCURE_DATA_DIR=<temp scurebox-ui-tests/<guid>> --DATABASE_URL= --ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://127.0.0.1:0 --urls=http://127.0.0.1:0 --SCURE_UI_DIR=<missing>}}.
** Registers {{BootTimings.Fast}}, a scriptable {{FakeBootSelfTest}}, a {{FakeOriginBrowser}} (no request leaves the test) and {{AddSCureBoxUi()}}.
** Exposes Navigation, Settings, Store and the Simulation (it unwraps {{FreezableHardwareSystem}}).
** {{TestAppBuilder}} sets {{[assembly: AvaloniaTestApplication]}} with {{UseSkia().WithInterFont().UseHeadless(UseHeadlessDrawing=false)}}, so {{RenderTargetBitmap}} produces real pixels.
# Repo-file lookup helpers walk up from the test binary or {{[CallerFilePath]}}: {{RepoFiles.Config(name)}} (config/presets.json, errors.json) and {{RepoFiles.Source()}} (src/, for tests that read the code itself, e.g. {{ErrorCoverageTests}}), and {{TestPaths.ComponentsJson()}}. Tests use the real repo config files, not copies.
# Naming: test methods are written as plain-English sentences with underscores (e.g. {{The_uv_fans_pulling_the_chamber_below_its_target_never_raise_9007}}). Every release note in versions.json names its proving tests (OPS-02).
# Time-dependent logic is tested with {{FakeTimeProvider}} or a time pump, never with wall-clock sleeps. Live polling in Api tests is allowed through {{WaitStateAsync}} with a timeout.
# Hung test hosts: {{run-all.ps1}} uses {{--blame-hang-timeout 3m}} per project, so a hang counts as FAIL instead of blocking the run.
# Tests that need Postgres ({{PostgresSmokeTests}}) run only when a database is configured. OPEN QUESTION: check the exact skip condition in that file (Application-Platform).
# Non-.NET tests: {{python deploy/image/test_patch_display.py}} (unittest, pyfatfs); {{python pwa/tests/test_pwa.py}} (Playwright); {{node qa/run-qa.mjs}} (live contract). No CI configuration exists in the repo (no {{.github/}} or other pipeline files). Everything is run locally on the Windows dev PC with the user-local SDK and Node 18 or newer.
# {{TestResults/}} folders are git-ignored.
*Configuration:* env vars set by the fixtures (above).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{dotnet test SCureBox.sln}} passes on Windows with no hardware attached, and with no ui/dist (static tests skip).
* No test writes outside its own temp folder.
* No test needs network access beyond loopback.
*Tests:* the projects themselves; {{qa/run-all.ps1}} as the aggregate gate.
*Reference (source):* {{tests/*/*.csproj}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests/ApiFixture.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Ui.Tests/UiHostFixture.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Ui.Tests/TestAppBuilder.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Domain.Tests/Programs/RepoFiles.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Hardware.Tests/TestPaths.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Application.Tests/Fakes/*}}, {{qa/run-all.ps1}}

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Programs & recipes
*Blocked by:* DOM-02, DOM-03

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Programs/}} ({{ProgramValidator.cs}}, {{ValidationError.cs}}, {{ValidationResult.cs}}, {{ProgramCsv.cs}}, {{CsvParseResult.cs}})
*Goal:* Pure validation of an operator-authored curing program (temperature/time/intensity ranges, cooling-drop rule, non-decreasing temperature chain, nitrogen block rules), collecting every failure with an error code; plus the 10-column CSV export/import (with legacy 5-column import) used by the editor and USB import.
*Depends on:* DOM-02 (codes), DOM-03 (CureStep / enums).
*Files to create:* {{Programs/ProgramValidator.cs}} ({{public static class ProgramValidator}}), {{Programs/ValidationError.cs}}, {{Programs/ValidationResult.cs}}, {{Programs/ProgramCsv.cs}} ({{public static class ProgramCsv}}), {{Programs/CsvParseResult.cs}}.
*Public contract:*
```csharp
namespace SCureBox.Domain.Programs;
public static class ProgramValidator
{
    public const double HeatMinC = 30;  public const double HeatMaxC = 80;  public const double DryMaxC = 50;
    public const double CoolMinC = 30;  public const double CoolMaxC = 75;  public const double CoolingDropMinC = 5;
    public const double UvMinPct = 10;  public const double UvMaxPct = 100;
    public const double HoldMinMin = 1; public const double HoldMaxMin = 120; public const double BleacherHoldMaxMin = 720;
    public const int MaxNitrogenSteps = 2;
    public static double HeatMaxFor(ProcessType process);           // Drying 50, else 80
    public static ValidationResult Validate(IReadOnlyList<CureStep> steps);
}
public sealed record ValidationError(int? Step ["step"], string Field ["field"], string Message ["message"], int Code ["code"]);
public sealed record ValidationResult
{ [JsonPropertyName("ok")] bool Ok => Errors.Count == 0; [JsonPropertyName("errors")] List<ValidationError> Errors { get; init; } = new();
  [JsonIgnore] int? FirstCode; [JsonIgnore] string Summary; }                 // Summary = messages joined with "; "
public static class ProgramCsv
{
    public const string Header = "Step,Process,Temperature,Time,TimerMode,UVIntensity,UVStart,UVRampPercent,CoolingMode,Ventilation";
    public static string ToCsv(IReadOnlyList<CureStep> steps);
    public static CsvParseResult Parse(string text);
}
public sealed record CsvParseResult(IReadOnlyList<CureStep> Steps, IReadOnlyList<string> Errors) { public bool Ok => Steps.Count > 0 && Errors.Count == 0; }
```
*Behaviour & rules (validator):*
# Empty list -> one error {{(null, "steps", "Add at least one step", 6015)}} and return.
# For each step at index i: {{n = s.Step > 0 ? s.Step : i + 1}}. Order of checks per step (determines {{FirstCode}}): (a) field checks, (b) nitrogen rules, (c) temperature chain. All failures are collected.
# Field checks ({{fmt}} = {{v.ToString("0.##", Invariant)}}):
** Nitrogen: none.
** Cooling: temperature null -> {{(n,"temperature","Step {n}: Cooling needs a target temperature (30-75°C)",7001)}}; else outside [30,75] or NaN -> {{"Step {n}: Invalid temperature {fmt} (must be 30-75 for Cooling)"}}, 7001. No time check.
** Heating/Drying/Cure/Bleacher: temperature present and ({{< 30}} or {{> HeatMaxFor(process)}} or NaN) -> {{"Step {n}: Invalid temperature {fmt} (must be 30-{max} for {Process})"}}, 7001; temperature null and not UV -> {{"Step {n}: {Process} needs a target temperature (30-{max}°C)"}}, 7001 (Cure/Bleacher with null temperature = UV-only, valid). Time: {{maxTime = Bleacher ? 720 : 120}}; NaN or {{< 1}} or {{> maxTime}} -> {{(n,"time","Step {n}: Invalid time {fmt} (must be 1-{maxTime})",6015)}}. UV (Cure/Bleacher): {{uv = EffectiveUvIntensity}}; NaN or outside [10,100] -> {{(n,"uvIntensity","Step {n}: Invalid UV intensity {fmt} (must be 10-100)",7002)}}.
# Nitrogen rules: when {{s}} is Nitrogen: count++; count > 2 -> {{(n,"process","Step {n}: A maximum of 2 nitrogen purge steps is allowed",6015)}}; if no next step -> {{"Step {n}: After an N2 purge, add a Cure or Bleaching step"}} 6015; else if next is UV and there is no step after it -> {{"Step {n}: Add a Cooling step after the Cure/Bleaching step that follows the N2 purge"}} 7003. Independently: previous step Nitrogen and {{s}} not UV -> {{"Step {n}: After nitrogen, only Cure or Bleaching is allowed"}} 6015; step i-2 Nitrogen and step i-1 UV and {{s}} not Cooling -> {{"Step {n}: Only Cooling is allowed after the Cure/Bleaching step that follows the N2 purge"}} 7003. (All with field "process".)
# Temperature chain ({{lastTemp}} = last heated target since the last Cooling, initially null): Cooling: if {{lastTemp}} and target both set and {{target > lastTemp - 5}} -> {{(n,"temperature","Step {n}: Cooling target ({fmt(target)}°C) must be at least 5°C below the previous step ({fmt(lastTemp)}°C)",7001)}}; then {{lastTemp = null}} (a first-step Cooling has nothing to check). Nitrogen: no change. Others: if temperature {{t}} set: {{t < lastTemp}} -> {{"Step {n}: Temperature ({fmt(t)}°C) cannot be lower than the previous step ({fmt(lt)}°C) without a Cooling step"}} 7001; then {{lastTemp = t}}. UV-only steps (null temperature) keep the chain unchanged.
# {{FirstCode}} = code of {{Errors[0]}} (null when valid); {{Summary}} = {{string.Join("; ", messages)}}.
*Behaviour & rules (CSV):*
# {{ToCsv}}: lines = Header + one line per step, joined with {{"\n"}}, no trailing newline. Columns: {{Step}} (invariant int); {{Process}} (enum name); {{Temperature}} = {{""}} for Nitrogen, {{"off"}} when {{IsUvOnly}}, else {{Num(Temperature)}}; {{Time}} = {{""}} for Cooling/Nitrogen else {{Num(Time)}}; {{TimerMode}} (UV only) {{"on-ramp"}} if OnRamp else {{"on-target"}}; {{UVIntensity}} (UV only) {{Num(UvIntensity ?? 30)}}; {{UVStart}} (UV only) {{"at-start"}} if AtStart else {{"at-target"}}; {{UVRampPercent}} always {{""}}; {{CoolingMode}} (Cooling only) {{(CoolingMode ?? Medium).Wire()}}; {{Ventilation}} (UV-only rows only) {{"on"}} if {{Ventilation == true}} else {{"off"}}; non-applicable columns {{""}}. {{Num(v)}} = null -> {{""}}, else {{v.ToString("0.##", Invariant)}}.
# {{Parse(text)}}: strip a leading BOM (U+FEFF); normalise {{\r\n}} and {{\r}} to {{\n}}; {{Trim()}}; split on {{\n}}. Fewer than 2 lines -> errors {{["CSV must have a header row and at least one data row"]}}. Header (line 0, lower-cased) must contain {{"process"}} or {{"step"}}, else {{["Missing required header: \"Step\" or \"Process\""]}}. Legacy layout when header has >= 5 columns, column 3 contains {{"intensity"}} and column 4 contains {{"time"}} ({{Step,Process,Temperature,Intensity,Time}}).
# Each data line i (1-based line index, blank/whitespace lines skipped but still counted): split on {{','}} (no quoting), trim cells. Fewer than 4 cells -> {{"Row {i}: Not enough columns (need at least 4)"}}, skip. Rejected rows are reported and skipped; parsed rows are returned.
# Row parse order: (a) process: {{Enum.TryParse<ProcessType>(cells[1], ignoreCase:false)}} and {{Enum.IsDefined}}, else {{"Row {i}: Invalid process \"{cell}\" (must be Heating, Drying, Cure, Cooling, Bleacher, or Nitrogen)"}} (note: numeric strings "0".."5" are accepted by TryParse — as in the source). (b) time (not for Cooling/Nitrogen): column = legacy ? cell 4 : cell 3; invariant float in [1, Bleacher ? 720 : 120] else {{"Row {i}: Invalid time \"{cell}\" (must be 1-{max})"}}; then {{Math.Floor}}. (c) step number = cell 0 parsed as int > 0, else i. (d) Nitrogen -> {{CureStep{Step, Nitrogen, Temperature null, Intensity null, Time 0}}}. (e) {{noHeat = isUv && cell2 equals "off" (case-insensitive)}}; if not noHeat and cell2 non-empty: range Cooling [30,75], else [30, HeatMaxFor] -> {{"Row {i}: Invalid temperature \"{cell}\" (must be {min}-{max} for {Process})"}}. Missing temperature defaults: Cooling 25, others 40 (UV-only stays null). NOTE: the 25 °C cooling default is outside the validator's 30-75 range (source behaviour). (f) Cooling -> {{{Temperature, Time 0, CoolingMode = CoolingModes.Parse(cell 8) ?? Medium}}}. (g) Heating/Drying -> {{{Temperature, Time}}}. (h) Cure/Bleacher: intensity column = legacy ? cell 3 : cell 5; non-empty must be invariant float in [10,100] else {{"Row {i}: Invalid UV intensity \"{cell}\" (must be 10-100)"}}; {{TimerMode}} = (not legacy) cell 4 exactly {{"on-ramp"}}/{{"on-target"}} else null; {{UvStartMode}} = cell 6 exactly {{"at-start"}}/{{"at-target"}} else null; {{UvRampPercent}} = cell 7 if parses and 10..100 else null (not legacy); {{Ventilation}} = noHeat ? (cell 9 equals "on", case-insensitive) : null; {{Intensity}} null. Missing cells read as {{""}}.
# After all rows: no steps and no errors -> {{["No valid steps found"]}}. Parsing is structural only; callers run {{ProgramValidator}} for sequence rules.
*Configuration:* none.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{Validate([])}} -> not Ok, {{FirstCode == 6015}}.
* Drying 50 valid, Drying 55 -> one 7001 error whose message contains "30-50"; Heating 55 valid; Heating 29.9 / Bleacher 81 / Drying 50.5 fail (7001); Cure 30 valid.
* Cooling after Heat 80: 29 and 76 fail, 30 and 75 pass. Heat 60 -> Cool 55 OK; Cool 56 -> single 7001 at step 2 containing "at least 5".
* Time: Heating 0 and 121, Cure 121, Bleacher 721 fail with 6015; Heating 1/120 and Bleacher 720 pass.
* UV 9 and 101 fail (7002), 10/100 pass; Cure without UvIntensity passes (30), with legacy {{Intensity = 5}} fails 7002.
* Heat 60 -> Dry 50 fails ("without a Cooling step"); Heat 60 -> Cool 40 -> Dry 50 OK; Heat 50 -> Cure(null) -> Dry 50 OK.
* N2 rules as in rule 4 (three purges -> error at step 9 "maximum of 2", 6015; N2 -> Heat -> error at the Heat "only Cure or Bleaching"; N2 -> Cure -> Cure -> error 7003 "Only Cooling"; N2 last -> "add a Cure or Bleaching step"; N2 -> Cure last -> 7003 "Cooling step").
* {{Validate([Heat(1,20,time 0), Cure(2,50,uv 5)])}}: >= 3 errors, Summary contains "; ", FirstCode 7001.
* {{ToCsv}} for the 7-step reference program yields exactly: {{"1,Drying,45,10,,,,,,"}}, {{"2,Cure,60,15,on-ramp,40,at-start,,,"}}, {{"3,Bleacher,off,20,on-target,25,at-target,,,on"}}, {{"4,Cooling,30,,,,,,fast,"}}, {{"5,Nitrogen,,,,,,,,"}}, {{"7,Cooling,35,,,,,,slow,"}}; round trip preserves every field and the result validates.
* Legacy {{"Step,Process,Temperature,Intensity,Time\n1,Heating,50,,10\n2,Cure,60,45,15\n3,Cooling,30,,\n"}} -> 3 steps, step 2 UvIntensity 45 Time 15, step 3 CoolingMode Medium.
* BOM + CRLF + blank line + {{"1,Cure,off,10,on-target,30,at-target,,,on"}} -> UV-only step with Ventilation true.
* Header {{"a,b,c,d"}} -> no steps, an error mentioning "header"; {{"Step,Process"}} alone -> error containing "header row".
* The 8 bad-row example (invalid process, temp 20, UV 5, time 0, bleacher 721, cooling 80, 2 columns) -> 1 step, 7 errors starting {{"Row 2:"}}..{{"Row 8:"}} mentioning "Invalid process", "30-80", "10-100", "1-120", "1-720", "30-75", "columns".
* {{"1,Heating,,10,..."}} -> temperature 40; {{"2,Cooling,,,..."}} -> 25.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Programs & recipes
*Blocked by:* DOM-03
*Blocks:* PLAT-10, UI-14, UI-16, UIDLG-12, UIDLG-13, UIDLG-14
*Relates to:* UI-14, UIDLG-13, UI-15, PLAT-02, UIDLG-12
*Implements:* OD-05, REQ-07, REQ-22

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Programs/ProgramEstimator.cs}}, {{ProgramEstimate.cs}}
*Goal:* Estimate what a program really takes (holds + heating ramps + cooling + nitrogen purges) from measured phase rates, per program and per step, and the minutes a print job shows. Rates are linear on purpose and come from phase timings collected on the test machine (reviewed 2026-09-07).
*Depends on:* DOM-03.
*Files to create:* {{Programs/ProgramEstimate.cs}} (record), {{Programs/ProgramEstimator.cs}} ({{public static class ProgramEstimator}}).
*Public contract:*
```csharp
public sealed record ProgramEstimate { double HoldSeconds ["holdSeconds"]; double RampSeconds ["rampSeconds"]; double CoolSeconds ["coolSeconds"];
                                       double NitrogenSeconds ["nitrogenSeconds"]; double TotalSeconds ["totalSeconds"]; }
public static class ProgramEstimator
{
    public const double AmbientC = 25;
    public const double DefaultNitrogenSeconds = 120;
    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<(double UpTo, double SecPerDeg)> HeatRateBands;   // (45,13), (75,50), (+inf,80)
    public static double CoolRateCPerMin(CoolingMode mode);                               // Fast 2.5, Medium 1.5, else 0.8
    public static double EstimateHeatSeconds(double fromC, double toC);
    public static double EstimateCoolSeconds(double fromC, double toC, CoolingMode mode = CoolingMode.Medium);
    public static double HeatSecPerDeg(double atC);
    public static ProgramEstimate EstimateProgram(IReadOnlyList<CureStep> steps, double startC = AmbientC, double nitrogenSeconds = DefaultNitrogenSeconds);
    public static IReadOnlyList<double> EstimateStepSeconds(IReadOnlyList<CureStep> steps, double startC = AmbientC, double nitrogenSeconds = DefaultNitrogenSeconds);
    public static int EstimateProgramMinutes(IReadOnlyList<CureStep> steps, double startC = AmbientC, double nitrogenSeconds = DefaultNitrogenSeconds);
    public static int PrintMinutes(PrintLog print, IEnumerable<Material> programs);
}
```
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Heating bands: 13 s/°C up to 45 °C, 50 s/°C from 45 to 75 °C, 80 s/°C above 75 °C. {{EstimateHeatSeconds(from, to)}}: 0 if {{to <= from}}; otherwise walk the bands accumulating {{(min(to, upTo) - t) * secPerDeg}} for each band segment above the current {{t}}; result {{Math.Round(x, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero)}}.
# {{HeatSecPerDeg(at)}}: secPerDeg of the first band with {{at < upTo}} (44.9 -> 13, 45 -> 50, 75 -> 80, 90 -> 80).
# {{EstimateCoolSeconds(from, to, mode)}}: 0 if {{to >= from}}; else {{Math.Round((from - to) / rate * 60, AwayFromZero)}} with rate fast 2.5, medium 1.5, slow 0.8 °C/min.
# {{EstimateProgram}}: {{temp = startC}}; per step {{holdSec = max(0, Time*60)}}:
** Heating/Drying/Cure/Bleacher: if Temperature {{target}} set: {{r = EstimateHeatSeconds(temp, target)}}; ramp += (TimerMode == OnRamp ? max(0, r - holdSec) : r); {{temp = max(temp, target)}}. hold += holdSec (also for UV-only, which keeps the temperature).
** Cooling: {{coolTarget = Temperature ?? 25}}; cool += EstimateCoolSeconds(temp, coolTarget, CoolingMode ?? Medium); {{temp = min(temp, coolTarget)}}.
** Nitrogen: n2 += nitrogenSeconds.
** Total = hold + ramp + cool + n2.
# {{EstimateStepSeconds}}: same walk, one value per step (heated = ramp contribution + hold; cooling = its cool seconds; nitrogen = nitrogenSeconds); values sum exactly to {{EstimateProgram(...).TotalSeconds}}.
# {{EstimateProgramMinutes}} = {{(int)Math.Ceiling(TotalSeconds / 60)}}.
# {{PrintMinutes(print, programs)}}: the first program with {{Name == print.MaterialName}} (ordinal) and at least one step -> {{EstimateProgramMinutes(program.Steps)}} (default start 25 °C, 120 s nitrogen); otherwise {{(int)Math.Ceiling(print.Duration / 60.0)}} (Duration is seconds). Rationale: a job and its program must never disagree.
*Configuration:* none here (callers may pass a nitrogen duration from system config).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Heat seconds: (25,60) = 1010, (25,45) = 260, (45,75) = 1500, (25,80) = 2160, (60,60) = 0, (60,40) = 0.
* Cool seconds: (60,25) medium 1400, fast 840, slow 2625; (25,60) fast 0.
* Steps [Drying 45/10, Cure 60/5, Nitrogen, Cooling 30 medium, Cooling 40 fast] from 25 with 120 s N2 -> per step {{[860, 1050, 120, 1200, 0]}}, sum equals program total.
* Program [Drying 45/10, Heating 60/5, Cure 60/15 uv30, Cooling 25 medium, Drying 40/5] with nitrogen 0: hold 2100, ramp 1205, cool 1400, n2 0, total 4705, minutes 79.
* Cure 60/10 on-target ramp 1010; on-ramp 410; on-ramp with 30 min hold -> ramp 0.
* [Heating 60/5, Cure UV-only 10, Cooling 40 fast, Nitrogen, Cure 60/10] -> n2 120, cool 480, ramp 1825.
* Every preset has a positive estimate.
* Job with existing program (Drying 50/8, Cure 60/12 uv100) and stored Duration 55 -> program minutes (> 1); job whose program is missing, Duration 5400 -> 90.
*Tests:* {{ProgramEstimatorTests}} (Heat_seconds_use_the_three_bands, Cool_seconds_per_mode, Heat_sec_per_deg_at_temperature, Step_estimates_add_up_to_the_program_and_cooling_starts_from_the_reached_temperature, Program_walk_carries_the_chamber_temperature, On_ramp_timer_mode_only_adds_the_ramp_beyond_the_hold, Uv_only_keeps_the_temperature_and_nitrogen_adds_the_purge, Preset_programs_have_a_positive_estimate); {{ProgramEstimatorPrintTests}} (A_job_shows_its_programs_time_whatever_was_stored_with_it, A_job_whose_program_is_gone_uses_its_stored_seconds).

column4: DOM-08 Heater PI + delta-sigma controller and HDT calibration maths
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Heating, HDT calibration
*Blocked by:* DOM-01
*Blocks:* DVT-07, PROC-03
*Relates to:* PROC-03, DVT-07, UI-22, API-11
*Implements:* OD-20, REQ-24

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Control/}} ({{PiDeltaSigmaController.cs}}, {{PiDeltaSigmaGains.cs}}, {{HdtModel.cs}})
*Goal:* The heater control law (PI(D) on a 0..1 power scale streamed as per-cycle ON/OFF by a first-order delta-sigma modulator, port of temperature_control._loop) and the pure maths used by HDT (heat-deflection) calibration: stability test, least-squares slope in °C/min, equilibrium temperature line vs power, first-order time constant and boost time.
*Depends on:* DOM-01.
*Files to create:* the three files above.
*Public contract:*
```csharp
namespace SCureBox.Domain.Control;
public sealed record PiDeltaSigmaGains(double Kp, double Ki, double Kd, double IntegMin, double IntegMax)
{ public static PiDeltaSigmaGains Default { get; } }      // new(0.22, 0.00015, 0.0, 0.0, 0.85)
public sealed class PiDeltaSigmaController
{ public PiDeltaSigmaController(PiDeltaSigmaGains gains); public double Integrator { get; } public double DacAccumulator { get; } public bool LastOutput { get; }
  public (double power, bool elementOn) Step(double err); public void Reset(); }
public static class HdtModel
{ public static double? SlopePerMinute(IReadOnlyList<(double t, double v)> window);
  public static bool IsStable(IReadOnlyList<(double t, double v)> window, double stabilityTimeSec, double bandC, double maxRateCPerMin);
  public static double EquilibriumAt(IReadOnlyList<(double power, double stableTemp)> levels, double power);
  public static double? TimeConstant(double startTemp, double stableTemp, IReadOnlyList<(double t, double avg)> trace);
  public static double? BoostTimeSec(double tau, double tEq, double t0, double limit); }
```
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Step(err)}} (err = target - measured, °C), once per sample (the heating loop samples every 50 ms): {{integ = clamp(integ + Ki*err, IntegMin, IntegMax)}}; {{deriv = prevErr is null ? 0 : Kd*(err - prevErr)}}; {{prevErr = err}}; {{control = Kp*err + integ + deriv}}; {{power = clamp(control, 0, 1)}}; {{delta = dacLast ? power - 1 : power}}; {{sig = dacAccum + delta}}; {{on = sig > 0.5}}; {{dacLast = on}}; {{dacAccum = sig}}; return {{(power, on)}}. The average ON-time equals the commanded power.
# {{Reset()}}: integ 0, prevErr null, dacAccum 0, dacLast false. Not thread-safe.
# {{HdtModel.SlopePerMinute}}: null if fewer than 2 samples; x = (t - t0)/60 centred on its mean; least squares; den <= 0 -> null.
# {{IsStable(window, stabilityTimeSec, bandC, maxRate)}}: false if empty or {{last.t - first.t < stabilityTimeSec}}; false if {{max - min > bandC}}; true if {{maxRate <= 0}} (rate rule disabled); else {{SlopePerMinute}} non-null and {{|slope| <= maxRate}}.
# {{EquilibriumAt(levels, p)}}: least-squares line through (power, stableTemp): {{slope = den > 0 ? num/den : 0}}; returns {{meanT + slope*(p - meanP)}}. (Empty input is not guarded — division by zero gives NaN.)
# {{TimeConstant(start, stable, trace)}}: null if {{stable - start < 1.0}} or trace empty; target = {{start + 0.632*(stable - start)}}; returns {{t - trace[0].t}} at the first sample with {{avg >= target}}, else null.
# {{BoostTimeSec(tau, tEq, t0, limit)}}: null if {{tEq <= limit}}; else {{tau * ln((tEq - t0)/(tEq - limit))}}.
*Configuration:* gains come from components.json {{heating}}: {{kp}} 0.22, {{ki}} 0.00015, {{kd}} 0.0, {{integ_min}} 0.0, {{integ_max}} 0.85 (also {{sample_sec}} 0.05, used by the heating loop in Application). The HDT parameters are passed by Application/Dvt-Hdt.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Default gains, constant err 2: (power, on, accum) sequence (0.4403,false,0.4403), (0.4406,true,0.8809), (0.4409,false,0.3218), (0.4412,true,0.7630), (0.4415,false,0.2045), (0.4418,true,0.6463) (9 decimals).
* err -3 for 20 steps -> power 0, off, integrator 0. err 100 for 10000 steps -> power 1, always on, integrator 0.85.
* Gains (0.1, 0, 0.5, 0, 1): step(1) = 0.1, step(2) = 0.7.
* Gains (0.1, 0, 0, 0, 1), err 3 for 1000 steps -> ON count 295..305.
* After Reset the first step(2) is 0.4403 again.
* HDT: 61 samples rising 0.01 °C/s -> 0.6 °C/min; single sample -> null. A 301 s window alternating 45/45.5 is stable (300 s, band 2, rate 0.5); first 200 samples -> not stable; alternating 45/47.5 -> not stable; drift 0.3 °C/min stable; 0.36 °C/min stable at 0.5, not at 0.3, stable with rate 0. Levels (10,29.5),(20,35),(30,40.5) -> 73.5 at 90; a first-order rise 24->34 with τ 40 s -> TimeConstant 40 (0 decimals); rise 0.5 -> null. Boost(40, 73.5, 35, 48) = 40*ln(38.5/25.5); Boost(40, 45, 35, 48) = null.
*Tests:* {{PiDeltaSigmaControllerTests}} (Reproduces_the_python_sequence_for_a_constant_error, Negative_error_gives_zero_power_and_element_off, Saturated_error_keeps_the_element_on_and_clamps_the_integrator, Derivative_term_uses_the_previous_error, Average_on_time_tracks_the_commanded_power, Reset_returns_to_the_initial_state); {{HdtModelTests}} (Slope_per_minute_of_a_linear_window, Stability_needs_the_window_the_band_and_the_rate, Equilibrium_line_and_time_constant, Boost_time_formula).
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Control/PiDeltaSigmaController.cs}}, {{PiDeltaSigmaGains.cs}}, {{HdtModel.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Domain.Tests/Control/PiDeltaSigmaControllerTests.cs}}, {{HdtModelTests.cs}}

h3. Links
*Features:* Status strip (RGB)
*Blocked by:* DOM-01

*Relates to:* HW-10, PROC-10

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Control/}} ({{StripModeLadder.cs}}, {{StripInputs.cs}})
*Goal:* Decide which status the RGB LED strip shows (fault, door, warning, manual heat, busy, no internet, normal) from machine flags, and provide the pure colour maths for blinking, brightness scaling and the "comet" busy animation (port of StatusLeds._mode / _paint_chase). The Application status-LED service drives the strip with these.
*Depends on:* DOM-01.
*Files to create:* {{Control/StripModeLadder.cs}}, {{Control/StripInputs.cs}}.
*Public contract:*
```csharp
namespace SCureBox.Domain.Control;
public sealed record StripInputs(bool DriverFault, bool UiCritical, bool DoorAbortLatched, bool DoorOpen, bool UiWarning,
    bool ManualHeat, bool AnyProcess);
public static class StripModeLadder
{ public const string Fault = "fault"; public const string Door = "door"; public const string Warn = "warn"; public const string ManualHeat = "manual_heat";
  public const string Busy = "busy"; public const string Normal = "normal";
  public static string Mode(StripInputs i); public static bool BlinkOn(double unixSeconds, double blinkSec);
  public static int Scale(int color, double level);
  public static int[] CometFrame(int count, int offset, int tail, int color, bool rtl, double level); }
```
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Mode}} priority (first match wins): DriverFault or UiCritical or DoorAbortLatched -> "fault"; DoorOpen -> "door"; UiWarning -> "warn"; ManualHeat -> "manual_heat"; AnyProcess -> "busy"; else "normal". OWNER DECISION 2026-11-05 (v1.0.153): the strip has NO internet marking - there is no no_net / busy_no_net mode and StripInputs has no internet field; an idle machine stays green with or without internet.
# {{BlinkOn(t, half)}} = {{(long)Math.Floor(t / half) % 2 == 0}} (ON half first).
# {{Scale(color, level)}}: clamp level to [0,1]; each 8-bit channel of 0xRRGGBB multiplied by level and truncated with {{(int)}} (like Python int()); recombine.
# {{CometFrame(count, offset, tail, color, rtl, level)}}: count <= 0 -> empty array; tail = max(1, tail); level clamped [0,1]; head = rtl ? mod(count-1-offset, count) : mod(offset, count); for each LED i: d = rtl ? mod(i - head, count) : mod(head - i, count); value = d < tail ? Scale(color, level * (1 - d/tail)) : 0. {{mod}} is the non-negative modulo.
*Configuration:* components.json {{rgb.status}} (used by Application, not the domain): {{blink_sec}} 0.5 (blink half period), {{chase_sec}} 0.12, {{chase_tail}} 5, {{busy_direction}} "rtl", {{busy_style}} "solid", {{brightness}} 100, {{count}} 21 LEDs; colours normal green, fault red, door_open ff7800, busy blue
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Idle (all false) -> "normal"; process -> "busy"; + ManualHeat -> "manual_heat"; + UiWarning -> "warn"; UiWarning + DoorOpen -> "door"; DoorOpen + DoorAbortLatched -> "fault"; DoorOpen + UiCritical -> "fault"; AnyProcess + DriverFault -> "fault".
* {{CometFrame(21, 0, 5, 0xAA00FF, rtl, 1.0)}}: length 21, frame[20] = 0xAA00FF, frame[0] = Scale(c, 0.8), frame[3] = Scale(c, 0.2), frame[4] = 0, frame[19] = 0; with offset 1 the head is frame[19].
* {{CometFrame(10, 3, 3, 0xFFFFFF, ltr, 0.5)}}: frame[3] = 0x7F7F7F, frame[2] = Scale(0xFFFFFF, 0.5*(1-1/3)), frame[0] = 0, frame[4] = 0; count 0 -> empty.
* {{Scale(0xFFB45A, 0.5) == 0x7F5A2D}}; level 0 -> 0; level 2 -> clamped (0xFFFFFF stays).
* {{BlinkOn(0.0,0.5)}} true, {{(0.49,0.5)}} true, {{(0.5,0.5)}} false, {{(1.0,0.5)}} true.
*Tests:* {{StripModeLadderTests}} (Priorities_top_to_bottom, Comet_frame_rtl_head_and_tail, Comet_frame_ltr_and_brightness, Scale_truncates_each_channel, Blink_phase_from_wall_time).

*Goal:* Implement {{IHardwareSystem}} for the real BRD-74205 board by wiring the PCA9685, TCA6424A, two ADS1115, GPIO pins, damper servo and RGB strip together with the fixed channel map. This ticket covers construction, I2C fault tracking, safe states, fans + RPM, heater element, temperature / UV / pressure reads with glitch hold, door, nitrogen, BOFA, door magnet, damper, light, NFC reset, RGB and disposal. The UV LED power path is HW-12 (same class).
*Depends on:* HW-01..HW-10, HW-12; Domain ({{NtcMath}}, {{ChamberTempCalibration}}, {{PressureConversion}}, {{PressureSensorParameters}}, {{SensorGlitchHold}}, {{GlitchVerdict}}, {{TachRateTracker}})

* {{src/SCureBox.Hardware/IoBoardMap.cs}} - {{internal static class IoBoardMap}}
* {{src/SCureBox.Hardware/IoBoardHardwareSystem.cs}} - {{internal sealed class IoBoardHardwareSystem : IHardwareSystem}}
*Public contract:*
```csharp
internal static class IoBoardMap {
    public const int I2cBusPca = 0, I2cBusU6 = 0, I2cBusU7 = 1, AdsTempAddress = 0x49;
    public const int ChHeater = 6, ChLight1 = 7, ChBofa = 10;
    public const int GpioNitrogenValve = 13, PressureAdcChannel = 3, PulsesPerRev = 2;

    public static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<Fan, int> FanTachGpio;     // HEATER 22, DOOR 23, RIGHT 24, LEFT 19, BACK 25, COOLING 26
    public static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<LedPanel, int> LedChannel; // BACK 11, DOOR 12, RIGHT 13, LEFT 14
    public static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<TempSensor, (bool U7, int Channel)> TempChannel;
        // RIGHT (false,1), LEFT (false,3), BACK (true,0), DOOR (true,1), CHAMBER (true,2)
    public static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<UvSensor, (bool U7, int Channel)> UvChannel;   // UV_RIGHT (false,0), UV_LEFT (false,2)
```

*Behaviour & rules:*
# Constructor: time = provider ?? System; sleep = given ?? {{Thread.Sleep}}; create {{ChamberTempCalibration(time)}}; tach epoch = {{time.GetTimestamp()}}; {{new Pca9685(bus0, 0x55, sleep)}} (MODE1/MODE2 writes), {{new Tca6424a(bus0, 0x23, sleep)}} (safe init), {{new Ads1115(bus0, 0x49, TempPga)}} = U6, {{new Ads1115(bus1, 0x49, TempPga)}} = U7. Open outputs LOW: GPIO13, {{led_power.ssr_450nm}}, {{ssr_405nm}}, {{routing}}, {{bofa.enable_gpio}}. Open the door pin as input without pull (failure logged as warning, not thrown). {{OpenCounter}} each tach pin (failure per pin logged "tach {Fan} on GPIO{Pin} unavailable"). Servo and RGB driver are NOT created here (lazy).
# I2C fault tracking: every chip operation runs inside {{Bus(op)}}: success clears {{_i2cFault}}; {{HardwareVerifyException}} passes through unchanged; any other exception sets {{_i2cFault = "I2C: {message}"}}, logs, throws {{HardwareVerifyException("I2C failure: {message}", e)}}. {{DriverFault}} = {{_i2cFault ?? _rgbFault}}. One instance lock {{_lock}} serialises compound sequences.
# {{StartupSafe()}} (under lock): Bus{ all 16 PCA channels {{SetDuty(ch, 0)}} (unverified); {{tca.AllSafe()}} }; GPIO13 low (failure logged); nitrogen = false; LED power off (HW-12 rule 6); clear LED state; route to {{led_power.default_mode}} (HW-12 rule 7): {{ActiveMode}} = default on success, null on failure; then LED_SWITCH -> 0 verified ({{HardwareRefusedException}} logged, not thrown). Log "startup: all components OFF (safe state)". Bus exceptions from the first block propagate.
# {{AllSafe()}} (under lock): builds an action list and runs {{Verify.Each}}: "PCA ch0".."PCA ch15" ({{SetDutyVerified(ch, 0)}} inside Bus), each of {{tca.AllSafeActions()}} (inside Bus), "NITROGEN_VALVE" GPIO13 -> false, "ssr_450nm" -> false, "ssr_405nm" -> false, "routing" -> the default mode's {{Routing}} level; GPIO steps use {{Verify.SetAndVerify("GPIO <name>", write, read == level)}}. Before running: nitrogen = false, LED state cleared, {{_ledSwitchMovedAt}} = now. {{ActiveMode}} unchanged. Failures aggregate into one {{HardwareVerifyException}} ("N component(s) not confirmed: ...").
# Fans: {{SetFanDuty(fan, pct, verify=true)}} -> under lock Bus{ verify ? {{SetDutyVerified(FanChannel[fan], pct)}} : {{SetDuty}} }. {{GetFanDuty}} = round({{pca.LastDuty[ch]}}) (no bus read).
# {{ReadRpm(fan)}}: {{gpio.ReadCounter(FanTachGpio[fan])}}; any exception -> null; nowSec = elapsed since tach epoch; under a tracker lock return {{TachRateTracker<Fan>(2).Rpm(fan, count, nowSec)}} (null until a first >=1 s window; same value for interleaved readers).
# {{MeasureRpm(fan, window)}}: c0 = counter; {{sleep(window)}}; c1; return round((c1-c0)/2 * (60/window.TotalSeconds)). {{InvalidOperationException}} -> {{HardwareVerifyException("tachometer {fan} unavailable: ...")}}.
# Heater element: {{SetHeaterElement(on)}} -> under lock Bus{ {{SetDuty(6, on ? 100 : 0)}} } (unverified). {{GetHeaterElement()}} = {{LastDuty[6] > 0}}.
# {{ReadTemperatureVolts(s)}} / {{ReadUvSensorVolts(s)}}: under lock Bus{ (U7 ? u7 : u6).ReadVolts(channel) } from {{TempChannel}} / {{UvChannel}}. UV sensors are never converted to temperature and never gated.
# {{ReadTemperature(s)}}: raw = {{NtcMath.VoltageToTemperature(volts)}}; for TEMP_CHAMBER a non-null raw goes through {{ChamberTempCalibration.Correct(raw)}} (under its own lock). Glitch hold ({{SensorGlitchHold<TempSensor,double>}}, own lock): a value within [{{heater.temp_valid_min}}, {{heater.temp_valid_max}}] (-20..120) is good -> {{Good()}} (log "reads again after X s" if a glitch ended) and returned. Otherwise (null, out of range, or exception) {{Bad(sensor, now, sensor_filter.glitch_hold_sec)}}: HoldStarted -> log warning, return held; Holding -> return held; HoldExpired -> log warning, then fall through; Report/HoldExpired: rethrow the captured exception if there was one, else return the raw value (null or the out-of-range value).
# {{ReadPressure()}}: under lock Bus{ u7.ReadVolts(3) }. On exception: {{SensorGlitchHold<int,PressureReading>.Bad(0, now, glitch_hold_sec)}}; HoldStarted logs; HoldStarted/Holding with a held value -> return it; else rethrow. On success: {{PressureConversion.Convert(v, new PressureSensorParameters(cfg.Mode, VMin, VMax, IMinMa, IMaxMa, ShuntOhms, PAtLowMpa, PAtHighMpa, Divider, AdcSaturationVolts, OnAboveVolts, SetPointMpa))}} -> {{PressureReading(p.Volts, p.Mpa, p.Bar, p.On, p.Saturated, p.Mode, p.SetPointMpa)}}, recorded as good. (Volts reported = the ADC volts.)
# {{DoorOpen()}}: {{gpio.OpenInput(door_sensor.gpio, pullUp: false)}} (idempotent) then {{level == door_sensor.open_level}} (level 1 = high); any exception -> null.
# Nitrogen: {{SetNitrogenValve(on)}} -> under lock {{gpio.Write(13, on)}} (no verify, exceptions propagate), remember; {{GetNitrogenValve}} returns the remembered value.
# BOFA: {{SetBofa(on)}} = {{SetBofaDuty(on ? 100 : 0)}}. {{SetBofaDuty(pct)}} -> channel duty = clamp(pct,0,100) * {{bofa.max_duty}} / 100 -> under lock Bus{ {{SetDuty(10, duty)}} }. {{GetBofa}} = {{LastDuty[10] > 0}}. {{GetBofaDuty}} = round(LastDuty[10]*100 / max(1, max_duty)). {{SetBofaPower(on)}} -> under lock {{gpio.Write(bofa.enable_gpio, on)}}, remember; {{GetBofaPower}} remembered. {{BofaPresent()}}: {{OpenInput(present_gpio, pullUp false)}}; return {{Read(pin) != present_active_low}}; exception -> null.
# {{SetDoorMagnet(on)}}: under lock Bus{ {{tca.SetPin(DOOR_MAGNET, on)}} } (unverified); log "door magnet -> OPEN/CLOSE". No auto release here.
# {{SetDamper(open)}}: angle = open ? {{cooling.damper_open_angle}} (0) : {{damper_closed_angle}} (90); under lock: create the servo on first use via {{servoFactory()}}, {{Goto(angle)}}; any non-{{HardwareVerifyException}} -> {{HardwareVerifyException("damper failed: {msg}")}}; then {{DamperOpen = open}}. {{DamperDriver}} = servo's driver name (null before first use).
# {{SetLight(on)}}: Bus{ {{SetDuty(7, on ? 100 : 0)}} }. {{NfcReset()}}: Bus{ {{tca.NfcReset()}} }.
# RGB (non-safety; never throws): {{RgbFill(colors)}} copies the span and {{RgbOff()}} under lock call {{RgbTry}}: if no driver and the last creation attempt was < 30 s ago -> return silently; else record attempt time and create via {{rgbFactory()}}; run the op; success clears {{_rgbFault}}; any exception sets {{_rgbFault = "rgb: {message}"}}, logs warning, disposes and drops the driver (retry after 30 s).
# {{Dispose()}} (once, under lock): servo, RGB driver, gpio, bus0, and bus1 if a different instance.
*Configuration:* {{led_power.*}}, {{door_sensor.gpio/open_level}}, {{bofa.*}}, {{cooling.damper_open_angle/damper_closed_angle}}, {{heater.temp_valid_min/max}}, {{sensor_filter.glitch_hold_sec}}, {{pressure_sensor.*}} - all read live on each call.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* After construction + {{StartupSafe}}: every PCA channel at logical 0 (inverted channels read full-on registers {{00 10 00 00}}, others {{00 00 00 10}}); TCA reg 0x84 == 0x02, reg 0x86 == 0x00; GPIO 13/16/17/20 low; ActiveMode Nm405; Source "io_controller"; DriverFault null; GPIO27 is an input without pull-up; GPIO 19,22,23,24,25,26 are pull-up counters.
* {{SetFanDuty(FAN_COOLING, 60)}} -> GetFanDuty 60, ch5 regs {{00 00 66 06}} (eff 40 % -> 1638). Heater on -> ch6 full on. {{SetBofa(true)}} -> ch10 {{00 00 99 09}} (60 % -> 2457). {{SetLight(true)}} -> ch7 full-off register (inverted).
* {{SetBofaDuty(10)}} -> GetBofaDuty 10, ch10 {{00 00 F5 00}} (6 % -> 245); 100 -> {{00 00 99 09}}; 0 -> GetBofa false, GetBofaDuty 0.
* RPM: first ReadRpm null; +100 pulses on GPIO26 and +1 s -> 3000; +50 pulses and +2 s -> 750; {{MeasureRpm(FAN_HEATER, 1 s)}} with no pulses -> 0 and sleeps 1 s. Readers 4 ms apart at 150 pulses/s both read 4400..4600 after the first window.
* 1.65 V (raw 0x3390) on U6 -> TEMP_LEFT 25.0; same on U7 -> TEMP_CHAMBER = 1.0979*25 - 3.9813 (static calibration, few samples), TEMP_BACK 25.0; 0 V on U7 for a never-read sensor -> null.
* Glitch: good 25.0, then open NTC: still 25.0 at +5 s and +14 s, null at +16 s; recovery returns live value and a new glitch is held again.
* UV_RIGHT reads U6 AIN0, UV_LEFT reads U6 AIN2 (one config write on bus0 at 0x49, MUX bits = 0b100 + ain, no bus1 write).
* Pressure (shipped config): raw 14000 (1.75 V) -> Mpa 0.1875, not saturated, On true, SetPointMpa 0.1, Mode "analog_voltage"; raw 10400 (1.30 V) -> On false.
* PCA NAK -> {{SetFanDuty}} throws {{HardwareVerifyException}}, DriverFault starts "I2C:"; next success clears it.
* Damper: SetDamper(false) -> servo pulse 1450, DamperDriver "pio", DamperOpen false; SetDamper(true) -> 2400, true. Door magnet on -> TCA reg 0x86 == 0x40, off -> 0x00. Nitrogen on -> GPIO13 high. NfcReset journal: {{i2c0 0x23 reg 0x84 <- 007E00}} then {{... <- 027E00}}. RgbFill 21 x 0x00FF00 reaches the driver; failing driver on RgbOff -> no throw, DriverFault starts "rgb:".
* AllSafe after heater fan 100 + nitrogen on -> ch0 full-on register, GPIO13 low, reg 0x84 0x02; with TCA NAK -> throws listing "motor 1" and "LED_SWITCH" but not "PCA ch0".
*Tests:* {{IoBoardHardwareSystemTests}} with a {{Rig}} (FakeI2cBus bus0 with TCA mirror 0x84->0x80, bus1, FakeGpioPins with GPIO27 high = closed, FakeTimeProvider, sleep that records and advances time, {{DamperServo(FakeServoDriver, settle, time)}}, FakeRgbDriver(21), config from shipped components.json; {{StartupSafe()}} then journal cleared): Startup_safe_parks_everything, Fans_heater_bofa_light_and_rpm, Fan_rpm_is_the_same_for_readers_that_call_a_few_ms_after_each_other, Bofa_duty_is_a_speed_on_the_0_to_10_volt_scale, Temperature_glitch_holds_the_last_good_value_for_the_configured_window, Uv_photoresistors_read_their_own_U6_channel, Temperatures_pressure_and_chamber_calibration, I2c_failure_sets_driver_fault_and_the_next_success_clears_it, Actuators_damper_magnet_nitrogen_nfc_and_rgb, All_safe_verifies_and_aggregates_failures.

*Public contract:* {{SetLed(LedPanel, double)}}, {{AllLedsOff()}}, {{SelectMode(Wavelength)}}, {{LedPowerOff()}}, {{AllowedLeds(Wavelength)}}, {{LedLevels}}, {{ActiveMode}} (see HW-01).
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Mode table ({{led_power.modes}}): 450nm = SSR450 1, SSR405 0, routing 0, LED_SWITCH 0, LED fan 30 %; 405nm = SSR450 1, SSR405 1, routing 0, LED_SWITCH 1, LED fan = LED's {{fan_speed}} (100). GPIO16 = SSR 450 nm, GPIO20 = SSR 405 nm, GPIO17 = routing (kept LOW in both modes: HIGH cuts the door DIM 12 V rail).
# {{AllowedLeds(w)}} = LEDs from {{config.Leds}} whose {{Modes}} contain w (shipped: 450 nm -> [LED_DOOR]; 405 nm -> all four).
# {{SetLed(led, pct)}}: unknown LED -> {{HardwareRefusedException("unknown LED: {led}")}}. on = pct > 0 && pct >= {{min_intensity}} (10); duty = on ? pct * {{led_max_duty}}(60) / 100 : 0. Under lock:
   a. If {{ActiveMode}} is null: compute the set of LEDs that will be on; if non-empty set ActiveMode = Nm405 if any of them lacks Nm450 in its modes, else Nm450.
   b. If on: {{DoorOpen() != false}} -> {{HardwareRefusedException("Door is Open - Operation Disabled")}}; mode = ActiveMode ?? default; LED not allowed in mode -> {{HardwareRefusedException("{led} not allowed in {mode.ModeName()} mode")}} (e.g. "450nm"); then ApplyLedPower(mode) (rule 4).
   c. Bus{ {{pca.SetDuty(LedChannel[led], duty)}}; LED fan {{pca.SetDuty(FanChannel[cfg.Fan], on ? LedPower.LedFanSpeed(cfg, ActiveMode ?? default) : 0)}} } (unverified writes).
   d. On: add to lit set (log "LED {led} ON ({mode})"), {{LedLevels[led] = pct}}. Off: remove (log), level 0; if no LED remains lit -> LED power off (rule 6).
   e. A refusal leaves the PWM untouched and the SSRs as they were.
# ApplyLedPower(mode): mode missing in config -> refused "no led_power config for {mode}". SetLedSwitch(st.LedSwitch) (rule 5); wait for settle (rule 8); {{gpio.Write(ssr450, st.Ssr450)}}, {{Write(ssr405, st.Ssr405)}}, {{Write(routing, st.Routing)}}; read routing back; mismatch -> {{HardwareRefusedException("GPIO{pin} routing not {0|1} (read {0|1})")}}. (Raw GPIO exceptions here propagate unwrapped.)
# SetLedSwitch(want, label): Bus{ changed = {{tca.GetPin(LED_SWITCH) != want}}; {{tca.SetPinVerified(LED_SWITCH, want)}}; if changed record {{_ledSwitchMovedAt = now}} and log }. {{HardwareVerifyException}} -> {{HardwareRefusedException("LED_SWITCH relay not {0|1} ({msg})")}}.
# LED power off ({{LedPowerOff()}} and internal, best effort, never throws): {{gpio.Write(false)}} on ssr450, ssr405, routing (each failure logged); Bus{ if {{tca.GetPin(LED_SWITCH)}} then SetPin false, record moved-at, log "LED_SWITCH relay -> 0 (rest)" } (verify failure logged).
# SetRouting(mode): want = mode's Routing; {{Write(routing, want)}}; read back; mismatch -> (false, "GPIO{pin} wavelength-select not {w} (read {r})"); exception -> (false, "GPIO{pin} wavelength-select failed ({msg})").
# Settle wait: if {{_ledSwitchMovedAt}} set: remaining = max(0, {{switch_settle_sec}})(0.1 s) - elapsed; if > 0 {{sleep(remaining)}}; then clear moved-at. So the relay settle happens once, only after the relay actually moved.
# {{AllLedsOff()}}: under lock Bus{ every configured LED's DIM channel 0 and its fan 0 }; clear LED state; LED power off.
# {{SelectMode(w)}}: under lock: {{AllLedsOff()}}; ActiveMode = w; SetRouting(w) - failure logs and throws {{HardwareRefusedException(why)}} (ActiveMode stays w); then SetLedSwitch(mode.LedSwitch) if the mode exists in config (405 nm moves the relay to 1 here, the settle is waited at the next LED on); log "wavelength mode -> {mode} (ok)".
*Configuration:* {{led_power.ssr_450nm}} 16, {{ssr_405nm}} 20, {{routing}} 17, {{default_mode}} "405nm", {{switch_settle_sec}} 0.1, {{min_intensity}} 10, {{led_max_duty}} 60, {{modes}}; {{leds.<LED>.fan/fan_speed/modes}}.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* After {{SelectMode(Nm405)}}, {{SetLed(LED_LEFT, 50)}} writes in this journal order: TCA {{0x23 reg 0x84 <- 227E00}} (LED_SWITCH 1), {{gpio16 <- 1}}, {{gpio20 <- 1}}, {{gpio17 <- 0}}, PCA {{0x55 reg 0x3E <- 0000CC04}} (ch14, 30 % -> 1228), PCA {{0x55 reg 0x12 <- 00000010}} (ch3 FAN_LEFT 100 %, inverted); exactly one 0.1 s sleep; LedLevels[LED_LEFT] 50; FAN_LEFT duty 100; GPIO17 low.
* A second LED (RIGHT 80) -> no sleep. LEFT 0 -> ch14 full-off, FAN_LEFT 0, GPIO16 still high; RIGHT 0 -> GPIO16 and GPIO20 low, TCA reg 0x84 == 0x02.
* 405 nm with LED_DOOR 50: GPIO17 low, 16 high, 20 high, reg 0x84 bit 0x20 set. {{SelectMode(Nm450)}} turns LED_DOOR off (ch12 full-off, level 0); LED_DOOR 50 in 450 nm -> 17 low, 16 high, 20 low, reg 0x84 == 0x02, ActiveMode Nm450.
* Door open (GPIO27 low) -> {{DoorOpen()}} true, SetLed throws "Door is Open - Operation Disabled", ch14 off, GPIO16 low. Door unreadable -> {{DoorOpen()}} null and SetLed still refused.
* SetLed 9.9 -> off (ch14 full-off, level 0, GPIO16 low); SetLed 10 -> ch14 {{00 00 F5 00}} (6 % -> 245), level 10.
* 450 nm: SetLed(LED_LEFT, 50) throws containing "450nm", nothing switched; LED_DOOR allowed.
* GPIO17 unreadable -> {{SelectMode(Nm405)}} throws {{HardwareRefusedException}}.
*Tests:* {{IoBoardHardwareSystemTests}}: Led_turn_on_order_led_switch_then_settle_then_ssrs_then_routing_readback_then_pwm_and_fan, Routing_gpio17_stays_low_in_both_modes, Led_refused_when_door_open_or_unreadable, Led_below_min_intensity_counts_as_off, Only_the_door_led_is_allowed_at_450nm, Led_refused_when_routing_readback_mismatches.

column4: PROC-02 Timing primitives (PeriodicWorker, TimeProvider waits)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cure run, Safety & watchdog, QA & tests
*Blocks:* DVT-01, PROC-03, PROC-04, PROC-05, PROC-08, PROC-09, PROC-10
*Implements:* REQ-17


*Project / folder:* {{SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Devices/}}

*Goal:* Provide testable blocking waits and a dedicated periodic thread, both driven by an injected {{TimeProvider}}, so
every loop (heating, cooling, supervision, runner, damper watch) can be advanced with {{FakeTimeProvider}} in tests.

*Depends on:* none (BCL {{TimeProvider}}, {{Microsoft.Extensions.Logging}}).

*Files to create:*
* {{Devices/TimeProviderWaits.cs}} — {{internal static class TimeProviderWaits}}
* {{Devices/PeriodicWorker.cs}} — {{internal sealed class PeriodicWorker : IDisposable}}

*Public contract:*
```csharp
internal static class TimeProviderWaits {
  public static bool Wait(this TimeProvider tp, TimeSpan delay, CancellationToken ct); // true = cancelled first
  public static void Sleep(this TimeProvider tp, TimeSpan delay);                     // not cancellable
}
internal sealed class PeriodicWorker : IDisposable {
  public PeriodicWorker(string name, TimeProvider tp, TimeSpan period, Action tick, ILogger log);
  public void Start(); public void Dispose();
}
```
The csproj declares {{<InternalsVisibleTo Include="SCureBox.Application.Tests" />}} (needed for {{RecipeRunner.FaultCode}} /
{{TelemetryTemps}} tests); existing tests use these two types only indirectly.

*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Wait}}: if {{ct}} already cancelled → return true immediately; else {{Task.Delay(delay, tp, ct).GetAwaiter().GetResult()}},
   return false; {{OperationCanceledException}} → true.
# {{Sleep}}: {{Task.Delay(delay, tp).GetAwaiter().GetResult()}}.
# {{PeriodicWorker.Start}}: idempotent; creates a background thread named {{name}}. Loop: {{while (!tp.Wait(period, ct)) tick();}}
   (first tick after one period). Exceptions from {{tick}} are caught; only the first one is logged (warning
   {{"{Worker}: tick failed"}}); the thread never ends on an exception.
# {{Dispose}}: idempotent; cancels, joins the thread up to 10 s (unless called from the worker thread itself), disposes the CTS.

*Configuration:* none.

*Acceptance criteria:*
* With {{FakeTimeProvider}}, advancing time by one period runs the tick once; a throwing tick keeps the thread alive.
* Dispose from inside the tick does not deadlock.

*Tests:* none dedicated; exercised by every loop test ({{TimePump}} in tests/Fakes advances fake time in small steps and
spins until {{FakeHardwareSystem.Activity}} changes).

*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Devices/TimeProviderWaits.cs}}, {{Devices/PeriodicWorker.cs}},
{{tests/SCureBox.Application.Tests/Fakes/TimePump.cs}}
