column4: PROC-04 Cooling loop (fixed-fan chamber cooling)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cooling & damper, Fans & tach, Temperature sensors
*Blocked by:* PROC-02, DOM-02, DOM-07, HW-01, HW-02
*Blocks:* PROC-03, PROC-05, PROC-11
*Relates to:* HW-09, DOM-06, API-06, HW-11
*Implements:* OD-26, OD-11, OD-18, REQ-22


*Project / folder:* {{SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Devices/}}

*Goal:* Fixed-duty chamber cooling: damper open, heater fan at a fixed duty, chamber cooling fan (FAN_COOLING) at a
constant duty until the chamber reaches the target, then auto-terminate (fans off, damper closed via {{EndOfProcess}}).
Reports the measured cooling rate for telemetry. Port of Python {{cooling_mode.CoolingController}}.

*Depends on:* PROC-02, Domain ({{SlopeEstimator}}, {{OpResult}}), Hardware ({{SetDamper(bool)}}, {{SetFanDuty}},
{{ReadTemperature}}, {{Config.Cooling}}, {{Config.Heater}}).

*Files to create:*
* {{Devices/ICoolingLoop.cs}} — {{ICoolingLoop}}
* {{Devices/CoolingStatus.cs}} — {{CoolingStatus}}
* {{Devices/CoolingLoop.cs}} — {{CoolingLoop}}

*Public contract:*
```csharp
public interface ICoolingLoop : IDisposable {
  bool Active { get; } string? Fault { get; }
  Action? EndOfProcess { get; set; }
  OpResult Start(double pwm, double targetC);
  void Stop(string reason = "user");
  CoolingStatus Status();
}
public sealed record CoolingStatus(bool Active, double Pwm, double? Rate, double? Temp, double? Target, string? Fault);
public sealed class CoolingLoop : ICoolingLoop { public CoolingLoop(IHardwareSystem hw, TimeProvider tp, ILogger<CoolingLoop> log); }
```

*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Start(pwm, targetC)}}: pwm clamped to 0..100. If the thread is alive and Active → {{SetPwm(pwm)}} (FAN_COOLING duty =
   round(pwm); exception → {{Fail("chamber fan not confirmed: {msg}", 6015)}}) and on success update the target; return.
# Fresh start: clear Fault; thermistor check on TEMP_CHAMBER (same three texts as heating with sensor name TEMP_CHAMBER,
   range {{heater.temp_valid_min..max}}) → on failure Fault = why, return {{FromRefusal(why)}}.
# Entry sequence (exact order): (1) {{SetDamper(true)}} — exception → Fault {{"damper open failed: {msg}"}}, FromRefusal;
   (2) {{SetFanDuty(FAN_HEATER, cooling.heater_fan_pwm)}} (default 100); (3) {{SetFanDuty(FAN_COOLING, round(pwm))}} —
   exception in 2/3 → Fault = msg, invoke EndOfProcess, FromRefusal(msg).
# Then pwm/target/temp stored, rate null, Active = true; thread "cooling-loop" started; return {{Success("cooling started")}}.
# Loop every {{max(0.1, cooling.sample_sec)}} (default 1.0 s): thermistor bad → Finish(why); {{t <= target}} → Finish(null)
   (auto-terminate); else add (seconds since start, t) to {{new SlopeEstimator(cooling.window_sec)}} (default 30 s);
   Rate = {{-(slope.RatePerMinute())}} (positive while cooling) or null.
# {{Finish(fault)}}: cancel; invoke {{EndOfProcess}}; Active = false; Fault = fault if non-null; log.
# {{Stop(reason)}}: cancel; join loop (10 s, not from own thread); if still Active → Finish(reason == "user" ? null : reason).
# {{Status()}} → {{CoolingStatus(Active, Pwm, Rate, Temp, Active ? Target : null, Fault)}}.

*Configuration:* {{cooling}} {damper_open_angle 0, damper_closed_angle 90, heater_fan_pwm 100, mode_pwms {fast 100,
medium 60, slow 30}, fast_led_fan_pwm 100, target_temp 25, sample_sec 1.0, window_sec 30}; {{heater.temp_valid_min/max}}.

*Acceptance criteria:*
* Entry order is damper open → heater fan → chamber fan.
* At chamber <= target the loop ends: fans off, damper closed, Active false.
* Rate is positive while the chamber cools.
* No valid thermistor → refused, nothing driven.
* Start while running updates FAN_COOLING duty and the target.

*Tests:* {{Process/CoolingLoopTests}} — Entry_sequence_opens_the_damper_then_fixes_both_fans,
Auto_terminates_at_the_target_with_fans_off_and_damper_closed, Reports_the_measured_cooling_rate,
Refuses_without_a_valid_thermistor, Retarget_while_running_updates_duty_and_target.

*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Devices/ICoolingLoop.cs}}, {{Devices/CoolingLoop.cs}},
{{Devices/CoolingStatus.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Application.Tests/Process/CoolingLoopTests.cs}}

*Behaviour & rules:*
# *Construction*: sets {{heating.EndOfProcess = cooling.EndOfProcess = CloseFansAndDamper}}; calls {{SetDamper(false)}}
   (start from a known-closed damper; logs "damper servo ready (closed)" or "unavailable"); starts a 1 s {{PeriodicWorker}}
   "damper-watch" running {{DamperWatchTick}}. LED factors default 1.0 for zones back/door/left/right.
   {{_fanDuty}} = {led_cooling 0, chamber_intake 0, chamber_heating 0}.
# *SensorPreflight* (run by Heat/Dry/CureUv/UvOnly/CoolToTarget BEFORE taking {{_op}}): (a) {{sup.BlockingCriticalFans}}
   non-empty → {{FromRefusal("[{FanFailureOf(first)}] Fan below minimum speed: {fans joined ', '} - the system cannot run until the fan is replaced")}}
   (9020-9025); (b) {{sup.HeaterReadingFrozen}} set → {{FromRefusal("[9006] {detail}")}}; (c) up to 3 attempts 0.5 s apart
   reading all supervised sensors; {{SensorSupervisionEvaluator.OpenRequired(readings)}} (chamber/left/right open or out of
   -20..120) empty → pass; after 3rd failure: {{sup.NoteSensorPreflightRefusal(bad, now)}} (raises 9010-9012 now) and
   refuse with {{SensorSupervisionEvaluator.PreflightRefusal(bad)}} = {{"[{code of first bad}] Temperature sensor disconnected: {Location (SENSOR), ...} - reconnect the sensor before starting a process"}}.
# *CoolingFanPreflight* (Dry and Cool only, after SensorPreflight): skipped if cooling Active, FAN_COOLING overridden,
   or a pass < 30 s ago ({{LedFanPreflightGraceSec}}). Drive FAN_COOLING 100 % (verify:false), sleep 1.5 s, {{MeasureRpm(0.5 s)}},
   set 0. rpm null or < {{fan_health.led_fan_min_rpm}} (default 100) → {{sup.SetFanStopped([FAN_COOLING], {fan: detail})}} and
   refuse {{"[9034] Chamber cooling fan not spinning: {Label(fan)}: {rpm|?} RPM - job start refused"}} (label e.g.
   "Chamber cooling fan (FAN_COOLING)"). Pass → {{SetFanStopped([FAN_COOLING], {})}} (clears 9034), remember pass time.
# *LedFanPreflight(wavelength)* (inside SetUv on): skipped if UV already on or a pass < 30 s ago. Fans = distinct
   {{LedFan[l]}} for {{hw.AllowedLeds(wavelength)}}; none → pass. All to 100 %, sleep 1.5 s, measure each 0.5 s; overridden
   fans are ignored; failures → all those fans set 0, {{SetFanStopped(fans, {fan: "LED cooling fan not spinning: {Label}: {rpm} RPM - job start refused"})}},
   refuse {{"[{FanStoppedOf(first)}] LED cooling fan not spinning: {list} - job start refused"}} (9030-9033). Pass → clear,
   record pass time (fans stay at 100 %).
# *SetUv(on, intensityPct, wavelength)* under {{_op}}: off → {{AllLedsOff()}} (exception → {{Fail("LED off failed: …", 6015)}}),
   {{_uv = Off}}, {{Success("UV off")}}. On → {{hw.SelectMode(wavelength)}} (all LEDs off, relay, SSRs + GPIO17 verified in
   Hardware; exception → {{_ledFault = msg}}, FromRefusal(msg)); LedFanPreflight; then for each allowed LED: physical =
   clamp(intensity × factor[zone], 0, 100), {{SetLed(led, physical)}}, outputs[zone] = round(physical, 2); per-LED exception
   recorded as fault. No LED lit → {{_ledFault = fault ?? "no LED could be enabled"}}, FromRefusal. Success: {{_ledFault = null}},
   {{_uv = new UvState(true, (int)intensity, wavelength, outputs)}}, message {{"UV {nm}nm @ {int}%"}}. 405 nm lights all four
   panels; 450 nm only LED_DOOR (decided by {{hw.AllowedLeds}}).
# *SetLedFactors*: for each zone, value clamped 0..1.5, missing → 1.0.
# *ReportUiAlerts(c, w)*: stores (max(0,c), max(0,w), now). Fresh for 90 s in {{StripInputs}}.
# *StripInputs(internetOk)* → `new StripInputs(DriverFault: hw.DriverFault!=null || heating.Fault!=null || _ledFault!=null || cooling.Fault!=null,
   UiCritical: fresh && critical>0, DoorAbortLatched, DoorOpen: hw.DoorOpen()==true, UiWarning: fresh && warning>0,
   ManualHeat: heating.Active && _manualHeat && !cooling.Active && !uv.On, AnyProcess: heating.Active||cooling.Active||uv.On, InternetOk)`.
# *Ventilation* (private {{SetVentilation(want)}}): unchanged → Success; want && cooling.Active → Fail("cooling owns the airflow while it is active", 6015);
   pwm = clamp(ventilation.fan_pwm, 0..100) (default 60); want: pwm<=0 → Fail("ventilation disabled (ventilation.fan_pwm = 0)", 6015);
   SetDamper(true) then SetFanSpeed(chamber_intake, pwm) (failure → close damper, return); off: intake 0, damper closed.
# *Drying*: {{DryToTarget}} arms {{_drying}}; {{DamperWatchTick}} (1 s) fires once when drying && heating.Active &&
    heating AtTemp: {{_drying=false}}, SetDamper(true), on success {{StartDryFan()}} = SetFanSpeed(chamber_intake, 30).
    {{StopDryFan()}} sets intake 0 if the dry fan was on.
# *SetDamper(open)*: no-op Success if already in that state; {{hw.SetDamper(open)}} exception → {{Fail("damper failed: …", 6015)}};
    messages "Damper opened"/"Damper closed".
# *SetFanSpeed(group, percent)*: refusals (6015): chamber_heating while heating Active ("heater fan is controlled by the
    heating loop while it is active"); chamber_intake while cooling Active ("intake fan is controlled by the cooling loop while it is active");
    led_cooling while the FAST-cool LED boost is on ("LED fans are boosting the fast cooling while it is active"). Writes every
    member fan (verify:false; exception → Fail("fan write failed: …", 6015)), stores {{_fanDuty[group]}}; chamber_intake →
    {{IntakeAir(percent > 0)}}. Message {{"{group} set to {percent}%"}}. {{SetHeaterFan(p)}} = SetFanSpeed(chamber_heating, p).
# *SetFanOverride(name, on)*: "all" → every fan; a group name; a fan name; else {{Fail("unknown fan: {name}")}} (no code).
    Calls {{sup.SetFanOverride(fans, on)}}.
# *SetCoolLedFans(on)* (FAST-cool boost): no-op if unchanged or any LED level > 0; pwm = clamp(cooling.fast_led_fan_pwm);
    on && pwm<=0 → no-op; writes the 4 LED fans; {{_fanDuty[led_cooling] = on ? pwm : 0}}.
# *BOFA*: {{IntakeAir(running)}} stores {{_intakeAir}} then {{ApplyBofa()}}. ApplyBofa: want = intakeAir && bofa.Connected;
    duty = want ? bofa.DutyPercent : 0; {{CheckBofaPresent()}}; nothing changed → return. Up: {{SetBofaPower(true)}} then
    {{SetBofaDuty(duty)}}; down: {{SetBofaDuty(0)}} then {{SetBofaPower(false)}}; exception → warning, no state change.
    CheckBofaPresent: fault = Connected && {{hw.BofaPresent()==false}} (exception → null = never raises) →
    {{"[9048] " + BofaNotDetectedText}}; on change → {{_bofaFault}}, {{sup.SetBofaNotDetected(text|null)}}.
    {{SetBofaConnected(c)}}: {{bofa.Choose(c)}}, ApplyBofa, messages "BOFA unit connected"/"BOFA unit not connected".
    {{SetBofa(on)}} (service, direct): power on first / off last, duty = on ? DutyPercent : 0; exception → Fail("BOFA control failed: …", 6015).
# *CloseFansAndDamper* (EndOfProcess of both loops): IntakeAir(false); keep = LED fans of lit panels (+ FAN_HEATER if
    {{heating.HoldFan}}); every other fan duty 0; {{hw.SetDamper(false)}} and {{_damperOpen=false}}.
# *HoldHeaterFan(on)* under {{_op}}: sets {{heating.HoldFan}}; on: cancel a running cooldown, ensure FAN_HEATER = heater.fan_pwm;
    off: if !heating.Active && !cooling.Active && FAN_HEATER duty > 0 → {{heating.StartRunOn()}}.
# *BeginProgramStep(stopDryFan)*: {{_drying=false}}; optional StopDryFan; {{_manualHeat=false}}; clear door-abort latch.
# *HeatToTarget(t)*: SensorPreflight; under {{_op}}: BeginProgramStep(true), SetUv(false), cooling.Stop("user"),
    SetVentilation(false), SetDamper(false), heating.Start(t) → {{"Heating to {t:0.0###}°C"}} or heating's refusal.
# *DryToTarget(t)*: SensorPreflight, CoolingFanPreflight; BeginProgramStep(false) …same… heating.Start; {{_drying = ok}};
    {{"Drying to {t}°C"}}.
# *CureUv(wl, t, i)*: SensorPreflight; BeginProgramStep(true), cooling.Stop, SetVentilation(false), SetDamper(false),
    h = heating.Start(t), u = SetUv(true, i, wl). Both ok → {{"{Cure|Bleaching} UV {nm}nm @ {int i}%, {t}°C"}} ("Bleaching" for 450).
    Else FromRefusal(join "; " of failed messages, each prefixed "[code] " when code != 6015; fallback "cure blocked").
# *UvOnly(wl, i, vent)*: SensorPreflight; BeginProgramStep(true), cooling.Stop, heating.Stop("user") (fan run-on continues),
    SetUv(true) (failure returned), SetVentilation(vent) (failure only logged); {{"UV {nm}nm @ {i}% — no heating[, fresh-air vent]"}}.
# *CoolToTarget(t, mode)*: SensorPreflight, CoolingFanPreflight; under {{_op}}: {{_drying=_dryFanOn=_manualHeat=false}},
    clear door latch, SetVentilation(false); pwm = cooling.mode_pwms[mode] ?? mode_pwms[Medium] ?? 60; if cooling not
    already Active: SetUv(false), {{heating.Shutdown("user")}} (no run-on: cooling owns the heater fan); {{cooling.Start(pwm, t)}};
    ok → {{_coolingMode = mode}}, {{_damperOpen = true}}, {{SetCoolLedFans(mode == Fast)}}, IntakeAir(true),
    {{"Cooling ({wire}) to {t}°C"}}.
# *SyncCoolingEnd()* (from GetState and every supervision tick): if cooling not Active and {{_coolingMode}} set → clear
    mode, {{_damperOpen=false}}, SetCoolLedFans(false).
# *StopAll(immediate)* under {{_op}} (always Success): drying off, StopDryFan, manualHeat off, SetUv(false), SetNitrogen(false),
    cooling.Stop, SetCoolLedFans(false), SetVentilation(false), {{heating.Stop("user")}} (run-on continues), SetDamper(false),
    clear coolingMode/damperOpen, IntakeAir(false). Message {{"All cure outputs stopped[ immediately]"}}.
# *Manual heating*: {{SetTargetTemperature(t)}}: heating Active → SetTarget, {{_manualHeat=true}}, "Target set to {t}°C";
    else heating.Start, {{_manualHeat = ok}}. {{StopHeating()}}: manualHeat false, heating.Stop("user"), "Heating stopped".
# *OpenDoor()* under {{_op}}: SetUv(false), heating.Stop("user"), {{SetDoorMagnet(true)}}, one-shot timer after 2.0 s →
    {{SetDoorMagnet(false)}}; exception → Fail("door release failed: …", 6015); "Door opened".
# *DoorAbort()* (called by the door watchdog, PROC-08): under {{_op}}: {{heating.Shutdown("door open")}} (no run-on),
    StopAll(true), every FanGroup SetFanSpeed 0, SetBofa(false), latch {{_doorAbortAt = now}}. Error log "[SAFETY] Door opened
    mid-process - ALL outputs forced OFF". The latch (state.doorAborted, 6016 to the runner) clears by {{AckDoorAbort()}}
    ("Door abort acknowledged") or any new process start (BeginProgramStep, CoolToTarget, SetNitrogen(true)).
# *AckFanAlarms()*: {{sup.AcknowledgeFanAlarms()}} → released list; message "Fan alarm acknowledged (nothing to release)"
    or "Fan alarm acknowledged: {list}". *AckWatchdogTrip()* → "Watchdog alert acknowledged" / "No watchdog alert to acknowledge".
# *SetRgb(on, color)*: off → {{strip.SetOverride(false, null)}}, "RGB off". On → {{RgbColors.Parse(color ?? "white")}}
    (ArgumentException → Fail(msg)); {{strip.SetOverride(true, color)}}; fill {{rgb.count}} pixels with
    {{StripModeLadder.Scale(rgb, brightness/100)}}; write exception → clear override, Fail("strip write failed: …").
# *GetState()*: calls SyncCoolingEnd; {{ChamberTemp = read(TEMP_CHAMBER) ?? heat.Temp}}; {{TargetTemp = heat.Active ? heat.Target : cool.Active ? cool.Target : null}};
    {{InternetOk = strip.InternetOk}}; {{DoorClosed = DoorOpen() null → null else !open}}; {{CoolingMode = mode?.Wire()}};
    {{UvWavelength = nm}}; {{FanDutyEach[fan] = hw.GetFanDuty}} (exception → key omitted); {{FanRpmEach[fan] = ReadRpm ?? 0}};
    {{FanRpm[group] = min of readable member RPMs, else 0}}; {{LedTemps}} keys left/right/back/door = round1(TEMP_LEFT/RIGHT/BACK/DOOR);
    {{UvSensors["left"/"right"]}} = (volts round 3, kOhm = round1(NtcMath.VoltageToResistance(v)/1000), lit = UvLightEvaluator.IsLit(v, sup.UvBaseline, uv_light_check.lit_ratio)),
    read exception → all null; N2 fields per PROC-06; {{HeaterPwm = heat.Active ? heat.Pwm : 0}}; {{HeaterOut = heat.Active && heat.HeaterOut}};
    {{CoolingRate = cool.Rate}}; {{CoolingFanPwm = cool.Active ? round(cool.Pwm) : null}}; {{Faults = {Heater: heat.Fault, Cooling: cool.Fault, Led: _ledFault, N2: _n2Fault, Bofa: _bofaFault}}};
    {{Sensors/FanHealth/LedHealth/Alerts/AlertDetails}} from {{sup.Snapshot}} (FanHealth keyed by Fan name, Duty rounded;
    LedHealth keyed by LedPanel name); {{FanOverride = sup.OverriddenFans}}; {{StripMode = strip.Mode}};
    {{UiAlerts = {critical, warning, at (unix s)}}} or empty; {{LedChecksEnabled = LedCheckOverride.Effective(led_heating, override).Enabled}};
    {{HwSource = hw.Source}}; {{DamperDriver = hw.DamperDriver}}.
# *Shutdown()*: dispose damper watch; then each step best-effort: RgbOff, heating.Shutdown("user"), cooling.Stop("user"),
    AllLedsOff, SetNitrogen(false), LedPowerOff; {{_uv = Off}}. {{Dispose()}} disposes the damper watch.

*Configuration:* {{ventilation.fan_pwm}} (60), {{cooling.mode_pwms}} / {{fast_led_fan_pwm}}, {{heater.fan_pwm}},

*Acceptance criteria:*
* TEMP_LEFT open → HeatToTarget refused with code 9011, message "Temperature sensor disconnected: Left LED panel (TEMP_LEFT) - reconnect the sensor before starting a process",
  at least 1.0 s of fake time consumed (3 reads 0.5 s apart), 9011 in state.alerts, heating not active; a latched
  critical FAN_COOLING → 9021.
* CureUv 405 @ 80 % with factors left 0.5/right 1.5/back 1.0/door 0.8 → levels 40/100/80/64; message
  "Cure UV 405nm @ 80%, 60.0°C"; all LED fans at 100 %. CureUv 450 @ 30 % → only door = 30; "Bleaching UV 450nm @ 30%, 50.0°C".

* FAN_BACK at 0 RPM → CureUv refused with 9032.
* UvOnly with vent → damper open, intake fan at ventilation.fan_pwm.
* Cool Fast boosts LED fans; changing mode releases them; fresh cooling entry shuts the heater down without run-on;

* Drying opens damper + intake 30 % once at temperature.
* StopAll clears everything but leaves the heater-fan run-on.
* OpenDoor stops UV and heater and pulses the magnet for 2 s.
* Manual heating sets StripInputs.ManualHeat; a program step clears it.
* Fan-speed refusals as in rule 12; override parsing ("all", group, fan, unknown).

h3. Links
*Features:* Nitrogen, Safety & watchdog, Errors & alerts

*Project / folder:* {{SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Process/CureController.cs}} (nitrogen section)

*Goal:* Open/close the nitrogen purge valve with line-pressure protections: never open above {{max_bar}} (9008), refuse
when the settled closed-valve pressure is below {{min_bar}} (9009), close the valve if the line pressure does not drop
after opening (flow check, 9015), raise 9016 when the pressure sensor gives no valid reading for 20 s and refuse opening
while it is active. The supervision tick calls {{SuperviseN2Pressure()}} every second.

*Depends on:* PROC-05 (same class), PROC-08 ({{SupervisionState}} setters), Hardware ({{ReadPressure()}} → {{PressureReading}}
{Volts, Mpa?, Bar?, On, Saturated, Mode, SetPointMpa}, {{SetNitrogenValve(bool)}}, {{Config.PressureSensor}}), Domain
({{PressureSensorParameters.ModeSwitch / ModeAnalogVoltage / ModeAnalogCurrent}}).

*Files to create:* part of {{Process/CureController.cs}}.

*Public contract:*
```csharp
public static readonly TimeSpan N2LowSettle = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);
public const string N2SensorNotReadingText = "N2 pressure sensor not reading - check that the nitrogen pressure sensor is connected.";
public static string N2TooHighText(double bar, double maxBar, string action);
public static string N2NoSupplyText(double bar, double minBar);
public static string N2FlowBlockedText(double bar);
public static string? N2SensorProblem(PressureReading r, PressureSensorConfig c);
public OpResult SetNitrogen(bool on);
public void SuperviseN2Pressure();
private sealed record N2FlowCheck(double P0, DateTimeOffset OpenedAt);
```
Texts (InvariantCulture; Bar1 = "0.0", BarLimit = "0.0##"):
* {{N2TooHighText}} = {{"N2 supply pressure too high ({Bar1(bar)} bar > {BarLimit(max)} bar) - nitrogen {action}. Lower the regulator below {max:0.###} bar."}}
* {{N2NoSupplyText}} = {{"No nitrogen supply - line pressure {Bar1(bar)} bar is below {BarLimit(min)} bar. Check the nitrogen line and regulator."}}
* {{N2FlowBlockedText}} = {{"Nitrogen is not flowing into the chamber - the line pressure stayed at {Bar1(bar)} bar after the valve opened. Check the nitrogen valve and the tube to the chamber."}}

*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{ReadN2()}} → {{(reading, problem)}}: {{ReadPressure()}} exception → {{(null, "read error: {msg}")}}; else {{(r, N2SensorProblem(r, cfg))}}.
# {{N2SensorProblem}}: switch mode → null (never flagged); Saturated → {{"input saturated ({volts:0.00} V)"}}; Bar null →
   {{"no pressure value"}}; vSensor = volts × divider; analog_voltage and vSensor outside {{[v_min×0.9, v_max×1.1]}} →
   {{"sensor output {v:0.00} V is outside its {vmin:0.#}-{vmax:0.#} V range"}}; analog_current: mA = vSensor/shunt_ohms×1000 outside
   {{[i_min×0.9, i_max×1.1]}} → {{"sensor output {ma:0.0} mA is outside its {imin:0.#}-{imax:0.#} mA range"}} (tolerance
   {{PressureSensorConfig.RangeTolerance = 0.10}}).
# {{LineBar()}} = bar only when problem is null.
# {{SetNitrogen(on)}}:
** on && valve closed && {{pressure_sensor.required}} && 9016 active → {{Fail(N2SensorNotReadingText, 9016)}}.
** p0 = (on && was closed) ? LineBar() : null. settled = never closed before OR now − closedAt >= 3 s.
** If on and bar (p0 when closing→opening, fresh LineBar when already open) is known: bar > max_bar → force valve closed
     (best effort), {{_n2On=false}}, {{sup.SetN2PressureTooHigh(N2TooHighText(bar,max,"closed"))}}, return
     {{Fail(N2TooHighText(bar,max,"not opened"), 9008)}}. Exactly max is allowed. If was closed && settled && bar < min_bar →
     {{Fail(N2NoSupplyText(bar,min), 9009)}} (low limit judged only with the valve closed and settled).
** {{SetNitrogenValve(on)}} exception → {{Fail("nitrogen valve failed: …", 6015)}}. Closing an open valve records closedAt.
** Flow-check bookkeeping (under {{_n2Lock}}): off → pending check dropped (no verdict); new opening → clear {{_n2Fault}} and
     {{sup.SetN2FlowBlocked(null)}}, pending check = {{flow_check_enabled && settled && p0 known ? new N2FlowCheck(p0, now) : null}}.
** on → clear door-abort latch. Messages "Nitrogen valve opened"/"Nitrogen valve closed".
# {{SuperviseN2Pressure()}} (1 Hz from supervision): read; {{SuperviseN2Sensor}}; bar = valid bar or null.
** bar > max_bar: if valve open → close it, {{_n2On=false}}, closedAt=now, drop flow check, error log; always
     {{sup.SetN2PressureTooHigh(N2TooHighText(bar,max,"closed"))}}.
** else if 9008 active → clear it (also when there is no reading: no evidence of over-pressure).
** then {{SuperviseN2Flow(bar)}}.
# {{SuperviseN2Sensor(cfg, problem)}}: required && problem → missingSince ??= now; once {{now − missingSince >= not_reading_after_sec}}
   (20 s) and 9016 not active → {{sup.SetN2SensorNotReading(N2SensorNotReadingText)}}; never touches the valve. Valid reading
   (or not required) → missingSince = null and clear 9016. A single valid reading restarts the debounce.
# {{SuperviseN2Flow(cfg, bar)}}: no pending check → return. Valve closed or check disabled → drop. {{P0 − bar >= min_drop − 1e-9}}
   → pass (drop). Within window ({{flow_check_window_sec}}, 5 s) → wait. Window over: drop the check; no bar → not judged
   (warning only); else close the valve, {{_n2On=false}}, closedAt=now, {{_n2Fault = "[9015] " + N2FlowBlockedText(bar)}},
   {{sup.SetN2FlowBlocked(detail)}}. 9015 clears only at the next opening.
# State fields: {{NitrogenActive = _n2On}}; {{N2Pressure = dto}} (volts round 3, mpa round 3, bar round 2, plus config
   min/max/flow fields) or null on read error; {{N2LinePressure = dto.Bar}}; {{N2Sensor = (required, problem == null, problem)}};
   {{Faults.N2 = _n2Fault}}.

*Configuration:* {{pressure_sensor}} {mode "analog_voltage", v_min 1.0, v_max 5.0, i_min_ma 4, i_max_ma 20, shunt_ohms 120,
p_at_low_mpa 0, p_at_high_mpa 1.0, divider 1.0, adc_saturation_volts 3.2, on_above_volts 2.0, set_point_mpa 0.6,
max_bar 3.0, min_bar 0.5, flow_check_enabled true, flow_check_window_sec 5, flow_check_min_drop_bar 0.3, required true,
not_reading_after_sec 20}.

*Acceptance criteria:*
* Open at 3.5 bar → Fail 9008, valve stays closed, 9008 in alerts; exactly 3.0 bar opens.
* Pressure rising above the limit while open → valve closes, 9008 raised; clears when ≤ limit; limit from config.
* No bar value (switch mode / read error) never blocks or closes; a lost reading after 9008 clears 9008.
* Settled closed-valve reading 0.3 bar → Fail 9009; reading near 0 while open keeps it open with no alert; a low reading
  < 3 s after closing is not judged.
* Flow check: drop ≥ 0.3 bar within 5 s passes (exactly 0.3 passes); no drop → 9015, valve closed, Faults.N2 = "[9015] …";
  closing before the window ends → no alert; no baseline → no check; no bar at window end → no verdict; config can disable/tune.
* A purge step hitting 9015 fails the program with 9015 (PROC-09).
* 9016: raised after 20 s of invalid readings, cleared by the first valid one; a glitch restarts the debounce; saturated
  and out-of-range are "not reading"; switch mode never flagged; opening refused with 9016 while active; losing the
  reading mid-purge raises the alert but leaves the valve open; required=false disables; unplugged sensor (~0 V) never
  reads as no supply or over-pressure.

*Tests:* {{Process/N2PressureInterlockTests}} (10 facts), {{Process/N2FlowCheckTests}} (11 facts),
{{Process/N2SensorSupervisionTests}} (9 facts) — names as listed in the source test files (e.g.
Open_is_refused_above_3_bar_with_9008_and_the_valve_stays_closed, No_drop_within_the_window_raises_9015_and_closes_the_valve,
Not_reading_is_debounced_20_s_then_raises_9016_and_clears_when_readings_return). Fake: {{FakeHardwareSystem.Pressure}},
{{OpenPressure}}, {{N2FlowBlocked}}, {{PressureFault}}, {{LinePressure(bar)}}.

*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Process/CureController.cs}} (ReadN2 … SetNitrogen),
{{tests/SCureBox.Application.Tests/Process/N2*Tests.cs}}

column5: Switch mode is never flagged. Saturated gives "input saturated", and a null Bar gives "no pressure value". Analog voltage/current outside the range x 0.9/1.1 gives the range texts. LineBar returns bar only when there is no problem.

*Goal:* Operator/service diagnostics: measure fan RPMs and judge them against the same nominal-RPM policy as the wear
supervision; and an LED test that lights the panels and checks that each panel thermistor rises.

*Depends on:* PROC-05, PROC-08 ({{SupervisionService.ToRules(FanHealthConfig, bool damperOpen)}}), Domain
({{FanHealthEvaluator.ExpectedRpm}}, {{FanHealthRules.CriticalFor(fan)}}, {{WarnBelowPct}}, {{HardwareNames.Label}}).

*Files to create:* part of {{Process/CureController.cs}}.

*Public contract:* {{FanTestResult RunFanTest(string fanOrGroupOrAll)}}; {{LedTestResult RunLedTest(int seconds, double minRiseC, Wavelength wavelength, int intensity = 100)}}.

*Behaviour & rules:*
# Fan test target: "all" → every fan; empty → "chamber_heating"; else a FanGroup name; unknown →
   {{FanTestResult(true, 0, "FAIL", {}, "unknown fan: {x}")}} (individual fan names are NOT accepted here).
# rules = {{ToRules(fan_health, damperOpenNow)}} (open-damper nominal table for FAN_COOLING when the damper is open);
   minRpm = {{heater.min_fan_rpm}} (100).
# Under {{_op}}: per fan, busy = current duty > 0; judged duty = busy ? current duty : 100. Non-busy fans set 100 %
   (verify:false); sleep 2.0 s; measure all fans in parallel threads ({{MeasureRpm(fan, 1 s)}}, exception → 0, join ≤ 5 s);
   judge; non-busy fans set back to 0 (a fan a loop owns keeps running).
# Judge: expected = ExpectedRpm(nominal points, duty) (int when > 0); rpm < minRpm → FAIL (with Expected); no expected
   → OK (duty only); deficit = round((1 − rpm/expected)×100, 1); FAIL if deficit ≥ CriticalFor(fan) (default 20 %, heater
   11.8 %), WARN if ≥ warn_below_pct (10 %), else OK.
# Result: Ok = true; Rpm = min rpm; Status FAIL > WARN > OK; Message = comma-joined lines for FAIL then WARN fans:
   {{"{label}: {rpm} RPM — not spinning"}} (rpm < min or no expected) or
   {{"{label}: {rpm} RPM, {exp} RPM expected at {duty} % duty ({deficit:0} % below nominal)"}}; null if all OK.
# LED test constants: precool when any start temp ≥ 30.0 C, precool 20 s; panel sensors ("Left LED", TEMP_LEFT),
   ("Right LED", TEMP_RIGHT), ("Back LED", TEMP_BACK), ("Door LED", TEMP_DOOR).
# Busy (UV on, heating or cooling active) → {{(false, "FAIL", "busy", …, [], "a process is running - run the LED test when the machine is idle")}}.
# Under {{_op}}: read start temps; precool: LED fans 100 % for 20 s then restore previous duties; re-read; Precooled = true.
   Sensor stage: each entry Status OK if temp < 80.0 C ({{LedTestMaxTempC}}) else FAIL (null = FAIL) → stage "sensors",
   message "no valid temperature reading: {names}".
# {{SetUv(true, intensity, wavelength)}} (LED-fan pre-flight applies); failure → stage "uv", message "LEDs could not be switched on: {msg}".
# Sleep {{seconds}}, read end temps, always {{SetUv(false)}}. At 450 nm "Door LED" is INFO (not judged). Rise = round(end − start, 1);
    OK if rise ≥ minRiseC else FAIL. Message: "did not heat up: {Name} ({+0.0} C in {s} s), …" plus "; {Name} not judged at {nm} nm ({rise} C)"
    notes; Status FAIL/OK; stage "heating".

*Configuration:* {{fan_health}} (warn_below_pct 10, critical_below_pct 20, critical_below_pct_by_fan {FAN_HEATER 11.8},
nominal_rpm tables, nominal_rpm_damper_open {FAN_COOLING 60→2470, 100→4075}), {{heater.min_fan_rpm}}.

*Acceptance criteria:* result shape per fan (Rpm, Status, Duty, Expected, DeficitPct); reading judged against nominal;
a busy fan judged at its own duty (e.g. 30 % run-on against the 30 % nominal); a fan a loop owns stays running after
the test; LED test stages busy/sensors/uv/heating; warm panel ≥ 30 C precools.

*Tests:* in {{Process/CureControllerTests}}: Fan_test_result_shape, Fan_test_judges_the_reading_against_the_nominal_rpm,

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Programs & recipes, Cure run, Cure history, Data & persistence
*Blocked by:* PROC-01, PROC-02, PROC-05, DOM-02, DOM-03, DOM-06, HW-13

*Project / folder:* {{SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Recipe/}}

*Goal:* Server-side execution of a whole program ({{Material}} with steps) without the UI driving each phase: a 1 s
loop drives the Domain {{RecipeStateMachine}}, translates its commands into {{ICureController}} calls, records telemetry
into the cure-run store, posts phase timings, tracks alerts raised during the run, and ends the run as completed,
aborted or error (with code). Exposed at {{/api/recipe/*}} (area Api).

*Depends on:* PROC-01, PROC-02, PROC-05 (via {{ICureController}} only), Domain ({{RecipeStateMachine}}, `RecipeState
{ Idle, Preflight, Running, Paused, Completed, Aborted, Error }{{, }}RecipeCommand{{, }}RecipeCommandKind { Heat, Dry,
CureUv, UvOnly, Cool, Nitrogen, Stop, PhaseEnded }{{, }}Material{{, }}CureStep{{, }}ProcessType{{, }}RunAlert(double T, int? Code,
string Message){{, }}CureRunStart{{, }}CureRunFinish{{, }}TelemetrySample{{, }}PhaseTiming{{), Hardware (}}OutputFreeze`).

*Files to create:*
* {{Recipe/RecipeRunner.cs}} — {{RecipeRunner : IRecipeRunner, IHostedService, IDisposable}}
* {{Recipe/RecipeValidator.cs}} — {{RecipeValidator}}

*Public contract:*
```csharp
public sealed class RecipeRunner : IRecipeRunner, IHostedService, IDisposable {
  public const double TelemetryPeriodSec = 2.0;
  public RecipeRunner(ICureController controller, TimeProvider timeProvider, ILogger<RecipeRunner> log,
    RecipeValidator? validator = null, ICureRunStore? runs = null, IPhaseTimingStore? timings = null, OutputFreeze? freeze = null);
  public bool FailFromOutside(string message, int code);
  public void Tick();
  internal static int? FaultCode(string fault);                               // "[9007] ..." -> 9007
  internal static Dictionary<string, double?> TelemetryTemps(MachineState state);
}
public sealed record RecipeValidator(Func<Material, (bool ok, string? message, int? code)> Validate) {
  public const double HeatTargetMin = 30; public const double TempMax = 80; public const double DryTempMax = 50;
  public const double CoolTargetMin = 20; public const double UvIntensityMin = 10;
  public static RecipeValidator Default { get; }                              // = new(BasicChecks)
  public static (bool ok, string? message, int? code) BasicChecks(Material material);
}
```

*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{RecipeValidator.BasicChecks}}: no steps → (false, "Program has no steps", 7001). Per step: Nitrogen → no check;
   Cooling: t = Temperature ?? 25, outside 20..80 → "Invalid target {t} (20-80°C)" 7001; others: max = Drying ? 50 : 80;
   Temperature outside 30..max → "Invalid target {t} (30-{max}°C)" 7001; Temperature null and not UV → "Step {n}: {Process}
   needs a target temperature" 7001; UV step: {{EffectiveUvIntensity}} outside 10..100 → "Invalid intensity {i} (10-100%)" 7002;
   Time < 0 → "Step {n}: negative time" 7001. The host may register the full Domain {{ProgramValidator}} instead.
# {{Start(material, runId?, serial?)}} under lock: a machine in Preflight/Running/Paused → Fail("A program is already
   running - abort it first", 6015); {{controller.AnyProcessActive}} → Fail("A process is active - stop it before starting a
   program", 6015); validator failure → Fail(message ?? "Invalid program", code ?? 7001). runId = given or new GUID;
   new {{RecipeStateMachine(material, runId)}}; reset finished flag and telemetry time; snapshot state: alert list cleared,
   active alerts = current {{state.Alerts}} (only alerts raised during the run are recorded), remembered heater fault and N2
   fault = current ones. `runs.Start(runId, CureRunStart{MaterialName, Steps=count, Phases=step process names,
   TargetTemp=first non-null step temperature, SerialNumber}){{ (exceptions logged). }}controller.HoldHeaterFan(true)`;
   {{Execute(machine.Start(now, chamberTemp))}}; Success("Program '{name}' started").
# {{Pause()}}: only when Running else Fail("No program is running", 6015); HoldHeaterFan(false); Execute(machine.Pause) (emits
   Stop → {{StopAll(false)}}); "Program paused". {{Resume()}}: only when Paused else Fail("No paused program", 6015);
   HoldHeaterFan(true); Execute(machine.Resume) (re-issues the current phase command); "Program resumed".
# {{Abort()}}: Preflight/Running/Paused else Fail("No program is running", 6015); machine.Abort; {{StopAll(true)}};
   FinishRun("aborted"); "Program aborted".
# {{SkipStep()}}: Running only else Fail("No program is running", 6015); Execute(machine.SkipStep(now, chamberTemp)); "Step skipped".
# {{FailFromOutside(message, code)}}: if a program is on → error log, Fail(message, code), true; else false (used by DVT hang).
# {{Tick()}} (PeriodicWorker 1 s "recipe-runner"; StartAsync starts it): return if OutputFreeze active or not Running.
   state = GetState(); TrackAlerts; then in order:
** {{state.DoorAborted}} → Fail("Door opened - program aborted", 6016).
** heater fault changed to a new non-null value: code = FaultCode(text) ?? first active alert in {9007, 9006, 9010, 9001};
     if code is NOT (family 9001 i.e. 9001/9010/9011/9012) and NOT 9006 → Fail("Heater stopped: {fault}", code ?? 6015).
     Sensor faults / 9006 are left to the cure screen (it pauses and asks Retry/Stop). Remember the fault.
** N2 fault changed to new non-null → Fail("Nitrogen stopped: {message without [code]}", FaultCode ?? 9015).
** telemetry when first or ≥ 2.0 s since last ({{TelemetryPeriodSec}}; the class comment says 5 s, the constant is 2 s).
** Execute(machine.Advance(now, chamberTemp)); if still Running → HoldHeaterFan(true) (re-assert every pass).
# {{Execute(commands)}}: Heat→HeatToTarget, Dry→DryToTarget, CureUv→CureUv(wl, target, intensity), UvOnly→UvOnly(wl,
   intensity, vent), Cool→CoolToTarget(target, mode), Nitrogen→SetNitrogen(on), Stop→StopAll(false), PhaseEnded→
   {{timings.Append}} (exceptions logged). First non-ok result → Fail(r.Message, r.Code ?? 6015) and stop. After the list:
   machine Completed → FinishRun("completed"); Aborted → FinishRun("aborted").
# {{TrackAlerts}}: t = round(total elapsed s); each code in state.Alerts not in the active set → add `RunAlert(t, code,
   detail or "Err {code}")`; active set = intersection with current alerts (a code that clears and returns is recorded again).
# {{Fail(message, code)}}: add {{RunAlert(t, code, message)}} unless an alert with that code was recorded ≤ 5 s earlier;
    machine.Fail; {{StopAll(true)}}; FinishRun("error").
# {{RecordTelemetry}} (only with a store and run id): `TelemetrySample{ T = round(total elapsed), ChamberTemp, UvOn,
    UvType = "{nm}nm" or null, LedTemps {right,left,door,back}, FanRpm = FanRpmEach copy, TargetTemp, HeaterPwm, HeaterOn =
    HeaterOut, FanDuty = FanDutyEach copy, Temps = TelemetryTemps(state) (chamber rounded 1 + every LedTemps entry),
    UvOutputs = uvOn ? copy : null, UvIntensity = uvOn ? intensity : null, DamperOpen, Nitrogen = NitrogenActive, DoorClosed }`.
# {{FinishRun(status)}}: always {{HoldHeaterFan(false)}} (normal run-on); once per run: `runs.Finish(runId,
    CureRunFinish{Status, StepsCompleted, Alerts}, sensorIssues = sensors not ok → SensorIssue(sensor, critical),
    fanIssues = fanHealth status "warn"/"critical" → FanIssue(name, deficitPct, status=="critical"))`.
# {{GetStatus()}}: no machine → {{new RecipeStatus()}} ("idle"); else State = lower-case enum name, Process/Phase/target
    from {{machine.Progress(now)}}, elapsed/remaining/estimated rounded to 0.1 s, StartedAt/EndedAt ISO "O", Message, ErrorCode.
# State machine summary (Domain, for reference): Nitrogen step = 120 s ({{NitrogenSec}}); cooling done at chamber ≤ target
    + 0.5 C; heat/dry/cure ramp reached at chamber ≥ target − 0.5 C then hold {{Time}} minutes (OnRamp timer counts through the
    ramp); a cure step with UV start "at target" heats first and emits CureUv when reached; UV-only holds immediately; pause
    shifts all anchors on resume; last step end emits Stop + Completed.

*Configuration:* none directly (validator limits are constants).

*Acceptance criteria:*
* Short program (Heat 40 C 0.5 min, Cure 40 C 0.5 min @30 %, Cool Fast to 30 C) runs to "completed": 3 phase timings
  (third coolingMode "fast"), one Finish with StepsCompleted 3, ≥ 3 telemetry samples, UV telemetry type "405nm",
  UvOutputs only while UV on, RunId propagated, SerialNumber stored.
* Invalid programs and double starts refused; refused while a manual process runs.
* Abort → StopAll, status "aborted". Pause/Resume work.
* Door abort → "error", ErrorCode 6016, store status "error".
* A refusal mid-run (cure pre-flight with TEMP_RIGHT open after an N2 step) → "error" with 9012 and the valve closed.
* Skip step moves on.
* Heater fan at 100 % for the whole program including no-heat steps; no run-on inside the run; run-on after the end.
* A 9007 mid-program ends the run with 9007, "Heater stopped" message, and the alert recorded once at ~600 s.
* A frozen reading (9006) is left to the cure screen and still recorded.
* FaultCode reads "[NNNN]"; outside a program UV-only does not hold the heater fan; a program without heating still runs
  the heater fan and pause releases it. A purge step hitting 9015 fails with 9015.

*Tests:* {{Process/RecipeRunnerTests}} — Runs_a_short_program_to_completion, Refuses_invalid_programs_and_double_starts,
Refuses_while_a_manual_process_runs, Abort_stops_everything_and_marks_the_run_aborted, Pause_and_resume,
Door_abort_ends_the_run_with_6016, A_refusal_mid_run_ends_the_run_with_the_code, Skip_step_moves_on,
The_heater_fan_runs_at_full_duty_for_the_whole_program_also_with_heating_off,
A_heater_fault_mid_program_ends_the_run_with_its_code_and_records_the_alert,
A_frozen_reading_is_left_to_the_cure_screen_and_still_recorded, FaultCode_reads_the_bracketed_code,
Outside_a_program_a_uv_only_process_does_not_hold_the_heater_fan,
A_program_with_no_heating_at_all_still_runs_the_heater_fan_and_pause_releases_it; plus
{{N2FlowCheckTests.A_purge_step_that_hits_9015_fails_the_program_with_the_code}}. Use in-memory {{ICureRunStore}} /
{{IPhaseTimingStore}} fakes and pump {{runner.Tick()}} once per simulated second on a pumped thread.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cure run, DVT bench, HDT calibration, Simulator
*Blocked by:* PROC-03, PROC-04, PROC-05, PROC-06, PROC-07, PROC-08, PROC-09, PROC-10, HW-13, HW-14, PLAT-01, PLAT-04, PLAT-09, PLAT-10, PLAT-12, DVT-01, DVT-02, DVT-03, DVT-04, DVT-05, DVT-06, DVT-07
*Blocks:* API-01
*Relates to:* API-01, HW-16, PLAT-16
*Implements:* OD-74, REQ-17


*Project / folder:* {{SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{ProcessServiceCollectionExtensions.cs}}

*Goal:* One extension method that registers the whole process execution layer (device loops, cure controller,
supervision, status strip, recipe runner) plus the DVT/HDT services that hang off it, as singletons, and the three hosted
services.

*Depends on:* PROC-03..PROC-10; Hardware ({{IHardwareSystem}}, {{IHardwareConfig}}, {{OutputFreeze}}, {{WatchdogTripFile}});
Application-Platform ({{FrozenReadingStore}}, {{PlannedRestart}}, {{BofaPolicy}}, {{NetworkPolicy}}, {{ICloudSync}}, {{DataOptions}});
Dvt-Hdt ({{ITemperatureProbe}}, {{SimulatedTc08Probe}}, {{PicoLogTc08Probe}}, {{IHdtCalibration}}/{{HdtCalibration}},
{{IUvMeterSource}}, {{StarBrightUsbSource}}, {{SimulatedUvMeterSource}}, {{DvtBench}}, {{UvSweep}}, {{UvOffTiming}}, {{RemoteConfirm}},
{{IWatchdogTripSource}}/{{WatchdogTripFileSource}}, {{DvtHang}}).

*Files to create:* {{ProcessServiceCollectionExtensions.cs}} — {{public static class ProcessServiceCollectionExtensions}}

*Public contract:* {{public static IServiceCollection AddSCureBoxProcess(this IServiceCollection services)}} (namespace {{SCureBox.Application}}).

*Behaviour & rules:* registrations, all {{TryAddSingleton}} unless noted, in this order:
# {{TimeProvider.System}}; {{FrozenReadingStore}}; {{PlannedRestart}}; {{SupervisionState}} (factory: {{new SupervisionState(sp.GetService<FrozenReadingStore>())}});
   {{StripStatus}}; {{LedCheckOverride}}; {{BofaPolicy}} (factory {{new BofaPolicy(sp.GetService<DataOptions>())}}).
# {{ICoolingLoop → CoolingLoop}}; {{IHeatingLoop → HeatingLoop}}; {{CureController}}; {{ICureController}} → the same CureController
   instance; {{SupervisionService}}.
# {{NetworkPolicy}} (factory {{new NetworkPolicy(() => sp.GetService<ICloudSync>()?.Status().Enabled == true, sp.GetService<DataOptions>())}}).
# {{StatusLedService}} (factory with hw, CureController, StripStatus, TimeProvider, logger, probe null, NetworkPolicy);
   {{InternetStatusProvider(() => StripStatus.InternetOk)}}.
# {{RecipeValidator.Default}}; {{RecipeRunner}} (factory with ICureController, TimeProvider, logger, optional RecipeValidator,
   optional ICureRunStore, optional IPhaseTimingStore, optional OutputFreeze); {{IRecipeRunner}} → same instance.
# {{ITemperatureProbe}}: env {{SCURE_SIM_TC08}} set and not ""/"0"/"false" → {{SimulatedTc08Probe(tp, () => CureController.CurrentUvPower)}},
   else {{PicoLogTc08Probe(tp, logger)}}. {{IHdtCalibration → HdtCalibration}}.
# {{IUvMeterSource}}: env {{SCURE_SIM_METER}} truthy → {{SimulatedUvMeterSource(() => (st.UvOn, st.UvIntensity, st.UvWavelength))}}
   from {{CureController.GetState()}}, else {{StarBrightUsbSource()}}.
# {{DvtBench}}, {{UvSweep}}, {{UvOffTiming}}, {{RemoteConfirm}}; {{IWatchdogTripSource → new WatchdogTripFileSource(WatchdogTripFile.ConfiguredPath())}};
   {{DvtHang(CureController, OutputFreeze ?? new OutputFreeze(), SupervisionState, TimeProvider, logger, RecipeRunner?, IWatchdogTripSource?)}}.
# {{AddSingleton<IHostedService>}} (not Try) for SupervisionService, StatusLedService, RecipeRunner (same singleton instances).
# Optional services resolved with {{GetService}} (null allowed): ICureRunStore, IPhaseTimingStore, RecipeValidator,
    OutputFreeze, DataOptions, ICloudSync.

*Configuration:* env vars {{SCURE_SIM_TC08}}, {{SCURE_SIM_METER}} (truthy = anything except empty, "0", "false").

*Acceptance criteria:*
* Resolving {{ICureController}} and {{CureController}} returns the same instance; same for {{IRecipeRunner}}/{{RecipeRunner}}.
* Three hosted services are registered; calling {{AddSCureBoxProcess}} after a host already registered e.g. a custom
  {{TimeProvider}} or {{RecipeValidator}} keeps the host's one (TryAdd).

*Tests:* none dedicated in this test project (OPEN QUESTION: the composition is presumably exercised by Api/host
integration tests — area Api).

*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Application/ProcessServiceCollectionExtensions.cs}}

h3. Links
*Features:* DVT bench, UV LEDs & wavelength, Door & magnet, UV light sensors
*Blocked by:* DVT-01, DVT-07, PROC-01, DOM-03, API-02
*Blocks:* API-12, DVT-03, PROC-11
*Relates to:* API-12, PROC-05, HW-12
*Implements:* OD-68, OD-67, OD-70, EP-03, REQ-20, REQ-24

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Dvt/}}; endpoints in {{src/SCureBox.Api}} {{Endpoints/DvtEndpoints.cs}} (Api area hosts the endpoints)
*Goal:* Measures StarBright irradiance at a ladder of LED intensities on one wavelength, using the machine's own clock. Every lit step gets a mean and standard deviation, plus a dark baseline. Also answers "is a meter present / what does it read" and sets the meter's wavelength. The JSON is identical to the Python {{server/uv_sweep.py}}.
*Depends on:* DVT-01, DVT-07 (IHdtCalibration.Running), Application-Process ({{ICureController}}: {{AnyProcessActive}}, {{GetState()}} → {{MachineState.DoorClosed/UvOn/LedTemps}}, {{SetUv(bool, double, Wavelength)}}), Domain ({{Wavelength}}, {{WavelengthExtensions.TryParse(int, out Wavelength)}}), Api.
*Files to create:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Dvt/UvSweep.cs}}, which holds {{UvSweep}}, {{UvSweepRequest}}, {{UvSweepConfig}}, {{UvSweepStep}}, {{UvSweepStatus}}, {{UvSweepStartResult}}, {{MeterStatus}}, {{MeterWavelengthResult}}.
*Public contract:*
```csharp
public sealed class UvSweep {
  public static readonly IReadOnlyList<int> DefaultSteps = { 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100 };
  public UvSweep(ICureController hardware, IUvMeterSource meters, IHdtCalibration hdt, TimeProvider timeProvider, ILogger<UvSweep> log, DvtBench? bench = null);
  public bool Running { get; }
  public MeterStatus Meter(bool identify = false);
  public MeterWavelengthResult SetMeterWavelength(int nm);
  public UvSweepStartResult Start(UvSweepRequest r);
  public UvSweepStatus Status(bool samples = true);
  public string Abort();
}
public sealed record UvSweepRequest(int Wavelength, IReadOnlyList<int>? Steps, double Dwell = 10, double Baseline = 5, double Settle = 5, double Tail = 3, double Hz = 5, bool Force = false);
public sealed record UvSweepConfig(int Wavelength [wavelength], IReadOnlyList<int> Steps [steps], double Dwell [dwell], double Baseline [baseline], double Settle [settle], double Tail [tail], double Hz [hz]);
public sealed record UvSweepStep(int Intensity [intensity], double? MeanMwCm2 [mean_mw_cm2], double? SdMwCm2 [sd_mw_cm2], int N [n], double DwellS [dwell_s], double? LedMaxC [led_max_c]);
public sealed record UvSweepStatus { running, status="IDLE", phase="idle", config, samples (List<object?[]>), n_samples (omitted when null), steps, error, aborted, started (unix s double?), finished, elapsed, step_index, intensity, reading, meter, meter_wavelength_nm, meter_wavelength_verified, dark_mw_cm2 }
public sealed record UvSweepStartResult(bool Ok, string Message, string? Code, int? MeterWavelengthNm, bool? MeterWavelengthVerified) { public static UvSweepStartResult Fail(string message); }
public sealed record MeterStatus(bool Present, MeterIdentity? Identity, double? ReadingMwCm2, string? Message);
public sealed record MeterWavelengthResult(bool Ok, int? WavelengthNm, string? Message);
```
Sample row format: {{[t_s (3 dp), mW/cm2 (4 dp) | null, intensity %, phase ("baseline"|"step"|"tail"), hottest LED °C (2 dp) | null, uv_on bool]}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Meter(identify)}}:
** While a sweep runs: {{(true, sweep identity, last reading, "a sweep is running - values from the sweep")}}.
** While {{DvtBench.Owner}} is set: {{(true, cached identity (may be null), null, "the meter is in use by {owner}")}}, without opening the meter.
** Otherwise open the meter. Run Identify only when {{identify}} is set or nothing is cached (Identify is nine commands). Then refresh {{WavelengthNm}} and return one {{PowerMwCm2()}} reading.
** On {{UvMeterException}}: clear the cache and return {{(false, null, null, msg)}}.
# {{SetMeterWavelength(nm)}}:
** Only 405 or 450, else "wavelength must be 405 or 450 (got N)".
** Refused while running: "a sweep is running - the meter is busy".
** Open, set, read back. Ok = (read == nm); otherwise the message is "meter reports X nm after setting Y".
# {{Start}} checks, in order:
** Already running: "a sweep is already running".
** Wavelength not parsable: "wavelength must be 405 or 450 (got N)".
** Steps: null or empty → DefaultSteps. Any step < 10 or > 100: "steps must be percentages between 10 and 100".
** dwell ≤ 0, baseline < 0, tail < 0 or settle ≤ 0: "dwell and settle must be above 0 s, baseline and tail not below 0 s".
** Build the config with settle = min(settle, dwell) and hz = clamp(hz, 0.5, 10).
** {{AnyProcessActive}}: "a process is running (heating, cooling or UV) - stop it first".
** HDT running: "HDT calibration is running - abort it first".
** {{DoorClosed == false}}: "door open - close the door (the LEDs are interlocked)".
** Open the meter and read Identify + WavelengthNm. A {{UvMeterException}} gives "StarBright not reachable: …".
** Meter wavelength ≠ request and not forced: {{(false, "the StarBright is set to X nm but this test is at Y nm - set the meter to Y nm first (or force=1 to record it as unverified)", "METER_WAVELENGTH", X, false)}}.
** {{bench.TryAcquire("uv-sweep")}} fails: "the DVT bench is busy ({owner})".
** Success: start a background thread named "dvt-uv-sweep" and return ok with "UV sweep started at Y nm: [s1, s2, …] x D s", plus the meter wavelength and the verified flag.
# Run:
** Open the meter.
** {{Hold(seconds, phase, intensity, uvOn)}} paces samples on an absolute schedule ({{next += period}}). When it falls behind, it does not wait (only checks cancel). It returns false when cancelled.
** Each sample reads the meter and {{CachedState()}} ({{GetState()}} at most once per 1.0 s), and records the row.
** While uvOn: {{DoorClosed == false}} throws "the door opened during the {p} % step - sweep stopped, LEDs off"; {{!st.UvOn}} throws "the LEDs went off during the {p} % step (a supervision fault) - sweep stopped". Both end as status ERROR.
# Sequence:
** Phase "baseline": {{SetUv(false,0,wl)}} and hold {{Baseline}} s. {{DarkMwCm2}} = mean of the baseline readings (4 dp), or null.
** For each step: phase "step" with {{StepIndex = i}}, then {{SetUv(true, pct, wl)}}. A refusal sets Error "UV refused at {p} %: {msg}" and breaks the loop. Otherwise reset the state cache and hold {{Dwell}}.
** Step result = the readings of this pct with t ≥ now − settle: mean (4 dp), population SD (4 dp; 0.0 for one reading; null for none), N, dwell_s (1 dp), LedMax from a forced state read.
** Phase "tail": UV off, and hold {{Tail}} only when every step completed and nothing was cancelled.
** LedMax = max of the non-null {{MachineState.LedTemps}} values, rounded to 2 dp.
# {{finally}}:
** UV off (best effort), dispose the meter, {{bench.Release("uv-sweep")}}.
** Status: ABORTED if cancelled; ERROR if Error is set; OK when every step has a non-null mean; INCOMPLETE otherwise.
** Phase "done", Intensity 0, Running false, Finished = unix s, Elapsed (1 dp).
** Other exceptions are logged, and the error is truncated to 300 chars.
# {{Abort()}}: with no sweep it returns "no sweep running" and touches nothing (the UV may belong to a cure). Otherwise cancel and return "abort requested - LEDs go off".
# Endpoints (Api; all answer HTTP 200 with {{ok}}):
** {{GET /api/dvt/meter?identify=}} → {{{ok:false,present:false,message}}}, or the flattened {{MeterIdentity}} plus {{ok,present,reading_mw_cm2,message}}.
** {{POST /api/dvt/meter/wavelength?nm=}} → {{{ok,wavelength_nm,message}}}.
** {{POST /api/dvt/uv-sweep?wavelength=405&steps=30,40&dwell=10&baseline=5&settle=5&tail=3&hz=5&force=}} → {{{ok,message,code,meter_wavelength_nm,meter_wavelength_verified}}}. A step that does not parse gives {{{ok:false,message:"bad parameter: steps '…'"}}}.
** {{GET /api/dvt/uv-sweep?samples=1}} → flattened status + {{ok}}.
** {{POST /api/dvt/uv-sweep/abort}} → {{{ok:true,message}}}.
** The lease endpoints {{GET /api/dvt/bench}} → {{{ok,owner}}}. {{POST /api/dvt/bench/claim?who=&lease_s=30}}: lease clamped to 1..300, an empty who gives "who= is required", success {{{ok,owner,lease_s,message:"bench held by {who} for {lease:0} s"}}}, busy "the DVT bench is busy ({owner})". {{POST /api/dvt/bench/release?who=}} → {{{ok,owner,message:"released"}}}.
*Configuration:* none (DI singletons {{UvSweep}}, {{DvtBench}}).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* A simulated sweep records every step with a mean > dark and ends OK with the LEDs off.
* A meter set to the other wavelength is refused with code METER_WAVELENGTH unless force=1. After {{SetMeterWavelength}} it is accepted.
* The door opening while a step is lit → ERROR, LEDs off, no dark readings stored as a step. The door opening between steps refuses the next step (the same error path).
* Refused when the door is open, when a process is active, when HDT is running, or when the meter is missing.
* While another bench owner holds the lock, {{Meter()}} does not open the meter. The Identify count stays the same; {{identify:true}} forces a new identify.
*Tests:* {{UvSweepTests}} (Simulated_sweep_measures_every_step_and_switches_the_leds_off, Meter_on_the_other_wavelength_is_refused_unless_forced_and_can_be_set_remotely, Abort_stops_with_the_leds_off, Door_opening_while_lit_stops_the_sweep_instead_of_recording_dark_readings, Door_opening_between_steps_refuses_the_next_step, Refusals_door_process_hdt_and_missing_meter, Meter_wavelength_reply_parsing); {{UvOffTimingTests.Meter_status_does_not_open_the_meter_while_a_bench_measurement_holds_it}} (CountingSource); Api {{DvtTests.Meter_reports_itself_and_takes_a_wavelength}}, {{The_bench_process_can_hold_the_meter_lock_on_a_lease}}, {{Sweep_validates_runs_and_reports_in_the_python_json}}. All use {{ProcessRig}} (FakeTimeProvider + simulated hardware) and {{SimulatedUvMeterSource(noise:0, seed:1)}}.

column4: DVT-03 UV-off-on-door-open timing (DVT-SAF-008 step 2)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* DVT bench, UV LEDs & wavelength, Door & magnet, Safety & watchdog
*Blocked by:* DVT-01, DVT-02, DVT-07, PROC-01, DOM-03, API-02
*Blocks:* API-12, PROC-11
*Relates to:* API-12, PROC-05, PROC-08, PROC-09
*Implements:* OD-21, OD-72, OD-68, OD-70, REQ-11, REQ-24

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Dvt/}}
*Goal:* Measures, on the machine's clock, how long the UV takes to go dark after the door opens during a cure:
* dark reading → a real UV-only cure program (or a direct UV command) until the StarBright plateau → the operator opens the door → sampling at {{hz}} until the reading is below 10 % and back at the dark level → tail → alarm watch.
* It records the program end state and the alerts, for the alarm check of the test.
*Depends on:* DVT-01, DVT-02 (shares {{UvSweepStartResult}}), DVT-07 (IHdtCalibration), Application-Process ({{ICureController}}: {{AnyProcessActive}}, {{DoorOpenNow()}}, {{GetState()}} [Alerts, AlertDetails, DoorAborted, UiAlerts, UvOn], {{SetUv}}, {{OpenDoor()}}; {{IRecipeRunner}}: {{Start(Material)}}, {{GetStatus()}} [State, Message, ErrorCode], {{Abort()}}), Domain ({{Material}}, {{CureStep}}, {{ProcessType.Cure/Bleacher}}, {{Wavelength.Nm450}}), Api.
*Files to create:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Dvt/UvOffTiming.cs}}, which holds {{UvOffTiming}}, {{UvOffRequest}}, {{UvOffStatus}}, {{ProgramEnd}}.
*Public contract:*
```csharp
public sealed class UvOffTiming {
  public const double OffFraction = 0.10, StableBandFraction = 0.02, ZeroFraction = 0.005, ZeroFloorMwCm2 = 0.01, ZeroHoldSec = 0.5, InterlockLimitSec = 12.0;
  public UvOffTiming(ICureController hardware, IUvMeterSource meters, IHdtCalibration hdt, DvtBench bench, TimeProvider timeProvider, ILogger<UvOffTiming> log, IRecipeRunner? recipes = null);
  public bool Running { get; }
  public UvSweepStartResult Start(UvOffRequest r);
  public UvOffStatus Status(bool samples = true);
  public string Abort(string? by = null);
}
public sealed record UvOffRequest(int Wavelength = 405 [wavelength], int Intensity = 100 [intensity], double PlateauMaxSec = 30 [plateau_max_s], double StableSec = 2 [stable_s], double OpenTimeoutSec = 30 [open_timeout_s], double TailSec = 3 [tail_s], double Hz = 20 [hz], bool Force = false [force], double AlarmWatchSec = 15 [alarm_watch_s], bool Release = false [release]);
public sealed record ProgramEnd(string State [state], string? Message [message], int? ErrorCode [error_code]);
public sealed record UvOffStatus {  // JSON names
  running, status="IDLE", phase="idle", config, samples, n_samples (omit null), error, aborted, started (unix s), finished, elapsed,
  reading, door_open, meter, meter_wavelength_nm, meter_wavelength_verified, dark_mw_cm2, plateau_mw_cm2, release_at_s, release_ok,
  door_open_at_s, below_10pct_at_s, uv_off_time_s, uv_off_before_door_open, release_to_off_s, residual_mw_cm2, zero_threshold_mw_cm2,
  zero_at_s, uv_zero_time_s, release_to_zero_s, mode ("direct"|"program"), program_end, alerts_before, alerts_after, alert_details,
  door_aborted, ui_alerts (List<string>), interlock_failed, aborted_by }
```
Sample row: {{[t_s (3 dp), mW/cm2 (4 dp) | null, door_open (true/false/null), phase]}}. Phases: starting, dark, plateau, open_door, decay, tail, alarm_watch, done.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Start}} refusals, in order:
** "a UV-off measurement is already running".
** "wavelength must be 405 or 450 (got N)".
** "intensity must be 10-100 % (got N)".
** {{AnyProcessActive}}: "a process is running (heating, cooling or UV) - stop it first".
** "HDT calibration is running - abort it first".
** recipe state preflight/running/paused: "a program is running - abort it first".
** {{DoorOpenNow() != false}}: "the door must be closed at the start (the LEDs are interlocked)".
** meter open/identify failure: "StarBright not reachable: …".
** wavelength mismatch without force: code "METER_WAVELENGTH", message "the StarBright is set to X nm but this measurement is at Y nm - set the meter first (or force=1)".
** {{bench.TryAcquire("uv-off")}} fails: "the DVT bench is busy ({owner})".
** Success: config with Hz = clamp(1, 50); status initialised with Mode ("direct" when no recipe runner, else "program") and AlertsBefore = current alerts. Thread "dvt-uv-off". Message "UV-off timing started at Y nm, P %".
# Dark: sample for 1 s. darkMean = the mean (0 when empty); darkSd = the population SD (0 for fewer than 2).
# Plateau:
** Program mode: start Material {{{Id="dvt-saf-012-uv-off", Name="DVT-SAF-008 UV off", Steps=[{Step=1, Process = Bleacher if 450 nm else Cure, Time=10, UvIntensity=intensity}]}}}. If the start is refused, throw "the program did not start: …". Then poll {{GetState().UvOn}} every 200 ms for up to 30 s, else throw "the program did not switch the UV on within 30 s ({recipe message})".
** Direct mode: {{SetUv(true, intensity, wl)}}; a refusal gives "UV refused: …".
** Find the plateau with a rolling window of need = max(2, round(StableSec × Hz)) readings. Plateau = the window mean, once the mean > darkMean and max − min ≤ 0.02 × mean, within PlateauMaxSec. Otherwise throw "the StarBright reading did not settle - check the head position and that the LEDs light".
# Thresholds:
** zeroLevel = darkMean + max(0.005 × (plateau − darkMean), 3 × darkSd, 0.01).
** zeroHold = max(1, round(0.5 × Hz)) consecutive samples.
** offThreshold = darkMean + 0.10 × (plateau − darkMean).
# open_door phase:
** Release=true: record {{ReleaseAt = now}} and call {{OpenDoor()}} (ReleaseOk = its Ok).
** Then sample until {{door == true}} (tOpen), or throw "the door sensor did not report the door open within {OpenTimeoutSec:0} s - open the door while the UV is on".
** {{Track(v)}} runs on every sample from here on: the first v ≤ offThreshold sets tBelow. A zero candidate starts at the first v ≤ zeroLevel and resets on any v above; after zeroHold consecutive samples, tZero = the candidate time.
# decay phase: sample until tZero is set or 20 s pass. If tBelow is still null 12 s (InterlockLimitSec) after the door opened, set InterlockFailed=true and throw "the UV was still above 10 % 12 s after the door opened - the machine did not switch it off; the run switched it off".
# tail: sample for TailSec; Residual = the mean of the tail readings (4 dp). alarm_watch: sample every 500 ms for AlarmWatchSec (default 15 s; it covers the ~10 s door grace → abort → error 6016).
# Results:
** In program mode, ProgramEnd = (state, message, errorCode) of the recipe.
** AlertsAfter, AlertDetails, DoorAborted, UiAlerts (the keys) come from {{GetState()}}.
** UvOffTime = max(0, tBelow − tOpen); UvOffBeforeDoorOpen = tBelow ≤ tOpen; ReleaseToOff = tBelow − tRelease; UvZeroTime = max(0, tZero − tOpen); ReleaseToZero = tZero − tRelease. All rounded to 3 dp.
** Error when tBelow is null: "the reading did not fall below 10 % of the plateau within 20 s of the door opening". Error when tZero is null: "the reading did not return to zero (<= X mW/cm2) within 20 s of the door opening".
# Cancellation at any wait returns immediately, and {{finally}} then runs:
** Abort the program if it is still preflight/running/paused, {{SetUv(false,0,wl)}}, dispose the meter, {{bench.Release("uv-off")}}.
** Status ABORTED / ERROR / OK; phase "done".
** {{InvalidOperationException}} and {{UvMeterException}} become the error message; other exceptions are logged too.
# {{Abort(by)}}: "no UV-off measurement running", or set AbortedBy = by ?? "unknown", cancel, and return "abort requested - LEDs go off".
# Endpoints:
*** {{POST /api/dvt/uv-off?wavelength&intensity&plateau_max&stable&open_timeout&tail&hz&force&alarm_watch&release}} → {{{ok,message,code,meter_wavelength_nm,meter_wavelength_verified}}}.
*** {{GET /api/dvt/uv-off?samples=1}} → flattened status + ok.
*** {{POST /api/dvt/uv-off/abort?by=}} (default User-Agent, else "api").
*Configuration:* reads nothing directly. The door grace it measures is the machine's {{components.json door_sensor.abort_after_sec}} (10 s).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* release=1 with the door opened 0.6 s later: OK, ReleaseOk true, UvOffBeforeDoorOpen true, UvOffTime 0, ReleaseToOff in [0,1), UvZeroTime 0, ReleaseToZero in [0,1.5), ZeroThreshold > Dark, Residual in [0,0.01], DoorOpenAt > ReleaseAt, UV off, tail samples present.
* Operator opens the door with no release: UvOffTime in [9,12] (the software door grace), UvZeroTime ≥ UvOffTime, OK.
* Door open with no supervision tick: ERROR, InterlockFailed, error starts "the UV was still above 10 % 12 s after the door opened", UV off.
* Door never opened (OpenTimeoutSec 5): ERROR "the door sensor did not report the door open…", LEDs off.
* While running, a UvSweep start says "the DVT bench is busy (uv-off)". Abort → ABORTED, bench free.
*Tests:* {{UvOffTimingTests}} (the 7 facts listed in the source, {{ProcessRig}} with {{Hardware.DoorOpenReading}}, step 50 ms); Api {{DvtTests.Uv_off_runs_a_real_program_and_reports_how_it_ended}}.

column4: DVT-04 Firmware hang on purpose for the watchdog test (DVT-SAF-010)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* DVT bench, Safety & watchdog, Errors & alerts
*Blocked by:* HW-13, HW-14, PROC-01, PROC-05, PROC-08, PROC-09, DOM-02, API-02
*Blocks:* API-05, API-12, PROC-11
*Relates to:* API-12, API-03, OPS-07, DOM-09
*Implements:* OD-69, EP-06, REQ-09, REQ-22, REQ-27

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Dvt/DvtHang.cs}}; endpoint + gate middleware in {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/DvtEndpoints.cs}}
*Goal:* Puts the firmware into a realistic HUNG state for N seconds. During it:
* no heartbeat is written and every output write blocks ({{OutputFreeze}});
* the supervision and the recipe runner are frozen;
* the firmware switches nothing off itself; the separate output watchdog (20 s) must cut.

When the hang ends, the firmware comes back SAFE: the program is failed and all outputs are off. If the watchdog trip record shows a cut during the hang, Err 9017 is raised and latched until the operator acknowledges it.
*Depends on:* Hardware ({{OutputFreeze}} with {{Hang()}}, {{Recover(Action safeState)}}, {{Hung}}, {{Active}}; {{OutputWatchdog.DefaultTimeoutSec = 20}}; {{WatchdogTripFile.TryRead(path)}} / {{ConfiguredPath()}} → {{/run/scurebox-heartbeat.trip}}), Application-Process ({{CureController.GetState()}}/{{StopAll(bool)}}, {{RecipeRunner.FailFromOutside(string, int)}}), Application-Platform/Supervision ({{SupervisionState.SetWatchdogTripped(string)}}), Domain ({{ErrorCodes.WatchdogTripped = 9017}}, {{ErrorCodes.CureAborted = 7005}}, {{MachineState}}, {{DvtHangDto}}), Api.
*Files to create:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Dvt/DvtHang.cs}}, which holds {{IWatchdogTripSource}}, {{WatchdogTripFileSource}}, {{DvtHangStart}}, {{DvtHang}}.
*Public contract:*
```csharp
public interface IWatchdogTripSource { (DateTimeOffset At, bool CutOk)? LastTrip(); }
public sealed class WatchdogTripFileSource : IWatchdogTripSource { public WatchdogTripFileSource(string? path); } // null path -> always null
public sealed record DvtHangStart(bool Ok, int Status, string Message, int Sec = 0);
public sealed class DvtHang {
  public const int MinSec = 5, MaxSec = 300, DefaultSec = 60;
  public const double HeartbeatTimeoutSec = OutputWatchdog.DefaultTimeoutSec; // 20
  public const string WatchdogTrippedText = "Firmware stopped responding - the output watchdog switched the heater and UV off. Restart the process to continue.";
  public DvtHang(CureController controller, OutputFreeze freeze, SupervisionState sup, TimeProvider timeProvider, ILogger<DvtHang> log, RecipeRunner? recipes = null, IWatchdogTripSource? trips = null);
  public bool Active { get; }               // => freeze.Active (hung or recovering)
  public DateTimeOffset? Until { get; }
  public MachineState? LastState { get; }
  public bool? LastTripSeen { get; }
  public DvtHangStart Prepare(int sec);
  public void Begin();
  public DvtHangStart Start(int sec);       // Prepare + Begin
  public void End();                        // idempotent
}
```
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Prepare(sec)}}:
** sec outside 5..300 → {{(false, 400, "sec must be 5-300 (got N)")}}.
** Under the lock: if {{freeze.Active}} or a hang is pending → {{(false, 409, "the firmware is already hung for a DVT test")}}.
** If the state shows neither heating nor UV on → {{(false, 409, "nothing is on (heater or UV) - start heating or a UV output first; there is nothing for the watchdog to cut")}}.
** Otherwise capture {{LastState = GetState()}}, store the pending sec, and return {{(true, 200, "the firmware hangs for N s", N)}}.
# {{Begin()}}:
** With nothing pending, or when already active, do nothing.
** Otherwise set {{_since = now}}, {{_until = since + sec}}, create a new CTS, and call {{freeze.Hang()}}. Log a warning.
** Start thread "dvt-hang": {{Wait(sec, ct)}} then {{End()}}.
# {{End()}}:
** Return unless {{freeze.Hung}} and {{_since}} is set. Cancel the timer.
** {{freeze.Recover(safeState)}}, where safeState does the following:
*** tripped = {{LastTrip()}} exists and its {{At ≥ since − 1 s}}; set {{LastTripSeen}}.
*** {{recipes?.FailFromOutside(why, code)}}: code 9017 with WatchdogTrippedText if tripped; else code 7005 with "Firmware hang (DVT) - the process was ended, nothing resumes".
*** {{controller.StopAll(true)}}.
*** If tripped: {{sup.SetWatchdogTripped(WatchdogTrippedText + (CutOk ? "" : " (the watchdog reported the cut INCOMPLETE)"))}}. This raises 9017, latched until {{AckWatchdogTrip}} ({{POST /api/watchdog/ack}}).
*** Each step is wrapped in try/log.
** Then clear {{_until}} and {{_since}}.
# A trip older than the hang (for example 10 min before) does not count.
# Endpoint {{POST /api/dvt/hang?sec=}} (loopback only, else 403 "only the DVT runner on this CureBox may hang the firmware"):
** A sec that is not an integer → 400 "sec must be a whole number 5-300 (got '…')". An absent sec means 60.
** A refusal → {{ApiJson.Fail(msg, status)}}.
** Success → {{{ok:true, sec, heartbeatTimeoutSec:20}}}. {{Begin()}} runs in {{Response.OnCompleted}}, so the reply goes out before the hang begins.
# Gate middleware {{UseDvtHangGate}}: while {{hang.Active}}, every non-GET/HEAD request under {{/api/}} answers 409 "the firmware is hung for a DVT test (DVT-SAF-010) until {unix} - no output commands". The exceptions are path prefixes {{/api/dvt/meter}}, {{/api/dvt/bench}}, {{/api/dvt/remote-confirm}}, {{/api/dev/picolog}}.

h3. Links
*Features:* HDT calibration, DVT bench, Temperature sensors, Simulator
*Blocked by:* PROC-05
*Blocks:* API-11, API-13, DVT-07, DVT-08, PROC-11, UI-22
*Relates to:* API-11, UI-22
*Implements:* OD-68, REQ-20

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Hdt/}}
*Goal:* Gives the firmware a continuous, thread-safe reading of the PicoLog TC-08:
* CH1: the type K thermocouple on the sample or heater body;
* CH2: the reference type K thermocouple in the chamber;
* channel 0: the cold junction, which is the instrument's ambient.

It is used by HDT calibration and the DVT pages. It can release the unit to the DVT bench process and take it back. A deterministic simulation exists for tests and for machines without the driver.
*Depends on:* native {{libusbtc08}} (Pico, {{libusbtc08.so}} on the loader path), Api ({{/api/dev/picolog/*}}), Application-Process ({{CureController.CurrentUvPower}} for the simulation).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Hdt/UsbTc08Native.cs}} — {{internal static class UsbTc08Native}} (also used by DVT-08 {{Tc08Source}})
* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Hdt/ITemperatureProbe.cs}}
* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Hdt/PicologStatusDto.cs}}
* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Hdt/PicoLogTc08Probe.cs}}
* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Hdt/SimulatedTc08Probe.cs}}
*Public contract:*
```csharp
internal static class UsbTc08Native {   // [DllImport("usbtc08")]; the driver is NOT thread-safe: one thread per handle
  short usb_tc08_open_unit();                                   // >0 handle, 0 none found, <0 failure
  short usb_tc08_set_mains(short handle, short sixtyHertz);     // 0 = 50 Hz rejection
  short usb_tc08_set_channel(short handle, short channel, sbyte tcType); // 'C' cold junction, 'K', 0 = off
  short usb_tc08_get_single(short handle, [Out] float[] temp, ref short overflowFlags, short units); // units 0 = °C; 0 = failure; float[9], [0]=CJ
  short usb_tc08_close_unit(short handle);
  short usb_tc08_get_unit_info2(short handle, StringBuilder buffer, short length, short line); // line 4 = batch and serial
}
public interface ITemperatureProbe : IDisposable { PicologStatusDto Status(); void Release(); void Resume(); bool Released { get; } }
public sealed record PicologStatusDto(bool Connected [connected], bool Ch1Available [ch1Available], double? Temperature [temperature],
  string? DeviceInfo [deviceInfo], string? Error [error], double? Ambient = null [ambient], bool Ch2Available = false [ch2Available], double? Ch2 = null [ch2]);
public sealed class PicoLogTc08Probe : ITemperatureProbe {
  public const double SamplingIntervalSec = 1.0, ReconnectSec = 5.0, StaleSec = 5.0, ValidMinC = -25.0, ValidMaxC = 400.0;
  public const string ReleasedMessage = "released to the DVT bench";
  public PicoLogTc08Probe(TimeProvider timeProvider, ILogger<PicoLogTc08Probe> log); // starts thread "tc08"
}
public sealed class SimulatedTc08Probe : ITemperatureProbe {
  public const double AmbientC = 24.0, GainCPerPct = 0.55, TauSec = 40.0;
  public SimulatedTc08Probe(TimeProvider timeProvider, Func<double> powerSupplier, double noise = 0.15, int? seed = null);
}
```
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Open sequence (shared with DVT-08):
** {{open_unit}}: 0 → "no TC-08 found (unplugged, or in use by PicoLog?)"; < 0 → "TC-08 open failed - replug the USB".
** Then {{set_mains(h,0)}}; channel 0 'C', 1 'K', 2 'K'; channels 3..8 set to 0.
** Info "PicoLog TC-08", or "PicoLog TC-08 S/N {line 4}" when {{get_unit_info2(h, sb, 256, 4) > 0}} (optional, exceptions ignored).
** {{DllNotFoundException}} → error "usbtc08 driver unavailable: …", logged once at Information. Other exceptions → "TC-08 open error: …".
# The reader thread loop (one thread owns every driver call):
** If released: close any open handle, set Connected=false with Error=ReleasedMessage, wait 1 s, and loop.
** If there is no handle: open. On failure set the error and wait 5 s. If the probe was released while opening, loop (it closes on the next pass).
** Read: {{get_single}} into float[9]; a return of 0 → IOException "usb_tc08_get_single failed".
** CH1 = buf[1], CJ = buf[0], CH2 = buf[2].
*** CH1 NaN → connected, error "CH1 reading is NaN (thermocouple disconnected?)".
*** CH1 outside −25..400 → error "CH1 reading {t:0.0}degC out of range".
*** Otherwise store the temperature.
*** The CJ (if finite) is stored, and also refreshes the sample time. CH2 is stored only if finite and inside −25..400, else null.
** An exception → Connected=false, "communication lost: …", close the handle, retry at once.
** Wait 1 s between reads. Dispose cancels and joins the thread for up to 5 s, closing the handle.
# {{Status()}}:
** fresh = last sample ≤ 5 s old.
** Ch1Available = connected && fresh && temperature present. Temperature (2 dp) only when available.
** Error = null when valid, else the stored error, or "stale data" when connected.
** Ambient = CJ (2 dp) whenever connected and fresh, even when CH1 is open. Ch2 (2 dp) likewise; Ch2Available = Ch2 is not null.
# {{Release()}}/{{Resume()}} flip a volatile flag and log "PicoLog TC-08 released to the DVT bench" / "PicoLog TC-08 back with the firmware".
# Simulation:
** target = 24 + 0.55 × power%; T += (target − T) × dt/40, with dt clamped to 0..10 s and integrated lazily on every {{Status()}} call.
** Reading = T ± U(−1,1) × noise (2 dp).
** DeviceInfo "PicoLog TC-08 (SIMULATED - SCURE_SIM_TC08)".
** Ambient = 24 ± noise; Ch2Available true, Ch2 = 24.
** When released: {{(false,false,null,info,ReleasedMessage,null)}}.
** A failing power supplier is read as 0.
# Endpoints:
** {{GET /api/dev/picolog/status}} → the DTO.
** {{POST /api/dev/picolog/release}}: refused while HDT runs ("HDT calibration is running - abort it first"); else {{{ok:true,message:"PicoLog TC-08 released to the DVT bench"}}}.
** {{POST /api/dev/picolog/resume}} → {{{ok:true,message:"PicoLog TC-08 back with the firmware"}}}.
# Difference from the Python reference: {{reference/picolog_tc08.py}} uses VALID_RANGE_C (−25, 250) and searches lib dirs ({{SCURE_TC08_LIB_DIR}}, {{/opt/picoscope/lib}}, {{~/pico/root/opt/picoscope/lib}}, {{/usr/local/lib}}). The C# code uses 400 °C (so a 250 °C cutout trip in DVT-SAF-009 is seen with headroom) and plain {{DllImport("usbtc08")}} with no custom resolver. OPEN QUESTION: whether a NativeLibrary resolver for the extracted-.deb dirs is needed on target images (none exists in the C# code).
*Configuration:* {{SCURE_SIM_TC08}} (anything but "", "0", "false" → {{SimulatedTc08Probe(tp, () => CureController.CurrentUvPower)}}, else {{PicoLogTc08Probe}}). Registered with {{TryAddSingleton<ITemperatureProbe>}}.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Simulated at 50 %, noise 0: 24.0 at t0. After 40 s (one 10 s clamped step) the reading is in [30.5, 31.0]. After 100 × 5 s it is in [51.4, 51.5]. Ch1Available is true.
* The simulated Ambient stays 24.0 while CH1 rises (difference in [27.0, 27.5]).
* A missing native library never throws out of the probe; status reports connected=false with the driver error.
*Tests:* {{HdtCalibrationTests.Simulated_probe_follows_the_led_power}}, {{HdtCalibrationTests.The_probe_reports_its_cold_junction_as_ambient}}; {{DeadProbe}} fake (Status → not connected) used by the HDT refusal test.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Hdt/UsbTc08Native.cs}}, {{ITemperatureProbe.cs}}, {{PicologStatusDto.cs}}, {{PicoLogTc08Probe.cs}}, {{SimulatedTc08Probe.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/DevEndpoints.cs}}, {{reference/picolog_tc08.py}}

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* HDT calibration, LED calibration, Developer mode, UV LEDs & wavelength
*Blocked by:* DVT-06, PROC-01, DOM-02, DOM-08
*Blocks:* API-11, DVT-02, DVT-03, PLAT-15, PROC-11, UI-03, UI-21, UI-22
*Relates to:* API-11, UI-22, PLAT-15, PLAT-12
*Implements:* OD-70, OD-44, OD-56, REQ-13, REQ-20, REQ-29

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Hdt/}}; pure math in {{src/SCureBox.Domain}} {{Control/HdtModel.cs}}
*Goal:* In Developer Mode, finds the highest calibrated SYSTEM LED power (405 nm) a material takes without its averaged CH1 temperature exceeding the material HDT minus a safety margin. It steps 10 → 90 %; at each level it waits for thermal stability or a timeout. Reaching the HDT stops everything at once. It also estimates the "boost" time (time at boost power from a start temperature up to the lower HDT limit) and produces a CSV report.
*Depends on:* DVT-06 (ITemperatureProbe), Application-Process ({{ICureController}}: {{SetUv(bool,double,Wavelength.Nm405)}}, {{SetHeaterFan(int)}}, {{CancelHeaterFanCooldown()}}, {{LedFactors}}, {{AnyProcessActive}}), Domain ({{OpResult}}, {{HdtModel}}), Api ({{/api/dev/hdt/*}}), Application-Platform (LED calibration store: factors 0..1.5 per zone), Reports ({{HdtReportBuilder}} consumes {{HdtStatusDto}} — other area).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Hdt/IHdtCalibration.cs}}
* {{HdtCalibration.cs}}
* {{HdtStartRequest.cs}}
* {{HdtStatusDto.cs}}
* {{HdtConfigDto.cs}}
* {{HdtLevelResult.cs}}
* {{HdtSample.cs}}
* {{HdtBoost.cs}}
* {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Control/HdtModel.cs}} (if not delivered by Domain)
*Public contract:*
```csharp

    DefaultStabilityMaxRateCPerMin = 0.5, DefaultMaxStabilizationTimeMin = 30.0, DefaultSafetyMarginC = 2.0, DefaultNextStepMaxTempDeltaC = 0.0,
    DefaultCooldownMaxWaitMin = 15.0, DefaultBoostPower = 90, DefaultBoostStartTempC = 35.0, HeaterFanReassertSec = 5.0;
  public const int HeaterFanPwmSetting = 100;
  public static readonly IReadOnlyList<int> PowerLevels = { 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 };

  bool IsStable(IReadOnlyList<(double t, double v)> window, double stabilityTimeSec, double bandC, double maxRateCPerMin);
  double EquilibriumAt(IReadOnlyList<(double power, double stableTemp)> levels, double power);

  double? BoostTimeSec(double tau, double tEq, double t0, double limit);
```
