*Behaviour & rules:*
# States: IDLE → STARTING_CALIBRATION → [PREPARING_POWER_LEVEL] → TESTING_POWER_LEVEL → WAITING_FOR_STABILITY → STABLE | NOT_CONVERGED, repeated for each of the 9 levels. The run ends in one of:
** CALIBRATION_COMPLETE, with finalStatus COMPLETED or NOT_CONVERGED (NOT_CONVERGED when every tested level was NOT_CONVERGED);
** HDT_LIMIT_REACHED (finalStatus HDT_LIMIT_REACHED);
** ABORTED (ABORTED_BY_USER);
** SENSOR_ERROR (SENSOR_ERROR).
# {{Start}} refusals:
** Thread alive: "HDT calibration already running".
** HdtC null: "Invalid material HDT".
** HdtC outside 30..200: "Invalid material HDT {hdt} (30-200degC)" (invariant culture, e.g. "Invalid material HDT 20 (30-200degC)").
** {{!probe.Status().Ch1Available}}: "PicoLog TC-08 CH1 has no valid temperature - " + (error ?? "not connected").
** {{AnyProcessActive}} (exceptions ignored): "A cure process is active - stop it before HDT calibration".
** Success: reset the state and apply the overrides. SafetyMarginC defaults to 2.0; every other parameter falls back to its current value, which is the default after the reset. State STARTING_CALIBRATION, message "Starting calibration", startedAt = local now, Running = true before the thread "hdt-calibration" starts. Returns "HDT calibration started".
# {{Abort()}}: cancel and immediately {{SetUv(false,0,Nm405)}}; returns "Abort requested - LEDs off". {{Reset()}}: false while the thread is alive, else reset to IDLE ("Idle").
# {{Tick()}}, once per sample:
** Wait samplingIntervalSec (cancel → Abort).
** Re-assert the heater fan at 100 % when ≥ 5 s have passed since the last time. {{HeaterFan(pwm>0)}} first calls {{CancelHeaterFanCooldown()}}, then {{SetHeaterFan}}; heaterFanPwm = pwm if ok, else 0.
** Read the probe. A Temperature that is null or not finite → SensorException(error ?? "invalid CH1 temperature").
** Moving average over the last n = max(1, round(window/interval)) raw values.
** Update lastRaw/lastAvg/maxMeasured (2 dp).
** Append an HdtSample: T = seconds since t0 (1 dp), Ts local "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss", Power = current, Step = stepIndex, State, Outputs = ScaledOutputs(power, factors).
** avg ≥ HdtC → HdtLimitException.
# Run:
** t0 = now; factors = {{LedFactors}}; heater fan 100 %.
** The results list holds every level as NOT_TESTED with its Outputs.
** 3 seed ticks; baseline = the last avg.
** For each level i: stepIndex = i, PrepareLevel, TestLevel. Then {{Finish("CALIBRATION_COMPLETE", null)}}.
# PrepareLevel:
** Skipped for i == 0 or when nextStepMaxTempDeltaC ≤ 0 (the default: the LEDs stay on, a direct transition).
** Otherwise: LEDs off, state PREPARING_POWER_LEVEL, message "Cooling toward {limit:0.0}degC before the {p}% level", where limit = baseline + delta. Tick until avg ≤ limit or cooldownMaxWaitMin passes (a timeout just continues).
# TestLevel:
** Result → RUNNING with StartTemp = lastAvg and StartedAt. State TESTING_POWER_LEVEL, message "Applying {p}% calibrated system power".
** {{SetUv(true,p,Nm405)}}; a refusal → SensorException "LED command refused: …".
** State WAITING_FOR_STABILITY, message "Waiting for thermal stabilization".
** Loop:
*** Tick, then add (t since t0, avg) to the window. Drop points older than needSec + interval, where needSec = stabilityTimeMin × 60.
*** Track min and max.
*** covered = the window spans ≥ needSec AND the step has run ≥ needSec.
*** rate = {{SlopePerMinute(window)}}.
*** PASS when covered && {{IsStable(window, needSec, band, maxRate)}}: StableTemp = the window mean, Min/Max of the window, TimeToStability = DurationSec = step seconds (1 dp), Rate (3 dp), EndedAt; state STABLE, message "{p}% stable at {x:0.0}degC".
*** NOT_CONVERGED after maxStabilizationTimeMin × 60 s: Min/Max of the whole step, Duration, EndedAt; message "{p}% did not converge within {N:0} min".
** {{finally}} fills in a missing Duration, EndedAt and MaxTemp.
# Exceptions:
** Abort: LEDs off, the current step → ABORTED, Finish(ABORTED, ABORTED_BY_USER).
** HdtLimit: LEDs off, step → HDT_LIMIT, Finish(HDT_LIMIT_REACHED, HDT_LIMIT_REACHED).
** Sensor: step → ABORTED, Finish(SENSOR_ERROR, SENSOR_ERROR, message).
** Other: as sensor, with message "internal error: …".
** A step is marked only while it is RUNNING or NOT_TESTED.
# Finish:
** LEDs off, heater fan 0.
** limit = HdtC − margin. recommendedPower = the highest PASS level with StableTemp ≤ limit.
** boost = BoostEstimate(limit); an exception gives a note "not available: …".
** endedAt; totalElapsed; message = given ?? "Calibration finished: {finalStatus}".
# BoostEstimate (p = boostPower, t0 = boostStartTempC):
*** No limit → note "no HDT limit". limit ≤ t0 → note "lower HDT limit {x:0.0}degC is not above {t0:0}degC".
*** Measured: if level p was tested, take the trace (samples with Step == idx and Power == p, as (T, Avg)). If it has ≥ 2 points and starts ≤ t0 + 0.5:
**** TimeSec = first T with avg ≥ limit minus first T with avg ≥ t0, when both exist and the first is ≥ the second. Method "measured".
**** Else, if the stable temp < limit: Method measured, note "{p}% stabilizes at {x}degC - below the lower HDT limit, never reaches it".
*** Estimated: needs ≥ 2 PASS levels with Stable, Start and TimeToStability > 0, else note "{p}% not tested and too few stabilized levels to estimate".
**** tEq = {{EquilibriumAt}} (a least-squares line of power vs stable temperature).
**** tau = the mean of {{TimeConstant}} over those levels. None → note "could not fit a thermal time constant".
**** Method "estimated", ModelEqTempC (1 dp), ModelTauSec (1 dp).
**** tEq ≤ limit → note "model: {p}% would stabilize at ~{tEq}degC, below the lower HDT limit - never reaches it".
**** Else TimeSec = {{BoostTimeSec}} (1 dp), note "estimated from a first-order model (tau {tau:0}s, {p}% equilibrium ~{tEq:0.0}degC)" + " - the {p}% step started above {t0}degC" (if tested) or " - {p}% was not tested".
# HdtModel:
*** Slope: least squares with x in minutes from the first t; null for n < 2 or a zero denominator.
*** IsStable: the span ≥ stabilityTimeSec, max − min ≤ band, and (only when maxRate > 0) |slope| ≤ maxRate.
*** TimeConstant: null when the rise is < 1 °C or the trace is empty; else the time from trace[0] to the first avg ≥ start + 0.632 × (stable − start), or null.
*** BoostTimeSec = τ·ln((Teq−T0)/(Teq−TL)), or null when Teq ≤ TL.
# Status(samplesFrom):
*** stepElapsed is measured from stepT0. totalElapsed is live while running, else the stored value.
*** factors = the run's factors ?? the current {{LedFactors}}. outputs = ScaledOutputs(currentPower ?? 0).
*** startedAt/endedAt use local format "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.ffffff". totalSteps = 9. picolog = the probe status.
*** samples = the list from index samplesFrom (null when the parameter is absent).
# CSV ({{\n}} line endings, comma separated; a cell containing {{,}}, {{"}} or {{\n}} is quoted with {{""}} escaping; doubles invariant; null → empty):
*** Metadata lines: {{# sCure Material HDT Calibration Report}}, {{# Started,<ts>}}, {{# Ended,<ts>}}, {{# Device,<info>,Channel,CH1}}, {{# Material HDT degC,<hdt>,Safety Margin degC,<m>}}, {{# Final Status,<final ?? state>}}, {{# Recommended System LED Power %,<rec>}}, {{# Max Measured Temp degC,<max>}}, then a blank line.
*** {{# Per-level results}}, then the header {{System Power %,Status,Start Temp degC,Stable Temp degC,Min Temp degC,Max Temp degC,Time To Stability s,Duration s,Started,Ended,Back Output %,Door Output %,Left Output %,Right Output %}} and one row per level, then a blank line.
*** Sample header {{Timestamp,Elapsed Time s,Test Step,Requested System LED Power %,Back LED Factor,Door LED Factor,Left LED Factor,Right LED Factor,Actual Back LED Output %,Actual Door LED Output %,Actual Left LED Output %,Actual Right LED Output %,Raw CH1 Temperature degC,Average Temperature degC,Material HDT degC,HDT Safety Margin degC,Stability Status,Test Status}}. Test Step = step + 1 (empty for −1). Test Status = that level's current status.
# Endpoints:
*** {{POST /api/dev/hdt/start}} (JSON HdtStartRequest; empty body → defaults) → {{{ok,message[,code]}}}.
*** {{POST /api/dev/hdt/abort}} → {{{ok:true,message:"Abort requested - LEDs off"}}}.
*** {{POST /api/dev/hdt/reset}} → {{{ok, message: null | "Calibration is running"}}}.
*** {{GET /api/dev/hdt/status?samplesFrom=N}}.
*** {{GET /api/dev/hdt/report.csv}} → text/csv attachment "hdt-calibration.csv" (and it logs "Report exported").
*** {{POST /api/dev/led-power}} is refused while HDT runs ("HDT calibration is running - abort it first").
# LED calibration layer (reference {{led_calibration.py}}; the C# store is in Platform): zones back/door/left/right; factor default 1.0, valid 0.0..1.5, stored 4 dp; physical = round(clamp(power × factor, 0, 100), 2). HDT only uses it through {{ScaledOutputs}} and {{LedFactors}}.
*Configuration:* none persistent. The run parameters come from the start request; the defaults are the constants above.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Simulated run (noise 0, seed 1; StabilityTimeMin 0.5, MaxStabilizationTimeMin 5, MaxRate 0.5, HDT 50):
** state and finalStatus HDT_LIMIT_REACHED; RecommendedPower 40;
** results[0] PASS with stable in [29,30]; results[3] PASS; results[4] HDT_LIMIT; results[5] NOT_TESTED;
** MaxMeasured ≥ 50; Boost.Method "estimated" with TimeSec > 0;
** SampleCount == Samples.Count; HeaterFanPwm 0 at the end; UV off; EndedAt set; PowerLevels as listed;
** the CSV starts with "# sCure Material HDT Calibration Report\n" and contains "# Recommended System LED Power %,40\n" and "10,PASS,".
* While running: the heater fan duty is 100 % and the state is WAITING_FOR_STABILITY. Abort → ABORTED / ABORTED_BY_USER, results[0] ABORTED, fan 0, UV off.
* The refusal messages are exactly those in rule 2.
*Tests:* {{HdtCalibrationTests}} (Simulated_run_reaches_a_recommendation, Heater_fan_is_held_at_full_speed_during_the_run, Start_refusals, plus the probe tests of DVT-06) using {{ProcessRig.AdvanceUntil(cond, max, step 1 s)}}; Domain {{HdtModelTests}} (Slope_per_minute_of_a_linear_window, Stability_needs_the_window_the_band_and_the_rate, Equilibrium_line_and_time_constant, Boost_time_formula); {{HdtReportBuilderTests}} belongs to Reports.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Hdt/*.cs}} (except the TC-08 files), {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Control/HdtModel.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/DevEndpoints.cs}}, {{reference/hdt_calibration.py}}, {{reference/led_calibration.py}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Application.Tests/Process/HdtCalibrationTests.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Domain.Tests/Control/HdtModelTests.cs}}

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* DVT bench, Heating, Safety & watchdog, Simulator
*Blocked by:* DVT-08, DVT-01
*Blocks:* DVT-10
*Relates to:* DOM-09, PROC-03, PROC-08, HW-14
*Implements:* OD-72, OD-20, OD-70, OD-68, REQ-11, REQ-24

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Application/SCureBox.Application.csproj}} — {{Dvt/Bench/}}
*Goal:* Runs a whole catalog test from the bench process, with the TC-08 in its own hands and on its own clock. The test checks that pulling the heater thermistor (TEMP_CHAMBER) while heating cuts the heater, raises the alarm, refuses a new heat command, and does not resume by itself after the reconnect. The operator is guided by prompts. Every exit leaves the heater and UV off (through the firmware, else through the watchdog's cut) and gives the TC-08 back. A full simulated machine lets everything run without hardware.
*Depends on:* DVT-08, DVT-01 (DvtBench, IUvMeterSource), DVT-10 (the host).
*Files to create:* {{Dvt/Bench/BenchRunner.cs}} — {{BenchRunner}}; {{Dvt/Bench/SimulatedBenchWorld.cs}} — {{SimulatedBenchWorld}}.
*Public contract:*
```csharp
public sealed class BenchRunner {
  public const string Saf004 = "DVT-SAF-002";            // NB: constant name Saf004, value DVT-SAF-002
  public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> Tests = { Saf004 };
  public const double RiseSlopeCPerSec = 0.05, RiseWindowSec = 10, RiseTimeoutSec = 300, TurnDropC = 0.5, FirmwareUpTimeoutSec = 240;
  public const int HeaterSensorAlert = 9010;             // private const HeaterSensorAlertBeforeSplit = 9001 also accepted
  public BenchRunner(IFirmwareClient firmware, ITc08Source tc08, ISafetyNet net, TimeProvider timeProvider, ILogger<BenchRunner> log, DvtBench? bench = null);
  public bool Running { get; }
  public BenchRunStatus Status(bool samples = false);
  public BenchReply Start(BenchRequest req);
  public string Abort(string? by = null);
}
public sealed class SimulatedBenchWorld : IFirmwareClient, ITc08Source, IUvMeterSource, IFirmwareProcess, IJournalReader, ISafetyNet {
  public const double WatchdogSec = 20, SystemdWatchdogSec = 60, RestartSec = 3, RiseCPerSec = 0.8, FallCPerSec = 0.3, AmbientC = 24, UvMwCm2 = 90;
  public SimulatedBenchWorld(TimeProvider tp);
  public string UnitName => "scurebox-ui.service (simulated)";
  public double BodyC { get; } public void SetBody(double c); public Func<double?>? Ch1Override { get; set; }
  public bool HeaterOn { get; } public bool UvOn { get; } public bool SensorOpen { get; } public bool Released { get; } public bool SafetyCutUsed { get; }
  public void SetSensorOpen(bool open); public double ReleaseDelaySec { get; set; } public DvtBench FirmwareBench { get; }
  public IUvMeter OpenMeter();
}
```
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Start}} refusals:
** "a bench run is already in progress ({test})".
** An unknown test → "unknown bench test X - one of DVT-SAF-002".
** HeatTargetC outside 30..80 → "heat_target_c must be 30-80".
** Snapshot(3 s) not alive → "the firmware does not answer - the bench starts only from a running machine".
** RecipeState preflight/running/paused → "a program is running on the machine - stop it first".
** {{bench.TryAcquire("bench run")}} fails → "the bench is busy ({owner})".
** Success: thread "dvt-bench", status RUNNING, phase "starting", reply "DVT-SAF-002 started".
# {{Abort(by)}}: "no bench run in progress", or cancel and return "abort requested - outputs go off".
# Primitives:
** Period = 1/clamp(Hz,1,20); the clock is seconds since the thread start (3 dp).
** {{SetPhase(name, prompt)}} closes the previous phase (ToS) and opens a new {{BenchPhase}}; it sets Phase and Prompt.
** {{TakeSample(phase)}} reads the TC-08 (a failure → note) and {{Snapshot(1 s)}}, and appends a row with a null meter.
** {{Until(phase, done, timeout, ct, prompt)}} samples, then checks done, then the timeout, then waits one period (cancel → internal Aborted).
** {{Rising()}}: Slope over 10 s ≥ 0.05 °C/s AND last − first point in the window ≥ 0.5 °C.
** {{StillRising(since)}}: the slope over all points since then > 0.05 (needs ≥ 3 points).
# Prepare (phase "prepare"):
** The firmware must be alive ("the firmware does not answer").
** PicologRelease (a failure → "the firmware did not release the TC-08: …"). Poll Released every 250 ms for up to 10 s; when it is still not released, add the note "the firmware did not confirm the TC-08 release within 10 s - trying to open it anyway".
** 5 open attempts 1 s apart (failure → "TC-08 not usable on the bench: …").
** Read once: CH1 null → "TC-08 CH1 gives no reading - is the thermocouple on CH1?".
** If it looks open: read 3 more times, 1 s apart.
*** The readings jump > 5 → BenchException "CH1 reads X C and jumps by J C in 3 s while the TC-08's own terminal block is at Y C and nothing is running - the thermocouple is open or badly seated, not hot. Reseat it on the heater body before the run".
*** Otherwise note "CH1 at X C with nothing running but steady (moved J C in 3 s) - a heater body still hot from an earlier test, not an open probe".
# EnsureIdleAndCool:
** Heating or UV on → StopAll and note "outputs were on - stopped".
** ChamberSensorOk == false → "the heater thermistor (TEMP_CHAMBER) is not reading - reconnect it before the run".
** If the chamber or the TC-08 body is > CooldownBelowC (60): note "… - waiting for both to fall below 60 C", e.g. "heater body at 119.x C - waiting for both…". Then {{Until("cooldown", both ≤ limit or null, CooldownMaxSec)}}; a timeout → "the chamber / heater body did not cool below 60 C in 20 min".
# StartHeatAndWaitRising:
** {{Heat(target)}}; a refusal → "the heater did not start: …". Set outputsMayBeOn and mark "heat_on".
** {{Until("heating_wait_rise", Rising, 300 s)}}; a timeout → "the heater body did not rise (0.05 C/s over 10 s) within 300 s - is the thermocouple on the heater body?".
# The DVT-SAF-002 sequence ({{RunSaf004}}):
** Prepare → EnsureIdleAndCool → StartHeatAndWaitRising.
** {{Until("prompt_disconnect", ChamberSensorOk == false, OperatorTimeoutSec, prompt "DISCONNECT THE HEATER THERMISTOR (TEMP_CHAMBER) NOW")}}. A timeout → "the machine did not see the heater thermistor open within {N:0} s".
** Mark "disconnect" (t0). Values: {{disconnect_timestamp}} (local ISO "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffK") and {{heater_temp_at_disconnect}} (the last CH1, 2 dp).
** {{WatchTurn("watch_cut", t0, CutTimeoutSec)}} finds {{Turn(ch1, t0, 0.5)}}. On every sample, collect the alert codes; at the first 9010/9001, mark "alarm". If no alarm yet: {{WatchFor("watch_alarm", 5 s)}}.
** Values: {{heater_body_drop_observed}} (turn found), {{heater_off_time}} (turn.T − t0, 2 dp, or null), {{heater_temp_peak}} (turn.V, 2 dp), {{alarm_raised}}, {{error_code}} (the sorted codes joined ", ", or ""), {{time_to_alarm_s}} (2 dp, only when raised). With no turn, add the note "no rise-to-fall turn on the heater body within N s of the disconnection".
** Alarm text = {{ErrorText(active)}} + " " + AlertDetails[active], where active = 9001 only if 9001 is present without 9010, else 9010. {{alarm_text_instructs_reconnect}} = raised && regex {{reconnect|re-connect|cable|connector|plug}} (case-insensitive). {{alarm_text}} = the trimmed text.
** Phase "inhibit": {{Heat(target)}} again. refused = !Ok; when accepted, add the note "the firmware ACCEPTED a heat command with the thermistor open - stopping it" and StopAll. Then {{WatchFor("inhibit_watch", 10 s)}}. {{heat_start_inhibited}} = refused && !StillRising; {{heat_command_reply}} = the message.
** {{Until("prompt_reconnect", ChamberSensorOk == true, OperatorTimeoutSec, prompt "RECONNECT THE HEATER THERMISTOR NOW")}}; a timeout → "the machine did not see the thermistor back within N s". Mark "reconnect".
** {{WatchFor("watch_resume", 20 s)}}: resumed if any sample is Heating or StillRising(tBack); alarmCleared once a sample has no 9010/9001. Values {{recovery_requires_ack}} = !resumed, {{alarm_cleared_after_reconnect}}, {{test_method}} = "thermistor disconnected and reconnected by the operator on the bench's prompts; everything else measured by the DVT bench process on the machine's clock (TC-08 CH1 at the heater body, firmware state at 5 Hz)".
# {{finally}} Cleanup:
** Snapshot(3 s); while dead, retry every 1 s for up to 15 s.
** If alive: StopAll (a failure → note) and RecipeAbort.
** Else, if outputsMayBeOn: note "firmware not answering with outputs possibly on - watchdog cut: " + {{net.CutNow()}}.
** Dispose the TC-08; PicologResume if it was released and the firmware is alive.
** {{bench.Release("bench run")}}.
** Status ABORTED (cancelled) / ERROR / OK; phase "done"; prompt null; close the last phase.
** BenchExceptions → the error message; others are logged.
# {{FirmwareUpTimeoutSec}} (240), {{IFirmwareProcess}}, {{IJournalReader}} and the BenchRequest fields {{UvIntensity}}/{{UvWavelengthNm}} are defined but not used by the only implemented test. OPEN QUESTION: they are meant for future bench tests (hang/kill tests); keep them in the contract.
# SimulatedBenchWorld:
*** A lazy {{Tick()}} on every call. Body += 0.8·dt while the SSR heater is on, else −min(0.3·dt, body − 24). Chamber +0.05·dt while on, else −min(0.02·dt, chamber − 24).
*** Alive and not frozen: sensor open with heat commanded → heater off and alert 9010 added; sensor closed → 9010 removed.
*** Output watchdog: silent (frozen or dead) ≥ 20 s with an output on → both SSRs off and a journal line "[WATCHDOG] TRIPPED - firmware silent for X s: heaters + UV LEDs OFF (verified)".
*** systemd: frozen ≥ 60 s → dead, restart in 3 s. Kill → restart in 3 s. A restart gives pid+1 with all outputs off.
*** Snapshot: Dead when not alive or frozen; else (true, heaterCmd, uvCmd, chamber (null if the sensor is open), !SensorOpen, door closed true, alerts, details {"9010": "Heater temperature sensor (chamber NTC TEMP_CHAMBER) is not reading - the heater is off"}, "idle", "sim", false).
*** Heat: throws BenchException "firmware not answering" when dead; sensor open → (false, "[9010] Heater temperature sensor (chamber NTC TEMP_CHAMBER) is not reading - reconnect the sensor before heating"); else (true, "Heating").
*** Uv/StopAll behave the same way; RecipeAbort → (true, "no program").
*** PicologReleased = released and ≥ ReleaseDelaySec since the release.
*** ClaimBench/ReleaseBench use the {{FirmwareBench}} lease ("the DVT bench is busy ({owner})").
*** ErrorText(9010) = "Chamber Temperature Sensor Disconnected. Check the chamber thermistor (TEMP_CHAMBER) cable and its connector on the IO board. The alert clears by itself once the sensor reads again".
*** TC-08 Open throws "no TC-08 found (unplugged, or still held by the firmware?)" unless released. Session Info "PicoLog TC-08 (SIMULATED)"; Read = (Ch1Override ?? body (3 dp), chamber (2 dp), 24).
*** Meter: Identify {Transport "simulated", Head "PD300RM-8W SIM", WavelengthNm 405}; power 90 with the UV on, else 0.002.
*** CutNow sets SafetyCutUsed, turns the SSRs off, and returns "manual cut: heaters + UV LEDs OFF (verified)".
*Configuration:* none ({{SCURE_SIMULATE}} is read by the host, DVT-10).
*Acceptance criteria (simulation, FakeTimeProvider 2026-09-27 12:00Z, 100 ms pump):*
* End to end with the operator acting on the prompts:
** status OK; the prompt sequence is exactly [DISCONNECT…, RECONNECT…];
** heater_body_drop_observed true; heater_off_time in [0,0.5]; heater_temp_peak in [28,31];
** alarm_raised true; error_code "9010"; alarm_text_instructs_reconnect true; heat_start_inhibited true; recovery_requires_ack true; alarm_cleared_after_reconnect true;
** disconnect_timestamp starts "2026-09-27T"; marks disconnect > heat_on and reconnect > alarm; the phase heating_wait_rise exists;
** Columns match; > 100 samples; heater off; TC-08 not released; no safety cut.
* Body at 120 °C: the run is not refused. It notes "steady"/"still hot" and "heater body at 1…waiting for both", goes through cooldown, ends OK, and heating_wait_rise starts after more than 150 s.
* A floating CH1 (236.1, 181.0, 230.4, 122.7 repeating) → ERROR containing "jumps by" and "open or badly seated"; the heater never on; the TC-08 returned.
* ReleaseDelaySec 4 → the run still opens the TC-08 (Tc08 "PicoLog TC-08 (SIMULATED)") and reaches heating_wait_rise.
* OperatorTimeoutSec 20 with no operator → ERROR starting "the machine did not see the heater thermistor open within 20 s"; heater off.
* Abort while heating → ABORTED, heater off, TC-08 returned. Abort again → "no bench run in progress".
* Refusals: an unknown test, and heat 90 → "heat_target_c must be 30-80".
*Tests:* {{BenchRunnerTests}} (all 8 facts named in the source).
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Application/Dvt/Bench/BenchRunner.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Dvt/Bench/SimulatedBenchWorld.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Application.Tests/Process/BenchRunnerTests.cs}}

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Bench/}}; {{deploy/scurebox-dvt-bench.service}}
*Goal:* Hosts the bench runner and recorder as their own ASP.NET Core process: {{scurebox --dvt-bench}}. It is separate from the firmware, so it keeps measuring while the firmware is hung, killed or restarting. It serves {{/bench/*}} to the DVT web page and reaches the firmware only through its HTTP API on :3001. In simulation it runs against {{SimulatedBenchWorld}}, with {{/bench/sim/*}} to play the operator.
*Depends on:* DVT-08, DVT-09, DVT-01, Api ({{CommandLine}} dispatch of {{--dvt-bench}}; {{ApiJson}}, {{Query}}, {{ScureConsoleFormatter}}, {{CommandLine.ReadAppVersion}}), Hardware (the {{scurebox --watchdog --cut-now}} CLI), Deploy-Ops (install of the unit).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Bench/DvtBenchHost.cs}} — {{DvtBenchHost}}
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Bench/HttpFirmwareClient.cs}} — {{HttpFirmwareClient}}, {{WatchdogCutSafetyNet}}
* {{deploy/scurebox-dvt-bench.service}}
*Public contract:*
```csharp
public static class DvtBenchHost {
  public const int DefaultPort = 3002;
  public static int Run(string[] args, TextWriter stderr);   // args after "--dvt-bench"
  public static WebApplication Build(int port, string firmwareUrl, Action<WebApplicationBuilder>? configure = null, bool? simulate = null);
}
public sealed class HttpFirmwareClient : IFirmwareClient { public HttpFirmwareClient(string baseUrl); }
public sealed class WatchdogCutSafetyNet : ISafetyNet { public string CutNow(); }
```
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Run}}:
** Parse {{--port <int>}} (invariant) and {{--firmware <url>}} (default {{http://127.0.0.1:3001}}).
** Anything else → write "usage: scurebox --dvt-bench [--port <n>] [--firmware <url>]" to stderr and return 2.
** Otherwise {{Build(...).Run()}} and return 0.
** {{CommandLine}} dispatches the first argument {{--dvt-bench}} to {{DvtBenchHost.Run(args[1..], stderr)}}.
# {{Build}}:
** {{UseUrls("http://*:{port}")}}; console logging with {{ScureConsoleFormatter}} (timestamp "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss "); CORS allowing any origin, method and header; {{TimeProvider.System}}.
** sim = the {{simulate}} parameter, or else env {{SCURE_SIMULATE}} not in ("", "0", "false").
** sim: one {{SimulatedBenchWorld}} registered as IFirmwareClient, ITc08Source, IUvMeterSource and ISafetyNet. Real: {{HttpFirmwareClient(firmwareUrl)}}, {{Tc08Source}}, {{StarBrightUsbSource}}, {{WatchdogCutSafetyNet}}.
** Always: singletons {{DvtBench}}, {{BenchRunner}}, {{BenchRecorder}}; then {{configure?.Invoke}}.
** Log a warning "[BENCH] DVT bench {version} on port {port}, firmware at {url}{ (SIMULATED)}".
# Endpoints (JSON via {{ApiJson.Json}}, HTTP 200):
** {{GET /bench/status}} → {{{ok:true, version, simulated, tests:["DVT-SAF-002"], firmware_alive, firmware_version, run: <BenchRunStatus without samples>}}} (Snapshot with a 2 s timeout).
** {{POST /bench/run?test=&heat_target=80&uv_intensity=100&uv_wavelength=405&hz=5&operator_timeout=180&cut_timeout=90&cooldown_max=1200&cooldown_below=60}} → {{{ok,message}}}.
** {{GET /bench/run?samples=}} ({{Query.On}}, default "1", so samples are included unless 0/false/off) → BenchRunStatus.
** {{POST /bench/run/abort?by=}} (default User-Agent, else "api") → {{{ok:true,message}}}.
** {{POST /bench/record/start?label=&tc08=1&meter=0&hz=5&max_s=10800}} (tc08 uses {{OnLoose}} with default "1"; meter uses {{OnLoose}} with default "0") → {{{ok,message}}}.
** {{POST /bench/record/mark?name=}} → {{{ok,message}}}.
** {{POST /bench/record/stop}} → {{{ok,message}}}.
** {{GET /bench/record?samples=&from=0}} → RecordStatus.
** Sim only:
*** {{POST /bench/sim/heat?on=1|0}} → Heat(80) or StopAll → {{{ok,message}}};
*** {{POST /bench/sim/sensor?open=1|0}} → {{{ok:true,sensor_open}}};
*** {{GET /bench/sim}} → {{{ok:true,body_c,heater_on,uv_on,sensor_open}}}.
** Query semantics: {{On}} is false only for "0", "false", "off". {{OnLoose}} is false for "0", "false", "". A malformed number throws {{ArgumentException("Invalid {key} '…'")}}.
# HttpFirmwareClient: {{HttpClient}} with BaseAddress = url (trailing "/" added) and Timeout 10 s.
** {{Snapshot(timeout)}}: {{GET api/state}} with a CTS of {{timeout}}; any failure → {{FirmwareSnapshot.Dead}}. Field mapping:

     | Snapshot field | Taken from {{/api/state}} |
     | Heating | {{isHeating}} (true only) |
     | UvOn | {{uvOn}} |
     | ChamberC | {{chamberTemp}} (number) |
     | ChamberSensorOk | {{sensors.chamber.ok}} (bool or null) |
     | DoorClosed | {{doorClosed}} (bool or null) |
     | Alerts | {{alerts}} (int array) |
     | AlertDetails | {{alertDetails}} (string values) |
     | RecipeState | {{recipe.state}} |
     | Version | {{version}} |
     | DoorAborted | {{doorAborted}} |

** POSTs with no body:

     | Method | Request |
     | Heat | {{api/cure/heat?target={invariant}}} |
     | Uv | {{api/uv?on=1/0&intensity=&wavelength=}} |
     | StopAll | {{api/cure/stop?immediate=1}} |
     | RecipeAbort | {{api/recipe/abort}} |
     | PicologRelease | {{api/dev/picolog/release}} |
     | PicologResume | {{api/dev/picolog/resume}} |
     | ClaimBench | {{api/dvt/bench/claim?who={escaped}&lease_s={invariant}}} |
     | ReleaseBench | {{api/dvt/bench/release?who=}} |

     The reply is {{ok}} = (JSON {{ok}} == true) and message = {{message}} ?? ("ok" | "HTTP {code}"). A body that is not JSON → (false, "HTTP {code}: {first 120 chars}"). A transport error → (false, exception message).
** {{PicologReleased()}} = {{GET api/dev/picolog/status}} with connected false and error containing "released" (case-insensitive); exceptions → false.
** {{ErrorText(code)}}: loaded lazily once, under a lock, from {{GET config/errors.json}}. For each item of {{errors[]}}, {{code}} maps to the join of {{message}}, {{description}} and the {{troubleshooting[]}} strings (non-empty ones, space-separated). A failure leaves the map empty, so the result is null.
# WatchdogCutSafetyNet.CutNow: run {{{AppContext.BaseDirectory}/scurebox}} ({{scurebox.exe}} on Windows) with args {{--watchdog --cut-now}}. Redirect stdout and stderr, read both to the end, {{WaitForExit(20000)}}, and return the trimmed output. A failed start → IOException "scurebox --watchdog --cut-now did not start".
# The systemd unit, exactly:
** {{[Unit]}}: Description "sCureBox DVT bench - runs DVT catalog tests on the machine with the TC-08 / StarBright, separate from the firmware"; {{Documentation=file:///opt/scurebox/docs/01-api-contract.md}}; {{After=network.target}}. It is deliberately NOT bound to scurebox-ui.service / scurebox.service.
** {{[Service]}}: {{Type=simple}}, {{User=root}}, {{WorkingDirectory=/opt/scurebox}}, {{ExecStart=/opt/scurebox/scurebox --dvt-bench --port 3002 --firmware http://127.0.0.1:3001}}, {{Environment=SCURE_COMPONENTS=/etc/scurebox/components.json}}, {{Environment=DOTNET_gcServer=0}}, {{Restart=always}}, {{RestartSec=3}}.
** {{[Install]}}: {{WantedBy=multi-user.target}}.
** root is needed for USB access to the TC-08 and the StarBright.
*Configuration:* CLI {{--port}} (3002), {{--firmware}} (http://127.0.0.1:3001); env {{SCURE_SIMULATE}}; {{SCURE_COMPONENTS}} is set by the unit (not read by the bench code itself; OPEN QUESTION whether anything in the bench path reads it); the app version comes from {{CommandLine.ReadAppVersion(AppContext.BaseDirectory)}} (the VERSION file).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Simulated host on TestServer:
** {{/bench/status}} gives ok, simulated true, firmware_alive true, tests containing DVT-SAF-002, run.status IDLE.
** An unknown test → ok false. {{test=DVT-SAF-002&heat_target=70}} → ok; a second start → ok false.
** {{/bench/run?samples=0}} has running true, config.heat_target_c 70, and the keys phase, prompt, values, marks, notes, phases, columns, n_samples, last.
** Abort → within 30 s status ABORTED, phase done, {{/bench/sim}} heater_on false.
* Recorder over HTTP: the idle document has the keys running, status, label, phase, clock, t0_unix, marks, events, notes, columns, n_samples, last. Start with tc08=1&meter=1, sim heat on, a mark "heat", then stop → OK; the events contain heating_on; t0_unix is a number; marks has "heat"; a sample row has 11 columns.
* {{Build(0, "http://127.0.0.1:1", UseTestServer, simulate:false)}} resolves BenchRecorder and BenchRunner without hardware. This is a regression test: 1.0.44 shipped without an IUvMeterSource registration.
*Tests:* {{DvtBenchHostTests}} (IAsyncLifetime host built with {{simulate: true}} on TestServer: Status_run_and_abort, Recorder_answers_with_events_and_clock_origin, The_real_bench_process_can_build_its_services_without_hardware).

*Goal:* Build the single firmware process: resolve host settings from the environment, configure Kestrel, systemd integration,
house-style console logging, CORS and JSON options, register all firmware layers in DI, install middleware and map every
endpoint group, then run the boot / graceful-shutdown hooks. Also provide the non-server command-line tool modes of the
{{scurebox}} executable.

{{OutputWatchdog}}, {{HeartbeatFile}}, {{OutputFreeze}}); Application-Process ({{AddSCureBoxProcess}}, {{ICureController}}, {{IHeatingLoop}},
{{RecipeValidator}}, {{StripStatus}}); Application-Platform ({{AddSCureBoxPlatform}}, {{DataOptions}}, {{DatabaseOptions}},
{{InternetReachability}}, {{ILedCalibrationStore}}, {{ICureRunStore}}, {{IComponentCounters}}, {{HeaterRunOnMarker}}, {{UpdatePackageBuilder}});
Dvt-Hdt ({{Bench.DvtBenchHost.Run}}); Native UI (consumes {{Build(args, configure)}} and {{IApiEndpointMapper}}); Deploy-Ops (systemd units).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web}}; {{RootNamespace=SCureBox.Api}}, {{AssemblyName=scurebox}},
  {{PublishTrimmed=false}}, {{StaticWebAssetsEnabled=false}}; PackageReference {{Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.Systemd}} 10.0.13;
  ProjectReference {{../SCureBox.Application/SCureBox.Application.csproj}}; Content items: {{../../ui/dist/**/*}} linked as
  {{wwwroot/%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)}} (only when {{../../ui/dist/index.html}} exists), {{../../config/**/*}} linked as
  {{config/...}}, {{../../VERSION}} linked as {{VERSION}}; all {{CopyToOutputDirectory/CopyToPublishDirectory=PreserveNewest}}.
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/appsettings.json}} — {{Logging:LogLevel:Default=Information}}, {{Logging:LogLevel:Microsoft.AspNetCore=Warning}}, {{AllowedHosts=*}}.
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/GITINFO}} — two lines: short git commit, commit date ({{yyyy-MM-dd}}) (written by the build/deploy scripts; read by the system service for {{/api/system/version}} — OPEN QUESTION: the reader lives in Application-Platform {{ISystemService}}; confirm there).

* {{src/SCureBox.Api/ScureApiHost.cs}} — {{public static class ScureApiHost}} with {{public static WebApplication Build(string[] args, Action<WebApplicationBuilder>? configure = null)}}; {{public interface IApiEndpointMapper { void Map(RouteGroupBuilder api); }}} (namespace {{SCureBox.Api}}).

* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/CommandLine.cs}} — {{public static class CommandLine}} with {{static bool TryRun(string[] args, TextWriter stdout, TextWriter stderr, out int exitCode)}} and {{static string ReadAppVersion(string baseDir)}}.

*Public contract:*

DatabaseUrl}}, {{string UiDir}} (default {{<base>/wwwroot}}).
* {{ScureApiHost.Build(args, configure)}} returns a built-but-not-running {{WebApplication}}.
* {{IApiEndpointMapper.Map(RouteGroupBuilder api)}} — every DI-registered mapper is called once under the {{/api}} group.
* Command line ({{Program}}): {{scurebox --version}} | {{--watchdog [args]}} | {{--dvt-bench [args]}} | {{--make-update-package <folder> <privateKeyPem> <out.scu>}} | anything else / no args → server.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Program}}: call {{CommandLine.TryRun(args, Console.Out, Console.Error, out exit)}}; if true return {{exit}}; else {{ScureApiHost.Build(args).Run(); return 0;}}.
# {{CommandLine.TryRun}}: empty args → false. {{args[0]}} switch: {{--version}} → print {{ReadAppVersion(AppContext.BaseDirectory)}}, exit 0; {{--watchdog}} → {{exitCode = SCureBox.Hardware.Safety.OutputWatchdog.Run(args[1..], stdout, stderr)}}; {{--dvt-bench}} → {{exitCode = Bench.DvtBenchHost.Run(args[1..], stderr)}}; {{--make-update-package}} with fewer than 4 args → stderr {{usage: scurebox --make-update-package <folder> <privateKeyPem> <out.scu>}}, exit 2; otherwise {{UpdatePackageBuilder.Build(args[1], args[3], File.ReadAllText(args[2]))}} then stdout {{update package written: <full path of args[3]>}}; on IOException / UnauthorizedAccessException / CryptographicException / ArgumentException stderr {{package build failed: <message>}}, exit 1. Any other first arg → false (server starts; ASP.NET treats args as configuration).
# {{ReadAppVersion(baseDir)}}: trimmed content of {{<baseDir>/VERSION}} if present and non-empty (IO/permission errors ignored), else the assembly version {{ToString(3)}}, else {{"unknown"}}.
# {{HostSettings.FromConfiguration}}: {{PORT}} parsed as int > 0 else 3001; {{SCURE_SIMULATE}} truthy when trimmed lower-case value ∈ {{{1}},{{true}},{{yes}}}; {{SCURE_COMPONENTS}}, {{SCURE_DATA_DIR}}, {{DATABASE_URL}}, {{SCURE_UI_DIR}} used when non-blank (trimmed) else defaults ({{DatabaseUrl}} null).
# Kestrel: if configuration {{ASPNETCORE_URLS}} is blank → {{UseUrls("http://*:" + Port)}} (all interfaces, IPv4+IPv6). Always {{Host.UseSystemd()}}.
# Logging: {{ClearProviders()}}, {{AddConsole(o => o.FormatterName = "scure")}}, {{AddConsoleFormatter<ScureConsoleFormatter, ConsoleFormatterOptions>(o => o.TimestampFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss ")}}.
# {{ScureConsoleFormatter.Write}}: skip when the message is empty and there is no exception. Line = timestamp (UTC if {{UseUtcTimestamp}}, format default {{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss }}) + {{[}} + {{Tag(category)}} + {{] }} + level prefix ({{WARN }}, {{ERROR }}, {{CRITICAL }}, {{debug }} for Debug/Trace, nothing for Information) + message + (exception ? {{ | <ExceptionTypeName>: <exception message>}} : ``) + newline. No stack traces.
# {{Tag(category)}}: no {{.}} in the category → category verbatim (e.g. {{API}}, {{DVT}}). {{SCureBox.Api*}} → {{API}}; {{SCureBox.Hardware*}} → {{HW}}; {{SCureBox.Application.<Area>...}} → {{Supervision}}→{{SAFETY}}, {{Process}}/{{Devices}}→{{HW}}, {{Status}}→{{LED}}, {{Recipe}}→{{RECIPE}}, {{Hdt}}→{{HDT}}, {{Persistence}}→{{DATA}}, {{Platform}}→{{SYS}}, other → {{APP}}; {{Microsoft.Hosting*}} → {{HOST}}; other {{Microsoft.*}} / {{System.*}} → {{ASP}}; else category verbatim.
# CORS: {{AddCors(default policy AllowAnyOrigin + AllowAnyMethod + AllowAnyHeader)}}; {{app.UseCors()}}. (The UI uses the absolute base URL {{http://localhost:3001/api}}, so CORS must stay open.)
# {{ConfigureHttpJsonOptions}} copies from {{ApiJson.Options}}: PropertyNamingPolicy, DictionaryKeyPolicy, DefaultIgnoreCondition, NumberHandling, Encoder (API-02).
# DI registration order (order matters; later layers use TryAdd so earlier registrations win):
    a. {{AddSingleton(settings)}} (HostSettings);
    b. {{AddSCureBoxHardware(new HardwareOptions { ComponentsPath = settings.ComponentsPath, ForceSimulation = settings.Simulate, NativeDir = env SCURE_NATIVE_DIR or null when blank })}};
    c. {{AddSingleton<InternetReachability>(sp => () => sp.GetRequiredService<StripStatus>().InternetOk)}};
    d. {{AddSingleton(RecipeValidation.Create())}} — registered BEFORE {{AddSCureBoxProcess}} so it replaces the default validator (API-09);
    e. {{AddSCureBoxProcess()}};
    f. {{AddSCureBoxPlatform(new DataOptions { DataDir = settings.DataDir, ConfigDir = settings.ConfigDir }, new DatabaseOptions { ConnectionString = settings.DatabaseUrl })}};
    g. {{AddSingleton<RunIssueTracker>()}} (API-08);
    h. {{AddHostedService<SystemdWatchdogService>()}} (API-03);
    i. only when {{OperatingSystem.IsLinux()}} AND {{HeartbeatFile.ConfiguredPath()}} is non-null AND its directory exists: {{AddHostedService(sp => new HeartbeatService(logger, path, sp.GetService<OutputFreeze>()))}} (API-03);
    j. {{configure?.Invoke(builder)}} (the native UI adds its services here).
# Pipeline after {{builder.Build()}}: {{UseCors()}} → {{UseScureApi()}} (API-02) → {{UseDvtHangGate()}} (API-12) → {{var api = app.MapGroup("/api")}} → in this order {{StateEndpoints.Map}}, {{CureEndpoints.Map}}, {{HardwareEndpoints.Map}}, {{DiagnosticsEndpoints.Map}}, {{MaterialEndpoints.Map}}, {{HistoryEndpoints.Map}}, {{CureRunEndpoints.Map}}, {{SystemEndpoints.Map}}, {{NetworkEndpoints.Map}}, {{DevEndpoints.Map}}, {{DvtEndpoints.Map}}, {{RecipeEndpoints.Map}} → each {{IApiEndpointMapper}} from DI → {{StaticUi.Map(app, settings.UiDir)}} (API-04, last).
# Boot hooks (inside {{Build}}, after mapping): resolve {{ICureController}} and call {{SetLedFactors(ILedCalibrationStore.Factors)}} (persisted LED calibration applied at boot). Create {{HeaterRunOnMarker(DataOptions, TimeProvider?, ILogger<HeaterRunOnMarker>?)}}; if {{Take()}} returns a value ≥ 1 s → log warning {{heater fan run-on cut by the last stop: resuming it for {Sec:0} s}} and {{IHeatingLoop.StartRunOn(left)}}; exceptions logged as warning {{heater run-on resume failed}}, never thrown.
# {{ApplicationStopping}} hook, each step in its own try/catch (warning on failure): log {{shutting down: outputs off, data flushed}}; if {{IHeatingLoop.PendingRunOnSec()}} > 0 → {{runOn.Save(pending)}} + warning {{stopping with the heater fan run-on due ({Sec:0} s): it resumes on the next start}}; {{controller.Shutdown()}}; {{ICureRunStore.Flush()}}; {{IComponentCounters.Flush()}}.
# Startup log (category {{API}}): {{sCureBox {Version} starting - hardware: {Hw}, data: {Data}, ui: {Ui}}} with Hw = {{SIMULATION (forced)}} when {{Simulate}} else {{auto}}.
# No authentication, no API key, no PIN anywhere in the host (Developer Mode is a UI-side concept). OPEN QUESTION: none found in the API project; if the UI requires a PIN it is enforced only in the UI.
*Configuration:* env / host config {{PORT}} (3001), {{ASPNETCORE_URLS}} (overrides PORT binding; the shipped unit sets {{http://*:3001}}), {{SCURE_SIMULATE}} (off), {{SCURE_COMPONENTS}} ({{<app>/config/components.json}}; units use {{/etc/scurebox/components.json}}), {{SCURE_DATA_DIR}} ({{<app>/data}}; units {{/var/lib/scurebox}}), {{DATABASE_URL}} (none = file stores), {{SCURE_UI_DIR}} ({{<app>/wwwroot}}), {{SCURE_NATIVE_DIR}} (none = {{<app>/native}}), {{SCURE_HEARTBEAT_FILE}} (API-03), {{WATCHDOG_USEC}} (API-03). appsettings.json as above.

column4: API-02 HTTP infrastructure: JSON conventions, envelopes, query parsing, exception envelope, request log
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* API host & infrastructure, Errors & alerts
*Blocked by:* DOM-02
*Blocks:* API-01, API-04, API-05, API-06, API-07, API-08, API-09, API-10, API-11, API-12, DVT-02, DVT-03, DVT-04, DVT-05, DVT-10, UI-01, UI-08
*Relates to:* DOM-02, PROC-05
*Implements:* OD-63, OD-64, OD-65, OD-67, EP-04, REQ-20

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Infrastructure/}}
*Goal:* One place for the wire conventions every endpoint uses: serializer options, the lenient body reader, the
{{{ok, code?, message}}} envelopes and the hardware-refusal mapping, Flask-compatible query-string parsing, and the middleware that
turns unhandled exceptions into JSON envelopes and logs every request.
*Depends on:* Domain ({{OpResult}}, {{OpResult.SplitCode}}, {{ErrorCodes.HardwareRefused}} = 6015).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/ApiJson.cs}} — {{public static class ApiJson}}.
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/Query.cs}} — {{public static class Query}}.
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/ApiMiddleware.cs}} — {{public static class ApiMiddleware}} with extension {{UseScureApi(this IApplicationBuilder app)}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{ApiJson.Options}} ({{JsonSerializerOptions}}, from {{JsonSerializerDefaults.Web}}): {{PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase}}, {{DictionaryKeyPolicy = null}} (dictionary keys verbatim, e.g. {{FAN_HEATER}}, {{"9052"}}), {{DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.Never}} (nulls always written), {{NumberHandling = JsonNumberHandling.AllowReadingFromString}}, {{Encoder = JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping}} (so {{°C}}, {{—}} are written literally).
* {{Task<T?> ReadBodyAsync<T>(HttpRequest) where T : class}} — null when {{ContentLength == 0}} or the body is not valid JSON of the shape ({{JsonException}} caught). No Content-Type check.
* {{Task<JsonElement?> ReadObjectAsync(HttpRequest)}} — body as a JSON object element, null when absent / not an object.
* {{IResult Ok(string message)}} → {{{ok:true, message}}} (200).
* {{IResult Fail(string message, int? code = null, int status = 200)}} → {{{ok:false, code, message}}} when code given, else {{{ok:false, message}}} (no {{code}} key).
* {{IResult Envelope(OpResult r)}} → {{Ok(r.Message)}} or {{Fail(r.Message, r.Code)}}.
* {{IResult HwResult(OpResult r, string successMessage)}} → success: {{Ok(successMessage)}}; failure: message = {{r.Message}} or {{"Hardware refused the operation"}} when empty; {{(embedded, stripped) = OpResult.SplitCode(message)}}; {{Fail(stripped, embedded ?? r.Code ?? 6015)}}.
* {{IResult Json<T>(T value, int status = 200)}} — serialize with {{Options}}.
* {{string Num(double)}} — {{value.ToString("0.0###", InvariantCulture)}} (Python-like: {{60}} → {{"60.0"}}, {{62.5}} → {{"62.5"}}).
* {{Query.Str(req, key, fallback)}} — last value of the key, else fallback.
* {{Query.On(req, key, fallback = "1")}} — true unless value ∈ {{{0}},{{false}},{{off}}} (case-sensitive).
* {{Query.OnLoose(req, key, fallback = "0")}} — true unless value ∈ {{{0}},{{false}},`{{} — so }}off` counts as TRUE (Flask fidelity).
* {{Query.Double(req, key, fallback)}} — empty/absent → fallback; else invariant float parse, must be finite, else {{throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid {key} '{s}'")}}.
* {{Query.Int(req, key, fallback)}} — same with integer parse; malformed → {{ArgumentException("Invalid {key} '{s}'")}}.
* {{Query.IntOrNull(req, key)}} — null when absent or malformed.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Every {{/api}} response is written with {{ApiJson.Options}} (endpoints call {{ApiJson.Json}}/{{Ok}}/{{Fail}}).
# {{OpResult.SplitCode(reason)}}: when the reason is longer than 7 chars, starts with {{[}}, and the text between {{[}} and the first {{]}} parses as int → (code, rest trimmed at start); else (null, reason). Hardware/supervision refusals arrive as {{"[9001] ..."}} this way.
# {{UseScureApi}} middleware (logger category {{API}}): wraps {{next}}; catches any exception that is not {{OperationCanceledException}} while the response has not started: logs error {{{Method} {Path} failed}}, clears the response, and for paths starting with {{/api/}} or equal to {{/api}} (case-insensitive) writes {{ApiJson.Fail(e.Message)}} (HTTP 200, no code); for other paths writes 500 {{Internal server error}} (text). So a malformed numeric query ({{?target=abc}}) becomes {{200 {ok:false, message:"Invalid target 'abc'"}}}.
# After every request except exactly {{GET|POST /api/state}} (path equality, any method) it logs Information {{{Method} {Path}{Query} -> {Status} ({Ms} ms)}}.
# No SSE, no WebSocket, no authentication middleware.
*Configuration:* none.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{POST /api/cure/heat?target=abc}} → 200 {{{"ok":false,"message":"Invalid target 'abc'"}}}.
* Null-valued properties appear in JSON (e.g. {{/api/state}} {{targetTemp: null}}).
* {{Num(40)=="40.0"}}, {{Num(62.5)=="62.5"}}.
* {{On}} with {{off}} → false; {{OnLoose}} with {{off}} → true, with {{""}} → false.
* {{HwResult(Fail("[9001] Chamber sensor open"), ...)}} → {{{ok:false, code:9001, message:"Chamber sensor open"}}}; {{HwResult(Fail("Door open"))}} → code 6015.
* {{GET /api/state}} produces no request log line; other requests do.
*Tests:* Covered indirectly by {{CureTests.Invalid_parameters_are_rejected_with_the_registry_code}}, {{CureTests.Stop_is_always_ok_and_off_counts_as_immediate}}, {{CureTests.Door_open_..._refuses_a_start_with_6015}}. Add unit tests for {{Query}} (On/OnLoose/Double/Int/IntOrNull), {{ApiJson.Num}}, {{ApiJson.HwResult}} code extraction, and a middleware test that an endpoint throwing yields 200 JSON under {{/api}} and 500 text elsewhere.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/ApiJson.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/Query.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/ApiMiddleware.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Errors/ErrorCodes.cs}} ({{OpResult}}), {{docs/01-api-contract.md}} (Conventions).

---

column4: API-02.1 Implement ApiJson.Options and Json/Ok/Fail/Envelope helpers in Infrastructure/ApiJson.cs
column5: Web defaults with camelCase, DictionaryKeyPolicy null, nulls always written, AllowReadingFromString, UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping; Fail omits the code key when no code is given. Done when /api/state shows targetTemp:null and keys like FAN_HEATER verbatim.

column4: API-02.2 Implement ApiJson.HwResult code pass-through and ApiJson.Num formatting
column5: HwResult: OpResult.SplitCode embedded [NNNN] first, else r.Code, else 6015, default message 'Hardware refused the operation'; Num uses 0.0### invariant so 60 -> '60.0'. Done when [9001] maps to code 9001 with the prefix stripped.

column4: API-02.3 Implement lenient body readers ReadBodyAsync<T> and ReadObjectAsync
column5: Null when ContentLength is 0 or the JSON is invalid (JsonException caught), no Content-Type check; ReadObjectAsync returns only object elements.

column4: API-02.4 Implement Query.Str/On/OnLoose/Double/Int/IntOrNull with Flask-compatible parsing
column5: On false only for 0/false/off; OnLoose false only for 0/false/empty so 'off' is true; Double/Int throw ArgumentException "Invalid {key} '{s}'" for malformed or non-finite values; IntOrNull returns null instead.

column4: API-02.5 Implement UseScureApi middleware: exception envelope and request log
column5: Non-cancellation exceptions before the response starts: /api paths -> 200 {ok:false,message}, other paths -> 500 text; log '{Method} {Path}{Query} -> {Status} ({Ms} ms)' for every request except /api/state. Done when ?target=abc yields 200 Invalid target 'abc'.

column4: API-02.6 Add unit tests for Query, ApiJson.Num, ApiJson.HwResult and the middleware
column5: Cover On/OnLoose/Double/Int/IntOrNull edge cases, Num(40)=='40.0', HwResult code extraction (9001 vs 6015), and a throwing endpoint giving 200 JSON under /api and 500 text elsewhere; none of these exist today.

column4: API-03 Liveness services: systemd watchdog keep-alive and output-watchdog heartbeat
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Safety & watchdog, API host & infrastructure
*Blocked by:* HW-13, HW-14
*Blocks:* API-01, API-12, OPS-05
*Relates to:* HW-14, OPS-05, OPS-07, DVT-04, HW-13
*Implements:* OD-69, REQ-21, REQ-22

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Infrastructure/}}
*Goal:* Keep systemd's {{WatchdogSec=}} satisfied while the process is healthy, and write the heartbeat file that the separate
output watchdog ({{scurebox --watchdog}}, scurebox-watchdog.service) monitors: when the firmware crashes, is killed or hangs, the
heartbeat goes silent and the watchdog switches heaters and UV LEDs off after 20 s.
*Depends on:* API-01 (registration); Hardware ({{SCureBox.Hardware.Safety.HeartbeatFile}}, {{OutputFreeze}}, {{OutputWatchdog}}, {{WatchdogTripFile}}); Dvt-Hdt / API-12 (DVT hang sets {{OutputFreeze}}); Deploy-Ops (units).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/SystemdWatchdogService.cs}} — {{public sealed class SystemdWatchdogService : BackgroundService}}; ctor {{(ILogger<SystemdWatchdogService> log, ISystemdNotifier? notifier = null)}}; {{public static TimeSpan? ReadInterval(string? watchdogUsec)}}.
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/HeartbeatService.cs}} — {{public sealed class HeartbeatService : IHostedService, IDisposable}}; {{public static readonly TimeSpan Interval = 1 s}}; ctor {{(ILogger<HeartbeatService> log, string? path = null, OutputFreeze? freeze = null)}}; {{public string Path}}.
*Public contract:* hosted services only, no routes.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{ReadInterval(usec)}}: null when not a positive long; else {{TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(Math.Max(usec / 2000.0, 500))}} (half the timeout, never under 500 ms).
# {{SystemdWatchdogService.ExecuteAsync}}: interval read from env {{WATCHDOG_USEC}} in the ctor; returns immediately when no notifier, no interval, or {{!SystemdHelpers.IsSystemdService()}}. Else logs {{systemd watchdog armed - keepalive every {Interval}}} and on a {{PeriodicTimer}} sends {{_notifier.Notify(new ServiceState("WATCHDOG=1"))}} until cancelled.
# {{HeartbeatService}} path: ctor argument, else {{HeartbeatFile.ConfiguredPath()}} (env {{SCURE_HEARTBEAT_FILE}}; {{off}} disables → null), else {{HeartbeatFile.DefaultPath}} = {{/run/scurebox-heartbeat}}.
# {{StartAsync}}: write one beat immediately, start a background thread named {{heartbeat}} that beats every {{Interval}} until stop; log {{watchdog heartbeat -> {Path} every {Interval}}}.
# Beat: if {{freeze?.Active == true}} → write nothing; log warning {{watchdog heartbeat paused - the firmware is hung on purpose (DVT)}} once per pause; when it beats again after a pause log {{watchdog heartbeat resumed}}. Else {{HeartbeatFile.Write(path, Environment.TickCount64, Environment.ProcessId)}}; IO/permission errors → warning {{watchdog heartbeat write failed: {Reason}}}.
# {{StopAsync}}: signal stop, join the thread (≤2 s), {{HeartbeatFile.Delete(path)}} — a clean stop removes the file and disarms the watchdog.
# Registration only on Linux with an existing heartbeat directory (API-01 rule 11i).
*Configuration:* {{WATCHDOG_USEC}} (set by systemd), {{SCURE_HEARTBEAT_FILE}} (default {{/run/scurebox-heartbeat}}; {{off}} disables).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{ReadInterval}}: null/""/"abc"/"0" → null; "60000000" → 30000 ms; "500" → 500 ms.
* After start the heartbeat file holds a tick within 2 s of now; after 2.3 s the tick has increased; after stop the file is gone.
* While {{OutputFreeze.Hang()}} is active the tick does not change for 2.3 s; after {{Recover(...)}} it increases again.
* Trip record path {{WatchdogTripFile.PathFor(hb)}} ends in {{.trip}} and round-trips {{(at, cutOk)}}.
*Tests:* {{SystemdWatchdogTests.Interval_is_half_the_watchdog_timeout}} (theory above); {{WatchdogHeartbeatTests}}: {{Heartbeat_is_written_at_start_refreshed_every_second_and_removed_on_a_clean_stop}}, {{No_heartbeat_is_written_while_the_firmware_is_hung_on_purpose_and_it_resumes_after}}, {{The_watchdog_trip_record_round_trips_next_to_the_heartbeat}}, {{Watchdog_mode_rejects_unknown_arguments}}.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/SystemdWatchdogService.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/HeartbeatService.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Hardware/Safety/HeartbeatFile.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests/SystemdWatchdogTests.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests/WatchdogHeartbeatTests.cs}}.

---

column4: API-03.1 Implement SystemdWatchdogService with ReadInterval(WATCHDOG_USEC)
column5: Interval = max(usec/2000 ms, 500 ms), null for non-positive/invalid; send WATCHDOG=1 on a PeriodicTimer only when a notifier, an interval and IsSystemdService() are present. Done when the interval theory (60000000 -> 30000 ms, 500 -> 500 ms) passes.

column4: API-03.2 Implement HeartbeatService: 1 s beat thread, path resolution and clean-stop delete
column5: Path = ctor arg, else SCURE_HEARTBEAT_FILE (off disables), else /run/scurebox-heartbeat; beat immediately on start, HeartbeatFile.Write(tick, pid) every second, warn on IO errors, join (<= 2 s) and delete the file on stop.

column4: API-03.3 Pause the heartbeat while OutputFreeze is active (DVT hang) and log pause/resume once
column5: No write while freeze.Active; log 'watchdog heartbeat paused - the firmware is hung on purpose (DVT)' once per pause and 'resumed' after, so the output watchdog trips after 20 s.

column4: API-03.4 Port SystemdWatchdogTests and WatchdogHeartbeatTests
column5: Interval_is_half_the_watchdog_timeout, heartbeat written/refreshed/removed, no heartbeat while hung then resumes, trip record (.trip) round-trips (at, cutOk), and watchdog mode rejects unknown arguments.

column4: API-04 Static kiosk UI, SPA fallback and unknown-route 404
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Kiosk web UI, API host & infrastructure
*Blocked by:* API-02
*Blocks:* API-01, OPS-11, OPS-17
*Relates to:* OPS-11, OPS-10
*Implements:* OD-63, OD-73, REQ-20

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Endpoints/StaticUi.cs}}
*Goal:* Serve the built React UI (and its {{/config/*.json}} assets) from {{SCURE_UI_DIR}} at {{/}}, fall back to {{index.html}} for
client-side routes, and give unknown {{/api}} routes a JSON 404 instead of the SPA page.
*Depends on:* API-01, API-02; Kiosk-Web (the {{ui/dist}} build, which contains {{index.html}} with {{<div id="root"}} and {{config/errors.json}}, {{config/system.json}}, {{config/versions.json}}).
*Files to create:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/StaticUi.cs}} — {{public static class StaticUi { public static void Map(WebApplication app, string uiDir) }}}.
*Public contract:*
||Method||Route||Response||
| GET/HEAD | any existing file under uiDir (e.g. {{/assets/x.js}}, {{/config/errors.json}}) | the file (content type by extension; unknown types served too) |
| any | non-file path not under {{/api}} | {{index.html}} as {{text/html; charset=utf-8}}, 200 |
| any | non-file path under {{/api}} with no endpoint | 404 {{{ok:false, message:"Not found"}}} |
| any | non-file path, no {{index.html}} | 404 {{{ok:false, message:"UI not built"}}} |
*Behaviour & rules:*
# When {{uiDir}} exists: {{app.UseStaticFiles(new StaticFileOptions { FileProvider = new PhysicalFileProvider(Path.GetFullPath(uiDir)), ServeUnknownFileTypes = true })}}.
# {{app.MapFallback(handler)}} (default ASP.NET fallback pattern {{{*path:nonfile}}}, so paths that look like files — containing a dot in the last segment — are NOT handled by the fallback and get the framework's empty 404). Handler: path starts with {{/api/}} or equals {{/api}} (case-insensitive) → {{ApiJson.Fail("Not found", status: 404)}}; else if {{<uiDir>/index.html}} exists → {{Results.File(index, "text/html; charset=utf-8")}}; else {{ApiJson.Fail("UI not built", status: 404)}}.
# {{/api/*}} endpoints always win over the fallback (fallback has the lowest order). The fallback matches every HTTP method.
# {{StaticUi.Map}} is called last in {{Build}} (after all {{/api}} maps).
*Configuration:* {{SCURE_UI_DIR}} (default {{<app>/wwwroot}}, filled by the csproj Content link of {{ui/dist}}).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{GET /api/no-such-route}} and {{POST /api/nothing/here}} → 404 {{{ok:false, message:"Not found"}}}.
* With a UI build: {{GET /}} → 200 text/html containing {{<div id="root"}}; {{GET /settings}} and {{/cure/process/123}} → identical HTML body.
* {{GET /config/errors.json}} → 200 {{application/json}} with {{errors[]}} (≥ 46 records, each with {{code,key,severity,category,layer,message,description,troubleshooting,supportUrl}}, including 7001); {{/config/system.json}} object; {{/config/versions.json}} 200.
* With a missing UI dir: {{GET /}} → 404 {{{ok:false, message:"UI not built"}}}, while {{GET /api/state}} still 200.
*Tests:* {{StaticUiTests}}: {{Unknown_api_path_is_a_json_404}}, {{Index_and_spa_fallback_serve_the_built_ui}} (skips when {{ui/dist}} is not built), {{Config_assets_come_from_the_ui_dir}} (skips without UI), {{Missing_ui_build_is_a_json_404}} (nested {{NoUiFixture}} overriding {{SCURE_UI_DIR}}).
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/StaticUi.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests/StaticUiTests.cs}}, {{docs/01-api-contract.md}} §10–11.

---

column5: PhysicalFileProvider on the full uiDir path when it exists, serving /assets/* and /config/*.json; called last in Build after all /api maps.

column4: API-05 Machine state poll and NFC setting
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* API host & infrastructure, NFC & barcode, DVT bench, Cloud sync & Origin
*Blocked by:* API-02, PROC-01, PROC-05, PROC-09, PLAT-09, PLAT-10, PLAT-11, PLAT-13, DVT-04
*Blocks:* API-01, API-12, OPS-13, OPS-17
*Relates to:* PROC-01, PLAT-13, UI-05, DVT-04, PROC-05
*Implements:* OD-14, OD-21, OD-60, OD-65, OD-66, REQ-11, REQ-20, REQ-22

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Endpoints/StateEndpoints.cs}}
*Goal:* {{GET /api/state}} is the 1 Hz poll of the UIs: the controller's {{MachineState}} decorated by the host with component
counters, cloud-sync status, offline mode, NFC reader info and the recipe runner status; during a DVT hang it returns the frozen
pre-hang state. The NFC routes read and switch the NFC feature.
*Depends on:* API-02; Application-Process ({{ICureController.GetState()}}, {{MachineState}}, {{IRecipeRunner.GetStatus()}} / {{RecipeStatus}}); Application-Platform ({{IComponentCounters.Hours()}}, {{ICloudSync.Status()}}, {{INfcReaderDetector}} ({{Enabled}}, {{Status()}}, {{Decorate(MachineState)}}, {{TrySetEnabled(bool, out reader)}}), {{INfcTagReader.Status()}}, {{NetworkPolicy.OfflineMode}}); Dvt-Hdt ({{SCureBox.Application.Dvt.DvtHang}}: {{Active}}, {{LastState}}, {{Until}}; {{DvtHangDto}}).
*Files to create:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/StateEndpoints.cs}} — {{public static class StateEndpoints { public static void Map(RouteGroupBuilder api) }}}.
*Public contract:*
||Method||Route||Request||Response||
| GET | {{/api/state}} | — | {{MachineState}} JSON (200) |
| GET | {{/api/nfc}} | — | {{{ok:true, enabled, reader, tag}}} |
| POST | {{/api/nfc}} | query {{on}} (default {{1}}, {{Query.On}}) | ok: {{{ok:true, message, enabled, reader}}}; refused: {{{ok:false, code, message, enabled, reader}}} (200) |
{{MachineState}} top-level keys (all always present except {{dvtHang}}): {{chamberTemp, targetTemp, internetOk, offlineMode, doorClosed, doorAborted, isHeating, isCooling, coolingMode, uvOn, uvIntensity, uvWavelength, uvOutputs, ventOn, damperOpen, damperDriver, fans, fanRpm, fanRpmEach, fanDutyEach, fanOverride, stripMode, uiAlerts, ledTemps, uvSensors, nitrogenActive, n2Pressure, n2LinePressure, n2Sensor, bofaOn, bofaConnected, bofaDutyPercent, bofaPowered, bofaDetected, atTemp, heaterPwm, heaterOut, coolingRate, coolingFanPwm, faults, sensors, fanHealth, ledHealth, ledChecksEnabled, alerts, alertDetails, hwSource, counters, cloudSync, nfcEnabled, nfcReader, recipe, dvtHang?}} (field semantics are owned by Application-Process; see docs/01 §1).
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{/api/state}}: if {{hang.Active}} and {{hang.LastState}} is not null → return {{LastState with { DvtHang = new DvtHangDto(true, (Until unix ms)/1000.0 or 0) }}} (no fresh read). Otherwise {{state = controller.GetState() with { Counters = counters.Hours(), CloudSync = cloud.Status(), OfflineMode = policy.OfflineMode }}}; {{state = nfc.Decorate(state)}} (sets {{nfcEnabled}}, {{nfcReader}}, and adds 9052 to alerts/alertDetails when enabled with no reader); {{run = recipe.GetStatus()}}; when {{run.State != "idle"}} set {{Recipe = run}}, else {{recipe}} stays null. {{dvtHang}} is omitted (WhenWritingNull) except during a hang.
# {{/api/state}} is never request-logged (API-02).
# {{GET /api/nfc}} → {{{ok:true, enabled: nfc.Enabled, reader: nfc.Status(), tag: tags.Status()}}}; {{reader}} = {{{detected, port, model, serial, usbId, ...}}}; {{tag}} = {{{connected, firmware, tagPresent, lastTag, lastTagAt, error}}} (shape owned by Platform).
# {{POST /api/nfc?on=}}: {{r = nfc.TrySetEnabled(on, out reader)}}. Enabling without a detected reader is refused by the detector with code 9052 and message {{No NFC reader detected - connect the reader (data USB cable) and try again}}. Disabling always succeeds.
*Configuration:* {{SCURE_SIM_NFC=1}} simulates a reader (Platform).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Every contract key listed in {{StateTests.ContractKeys}} is present; {{hwSource == "simulation"}} in simulation.
