column4: API-06 Cure process commands (`/api/cure/*`)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cure run, UV LEDs & wavelength, Heating, Cooling & damper
*Blocked by:* API-02, PROC-01, PROC-05, PROC-06, PROC-09, DOM-02, DOM-03
*Blocks:* API-01, OPS-17
*Relates to:* PROC-05, PROC-06, PROC-03, PROC-04, UI-16
*Implements:* OD-28, OD-30, OD-38, OD-41, OD-42, OD-64, REQ-08, REQ-18, REQ-20, REQ-22

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Endpoints/CureEndpoints.cs}}
*Goal:* One POST per recipe process (heat, dry, cure-405, cure-450, uv-only, cool, nitrogen, stop) used by the UI's
phase-by-phase cure flow. The API validates the parameter ranges with registry codes, then forwards to {{ICureController}}, mapping
refusals through {{ApiJson.HwResult}}.
*Depends on:* API-02; Application-Process ({{ICureController}} methods {{HeatToTarget, DryToTarget, CureUv, UvOnly, CoolToTarget, SetNitrogen, StopAll}}; {{RecipeValidator}} constants {{HeatTargetMin=30, TempMax=80, DryTempMax=50, CoolTargetMin=20, UvIntensityMin=10}}); Domain ({{Wavelength.Nm405/Nm450}}, {{WavelengthExtensions.TryParse(int, out Wavelength)}}, {{CoolingModes.Parse(string)}} + {{.Wire()}}, {{CoolingMode}}, {{ErrorCodes.InvalidTemperature=7001, InvalidIntensity=7002, InvalidCoolingMode=7003}}).
*Files to create:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/CureEndpoints.cs}} — {{public static class CureEndpoints { public static void Map(RouteGroupBuilder api) }}} (group {{/cure}}), private helpers {{CureUv}}, {{BadHeat}}, {{BadIntensity}}.
*Public contract (all POST, query parameters, HTTP 200):*
||Route||Query (default)||Validation (→ {{{ok:false, code, message}}})||Controller call||Success message||
| {{/api/cure/heat}} | {{target}} (60) | 30–80 else 7001 {{Invalid target {t} (30-80°C)}} | {{HeatToTarget(t)}} | {{Heating to {t}°C}} |
| {{/api/cure/dry}} | {{target}} (50) | > 50 → 7001 {{Invalid target {t} (30-50°C for drying)}}; < 30 → 7001 {{Invalid target {t} (30-80°C)}} | {{DryToTarget(t)}} | {{Drying to {t}°C}} |
| {{/api/cure/cure-405}} | {{target}} (60), {{intensity}} (30, int) | 7001 as heat; intensity 10–100 else 7002 {{Invalid intensity {i} (10-100%)}} | {{CureUv(Nm405, t, i)}} | {{Cure UV 405nm @ {i}%, {t}°C}} |
| {{/api/cure/cure-450}} | same | same | {{CureUv(Nm450, t, i)}} | {{Bleaching UV 450nm @ {i}%, {t}°C}} |
| {{/api/cure/uv-only}} | {{intensity}} (30), {{wavelength}} (405), {{vent}} (0, {{OnLoose}}) | 7002; wavelength not 405/450 → {{{ok:false, message:"Invalid wavelength {w} (405|450)"}}} (NO code) | {{UvOnly(wl, i, vent)}} | {{UV {w}nm @ {i}% — no heating}} + (vent ? {{, fresh-air vent}} : ``) |
| {{/api/cure/cool}} | {{target}} (25), {{mode}} ({{medium}}) | 20–80 else 7001 {{Invalid target {t} (20-80°C)}}; mode must parse AND equal its wire form ({{fast}}/{{medium}}/{{slow}}, exact case) else 7003 {{Invalid cooling mode {mode}}} | {{CoolToTarget(t, mode)}} | {{Cooling ({mode}) to {t}°C}} |
| {{/api/cure/nitrogen}} | {{on}} (1, {{On}}) | — | {{SetNitrogen(on)}} | {{Nitrogen valve opened}} / {{Nitrogen valve closed}} |
| {{/api/cure/stop}} | {{immediate}} (0, {{OnLoose}}) | — | {{StopAll(immediate)}} | always {{{ok:true, message:"All cure outputs stopped"}}} + {{ immediately}} when immediate |
{{{t}}} is formatted with {{ApiJson.Num}} ({{60.0}}), {{{i}}} as an integer.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Validation order: cure-405/450 → target first, then intensity. uv-only → intensity first, then wavelength. Cool → target, then mode.
# All except stop return {{ApiJson.HwResult(result, successMessage)}}: controller refusals give 6015 by default, or the embedded {{[NNNN]}} code (9001/9002/9003/9004..., N2 codes 9008/9009/9015/9016) with the prefix stripped.
# Admission rules live in the controller (Application-Process), not in the API: e.g. door open → refused 6015 with a message containing {{Door}} (LEDs are door-interlocked); required sensor open → 9001; fans failing → 9002/9003; N2 pressure outside 0.5–3 bar → 9008/9009. During a DVT hang the hang gate answers 409 before the endpoint (API-12). OPEN QUESTION: whether the controller refuses these manual commands while the server-side recipe runner is executing is decided inside {{CureController}}/{{RecipeRunner}}, not visible in the API code.
# {{stop}} never fails; {{immediate=off}} counts as immediate (Flask quirk via {{OnLoose}}).
# Malformed numbers → {{ArgumentException}} → 200 {{{ok:false, message:"Invalid target 'x'"}}} via middleware.
*Configuration:* none.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Each of these returns 200, {{ok:false}}, the code, non-empty message: {{heat?target=99}} 7001, {{heat?target=10}} 7001, {{dry?target=81}} 7001, {{dry?target=51}} 7001, {{cure-405?target=60&intensity=5}} 7002, {{cure-450?target=60&intensity=101}} 7002, {{uv-only?intensity=0}} 7002, {{cool?target=15}} 7001, {{cool?target=25&mode=turbo}} 7003.
* {{uv-only?intensity=30&wavelength=500}} → {{ok:false}}, no {{code}}, message {{Invalid wavelength 500 (405|450)}}.
* {{heat?target=40}} → {{Heating to 40.0°C}}; state then {{isHeating:true}}, {{targetTemp:40}}. {{stop?immediate=1}} → {{All cure outputs stopped immediately}}, then {{isHeating:false}}.
* {{stop}} → {{All cure outputs stopped}}; {{stop?immediate=off}} → {{... immediately}}.
* {{cure-405?target=60&intensity=30}} → {{Cure UV 405nm @ 30%, 60.0°C}}, state {{uvOn:true, uvWavelength:405}}. {{cool?target=25&mode=fast}} → {{Cooling (fast) to 25.0°C}}, state {{isCooling:true, coolingMode:"fast"}}. {{nitrogen?on=1|0}} → opened/closed messages.
* After {{POST /api/door/open}}, {{uv-only?intensity=30}} → 200 {{{ok:false, code:6015}}} with {{Door}} in the message.
*Tests:* {{CureTests}}: {{Invalid_parameters_are_rejected_with_the_registry_code}} (theory, also covers {{/api/chamber/temperature}} and {{/api/uv}}), {{Bad_wavelength_is_refused_without_a_code}}, {{Heat_then_stop_reflects_in_state}}, {{Stop_is_always_ok_and_off_counts_as_immediate}}, {{Cure_405_and_cool_and_nitrogen_succeed_in_simulation}}, {{Door_open_is_always_ok_reads_open_then_recloses_after_5_s_and_refuses_a_start_with_6015}}.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/CureEndpoints.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Recipe/RecipeValidator.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Contracts/ICureController.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests/CureTests.cs}}, {{docs/01-api-contract.md}} §8.

---

column4: API-06.1 Implement POST /api/cure/heat and /api/cure/dry with 7001 range validation
column5: heat target default 60, 30-80 else 7001 'Invalid target {t} (30-80°C)'; dry default 50, > 50 -> 7001 drying message, < 30 -> 7001; forward via ApiJson.HwResult with 'Heating to {t}°C' / 'Drying to {t}°C' (Num formatting).

column4: API-06.2 Implement POST /api/cure/cure-405, cure-450 and uv-only with target/intensity/wavelength checks
column5: Target first then intensity 10-100 (7002) for cure-405/450; uv-only checks intensity first then wavelength 405|450 (refusal without code), vent via OnLoose; messages 'Cure UV 405nm @ {i}%, {t}°C', 'Bleaching UV 450nm ...', 'UV {w}nm @ {i}% — no heating[, fresh-air vent]'.

column4: API-06.3 Implement POST /api/cure/cool (7001/7003), /api/cure/nitrogen and /api/cure/stop
column5: cool target 20-80 else 7001, mode must parse and equal its wire form fast/medium/slow else 7003; nitrogen ?on= -> opened/closed; stop always ok, immediate via OnLoose so 'off' counts as immediate.

column4: API-06.4 Map controller refusals through HwResult with full code pass-through
column5: Embedded [NNNN] codes (9001.., 9008/9009/9015/9016) are stripped and returned, otherwise 6015 (e.g. door open -> 6015 with 'Door'); malformed numbers return 200 Invalid target via the middleware.

column4: API-06.5 Resolve OPEN QUESTION: are manual /api/cure/* commands refused while the recipe runner executes?
column5: Check CureController/RecipeRunner admission against OD-28/OD-33 (cure step routes need an active run and are refused inside a manual session) and document the expected API answer.

column4: API-06.6 Port CureTests (validation theory, bad wavelength, heat/stop, cure-405/cool/nitrogen, door 6015)
column5: Invalid_parameters_are_rejected_with_the_registry_code, Bad_wavelength_is_refused_without_a_code, Heat_then_stop_reflects_in_state, Stop_is_always_ok_and_off_counts_as_immediate, Cure_405_and_cool_and_nitrogen_succeed_in_simulation, and the door-open 6015 test.

column4: API-07 Direct hardware, acknowledgements, BOFA policy and diagnostics
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Fans & tach, BOFA extractor, Status strip (RGB), Door & magnet
*Blocked by:* API-02, PROC-01, PROC-05, PROC-07, PLAT-12, DOM-01, DOM-02, DOM-03
*Blocks:* API-01, OPS-17
*Relates to:* PROC-05, PROC-07, PLAT-12, PROC-10, HW-10, UI-19
*Implements:* OD-24, OD-27, OD-28, OD-30, OD-37, OD-20, OD-64, REQ-13, REQ-20, REQ-22

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Endpoints/HardwareEndpoints.cs}}, {{Endpoints/DiagnosticsEndpoints.cs}}
*Goal:* Service / settings-screen routes that drive single outputs (door, manual chamber heating, RGB strip, fans, damper, UV,
BOFA extractor), operator acknowledgements of latched alarms, the persisted BOFA policy, and the fan RPM and LED heating
diagnostics. Several routes answer {{ok:true}} unconditionally (Flask fidelity).
*Depends on:* API-02; Application-Process ({{ICureController}}: {{OpenDoor, AckDoorAbort, AckWatchdogTrip, AckFanAlarms, SetTargetTemperature, StopHeating, ReportUiAlerts, SetRgb, SetFanOverride, SetFanSpeed, SetDamper, SetUv, SetBofa, SetBofaConnected, RunFanTest, RunLedTest}}; {{FanTestResult}}, {{FanTestEntry}}, {{LedTestResult}}, {{LedTestEntry}}); Application-Platform ({{BofaPolicy}}: {{Connected}}, {{DutyPercent}}, {{Choose(bool?, int?)}}, persisted {{bofa.json}}, default duty 10); Domain ({{HardwareNames.TryParseFanGroup}} (exact-case enum {{FanGroup { led_cooling, chamber_intake, chamber_heating }}}), {{WavelengthExtensions.TryParse}}, {{Wavelength.Nm405}}, {{ErrorCodes}}).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/HardwareEndpoints.cs}} — {{public static class HardwareEndpoints { public static void Map(RouteGroupBuilder api) }}}.
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/DiagnosticsEndpoints.cs}} — {{public static class DiagnosticsEndpoints { public static void Map(RouteGroupBuilder api) }}}.
*Public contract (all 200 unless noted):*
||Method||Route||Query / body||Response||
| POST | {{/api/door/open}} | — | always {{{ok:true, message:"Door opened"}}} (calls {{OpenDoor()}}, result ignored) |
| POST | {{/api/door-abort/ack}} | — | always {{{ok:true, message:"Door abort acknowledged"}}} |
| POST | {{/api/watchdog/ack}} | — | {{{ok:true, message: AckWatchdogTrip().Message}}} (Err 9017; default {{Watchdog alert acknowledged}}) |
| POST | {{/api/fans/ack}} | — | {{{ok:true, message: AckFanAlarms().Message}}} (e.g. {{Fan alarm acknowledged: 9022 FAN_LEFT, ...}}) — always ok |
| POST | {{/api/chamber/temperature}} | {{target}} (25) | 30–80 else {{{ok:false, code:7001, message:"Invalid target {t} (30-80°C)"}}}; else {{{ok: r.Ok, message: ok ? "Target set to {t}°C" : r.Message}}} (no code on refusal) |
| POST | {{/api/chamber/stop}} | — | always {{{ok:true, message:"Heating stopped"}}} |
| POST | {{/api/rgb/alerts}} | {{critical}} (0), {{warning}} (0) ints | {{{ok:true, critical, warning}}} (calls {{ReportUiAlerts}}) |
| POST | {{/api/rgb}} | {{on}} (1, {{On}}), {{color}} (empty → null) | {{Envelope(SetRgb(on, color))}} |
| POST | {{/api/fans/override}} | {{fan}} (""), {{on}} (1) | {{{ok: r.Ok, message: ok ? "fan override on|off: {fan}" : r.Message}}}; unknown fan → controller message {{unknown fan: X}} |
| POST | {{/api/fans/{fan}}} | route {{fan}}, {{speed}} (0) | always {{{ok:true, message:"{fan} set to {speed}%"}}}; {{SetFanSpeed}} only called when {{{fan}}} parses as a {{FanGroup}} (exact case) |
| POST | {{/api/damper/{action}}} | route {{action}} | {{SetDamper(action == "open")}}; always {{{ok:true, message:"Damper opened"}}} or {{"Damper closed"}} (any action other than {{open}} closes) |
| POST | {{/api/uv}} | {{on}} (0!), {{intensity}} (30), {{wavelength}} (405) | when on: intensity 10–100 else 7002 {{Invalid intensity {i} (10-100%)}}; unknown wavelength → {{{ok:false, message:"Invalid wavelength {w} (405|450)"}}}; then {{HwResult(SetUv(on, i, wl), "UV on"|"UV off")}} (when off, validation is skipped) |
| POST | {{/api/bofa}} | {{on}} (1) | {{HwResult(SetBofa(on), "BOFA on"|"BOFA off")}} |
| GET | {{/api/bofa/policy}} | — | {{{ok:true, connected, dutyPercent}}} |
| POST | {{/api/bofa/policy}} | {{connected}} (present → {{On(...,"1")}}, absent → unchanged), {{dutyPercent}} (int, absent/malformed → unchanged) | neither → {{{ok:false, message:"connected=0|1 and/or dutyPercent=0..100 required"}}}; duty outside 0..100 → {{{ok:false, code:7002, message:"dutyPercent must be 0..100"}}}; else {{Choose(connected, duty)}}, {{SetBofaConnected(p.Connected)}}, {{{ok:true, connected, dutyPercent}}} |
| POST | {{/api/diagnostics/fan-test}} | {{fan}} ({{all}}) | {{{ok:true, rpm, status, fans:{FAN_X:{rpm,status,duty,expected,deficitPct}}, message}}} |
| POST | {{/api/diagnostics/led-test}} | {{seconds}} (15, rounded to int), {{min_rise}} (0.8), {{wavelength}} (405; unknown → default enum value) | {{{ok:true, status, stage, seconds, wavelength, precooled, intensity, min_rise_c, results:[{name,start,temp,rise,status}], message}}} |
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{fans/{fan}}} refusals by a control loop (heater fan while heating, intake while cooling, LED fans during fast-cool boost) are silent; the API still reports ok.
# {{bofa/policy}} after a change always calls {{ICureController.SetBofaConnected(policy.Connected)}} so a disconnect drops the output at once and a re-tuned duty applies immediately if the intake fan runs.
# Diagnostics always return {{ok:true}}; the verdict is {{status}} ({{OK}}/{{FAIL}}, fan test also {{WARN}}). Unknown fan → {{rpm:0, status:"FAIL", message:"unknown fan: <fan>"}}. LED test refused while a process runs → {{stage:"busy"}} (controller).
# {{led-test}} passes {{intensity}} default 100 (interface default) to {{RunLedTest(seconds, minRise, wl)}}.
# Hang gate (API-12) answers 409 for all these POSTs during a DVT hang.
*Configuration:* none (BOFA persisted by Platform in {{<data>/bofa.json}}).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{fans/chamber_intake?speed=40}} → {{chamber_intake set to 40%}}; state {{fans.chamber_intake == 40}}, simulated {{fanRpmEach.FAN_COOLING == 1720}}.
* {{damper/open}} → {{Damper opened}}, state {{damperOpen:true}}; {{damper/close}} → {{Damper closed}}.
* {{fans/override?fan=FAN_DOOR&on=1}} → ok, {{fanOverride}} contains {{FAN_DOOR}}; {{fan=FAN_NOPE}} → ok:false, message contains {{unknown fan}}.
* {{uv?on=1&intensity=30&wavelength=450}} → {{UV on}}, state {{uvWavelength:450}}, {{uvOutputs}} object; {{uv?on=0}} → {{UV off}}; {{uv?on=1&intensity=200}} → 7002.
* {{bofa?on=1|0}} → {{BOFA on|off}}.
* {{rgb/alerts?critical=1&warning=2}} → echoes 1 and 2; {{rgb?on=1&color=blue}} has {{ok}} and {{message}}.
* {{chamber/temperature?target=45}} → {{Target set to 45.0°C}}; {{target=99}} → 7001; {{chamber/stop}} → {{Heating stopped}}.
* {{diagnostics/fan-test?fan=all}} (sim) → {{status:"OK"}}, {{rpm:3560}}, all six FAN_* with {{rpm,status}}, {{message}} key present; {{fan=nope}} → {{ok:true, status:"FAIL", rpm:0, message:"unknown fan: nope"}}.
* {{diagnostics/led-test?seconds=1&min_rise=0.1&wavelength=405}} → all keys present, {{wavelength:405}}, {{results}} array of {{{name,start,temp,rise,status}}}.
* {{watchdog/ack}} → ok (also right after a DVT hang).
*Tests:* {{HardwareTests}}: {{Fan_speed_is_always_ok_and_damper_reports_its_direction}}, {{Fan_override_round_trip_and_unknown_fan}}, {{Uv_and_bofa_direct_control}}, {{Rgb_alerts_and_manual_strip}}, {{Fan_test_shape_and_unknown_fan}}, {{Led_test_shape}}; {{CureTests.Chamber_temperature_manual_heating}}, door test. Add: {{bofa/policy}} GET/POST validation (missing both → message; duty 101 → 7002; round trip).
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/HardwareEndpoints.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/DiagnosticsEndpoints.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Platform/BofaPolicy.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Domain/Models/HardwareNames.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests/HardwareTests.cs}}, {{docs/01-api-contract.md}} §7.

---

column4: API-07.1 Implement door, acknowledgement and chamber routes in HardwareEndpoints.cs
column5: door/open and door-abort/ack always ok; watchdog/ack and fans/ack return the controller message with ok:true; chamber/temperature target 30-80 else 7001 then 'Target set to {t}°C' or the refusal message without code; chamber/stop always 'Heating stopped'.

column4: API-07.2 Implement RGB, fan override, fan speed and damper routes
column5: rgb/alerts echoes critical/warning after ReportUiAlerts; rgb -> Envelope(SetRgb); fans/override reports 'unknown fan: X'; fans/{fan} always ok and calls SetFanSpeed only for an exact-case FanGroup; damper/{action} opens only for 'open'.

column4: API-07.3 Implement POST /api/uv and /api/bofa with HwResult mapping
column5: uv: on default 0, when on validate intensity 10-100 (7002) and wavelength 405|450 (no code), skip validation when off, HwResult 'UV on'/'UV off'; bofa -> HwResult 'BOFA on'/'BOFA off'.

column4: API-07.4 Implement GET/POST /api/bofa/policy with BofaPolicy.Choose and SetBofaConnected
column5: Neither connected nor dutyPercent -> 'connected=0|1 and/or dutyPercent=0..100 required'; duty outside 0..100 -> 7002; else Choose, then controller.SetBofaConnected(policy.Connected) and return {ok, connected, dutyPercent} (default duty 10).

column4: API-07.5 Implement POST /api/diagnostics/fan-test and led-test in DiagnosticsEndpoints.cs
column5: Always ok:true with the verdict in status; unknown fan -> rpm 0, FAIL, 'unknown fan: <fan>'; led-test passes seconds (rounded), min_rise, wavelength and intensity default 100 to RunLedTest; busy stage comes from the controller.

column4: API-07.6 Port HardwareTests and add bofa/policy validation tests
column5: Port fan speed/damper, fan override, UV and BOFA, RGB, fan-test and LED-test shape tests plus CureTests.Chamber_temperature_manual_heating; add bofa/policy missing-both message, duty 101 -> 7002 and a round trip.

| GET | {{/api/cure-history}} | — | {{CureLog[]}} from {{GetHistory()}} (newest first) |
| DELETE | {{/api/cure-history/{id}}} | — | {{{ok:true}}}; unknown or still running → 404 {{{ok:false, message:"Unknown run or still running"}}} |
| DELETE | {{/api/cure-history}} | — | {{{ok:true, deleted:<int>}}} (finished runs only) |
| GET | {{/api/phase-timings}} | — | {{PhaseTiming[]}} |
| POST | {{/api/cure-runs/{extId}/start}} | {{CureRunStart {materialName, steps, phases[], targetTemp, serialNumber}}} (bad/empty → defaults) | {{{ok:true}}} |
| POST | {{/api/cure-runs/{extId}/telemetry}} | {{TelemetrySample {t, chamberTemp, uvOn, uvType, fanRpm{FAN_*}, ledTemps{...}}}} | {{{ok: AddTelemetry(...)}}} (false for unknown id) |
| POST | {{/api/cure-runs/{extId}/finish}} | {{CureRunFinish {status ("completed" default), stepsCompleted?, alerts?}}} | {{{ok, sensorIssues:[{sensor,critical}], fanIssues:[{fan,deficitPct,critical}]}}} |
| POST | {{/api/cure-runs/{extId}/report}} | {{CureReport {content, summary (any JSON), format ("html")}}} | {{{ok:true, reportId}}} |
| GET | {{/api/cure-runs/{extId}/report}} | — | {{{ok:true, content, summary, format}}}; none → 404 {{{ok:false, message:"No report"}}} |
| POST | {{/api/cure-runs/{extId}/phase}} | {{PhaseTiming {program, step, process, targetTemp, plannedMin, startedAt, endedAt, seconds, rampSeconds, tempStart, tempEnd, coolingMode, intensity, timerMode}}} | {{{ok:true, count}}}; body null or {{process}} empty or {{seconds}} null → 400 {{{ok:false, message:"process and seconds required"}}} |
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Bodies are read with {{ApiJson.ReadBodyAsync<T>}}; for start/telemetry/finish/report a missing or malformed body falls back to {{new T()}} (no error).
# {{phase}}: the stored record is {{timing with { RunId = extId }}}; {{count}} = the store's count after append.
# Telemetry and finish both call {{issues.Note(extId, controller.GetState())}} BEFORE the store call; finish then {{Take(extId)}} and passes the lists to {{store.Finish(extId, finish, sensorIssues, fanIssues)}}, returning them in the response.
# {{RunIssueTracker.Note}} (thread-safe, one lock): for each {{state.Sensors}} entry with {{Ok == false}} record {{key → Critical}} (sorted ordinal by key; last value wins). For each {{state.FanHealth}} entry whose {{Status}} is {{warn}} or {{critical}} keep, per fan, the entry with the largest {{DeficitPct}} (null treated as 0) as {{new FanIssue(fan, DeficitPct, Status == "critical")}}. {{Take}} removes and returns both, sorted by name; unknown id → empty lists.
# Cure-history deletion also queues the ids for deletion on the cloud portal (Platform {{CureHistoryDeletion}}); a running run is never deleted.
# Store semantics owned by Platform (docs/01 §5): start idempotent, inserts at index 0 with status {{running}}; runs left {{running}} after a power cut become {{error}} on load; {{cure_history.json}} etc. under {{SCURE_DATA_DIR}}; user materials in {{user_materials.json}}.
# No admission rules (these routes work during a run); during a DVT hang all POST/DELETE here answer 409 (API-12).
*Configuration:* {{SCURE_DATA_DIR}}, {{DATABASE_URL}} (via Platform).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Presets: 200 non-empty array containing {{id == "preset-ST45"}}; each has {{id, name, isPreset, createdAt, steps, totalDuration}}; steps have {{step, process, temperature, intensity, time}}.
* User materials round trip preserves {{timerMode:"on-target"}}, {{coolingMode:"medium"}}; writes {{<data>/user_materials.json}}; posting {{[]}} clears; posting {{not json}} → 400.
* Print history round trip keeps all keys {{id, printName, materialName, printerName, date, duration, status, steps, csvFile}}.
* Cure run: start ok; telemetry ok for the id, {{ok:false}} for an unknown id; history shows {{running}}; finish ok with {{sensorIssues}}/{{fanIssues}} arrays; history then {{completed}}, {{stepsCompleted 2}}, {{serialNumber "SN-QA"}}, one telemetry row, and keys {{materialName, steps, startedAt, endedAt, duration, phases, targetTemp, sensorIssues, fanIssues}}.
* Report: GET before save → 404 {{No report}}; POST → {{reportId}} key; GET → 200 with same {{content}}, {{format:"html"}}, {{summary.steps == 2}}.
* Phase: missing process/seconds → 400 {{process and seconds required}}; valid → {{count >= 1}}, and {{/api/phase-timings}} contains {{process:"Heating", seconds:612.5}}.
* {{DELETE /api/cure-history/<unknown>}} → 404; {{DELETE /api/cure-history}} → {{{ok:true, deleted:n}}}.
*Tests:* {{DataTests}}: {{Presets_are_served_from_the_bundled_file}}, {{User_materials_replace_round_trip}}, {{Print_history_replace_round_trip}}, {{Cure_run_round_trip_with_qa_test_run}}, {{Phase_timing_requires_process_and_seconds}}. Add: cure-history delete tests and a {{RunIssueTracker}} unit test (worst deficit kept, sorted output, Take clears).

column4: API-09 Server-side recipe runner endpoints and recipe validation wiring
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Programs & recipes, Cure run
*Blocked by:* API-02, API-08, PROC-01, PROC-09, DOM-03, DOM-04, PLAT-02
*Blocks:* API-01, OPS-17
*Relates to:* PROC-09, DOM-06, DOM-04, UI-16
*Implements:* OD-03, OD-07, OD-08, OD-33, REQ-19, REQ-20, REQ-22

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Endpoints/RecipeEndpoints.cs}}, {{Infrastructure/RecipeValidation.cs}}
*Goal:* Run a whole program (Material) on the machine without the UI driving each phase: start by preset/user id or inline
material, pause, resume, abort, skip a step, read the status. The host supplies the recipe validator that combines the API range
checks with the Domain program rules.
*Depends on:* API-02, API-08 ({{IMaterialStore.Find}}); Application-Process ({{IRecipeRunner}}: {{GetStatus()}} → {{RecipeStatus}}, {{Start(Material, string? runId, string? serialNumber)}}, {{Pause()}}, {{Resume()}}, {{Abort()}}, {{SkipStep()}}; {{RecipeValidator}} record ({{Func<Material,(bool ok,string? message,int? code)> Validate}}), {{RecipeValidator.BasicChecks}}, constants {{CoolTargetMin}}, {{TempMax}}); Domain ({{Material}}, {{ProgramValidator.Validate(steps)}} → errors with {{Field}}, {{Step}}, {{Message}}, {{Code}}; {{ProcessType.Cooling}}).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/RecipeEndpoints.cs}} — {{public static class RecipeEndpoints}} (group {{/recipe}}).
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/RecipeValidation.cs}} — {{public static class RecipeValidation { static RecipeValidator Create(); static (bool ok, string? message, int? code) Validate(Material material); }}}.
*Public contract (200 always):*
||Method||Route||Body||Response||
| GET | {{/api/recipe/status}} | — | {{RecipeStatus}}: {{{state ("idle"|"running"|"paused"|"aborted"|...), runId, materialId, materialName, stepIndex, totalSteps, process, phase, targetTemp, stepElapsedSec, stepRemainingSec, totalElapsedSec, estimatedTotalSec, startedAt, endedAt, message, errorCode}}} |
| POST | {{/api/recipe/start}} | {{{materialId}}} or {{{material:{...Material}}}}, optional {{runId}}, {{serialNumber}} | {{Envelope(runner.Start(...))}} |
| POST | {{/api/recipe/pause}} | — | {{Envelope(Pause())}} |
| POST | {{/api/recipe/resume}} | — | {{Envelope(Resume())}} |
| POST | {{/api/recipe/abort}} | — | {{Envelope(Abort())}} |
| POST | {{/api/recipe/skip}} | — | {{Envelope(SkipStep())}} |
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{start}}: body not a JSON object → {{{ok:false, message:"Body {materialId} or {material} required"}}}. If {{material}} is an object → deserialize with {{ApiJson.Options}} (JsonException → {{{ok:false, message:"Invalid material: <e.Message>"}}}). Else if {{materialId}} (string or number text) is non-empty → {{store.Find(id)}}; null → {{{ok:false, message:"Unknown material: <id>"}}}. Still no material → the "Body ... required" message. Then {{Envelope(r.Start(material, runId, serialNumber))}}.
# Runner refusals (Application-Process, all code 6015): {{A program is already running - abort it first}}; {{A process is active - stop it before starting a program}} (admission: refused while any manual process is active); pause/abort/skip without a run → {{No program is running}}; resume without pause → {{No paused program}}. Validation failure → {{{ok:false, code, message}}} with the validator's code (default 7001). Success messages: {{Program '<name>' started}}, {{Program paused}}, {{Program resumed}}, {{Program aborted}}, {{Step skipped}}.
# {{RecipeValidation.Validate}}: first {{RecipeValidator.BasicChecks(material)}} (API ranges, codes 7001/7002); if it fails return it. Then {{ProgramValidator.Validate(material.Steps)}}; drop errors that are a Cooling-step temperature range error ({{Field == "temperature"}}, step found by {{Step}} number or index {{n-1}}, {{Process == Cooling}}, temperature within 20–80, message contains {{Invalid temperature}}) — the Domain step-editor window 30–75 °C is relaxed to the API window. No errors → (true, null, null); else (false, messages joined with {{"; "}}, first error's code). Other Domain rules (nitrogen block e.g. {{After nitrogen...}}, hold times, UV range, temperature chain) are enforced.
# {{RecipeValidation.Create()}} → {{new RecipeValidator(Validate)}}, registered in DI before {{AddSCureBoxProcess}} (API-01).
# While running, {{/api/state.recipe}} carries the status (API-05). An aborted run appears in {{/api/cure-history}} with status {{aborted}} under the given {{runId}}.
*Configuration:* none.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Idle status has {{state:"idle"}} and every key listed above.
* {{start {materialId:"preset-ST45", runId:"qa-recipe-run", serialNumber:"SN-1"}}} → ok; status becomes {{running}} with {{runId}}, {{materialName "Ultracur3D ST45"}}, {{totalSteps 3}}, {{process "Drying"}}; second start → {{ok:false, code:6015}}.
* pause → {{paused}}; resume ok; abort → {{aborted}}; cure-history entry {{qa-recipe-run}} status {{aborted}}; skip when idle → {{ok:false}}.
* Unknown id → message contains {{Unknown material}}; inline Heating 99 °C → 7001; inline Cure uvIntensity 5 → 7002; Nitrogen followed by Heating → message contains {{After nitrogen}}; {{{}}} → ok:false.
*Tests:* {{RecipeTests}}: {{Preset_runs_shows_in_state_double_start_is_6015_and_abort_works}}, {{Invalid_programs_are_refused_with_validation_codes}}. Add a unit test that a Cooling step at 20 °C passes {{RecipeValidation.Validate}} while 15 °C fails with 7001.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/RecipeEndpoints.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Api/Infrastructure/RecipeValidation.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Recipe/RecipeValidator.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Recipe/RecipeRunner.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Contracts/IRecipeRunner.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests/RecipeTests.cs}}.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Settings, Network & NetBird, Software update, Clock & time
*Blocked by:* API-02, PLAT-06, PLAT-07, PLAT-08, PLAT-09, PLAT-10
*Blocks:* API-01, OPS-02, OPS-13, OPS-17
*Relates to:* PLAT-06, PLAT-07, PLAT-08, PLAT-09, PLAT-10, UI-19
*Implements:* OD-31, OD-32, OD-50, OD-52, OD-53, OD-54, OD-55, REQ-13, REQ-20, REQ-21

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Endpoints/SystemEndpoints.cs}}, {{Endpoints/NetworkEndpoints.cs}}
*Goal:* Settings-screen system actions: reboot/shutdown, clock and network time, version, USB exports, signed software update
from USB, offline/network policy, cloud sync configuration, wired-network status, safe network diagnostics and static IP. The API
is a thin adapter; behaviour lives in Platform services.
*Depends on:* API-02; Application-Platform ({{ISystemService}}: {{Reboot, Shutdown, SetDateTime(date,time), Version(), NetworkTimeEnabled(), SetNetworkTime(bool), ExportLogs(), ExportCsv(filename, content), ExportReport(filename, content)}}; {{IUpdateService}}: {{Manifest()}} (has {{Ok}}), {{FindPackage()}} ({{Ok, Path, FileName, Message, Code}}), {{RunUpdate()}}; {{NetworkPolicy}}: {{OfflineByChoice, OfflineMode, ExpectsNetwork, Choose(bool?)}}; {{ICloudSync.Configure(url, key, name, interval)}}; {{INetworkService}}: {{Status(), Diagnostics(tool, address), SetStatic(dhcp, ip, gateway, subnet, dns)}}).
*Files to create:*
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/SystemEndpoints.cs}} — {{public static class SystemEndpoints}} (group {{/system}} + {{/network/policy}} + {{/cloud/config}} on the api group) with {{internal static string? Str(JsonElement? body, string name)}}.
* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/NetworkEndpoints.cs}} — {{public static class NetworkEndpoints}} (group {{/network}}).
*Public contract:*
||Method||Route||Body||Response||
| POST | {{/api/system/reboot}} | — | {{Envelope(Reboot())}} — {{Rebooting...}} / off-device {{Reboot simulated}} |
| POST | {{/api/system/shutdown}} | — | {{Envelope(Shutdown())}} — {{Shutting down...}} / {{Shutdown simulated}} |
| POST | {{/api/system/datetime}} | {{{date:"YYYY-MM-DD", time:"HH:MM[:SS]"}}} | {{Envelope(SetDateTime(...))}}; bad/missing → 200 {{{ok:false, message:"Invalid date/time format"}}} |
| GET | {{/api/system/version}} | — | {{{appVersion, gitCommit, gitDate, lastBoot, os, kernel, python, runtime, emmcSerial}}} |
| GET | {{/api/system/network-time}} | — | {{{enabled}}} (no {{ok}}) |
| POST | {{/api/system/network-time}} | {{{enabled: true|false}}} | {{{ok, message, enabled}}}; {{enabled}} missing or not a JSON boolean → 400 {{{ok:false, message:"enabled must be true or false"}}} |
| POST | {{/api/system/export-logs}} | — | {{Envelope(ExportLogs())}} — ok {{Logs exported to USB}} or {{{ok:false, code:9083}}} |
| POST | {{/api/system/export-csv}} | {{{filename, content}}} | {{Json(ExportCsv(...))}} — {{{ok:true, message, path}}} ({{.csv}}) or 9081 ({{No Disk-on-Key found. Please connect a Disk-on-Key (USB drive).}}) / 9082 |
| POST | {{/api/system/export-report}} | {{{filename, content}}} | same with {{.html}} |
| GET | {{/api/system/update/manifest}} | — | manifest JSON {{{ok:true, version, sha256}}} 200, or 404 with {{{ok:false, code:9081|9086|9087, message}}} |
| GET | {{/api/system/update/package}} | — | {{.scu}} bytes, {{application/octet-stream}}, attachment name {{FileName}} or the file's name; else 404 {{{ok:false, code?, message (default "No update package")}}} |
| POST | {{/api/system/update}} | — | {{Json(RunUpdate())}} — {{{ok, steps:[{step,status}], version, message, code?}}} |
| GET | {{/api/network/policy}} | — | {{{ok:true, offline: bool|null, offlineMode, expectsNetwork}}} |
| POST | {{/api/network/policy}} | {{{offline: true|false|null}}} | {{Choose(offline)}}; {{{ok:true, offline, offlineMode, message}}} |
| POST | {{/api/cloud/config}} | {{{url, key, name?, interval?}}} | missing url or key → 400 {{{ok:false, message:"url and key required"}}}; else {{Envelope(Configure(url, key, name, interval))}} |
| GET | {{/api/network/status}} | — | {{{connected, ip, mac, gateway, interfaces:[{name,status:"UP"|"DOWN",ip}], internet, wireguardIp}}} (+{{code:9084}} on error) |
| POST | {{/api/network/diagnostics}} | {{{tool (default "ping"), address (default "8.8.8.8")}}} | {{Json(Diagnostics(...))}} — {{{ok, result, code?}}} |
| POST | {{/api/network/static}} | {{{dhcp: bool (only JSON true counts), ip (""), gateway (""), subnet ("255.255.255.0"), dns ("")}}} | {{Envelope(SetStatic(...))}} |
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Str(body, name)}}: string value; number / true / false → raw JSON text; absent / other kinds → null.
# {{network/policy}} POST: {{offline}} = JSON true → true, false → false, anything else or missing → null (follow cloud enrolment); never refused. Message: offlineMode true → {{Working without a network - the missing connection is not reported}}; else {{A network is expected - a missing connection is shown as before}}. Persisted by Platform in {{data/network-policy.json}}.
# {{cloud/config}}: {{interval}} only when a JSON number; {{name}} via {{Str}}. Writes {{<data>/cloud.json}} (Platform).
# Diagnostics: unknown tool → {{{ok:false, code:9080, result:"Unknown tool"}}}; invalid address (e.g. shell metacharacters) → {{{ok:false, code:9085, result:"Invalid address..."}}}. The address is validated and never passed through a shell (Platform).
# Static IP off-Linux → {{{ok:true, message:"Network config simulated (off-device)"}}}; nmcli error → 9084.
# {{datetime}} switches network time off (Platform); {{network-time}} POST is the only way back on.
# No admission rules in the API (reboot is not refused during a run — OPEN QUESTION whether {{ISystemService.Reboot}} checks for an active process; not visible here). During a DVT hang all POSTs answer 409.
*Configuration:* none in the API; Platform uses data dir, {{keys/scure-update.pub}}, USB mount detection.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Version has all nine keys; {{appVersion}} matches {{^\d+\.\d+\.\d+}}.
* {{datetime {date:"14/09/2026", time:"10:00"}}} → 200 {{{ok:false, message:"Invalid date/time format"}}}; no body → ok:false; {{{date:"2026-09-14", time:"10:00"}}} → ok (simulated off-device).
* Exports: 200 and either ok (csv {{path}} ends {{.csv}}) or 9081/9082 with {{Disk-on-Key}} in the message; logs ok or 9083.
* Without a package: manifest 404, {{ok:false}}, code ∈ {9081, 9086, 9087}; package 404 {{ok:false}}.
* {{cloud/config {url}}} → 400 {{url and key required}}; full body → 200 ok and {{<data>/cloud.json}} exists.
* Network status keys present; interfaces have {{name, status ∈ {UP, DOWN}, ip}}.
* Diagnostics {{nmap}} → 9080 {{Unknown tool}}; {{ping}} of {{127.0.0.1; rm -rf /}} → 9085 with {{Invalid address}}; {{ping 127.0.0.1}} returns {{ok}} and {{result}} keys.
* Static {{{dhcp:true}}} → 200 with {{ok}}, {{message}}; off Linux {{ok:true}}.
* {{network-time {enabled:"yes"}}} → 400.
*Tests:* {{SystemTests}}: {{Version_has_every_key}}, {{Datetime_validation}}, {{Exports_report_no_usb_with_9081_or_succeed}}, {{Update_manifest_and_package_are_404_without_a_package}}, {{Cloud_config_requires_url_and_key}}, {{Network_status_shape}}, {{Network_diagnostics_reject_unknown_tools_and_shell_injection}}, {{Network_static_is_simulated_off_device}}. Add: network-time 400 and network/policy round trip.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/SystemEndpoints.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/NetworkEndpoints.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Platform/NetworkPolicy.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Platform/ISystemService.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Platform/IUpdateService.cs}}, {{src/SCureBox.Application/Platform/INetworkService.cs}}, {{tests/SCureBox.Api.Tests/SystemTests.cs}}, {{docs/01-api-contract.md}} §2, §6.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* DVT bench, Safety & watchdog, UV light sensors, LED calibration
*Blocked by:* API-02, API-03, API-05, DVT-01, DVT-02, DVT-03, DVT-04, DVT-05, PROC-08, HW-02, HW-13
*Blocks:* API-01, OPS-17

*Implements:* OD-21, OD-61, OD-67, OD-68, OD-69, OD-71, OD-58, REQ-20, REQ-24

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/SCureBox.Api.csproj}} — {{Endpoints/DvtEndpoints.cs}}
*Goal:* Routes used by the DVT console, the DVT web page and the on-machine DVT runner: the Ophir StarBright meter on the
machine's USB, the bench lock lease, the UV linearity sweep (DVT-OPT-001/002), the UV-off-on-door-open timing (DVT-SAF-008), the
deliberate firmware hang (DVT-SAF-010) with its 409 gate, the in-memory LED panel check override (DVT-SAF-016) and the
"confirm at the machine" requests raised for tests started from sCure Cloud. JSON uses snake_case keys identical to sCure-A
{{server/uv_sweep.py}}.
*Depends on:* API-02, API-05 (hang state in {{/api/state}}), API-03 (heartbeat pause); Dvt-Hdt / Application ({{SCureBox.Application.Dvt}}: {{UvSweep}} ({{Meter(identify)}} → {{MeterStatus {Present, Identity, ReadingMwCm2, Message}}}, {{SetMeterWavelength(int)}} → {{{Ok, WavelengthNm, Message}}}, {{Start(UvSweepRequest)}}, {{Status(samples)}}, {{Abort()}} → string), {{UvSweepRequest(int Wavelength, IReadOnlyList<int>? Steps, double Dwell=10, double Baseline=5, double Settle=5, double Tail=3, double Hz=5, bool Force=false)}}, {{UvOffTiming}} ({{Start(UvOffRequest)}}, {{Status(samples)}}, {{Abort(string by)}}), {{UvOffRequest(int Wavelength=405, int Intensity=100, double PlateauMaxSec=30, double StableSec=2, double OpenTimeoutSec=30, double TailSec=3, double Hz=20, bool Force=false, double AlarmWatchSec=15, bool Release=false)}}, start results {{{Ok, Message, Code, MeterWavelengthNm, MeterWavelengthVerified}}}, {{DvtBench}} ({{Owner}}, {{TryAcquire(who, TimeSpan?)}}, {{Release(who)}}), {{DvtHang}} ({{Prepare(int)}} → {{DvtHangStart(Ok, Status, Message, Sec)}}, {{Begin()}}, {{Active}}, {{Until}}, {{MinSec=5}}, {{MaxSec=300}}, {{DefaultSec=60}}, {{HeartbeatTimeoutSec}}=20), {{RemoteConfirm}} ({{Ask(id,title,detail,TimeSpan?)}} → {{Request{Id,...,Expires}}}, {{Status(id)}} → {{State {Pending, Accepted, Declined, Expired, Withdrawn, Unknown}}}, {{Withdraw(id)}}; default timeout 10 min, max 60 min)); {{SCureBox.Application.Supervision.LedCheckOverride}} ({{On}}, {{static Effective(LedHeatingConfig, LedCheckOverride?)}} → {{{Enabled, Panels: dict panel→sensor}}}); Hardware ({{SCureBox.Hardware.IHardwareConfig.LedHeating}}, {{OutputFreeze}}); Native UI (shows the remote-confirm dialog and calls {{Resolve}}).
*Files to create:* {{src/SCureBox.Api/Endpoints/DvtEndpoints.cs}} — {{public static class DvtEndpoints}} with {{public static void Map(RouteGroupBuilder api)}}, extension {{public static IApplicationBuilder UseDvtHangGate(this IApplicationBuilder app)}}, {{internal static readonly string[] HangAllowed}}, {{internal static bool IsLocal(HttpContext ctx)}}, private {{LedChecks}}, {{LocalOnly}}, {{Flatten<T>}} (serialize with {{ApiJson.Options}} to a {{JsonObject}}).
*Public contract:*
||Method||Route||Query / body||Response||
| GET | {{/api/dvt/meter}} | {{identify}} ({{OnLoose}}, default false) | no meter → {{{ok:false, present:false, message}}}; else the flattened identity ({{transport, path, firmware, instrument, head, head_type, units, unit_name, ranges, range_in_use, wavelengths, measurement_mode, wavelength_nm, errors}}; empty when never identified) + {{ok:true, present:true, reading_mw_cm2, message}} |
| GET | {{/api/dvt/bench}} | — | {{{ok:true, owner: string|null}}} |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/bench/claim}} | {{who}} (required), {{lease_s}} (30, clamped 1..300) | {{{ok:true, owner, lease_s, message:"bench held by {who} for {lease:0} s"}}}; blank who → {{{ok:false, message:"who= is required"}}}; busy → {{{ok:false, message:"the DVT bench is busy ({owner})"}}} |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/bench/release}} | {{who}} | {{{ok:true, owner, message:"released"}}} (only the owner's release takes effect) |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/meter/wavelength}} | {{nm}} (0) | {{{ok, wavelength_nm, message}}} |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/uv-sweep}} | {{wavelength}} (405), {{steps}} (comma ints, optional), {{dwell}} (10), {{baseline}} (5), {{settle}} (5), {{tail}} (3), {{hz}} (5), {{force}} ({{OnLoose}}) | {{{ok, message, code, meter_wavelength_nm, meter_wavelength_verified}}}; a non-int step → {{{ok:false, message:"bad parameter: steps '<raw>'"}}} |
| GET | {{/api/dvt/uv-sweep}} | {{samples}} ({{On}}, default true) | flattened sweep status + {{ok:true}} |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/uv-sweep/abort}} | — | {{{ok:true, message}}} ({{no sweep running}} when idle) |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/uv-off}} | {{wavelength}} (405), {{intensity}} (100), {{plateau_max}} (30), {{stable}} (2), {{open_timeout}} (30), {{tail}} (3), {{hz}} (20), {{force}}, {{alarm_watch}} (15), {{release}} ({{OnLoose}}) | {{{ok, message, code, meter_wavelength_nm, meter_wavelength_verified}}} |
| GET | {{/api/dvt/uv-off}} | {{samples}} ({{On}}) | flattened UV-off status + {{ok:true}} |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/uv-off/abort}} | {{by}} (default the User-Agent, or {{api}}) | {{{ok:true, message}}} |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/hang}} | {{sec}} (60; whole number) | loopback only; {{{ok:true, sec, heartbeatTimeoutSec}}} |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/led-checks}} | {{on}} ∈ {1,true,on,0,false,off} (trimmed, lower-cased) | loopback only; LedChecks shape |
| GET | {{/api/dvt/led-checks}} | — | {{{ok:true, enabled, override: bool?, panels:[...], sensors:{panel: sensor}}}} (no loopback check) |
| POST | {{/api/dvt/remote-confirm}} | JSON {{{id, title?, detail?, timeoutSec?}}} | loopback only; {{{ok:true, id, state:"pending", expires:<unix s>}}}; empty id → 400 {{{ok:false, message:"a confirmation needs an id"}}} |
| GET | {{/api/dvt/remote-confirm/{id}}} | — | loopback only; {{{ok:true, id, state}}} with state lower-case enum name |
| DELETE | {{/api/dvt/remote-confirm/{id}}} | — | loopback only; withdraw, then {{{ok:true, id, state}}} |
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{IsLocal(ctx)}}: {{RemoteIpAddress}} non-null and {{IPAddress.IsLoopback(ip.IsIPv4MappedToIPv6 ? ip.MapToIPv4() : ip)}} (Kestrel on {{*:3001}} hands IPv4 as {{::ffff:127.0.0.1}}). Non-local → 403 with {{only the DVT runner on this CureBox may hang the firmware}} (hang), {{... may switch the LED checks}} (led-checks POST), {{... may ask for a confirmation}} (all remote-confirm routes). A {{TestServer}} request has no remote IP → treated as not local.
# {{hang}}: order = local check → {{sec}} parse (non-integer → 400 {{sec must be a whole number 5-300 (got '<raw>')}}) → {{hang.Prepare(sec)}}: out of 5..300 → 400 {{sec must be 5-300 (got N)}}; already hung → 409 {{the firmware is already hung for a DVT test}}; neither heating nor UV on → 409 {{nothing is on (heater or UV) - start heating or a UV output first; there is nothing for the watchdog to cut}}; else capture state. The 200 reply is sent first; {{hang.Begin()}} runs in {{ctx.Response.OnCompleted}}. During the hang: no heartbeat (API-03), outputs frozen, {{/api/state}} returns the captured state + {{dvtHang}}. After it: outputs off, program ended as failed, Err 9017 when the watchdog trip record shows a cut (acknowledged via {{POST /api/watchdog/ack}}), else 7005.
# {{UseDvtHangGate}} (installed after {{UseScureApi}}, before endpoints): when {{DvtHang}} is registered and {{Active}}, and the method is not GET/HEAD, and the path starts with {{/api/}} and does not start (case-insensitive) with any of {{/api/dvt/meter}}, {{/api/dvt/bench}}, {{/api/dvt/remote-confirm}}, {{/api/dev/picolog}} → 409 {{{ok:false, message:"the firmware is hung for a DVT test (DVT-SAF-010) until <unix s> - no output commands"}}} (the {{ until N}} part only when {{Until}} is known). GETs keep answering.
# {{led-checks}} POST: invalid/missing {{on}} → 400 {{on must be 1 or 0 (got '<raw>')}}; sets {{LedCheckOverride.On}} in memory only (never written to components.json); logs warning (category {{DVT}}) {{[DVT] LED panel checks override ON (all four panels, in memory)}} / {{off (components.json again)}}. Response from {{LedCheckOverride.Effective(cfg.LedHeating, o)}}: {{enabled}}, {{override}} = {{o.On}}, {{panels}} = panel names sorted ordinal, {{sensors}} = panel → sensor name. With the override on, {{/api/state.ledChecksEnabled}} is true; panels {{LED_LEFT}}→{{TEMP_LEFT}}, {{LED_RIGHT}}→{{TEMP_RIGHT}}.
# {{remote-confirm}} POST: body fields read only when JSON strings ({{id}}, {{title}}, {{detail}}); {{timeoutSec}} any JSON number ({{TryGetDouble}}); asking again with a pending id returns the same request. Only the screen (Native UI) resolves a request.
# Sweep / UV-off refusals (Dvt-Hdt): already running; {{wavelength must be 405 or 450...}}; steps outside 10–100; intensity too low (e.g. 5); process active; HDT running; door open; program running (UV-off); meter unreachable; meter on another wavelength ({{code:"METER_WAVELENGTH"}} unless {{force=1}}); bench lease held → message starts {{the DVT bench is busy}}. While someone else holds the bench, {{/api/dvt/meter}} returns {{ok:true, present:true, message:"the meter is in use by <owner>", reading_mw_cm2:null}}.
# {{Flatten}}: serialize the status record with {{ApiJson.Options}} and add {{ok}} (and for the meter {{present}}, {{reading_mw_cm2}}, {{message}}) as JSON object keys.
*Configuration:* {{SCURE_SIM_METER=1}} simulated StarBright (head {{PD300RM-8W SIM-0001}}).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Meter (sim): ok, {{present:true}}, {{head:"PD300RM-8W SIM-0001"}}, numeric {{reading_mw_cm2}}; {{meter/wavelength?nm=450}} → {{wavelength_nm:450}}; {{nm=365}} → ok:false.
* Bench: claim without who → ok:false; claim {{who=DVT bench recording&lease_s=30}} → ok; {{GET /api/dvt/bench}} owner = that string; meter then {{the meter is in use by DVT bench recording}} and {{reading_mw_cm2:null}}; uv-sweep message starts {{the DVT bench is busy}}; same-who claim renews; release → owner null; meter reading numeric again.
* Sweep idle status has {{running, status, phase, config, steps, error, meter, meter_wavelength_verified, dark_mw_cm2, n_samples}}; {{wavelength=365}} → message starts {{wavelength must be 405 or 450}}; abort idle → {{no sweep running}}; a short sweep {{steps=30,60}} ends {{status:"OK"}} with two steps, rising mean, samples of 6 elements with first phase {{baseline}}, UV off after.
* UV-off: {{intensity=5}} refused; a short run ends {{status:"OK"}}, {{mode:"program"}}, {{plateau_mw_cm2 > 30}}, UV off afterwards, recipe not running.
* Hang from loopback: idle → 409; {{sec=4}}, {{301}}, {{abc}} → 400; with heating on → 200 {{{ok:true, sec:5, heartbeatTimeoutSec:20}}}; state shows {{dvtHang.active}}; {{POST /api/cure/stop}} → 409 containing {{hung}}; second hang → 409; {{GET /api/dev/picolog/status}} and {{GET /api/dvt/meter}} → 200; after it {{dvtHang}} absent, {{isHeating:false}}, {{uvOn:false}}, commands ok, {{watchdog/ack}} ok.
* From a non-loopback client: {{POST /api/dvt/led-checks?on=1}} and {{POST /api/dvt/hang?sec=60}} → 403; {{ledChecksEnabled}} stays false.
* LED checks from loopback: no {{on}} / {{on=maybe}} → 400; {{on=1}} → {{enabled:true}}, {{panels ["LED_LEFT","LED_RIGHT"]}}, sensors {{TEMP_LEFT}}/{{TEMP_RIGHT}}; {{on=0}} → {{enabled:false}}; components.json unchanged.
*Tests:* {{DvtTests}}: {{Meter_reports_itself_and_takes_a_wavelength}}, {{The_bench_process_can_hold_the_meter_lock_on_a_lease}}, {{Sweep_validates_runs_and_reports_in_the_python_json}}, {{Uv_off_runs_a_real_program_and_reports_how_it_ended}}. {{DvtHangApiTests.Hang_contract_end_to_end}}, {{DvtLedChecksApiTests.Led_checks_override_on_off_and_validation}} (both on {{LoopbackApiFixture}}), {{DvtLocalOnlyTests.Hang_and_led_checks_are_refused_from_another_host}}. Add: remote-confirm 403 off-loopback, 400 without id, pending → withdrawn state.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Native UI shell & theme, Simulator, API host & infrastructure
*Blocked by:* UI-02, UI-05, UI-06, UI-09, UI-10, API-01, API-02, PLAT-01, PLAT-04, PLAT-05, PLAT-12, UIDLG-01
*Blocks:* OPS-03, OPS-05, OPS-14, OPS-18, UI-08

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Ui/SCureBox.Ui.csproj}} — root ({{Program.cs}}, {{App.axaml(.cs)}}, {{UiPages.cs}}, {{UiServiceCollectionExtensions.cs}}, {{ViewLocator.cs}}, {{app.manifest}}), {{Hosting/}}, {{Views/ShellView.axaml(.cs)}}, {{Views/ShellScaler.cs}}, {{Views/ShellWindow.cs}}, {{ViewModels/ShellViewModel.cs}}, {{ViewModels/PageViewModel.cs}}, {{Services/UiRuntime.cs}}
*Goal:* Run the firmware host and the Avalonia UI in one process with one DI container, choose the output (DRM/KMS on the unit, a desktop window elsewhere), guarantee the process exits within 10 s of any stop request with the "Restarting…" frame on the panel, and host every page inside a 1600x1000 shell that scales/rotates to the output, blurs behind dialogs and resets the idle timer on every touch. A {{demo.mode}} file next to the exe turns the app into the PC simulator.
*Depends on:* UI-02, UI-05, UI-06, UI-09, UI-10; Api ({{ScureApiHost.Build}}, {{CommandLine.TryRun}}, {{IApiEndpointMapper}}, {{ApiJson}}), Application-Platform ({{PlatformInfo}}, {{PlannedRestart}}, {{DataOptions}}, {{SerialBackup}}), Native UI dialogs ({{IDialogService}}, {{DialogService}}, {{DialogViewModel}})
*Files to create:*
* {{Program.cs}} — {{internal static class Program}} ({{Main}}, {{RunAvalonia}}, {{BuildAvaloniaApp}}, {{ParseSize}}, {{HardExit}})
* {{App.axaml}} / {{App.axaml.cs}} — {{public partial class App : Avalonia.Application}}

PageBlurSource}}, {{double PageBlurOpacity}}, {{bool DialogIsUp}}, {{void StepPageFade()}}; named parts {{PageLayer}}, {{PageHost}}, {{PageFade}}, {{PageBlur}}, {{PageBlurStill}}, {{Dialogs}} (DialogHost), {{FloatLayer}} (Canvas, exposed as {{FloatLayer}} property used by FloatingList).
* {{ShellScaler : UserControl}}: ctor {{(Control shell)}}, {{Control Shell}}, {{int Rotation}}, {{static int Resolve(Size output)}}.
* {{ShellWindow : Window}}: ctor {{(Control content, Size size, bool hideCursor, bool fullScreen = false)}}.
* {{UiRuntime}}: ctor {{(MachineStateStore, AlertService, IdleService, INavigationService, UiSettingsStore, BarcodeScanner, RemoteConfirmPrompter, NfcJobService)}}; {{Control? ShellRoot}}, {{TopLevel? TopLevel}}, {{bool Started}}, {{void Start(bool skipBoot = false)}}, {{void Stop()}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Main}}: (a) {{DemoMode.ApplyFromProcess()}}; (b) {{CommandLine.TryRun(args, Console.Out, Console.Error, out exit)}} — if it handled a CLI tool command return its exit code; (c) {{app = ScureApiHost.Build(args, b => b.Services.AddSCureBoxUi())}}, logger category "UI", {{app.StartAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult()}}, {{App.Services = app.Services}}; (d) register on {{app.Lifetime.ApplicationStopping}}: if the UI already stopped, return; else start background thread "hard-exit-deadline" that sleeps 10 s then logs an error and {{HardExit(0)}}; call {{PlannedRestart.Mark("host stopping")}} if registered (next boot = quick boot); {{Dispatcher.UIThread.Post}} a {{Navigate(Route.Restart, null, replace: true)}}; sleep 400 ms; {{Post(App.RequestShutdown)}}; then start thread "ui-stop-guard": sleep 4 s, if the UI loop has not ended, {{app.StopAsync}} with a 10 s token, then {{HardExit(0)}}. (e) {{exit = RunAvalonia(args, log)}}; in {{finally}}: mark UI stopped, {{app.StopAsync}} bounded by 5 s (wait 6 s), {{app.DisposeAsync}} bounded by 2 s, then {{HardExit(exit)}}.
# {{HardExit(status)}}: on Linux P/Invoke {{libc _exit(status)}}; else {{Process.GetCurrentProcess().Kill()}}; last resort {{Environment.Exit(status)}}. Reason: worker threads and DRM exit handlers keep the process alive until systemd SIGKILLs it at 90 s.
# {{RunAvalonia}}: {{SCURE_UI_WINDOW}} truthy forces a window. {{UiMotion.Enabled = Truthy(SCURE_UI_ANIMATIONS)}} (animations OFF unless asked). Builder = {{AppBuilder.Configure<App>().UseSkia().UseHarfBuzz().WithInterFont().LogToTrace()}} (UseHarfBuzz is mandatory: the DRM path crashed without a text shaper). Linux and not forced window → {{card = DrmCards.Select(env SCURE_UI_DRM_CARD)}}, {{App.HideCursor = true}}, {{return builder.StartLinuxDrm(args, card, 1.0)}}. Otherwise: {{App.HideCursor = Truthy(SCURE_UI_HIDE_CURSOR)}}, {{App.FullScreen = Truthy(SCURE_UI_FULLSCREEN)}}, {{App.WindowSize = ParseSize(SCURE_UI_SIZE) ?? 1920x1200}}; {{builder.UsePlatformDetect().UseWaylandWithFallback()}}; {{SCURE_UI_RENDER}} (trimmed lower): {{gles}} → {{WaylandPlatformOptions.GlProfiles = [OpenGLES 3.1, 3.0, 2.0]}}; {{software}} → {{WaylandPlatformOptions{GlProfiles = empty, UseDmabufSwapchain = false}}} + {{X11PlatformOptions{RenderingMode = [Software]}}}; {{StartWithClassicDesktopLifetime(args, ShutdownMode.OnMainWindowClose)}}.
# {{Truthy(v)}}: trimmed lower-case is "1", "true" or "yes". {{ParseSize("WxH")}}: case-insensitive "x" split, exactly 2 ints, w ≥ 200 and h ≥ 120, else null.
# {{DemoMode.Environment(root)}} = SCURE_SIMULATE=1, SCURE_UI_WINDOW=1, SCURE_UI_SIZE=1600x1000, PORT=3011, ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://127.0.0.1:3011, SCURE_DATA_DIR=<root>/data. {{Apply}}: returns false when {{<baseDir>/demo.mode}} does not exist; root = {{<localAppData or baseDir>/sCureBox Demo}}; each variable is set only when {{get(name)}} is null/whitespace (environment wins); returns true.
# {{DrmCards.Select}}: a non-blank override is returned trimmed; else {{Scan}} → {{/dev/dri/<cardN>}} or null. {{Scan}}: directories {{card*-*}} under sysClassDrm sorted ordinal; name split at first '-' (skip if dash index ≤ 4); first card with any connector remembered; a connector whose {{status}} file reads "connected" (case-insensitive) wins immediately; IO/permission errors ignored; missing dir → null.
# {{App.axaml}}: {{RequestedThemeVariant="Dark"}}, DataTemplates = {{ViewLocator}}; resources merge {{avares://scurebox-ui/Styles/Tokens.axaml}} and {{.../Styles/ScrollViewer.axaml}}; styles = {{FluentTheme}} then {{avares://scurebox-ui/Styles/Controls.axaml}}.
# {{OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted}} (only when {{Services}} is set; headless tests leave it null): create {{ShellView { DataContext = ShellViewModel }}}, {{runtime.ShellRoot = shell}}, wrap in {{new ShellScaler(shell)}}; desktop lifetime → {{new ShellWindow(scaler, WindowSize, HideCursor, FullScreen)}} as MainWindow and {{runtime.TopLevel = window}}; single-view lifetime (DRM) → {{MainView = scaler}}, TopLevel set when the scaler attaches; then {{runtime.Start()}}. {{RequestShutdown()}} calls {{Shutdown()}} only if the lifetime is {{IControlledApplicationLifetime}}.
# {{AddSCureBoxUi}} registers: {{TryAddSingleton(TimeProvider.System)}}, {{TryAddSingleton<SerialBackup>(new SerialBackup())}}, singletons {{UiSettingsStore}}, {{MachineStateStore}}, {{AlertService}}, {{DevModeService}}, {{IdleService}}, {{BarcodeScanner}}, {{RemoteConfirmPrompter}}, {{NfcJobService}}, {{TryAddSingleton<IOriginBrowserSignIn, OriginBrowserSignIn>}}, {{UiRuntime}}, {{INavigationService→NavigationService}}, {{IDialogService→DialogService}}, {{TopBarViewModel}}, {{ShellViewModel}}, {{TryAddSingleton(BootTimings.Default)}}, {{TryAddSingleton<IBootSelfTest, HardwareBootSelfTest>}}, every page VM type of {{UiPages.All}} as transient, {{AddSingleton<IApiEndpointMapper, UiEndpoints>}}. (TryAdd lets tests pre-register fakes.)
# {{UiPages.All}} order and titles exactly as the overview table. {{UiPages.Dialogs}} maps 24 dialog VMs to views: OnScreenKeyboard, NumberPad, MessageDialog, CriticalAlertDialog, NitrogenOnlyDialog, PreflightDialog, FanFailDialog, UsbFileBrowserDialog, DevAuthDialog, AbortDialog, PauseDialog, PauseOverlay, HeaterFaultDialog, TemperatureWarningDialog, CureCompleteDialog, DoorOpenDialog, PrintHistoryDialog, VersionsDialog, ComplianceDialog, SoftwareUpdateDialog, StaticIpDialog, MaterialEditorDialog, ImportCsvDialog, OriginSignInDialog (each {{XxxViewModel → XxxView}}; keyboard/numberpad are {{OnScreenKeyboardViewModel→OnScreenKeyboardView}}, {{NumberPadViewModel→NumberPadView}}). {{ViewFor}} looks up a merged map of both. {{DialogsAreValid()}} = every key is assignable to {{DialogViewModel}}.
# {{ViewLocator.Match}} = data is {{PageViewModel}} or {{DialogViewModel}}. {{Build}}: null → empty TextBlock; unknown type → {{TextBlock "No view for {TypeName}"}}; else {{Activator.CreateInstance(viewType)}} with {{DataContext = data}}.
# {{ShellViewModel}}: on {{navigation.Changed}} → {{CurrentPage = navigation.CurrentPage}}, {{ShowTopBar = !Current.IsFullScreen()}}, and if a dialog is open {{dialogs.CloseAll(pageChange: true)}} (dialogs belong to the page that opened them, except those with {{KeepAcrossPageChange}}). On {{dialogs.Changed}} → {{BelowDialog = dialogs.Below; Dialog = dialogs.Current}}. Calls {{OnNavigated()}} once in the ctor. {{Touch()}} → {{IdleService.Touch()}}.
# {{ShellView}} (1600x1000, Background {{BackgroundBrush}}, ClipToBounds): TopBar {{IsVisible}} bound to {{ShowTopBar}}; {{DialogHost Dialog={Binding Dialog} Below={Binding BelowDialog}}}. Tunnel handlers (handledEventsToo) for PointerPressed and PointerMoved call {{ShellViewModel.Touch()}}. A static class handler on {{ScrollContentPresenter.RequestBringIntoViewEvent}} marks the event handled when the presenter is inside a {{ShellView}} whose {{DialogIsUp}} ({{Dialogs.HasDialog || Dialogs.FadeProgress > 0}}) — a modal must never scroll the page behind it.
# Dialog blur: when {{DialogHost.HasDialog}} turns true, {{PrepareDialogBlur()}} immediately renders {{PageLayer}} into a {{RenderTargetBitmap}} at scale 0.08 (pixel size ≥ 2x2, DPI 96·scale) with {{TextOptions.TextRenderingMode = Antialias}} temporarily (greyscale — subpixel AA produced coloured confetti) and sets it as {{ImageBrush{Stretch=Fill}}} background of {{PageBlurStill}}; {{PageBlur}} (outer border, opaque {{BackgroundBrush}}) shows it. On every {{DialogHost.FadeProgress}} change: progress > 0.001 → ensure still, {{PageBlur.Opacity = DialogHost.Ease(progress)}}; else hide, opacity 0, dispose and drop the still. A capture failure returns null and is never fatal. When {{CurrentPage}} changes while a dialog is open, after the next {{PageLayer.LayoutUpdated}} take a fresh still (keep the old one if the capture fails). Never use an Avalonia blur {{Effect}} (it ignores the 90° rotation and drew upside down).
# Page fade (off by default, {{PageFadeEnabled=false}}): on {{PropertyChanging(CurrentPage)}} capture the page at 0.5 scale into {{PageFade}} (opacity 1) and on {{PropertyChanged(CurrentPage)}} tween it to 0 over 200 ms ({{Tween(…, 200, 16)}}); at ≤ 0.001 hide and dispose.
# {{ShellScaler}}: Background black; {{Content = Viewbox{Stretch=Uniform, StretchDirection=Both, Child = LayoutTransformControl{Child = shell}}}}; on SizeChanged {{Resolve(size)}} = 90 when Height > Width else 0; apply {{RotateTransform(90)}} (or null) only when it changed. Touch follows the transform.
# {{ShellWindow}}: Title {{Strings.AppName}} ("sCure"), fixed Width/Height, {{CanResize=false}}, {{WindowDecorations = None}}, Background black, CenterScreen, {{WindowState = FullScreen}} only when {{fullScreen}}, {{Cursor = None}} when {{hideCursor}}.
# {{UiRuntime.Start(skipBoot)}}: idempotent; starts {{MachineStateStore}}, {{AlertService}}, {{IdleService}}, {{BarcodeScanner}}, {{RemoteConfirmPrompter}}, {{NfcJobService}}; then {{Navigate(Route.Boot, replace: true)}} (or, with skipBoot, Home if {{SetupComplete}} else Setup). {{Stop()}} stops idle, alerts, store and clears {{Started}}.
*Configuration:* env {{SCURE_UI_WINDOW}}, {{SCURE_UI_ANIMATIONS}}, {{SCURE_UI_DRM_CARD}}, {{SCURE_UI_HIDE_CURSOR}}, {{SCURE_UI_FULLSCREEN}}, {{SCURE_UI_SIZE}} ("WxH"), {{SCURE_UI_RENDER}} ({{gles}} | {{software}}); demo marker file {{demo.mode}} beside the exe (sets SCURE_SIMULATE, SCURE_UI_WINDOW, SCURE_UI_SIZE, PORT, ASPNETCORE_URLS, SCURE_DATA_DIR); csproj property {{DemoWinExe=true}} makes OutputType {{WinExe}} (no console window for the PC demo installer).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Shell renders the TopBar with the system name and no clock; TopBar hidden on Boot/Wake/Setup/Restart.
* Navigating to every {{Route}} (dev mode unlocked) yields a page VM of that route and a resolved view (no "No view for" text).
* {{Resolve(1200x1920) == 90}}, {{Resolve(1920x1200) == 0}}.
* {{ParseSize("1600x1000")}} → 1600x1000; "abc", "100x100", "" → null.
* DemoMode: no marker → nothing set, returns false; marker → the six variables set with {{<LocalAppData>/sCureBox Demo/data}}; pre-set variables are kept.
* DrmCards prefers a connected connector and honours the override.
* Opening a dialog shows a blurred still on an opaque base; closing removes it; a dialog that outlives a page change shows a still of the new page.
* {{ShellWindow}} is full screen only when asked.
* After a stop request the process exits within 10 s.
*Tests:* {{ShellTests}} (top bar/no clock, every route resolves a view, top bar hidden on full-screen routes + back pops history, blur while dialog open, page fade, placeholder registry/{{DialogsAreValid}}, "No_view_uses_a_popup_control", icon kinds parse), {{ShellScalerTests}}, {{ShellWindowTests}}, {{DemoModeTests}}, {{DialogBlurTests}}, {{DialogMotionTests}} (opening a dialog moves neither page nor shell scale; never scrolls into view), {{DialogViewModelTests.DrmCards_prefers_a_connected_connector_and_honours_the_override}} and {{Window_size_parses_WxH}}. column4: UI-04 Touch gestures: SwipeRow and TouchScrollGestureRecognizer
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Native UI shell & theme, Programs & recipes
*Blocked by:* UI-02
*Blocks:* UI-08, UI-14
*Implements:* REQ-06, REQ-25

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Ui/SCureBox.Ui.csproj}} — {{Controls/SwipeRow.cs}}, {{Controls/TouchScrollGestureRecognizer.cs}}
*Goal:* Make touch feel right on the rotated portrait panel: a scroll recognizer that measures the finger in the scrolled control's own coordinates, damps panel noise, fits fling velocity robustly and steps all motion on rendered frames; and a swipeable list row (right = run, left = uncover an action tray) that can never start a cure by accident and never fights the page scroll.
*Depends on:* UI-02 (SwipeRow theme, ScrollViewer theme), UI-05 ({{UiMotion}} is NOT consulted by the row)
*Files to create:*
* {{Controls/SwipeRow.cs}} — {{public enum SwipeAction { None, Start, Open, Close }}}, {{public class SwipeRow : ContentControl}} (TemplateParts {{PART_Row}}, {{PART_Start}}, {{PART_Actions}}; pseudo-classes {{:swiping}}, {{:armed}}, {{:open}}, {{:revealed}})
* {{Controls/TouchScrollGestureRecognizer.cs}} — {{public sealed class TouchScrollGestureRecognizer : GestureRecognizer}}, {{internal sealed class FlingTracker}}
*Public contract:*
* {{SwipeRow}} constants: {{StartDistance = 14}}, {{StartFraction = 0.5}}, {{ActivateStart = 180}}, {{ActivateOpen = 120}}, {{ActivateClose = 60}}, {{AxisRatio = 1.2}}, {{Overshoot = 24}}, {{PxPerMm = 7.4}}, {{ActionsRevealMm = 5}}, {{SnapMs = 180}}, {{CompleteMs = 160}}. Statics: {{double StartThreshold(double rowWidth) = max(180, rowWidth·0.5)}}, {{SwipeAction Decide(double dx, double dy, bool open, bool canStart, bool canOpen, double rowWidth = 0)}}, {{double ActionsOpacity(double x)}}, {{bool IsClaimed(IPointer)}}. Styled props: {{Actions}} (object?), {{OpenWidth}} (double), {{IsOpen}} (bool, TwoWay default), {{StartCommand}} (ICommand?), {{SwipeEnabled}} (true), {{StartText}} (""). Read-only: {{SwipeAction LastAction}}, {{double Offset}}. Method {{void FinishMotion()}}.
* {{TouchScrollGestureRecognizer}} styled props {{CanHorizontallyScroll}}, {{CanVerticallyScroll}}, {{IsScrollInertiaEnabled}}, {{ScrollStartDistance}} (default 8); private consts {{InertialScrollSpeedEnd = 5}}, {{InertialResistance = ScrollGestureRecognizer.InertialResistance}} (0.15), {{MaxFlingSpeed = 6000}}, {{JitterPx = 4}}, {{MinFollow = 0.4}}, {{MaxCoast = 6 s}}; {{internal Point Damp(Point raw)}}, {{internal static double CoastShare(double t)}}, {{internal static Vector ClampSpeed(Vector v)}}.
* {{FlingTracker}}: {{const double WindowMs = 100}}, {{Reset(ulong ts, Point p)}}, {{Add(ulong ts, Point p)}}, {{Vector Velocity()}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Decide}}: if |dx| < |dy|·1.2 → None; open row → Close when dx ≥ 60 else None (an open row can never start); closed: canStart and dx ≥ StartThreshold(rowWidth) → Start; canOpen and dx ≤ −120 → Open; else None.
# SwipeRow listens to PointerPressed/Moved/Released with Tunnel|Bubble and handledEventsToo (the row content is a Button), de-duplicating the same args object; PointerCaptureLost cancels. {{ClipToBounds = true}}. {{CanStart}} = SwipeEnabled && StartCommand.CanExecute(null); {{CanOpen}} = SwipeEnabled && Actions != null && OpenWidth > 0.
# Press: finish any slide in flight ({{FinishMotion}}), cancel the previous drag; ignore if swipe disabled or nothing possible; remember pointer, origin and {{_from}} (−OpenWidth when open else 0). The press is NOT handled (taps reach the button).
# Move: until swiping, require |dx| ≥ 14 and |dx| ≥ |dy|·1.2; then set {{:swiping}}, add the pointer to the static {{Claimed}} set and {{Capture}} it (cancels the button click). Offset = clamp(_from + dx, left, right) with right = 0 if the row started open, else row width if CanStart else 0; left = −(OpenWidth + 24) if CanOpen else min(_from, 0). Handled.
# Release while swiping: decide with {{Decide(dx, 0, _from < 0, CanStart, CanOpen, Bounds.Width)}} (only sideways travel counts once sliding). Open → IsOpen=true; Close → IsOpen=false; Start → IsOpen=false, slide to {{Bounds.Width}} over 160 ms, then execute {{StartCommand}} and snap home without animation; None → spring back to home (−OpenWidth if open else 0) over 180 ms. {{LastAction}} records the decision.
# {{Place(x)}}: Offset and the row's TranslateTransform.X = x; {{PART_Start}} visible only when x > 5 mm·7.4 = 37 px (shown, never faded); {{:armed}} when x ≥ StartThreshold(width); tray opacity = {{ActionsOpacity(x)}} = 0 until the row travelled 37 px left, then linear to 1 at 120 px; {{:revealed}} when > 0.
# Slides are stepped with {{TopLevel.RequestAnimationFrame}} (ease-out cubic {{1 − (1−t)^3}}, by wall clock), one slide at a time (a newer slide, a jump or a press retires the older one's frames and completion); backstop {{DispatcherTimer.RunOnce(FinishMotion, ms + 120)}}; no top level or ms ≤ 0 → land at once and run the completion. Changing {{IsOpen}} or {{OpenWidth}} re-settles (animated) unless dragging.
# Recognizer press (touch/pen only): end previous gesture, track pointer, new gesture id, start point = damped = position in the target's own coordinate space ({{Target as Visual}}), reset FlingTracker.
# Recognizer move: point = {{Damp(position)}} where follow = clamp(|delta|/4, 0.4, 1). Not yet scrolling: do nothing while {{SwipeRow.IsClaimed(pointer)}}; start scrolling when movement on an enabled axis exceeds {{ScrollStartDistance}} (absorb the start distance from the tracked point) and capture the pointer. While scrolling: delta = tracked − point, zeroing the non-scrollable axis; feed the velocity tracker; sum deltas and apply once per rendered frame ({{RequestAnimationFrame}}, immediately when no top level) by raising {{ScrollGestureEventArgs(gestureId, delta)}}; handled.
# Release while scrolling: flush; v0 = {{ClampSpeed(Velocity())}} (cap 6000 px/s, direction kept), zero non-scrollable axis; no coast when v0 = 0, timestamps missing, > 200 ms since the last move, inertia disabled or no top level → end gesture. Coast: each frame raise a delta of {{v0 · CoastSeconds · (CoastShare(t) − previous share)}} with {{CoastSeconds = −1/ln R}} and {{CoastShare(t) = 1 − R^t}}; stop when the event is not handled, {{ShouldEndScrollGesture}}, > 6 s, or speed {{v0·R^t}} < 5 px/s on both axes; a new touch (new gesture id) stops it. {{EndGesture}} raises {{ScrollGestureEndedEventArgs}}. Capture lost → end.
# {{FlingTracker.Velocity}}: keeps samples within the last 100 ms (at least 2); 2 samples → (p0 − p1)/span; else least-squares slope of x(t), y(t) negated (content direction); degenerate → two-point fallback.
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* A right drag past half the row (≥ 180 px) runs {{StartCommand}} once after the finishing slide; a shorter one springs back and runs nothing.
* A left drag of ≥ 120 px opens the tray; an open row dragged right ≥ 60 px closes and never starts.
* A diagonal/vertical drag scrolls the page and leaves rows alone; once a row is sliding the page does not scroll and a drifting finger still starts.
* A tap still selects the row; the tray stays invisible until the row has moved > 37 px left (pressed 0.8-opacity row never shows it).
* Fling speed follows a steady drag, a single stray sample does not define it, speed capped at 6000; the coast covers the same distance regardless of frame timing; jitter < 4 px is damped but a real drag is followed 1:1.
*Tests:* {{SwipeRowTests}} (12 cases incl. {{A_right_swipe_starts_only_past_half_the_row}}, {{Putting_an_open_row_back_can_never_start_a_cure}}, {{Touching_a_row_while_it_springs_back_puts_it_home}}, {{Once_a_row_slides_the_page_does_not_scroll_and_a_drifting_finger_still_starts}}), {{TouchScrollTests}} (6 cases), {{DialogBlurTests.The_action_tray_stays_hidden_until_the_row_has_really_moved}}.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Ui/Controls/SwipeRow.cs}}, {{Controls/TouchScrollGestureRecognizer.cs}}, {{Styles/ScrollViewer.axaml}}, {{docs/05-native-ui.md}} "Touch behaviour"

---

*Behaviour & rules:*
# Store {{Start()}} (UI thread, idempotent): one synchronous {{Refresh()}} (first snapshot before the first frame), then {{Task.Run(PollAsync)}} with a {{PeriodicTimer(1 s)}}; each tick {{Read()}} on the pool and {{Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(Apply, DispatcherPriority.Background)}} (never preempts touch/layout). {{Stop()}} cancels.
# {{Read()}}: {{state = Decorate(controller.GetState())}}, {{run = recipeRunner.GetStatus()}}; Recipe = run unless {{run.State == "idle"}}; exceptions captured into the reading. {{Decorate}} (identical to GET /api/state): {{state with { Counters = counters.Hours(), CloudSync = cloud.Status(), OfflineMode = policy?.OfflineMode ?? false }}}, then {{nfc.Decorate(state)}}, then {{Recipe = run}} when not idle.
# {{Apply}}: {{Now = clock.GetLocalNow()}}; success → {{HeatingSince ??= Now}} while {{state.IsHeating}} else null, Recipe, State, {{ApiConnected = EverConnected = true}}; failure → keep the last State, log once on the transition, {{ApiConnected = false}}. Always raise {{Updated}}. {{RecipeActive}} = Recipe state not in idle/completed/aborted/error.
# Settings files: {{<data>/ui-settings.json}} (indented JSON, written atomically via {{.tmp}} + {{File.Move(overwrite)}}; IO errors logged, defaults on read error) over {{<config>/system.json}} (read-only). {{OrganizationId}} = settings value ?? system value, blank → null. {{SetupComplete}} = settings ?? system. {{SerialNumber}} = settings serial, else system serial, else (only when env {{SCURE_SIMULATE == "1"}}) {{SCURE_SERIAL}} trimmed or "SIM-0001". Every mutation is under a lock, saves, then raises {{Changed}}.
# {{SetSystemName(blank)}} stores "sCure", else trimmed. {{SetFavorite}} removes then re-adds (appended) when favourite. {{CompleteSetup(org)}} stores org ("" when blank) and {{setupComplete = true}}. {{ResetSetup()}} sets organizationId "" and setupComplete false. {{SetOrganization(null)}} stores "".
# Serial backup (SRS 3.4): {{SetSerialNumber}} trims, saves, then {{Backup.Write(serial, SystemName)}}; clears earlier 4003 faults; failure adds {{(r.Code, r.Detail)}} to {{SerialFaults}}. In the ctor {{RestoreSerialFromBackup()}}: only when no serial is known; {{Backup.Read(out problem)}} — problem → add (3001, problem); a serial → store it; none → nothing (Setup asks). Boot raises {{SerialFaults}} as alerts (UI-11).
# Alerts persistence {{<data>/ui-alerts.json}} (list of UiAlert). Load drops codes not in the registry and undismissed 9052 (live condition re-raised by the machine).
# {{Raise(code, detail)}}: an undismissed alert with that code only gets its detail refreshed (no-op when equal); else add a new alert with {{Timestamp = clock.GetUtcNow()}}. Save, report counts (if changed), raise Changed.
# {{Active}} = undismissed, newest first. {{Count}} = Active whose code resolves in the registry (bell badge). {{CriticalCount}} = registry severity "critical"; {{WarningCount}} = resolved and not critical.
# {{Dismiss(id)}} marks dismissed and remembers ("Forget") machine codes still listed in {{State.Alerts}} with their current detail in a {{_deleted}} map so the next update does not re-raise them; acknowledgements: 6016 → {{controller.AckDoorAbort()}}, any code of family 9002/9003/9051 → {{AckFanAlarms()}}, 9017 → {{AckWatchdogTrip()}} (exceptions logged). {{ClearAll()}} dismisses all with the same acks (each at most once).
# On every store update: if {{!ApiConnected}} and it was up before → {{Raise(9089, "Machine state read failed")}} (only on the transition after it had worked); else mark up; drop {{_deleted}} codes the machine no longer lists; for each {{state.Alerts}} code: detail = {{state.AlertDetails[code.ToString()]}}; skip if deleted with the same detail, a different detail forgets the deletion; {{Raise(code, detail)}}. Raise 7004 with the fault text when {{state.Faults.Heater}} or {{state.Faults.Cooling}} is non-null and differs from the last seen value.
# Strip report: {{Start()}} reports {{(CriticalCount, WarningCount)}} via {{controller.ReportUiAlerts}} immediately and every 30 s (forced); every change reports only when the pair changed.
# DevModeService: {{RegisterSettingsPress()}} (ignored when dev) counts; the 10th press resets the counter, logs "Developer Mode requested" and returns true. {{TryPassword(pin)}}: wrong → log "Developer Mode authentication failed", false; "8176" → log "…authentication successful" and "Developer Mode entered", {{IsDev = true}}, Changed. {{Exit()}} (when dev) logs "Developer Mode exited", clears, Changed. Session only — not persisted.
# IdleService: {{Start()}} touches and runs a 5 s Background DispatcherTimer calling {{Check()}}. {{Enabled}} = route not full-screen (Boot/Wake/Setup/Restart) AND route ≠ CureProcess AND not dev AND no dialog open AND {{!store.RecipeActive}}. {{Check()}}: when enabled and idle ≥ 2 min → {{Navigate(Route.Wake)}} (push, so Wake can go Back), touch, return true.
# {{UiMotion.Enabled}} — Program sets it from {{SCURE_UI_ANIMATIONS}} (default off on the unit); tests keep true. Off → tweens land at once, dialog fade jumps.
# Tween: {{To(target)}}: no-op (stop) if within 0.0001; motion off → {{Set(target)}}; else from = Current, steps = round(duration/interval) (interval clamped 10..100 ms), DispatcherTimer at Render priority. Each timer step t = max(step/steps, elapsed/duration) (ends on time on a slow panel); {{Advance()}} is step-only (tests). Value = from + (to − from)·(1 − (1−t)^3); at t ≥ 1 apply the target and stop. Retargeting mid-flight continues from Current.
# Debouncer: trailing edge on a Background DispatcherTimer; {{Schedule}} replaces the pending action and restarts; {{Flush}} stops and runs the pending action now. TransientLabel: sets text, reverts to the default after the delay.
*Configuration:* files {{<SCURE_DATA_DIR>/ui-settings.json}}, {{<SCURE_DATA_DIR>/ui-alerts.json}}, {{<config>/system.json}}; env {{SCURE_SIMULATE}}, {{SCURE_SERIAL}}, {{SCURE_UI_ANIMATIONS}} (via Program).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* The store reads the machine off the UI thread, stops cleanly, and keeps the last state when a read fails (ApiConnected false).
* {{HeatingSince}} is set on the first heating snapshot and cleared when heating stops.
* Raising the same code twice keeps one alert and refreshes its detail; it is persisted.
* Deleting a fan alarm acknowledges it and it does not come back while the machine keeps listing it with the same detail.
* 9089 is raised only on the transition after the store had worked.
* Unknown codes and live 9052 are dropped when loading.
* 10 gear presses → true; PIN 8176 enters dev mode; wrong PIN does not.
* The screensaver does not fire while a dialog is open, while curing, in dev mode or on full-screen routes.
* The PC simulator has serial "SIM-0001" (or SCURE_SERIAL); shipped system.json has no serial.
* A scanned serial is written to the card and survives storage replacement; no card → 4003 recorded, the machine keeps working; a damaged backup → 3001 at startup; the card never overrides an existing serial.
