*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Ui/SCureBox.Ui.csproj}} — {{Services/}}
*Goal:* Bring outside events onto the screen safely: USB barcode scanners read straight from Linux input devices (no focused text box on DRM), NFC tags that start a cloud job only after the operator confirms, DVT tests requested from sCure Cloud that wait for Start/Decline at the machine, and the real hardware checks of the boot screen.
*Depends on:* UI-05, UI-09, UI-14 ({{HomeViewModel.StartFromTagAsync}}); Application ({{INfcTagReader.TagPresented}}, {{NfcTagRead}}, {{NfcUid.SameTag/Display}}, {{IPrintHistoryStore}}, {{ICureController}}, {{RemoteConfirm}} (Dvt), {{HardwareNames.SupervisedSensors/Location}}, {{FanTestResult}}, {{LedTestResult}}), Native UI dialogs ({{MessageDialogViewModel}} with {{Title, Body, OkText, CancelText, StayUp, Destructive, Cancel()}})
*Files to create:*
* {{Services/BarcodeScanner.cs}} — {{public sealed class BarcodeScanner : IDisposable}}, {{public sealed class ScanDecoder}}
* {{Services/NfcJobService.cs}} — {{public sealed class NfcJobService : IDisposable}}, {{public enum NfcTagOutcome { Ignored, NoJob, NotStarted, Started }}}
* {{Services/RemoteConfirmPrompter.cs}} — {{public sealed class RemoteConfirmPrompter}}
* {{Services/BootSelfTest.cs}} — {{public sealed record BootCheckOutcome(bool Ok, string? Detail = null)}} (statics {{Pass}}, {{Fail(string)}}), {{public interface IBootSelfTest}}, {{public sealed class HardwareBootSelfTest : IBootSelfTest}}
*Public contract:*
* {{BarcodeScanner(ILogger<BarcodeScanner>)}}: {{static readonly TimeSpan RescanInterval = 2 s}}; {{static readonly Regex SerialPattern = ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{2,39}$}}; {{event EventHandler<string>? Scanned}}; {{IReadOnlyList<string> Devices}}; {{static string? NormalizeSerial(string? raw)}}; {{void Inject(string code)}}; {{void Start()}}; {{static bool HasKey(string bitmap, int code)}}; {{Dispose()}}.
* {{ScanDecoder}}: {{const int KeyEnter = 28}}, {{KeyKpEnter = 96}}, {{MaxLength = 128}}, {{const long GapMs = 1000}}; {{string? Feed(int code, int value, long nowMs)}}.
* {{NfcJobService(INfcTagReader, IPrintHistoryStore, ICureController, INavigationService, IDialogService, ILogger<NfcJobService>)}}: {{Start()}}, {{Dispose()}}, {{Task<NfcTagOutcome> HandleAsync(string uid)}}.
* {{RemoteConfirmPrompter(RemoteConfirm, IDialogService, ILogger<RemoteConfirmPrompter>)}} (+ internal ctor with {{Action<Action> post}} for tests); {{Start()}}; {{internal MessageDialogViewModel? DialogOf(string id)}}.
* {{IBootSelfTest}}: {{bool? DoorClosed()}}, {{BootCheckOutcome Thermistors()}}, {{BootCheckOutcome LedTest(Wavelength)}}, {{BootCheckOutcome FanTest()}}, {{BootCheckOutcome N2PressureSensor()}}.
* {{HardwareBootSelfTest(ICureController)}}: {{const int Led405Seconds = 15}}, {{Led450Seconds = 30}}, {{const double LedMinRiseC = 0.8}}; {{static bool IsSimulation(MachineState)}}; {{static BootCheckOutcome EvaluateThermistors(MachineState)}}; {{static BootCheckOutcome EvaluateN2Sensor(MachineState)}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Scanner {{Start()}} (Linux only, {{/dev/input}} must exist, idempotent): background thread "barcode-watch" rescans {{/dev/input/event*}} every 2 s; a node is a scanner when {{/sys/class/input/<node>/device/phys}} starts with "usb-" and {{capabilities/key}} has keys 28 (Enter), 2 and 11 (digits). Each new device gets its own thread opening the file shared read/write (nothing grabbed), reading 24-byte {{input_event}}s (type at offset 16, code 18, value 20); only EV_KEY (1) goes to a {{ScanDecoder}}; a complete code raises {{Scanned}} (background thread). Read errors close the device (it is picked up again on the next rescan).
# {{HasKey(bitmap, code)}}: sysfs words hex, most significant first; word index = len − 1 − code/64; bit code % 64.
# {{ScanDecoder.Feed}}: 42/54 track left/right shift (press/release); only value 1 (press) otherwise; 58 toggles caps lock; a gap > 1000 ms since the last key clears a non-empty buffer; Enter (28 or 96) returns the trimmed buffer (null when empty) and clears; 57 = space; keypad map 71..83, 98 '/', 55 '*'; US-layout lookup by Linux key code (index = code; NUL = no character): codes 0-1 none, 2-13 = {{1234567890-=}}, 14-15 none, 16-27 = {{qwertyuiop[]}}, 28-29 none, 30-41 = {{asdfghjkl;'}} followed by the backtick (code 41), 42 none, 43 = backslash, 44-53 = {{zxcvbnm,./}}; shifted table: 2-13 {{!@#$%^&*()_+}}, 16-27 {{QWERTYUIOP{}}}, 30-41 {{ASDFGHJKL:"~}}, 43 {{|}}, 44-53 {{ZXCVBNM<>?}}; caps lock inverts letter case; buffer max 128 chars.
# {{NormalizeSerial}} = trimmed value when it matches {{SerialPattern}}, else null. {{Inject(code)}} raises {{Scanned}} with the trimmed code (QA endpoint / tests).
# NFC jobs: {{Start()}} subscribes {{reader.TagPresented}} (raised on the reader's thread) → {{Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(HandleAsync(tag.Uid))}}. {{HandleAsync}}: busy → Ignored; {{controller.AnyProcessActive}}, route CureProcess or any full-screen route → log, Ignored. Else the newest print-history job whose {{NfcTag}} is the same tag ({{NfcUid.SameTag}}, {{GetAll()}} order = newest first). None → MessageDialog Title "No job for this tag", Body "Tag {display uid} was read, but no job on this machine was sent with it.", OK "OK", no Cancel → NoJob. Job → navigate Home (replace) unless already there; {{home.StartFromTagAsync(job)}} → Started / NotStarted.
# RemoteConfirmPrompter {{Start()}} (once): subscribe {{confirm.Requested}} (post {{Show}}) and {{confirm.Closed}} (post {{Drop}}), and show every {{confirm.Pending()}} request. {{Show(r)}}: one dialog per request id: MessageDialog Title "DVT test requested from sCure Cloud", Body {{"{test}\n{detail\n}\nNothing turns on until you press Start. Press Start only if the chamber is ready and it is safe to run this test now; the test may light the UV LEDs or heat the chamber."}}, OK "Start", Cancel "Decline", {{StayUp = true}}; await; exceptions = Decline; {{confirm.Resolve(r.Id, start)}} (a late answer to a withdrawn/expired request is ignored and logged). {{Drop(id)}} cancels the open dialog.
# HardwareBootSelfTest: {{IsSimulation(state)}} = {{state.HwSource == "simulation"}} (ignore case) → Thermistors, LedTest, FanTest, N2PressureSensor pass at once. {{DoorClosed()}} = {{GetState().DoorClosed}}. {{EvaluateThermistors}}: for every {{HardwareNames.SupervisedSensors}} entry (sensor → (name, _)), fail when {{state.Sensors[name]}} is missing or not {{Ok}}; detail "Not reading: " + join(", ", "{Location(sensor)} ({sensor})") e.g. "Right LED panel (TEMP_RIGHT)". UV photoresistors are not checked. {{EvaluateN2Sensor}}: fail "N2 pressure sensor not reading - check that the nitrogen pressure sensor is connected." only when {{state.N2Sensor}} is Required and not Ok.
# {{LedTest(wl)}}: {{controller.RunLedTest(wl==450 ? 30 : 15, 0.8, wl)}}; Status "OK" (ignore case) → pass, else {{Fail(r.Message ?? "The LED test failed")}}.
# {{FanTest()}}: if the damper is not open, {{SetDamper(true)}} first (the intake fan chokes against a closed damper); {{RunFanTest("all")}}; finally close the damper again only if this call opened it. Fans with Status "FAIL" (WARN = worn but passes) → {{Fail("Not spinning: " + join(", ", "{fan} ({rpm} RPM)"))}}; no failed fans and Status ≠ "FAIL" → pass; otherwise {{r.Message ?? "The fan test failed"}}.
*Configuration:* {{/dev/input}}, {{/sys/class/input/*/device/{phys,name,capabilities/key}}} (Linux).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Key events "A","B","C","1", Enter produce "ABC1"; a > 1 s gap starts a new code; shift and caps lock produce the right case.
* {{POST /api/ui/scan?code=}} delivers a code exactly like the scanner.
* A presented tag with a job asks "Start this job?" and starts only on Start; an unknown tag says so and shows the UID; tags are ignored while a cure runs.
* A DVT request pops Start/Decline; Start is what the runner reads; Decline declines; a withdrawn request closes its dialog and counts as nothing; requests already waiting at start are shown.
* Boot fan test runs with the damper open and closes it after; an already open damper stays open; the simulation passes every check at once; thermistor failure names every sensor that does not read; missing required N2 sensor fails with the 9016 text.
*Tests:* {{BootAndSetupTests.Scan_decoder_turns_key_events_into_codes}}, {{BootAndSetupTests.Ui_scan_endpoint_delivers_a_code_like_the_scanner}}, {{HomeTests.A_jobs_nfc_tag_asks_to_start_that_job}}, {{RemoteConfirmPrompterTests}} (4), {{BootSelfTestTests}} (13), fake {{FakeBootSelfTest}} (scriptable {{IBootSelfTest}} with {{Reset()}}).

h3. Links
*Features:* Native UI shell & theme

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Ui/SCureBox.Ui.csproj}} — {{Navigation/}}
*Goal:* A tiny history-stack navigator: one enum of screens, a fresh page view model from DI on every navigation, {{OnNavigatedFrom}}/{{OnNavigatedTo}} lifecycle calls, push or replace, and Back. Gating (setup, dev, curing) is done by the callers and the pages themselves.
*Depends on:* UI-01 ({{UiPages.Get}}, {{PageViewModel}})
*Files to create:*
* {{Navigation/Route.cs}} — {{public enum Route}}, {{public static class RouteExtensions}}
* {{Navigation/INavigationService.cs}} — {{public interface INavigationService}}
* {{Navigation/NavigationService.cs}} — {{public sealed class NavigationService : INavigationService}}
*Public contract:*
* {{enum Route { Boot, Wake, Setup, Home, CureProcess, CureHistory, Alerts, Settings, Network, DevMenu, DevLedCalibration, DevHdt, Restart }}} (13 values, this order).
* {{RouteExtensions.IsFullScreen(this Route)}} = Boot, Wake, Setup, Restart. {{RouteExtensions.IsDev(this Route)}} = DevMenu, DevLedCalibration, DevHdt.
* {{INavigationService}}: {{Route Current}}, {{PageViewModel? CurrentPage}}, {{bool CanGoBack}}, {{event EventHandler? Changed}}, {{void Navigate(Route route, object? parameter = null, bool replace = false)}}, {{bool Back()}}.
* {{NavigationService(IServiceProvider services, ILogger<NavigationService> log)}}; initial {{Current = Route.Boot}}, {{CurrentPage = null}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# History is a list of {{(Route, object? Parameter)}}. {{Navigate}}: {{replace && history non-empty}} → overwrite the last entry, else append; then {{Show}}.
# {{Back()}}: fewer than 2 entries → false (nothing happens); else remove the last entry and {{Show}} the new last entry WITH ITS ORIGINAL PARAMETER (a fresh VM instance); true.
# {{CanGoBack}} = history count > 1.
# {{Show(route, parameter)}}: call {{OnNavigatedFrom()}} on the previous page (exceptions logged as warning, not rethrown); create the VM with {{ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance(services, UiPages.Get(route).ViewModel)}}; set {{Current}}, {{CurrentPage}}; log "[UI] navigate {Route}"; call {{page.OnNavigatedTo(parameter)}}; raise {{Changed}}.
# Lateral moves between top-level screens use {{replace: current != Home}} (TopBar), so Back from any of them lands on Home. Moves that must come back (Alerts from the critical dialog, Wake from idle, DevLed/DevHdt from DevMenu) push.
# A page may navigate inside its own {{OnNavigatedTo}} (dev pages redirect to Home when not in dev mode) — nested {{Navigate}} calls are allowed.
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{Navigate(Home)}} then {{Navigate(Settings)}} then {{Back()}} → Home with a new HomeViewModel; {{Back()}} on a single entry returns false.
* {{Navigate(x, replace: true)}} keeps the history length.
* The previous page's {{OnNavigatedFrom}} runs before the next page's {{OnNavigatedTo}}.
*Tests:* {{ShellTests.TopBar_is_hidden_on_full_screen_routes_and_back_pops_history}}, {{ShellTests.Navigation_reaches_every_route_and_resolves_a_view}}, {{BootAndSetupTests.Wake_needs_two_taps_and_returns_to_the_previous_screen}}.
*Reference (source):* {{src/SCureBox.Ui/Navigation/{Route,INavigationService,NavigationService}.cs}}

* ctor {{(INavigationService, MachineStateStore, AlertService, UiSettingsStore, DevModeService, ICureController, IDialogService, ILogger<TopBarViewModel>)}}; {{static readonly TimeSpan HeatingLongAfter = 10 s}}.
* Observable: {{SystemName}} ("sCure"), {{ShowBack}}, {{IsCuring}}, {{ShowDoor}}, {{ShowTemperature}} (true), {{DoorIsOpen}}, {{DoorLabel}} ("Open Door"), {{Temperature}} ("--.-°C"), {{TemperatureHot}}, {{ShowTarget}}, {{TargetText}}, {{ShowDev}}, {{ShowN2}}, {{N2Active}}, {{ShowNfc}}, {{AlertCount}} (int), {{ShowAlertBadge}}, {{BellCritical}}, {{BellWarning}}, {{NetworkDown}}, {{HistoryActive}}, {{AlertsActive}}, {{SettingsActive}}, {{NetworkActive}}, {{DevActive}}.

*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{Update()}} runs on navigation change, store update, alerts change, settings change, dev change, and once in the ctor:
** {{SystemName = settings.SystemName}}; {{IsCuring = route == CureProcess}}; {{ShowBack = route != Home && !IsCuring}}; {{ShowDoor = ShowTemperature = !IsCuring}} (the cure page header shows them itself).
** {{DoorIsOpen = state.DoorClosed == false}}; {{DoorLabel = DoorIsOpen ? "Door Open" : "Open Door"}}.

** {{ShowDev = dev.IsDev && !route.IsDev()}}; {{ShowN2 = settings.NitrogenMode}}; {{N2Active = state.NitrogenActive}}; {{ShowNfc = state.NfcEnabled && (state.NfcReader?.Detected ?? true)}}.
** {{AlertCount = alerts.Count}}, {{ShowAlertBadge = Count > 0}}, {{BellCritical = CriticalCount > 0}}, {{BellWarning = !BellCritical && WarningCount > 0}}.
** {{NetworkDown = state.InternetOk == false && !state.OfflineMode}} (a machine working offline on purpose keeps a white globe).
** {{HistoryActive/AlertsActive/SettingsActive/NetworkActive}} = route equals CureHistory/Alerts/Settings/Network; {{DevActive = route.IsDev()}}.
# {{Back}}: {{navigation.Back()}} or, when there is no history, {{Navigate(Home, replace: true)}}.
# {{OpenDoor}}: ignored when already open or curing; {{controller.OpenDoor()}} (refusal logged); optimistic {{DoorIsOpen = true}}, label "Door Open" (the 1 Hz tick re-syncs).
# Lateral(route): ignored while curing or when already on that route; {{Navigate(route, replace: current != Home)}}. History/Alerts/Network/Dev use Lateral.
# {{GoSettings}}: ignored while curing; if {{dev.RegisterSettingsPress()}} is true (10th press) → show {{DevAuthDialogViewModel}}; on true navigate DevMenu (replace when not on Home); return. Else Lateral(Settings).
# Layout (Height 96, bg {{SecondaryBrush}}, Grid {{Auto,*,Auto}}, Margin 24,0): left StackPanel spacing 16 = Back ({{icon-md ghost}}, ArrowLeft 44 white, visible {{ShowBack}}), {{SCureLogo}} 56, system name ({{title wide}}, FontXl). Centre spacing 24: door button ({{secondary lg}}, Padding 24,0, LineBrush border, class {{door-open}} when open = OrangeDim bg + Orange400 fg; disabled while open; hidden {{!ShowDoor}}) containing DoorClosed icon white / DoorOpen icon Orange400 (44) and {{DoorLabel}} (sm semibold); 2x56 divider; temperature group (visible {{ShowTemperature}}): Thermometer 44 (red #ef4444 when {{TemperatureHot}}), {{Temperature}} (base bold, red when hot), {{TargetText}} (xxs orange, {{ShowTarget}}). Right spacing 8: DEV pill ({{amber xs}}, radius 999, text "DEV" xxs bold widest Amber400, {{inert}} while curing, → GoDev, visible {{ShowDev}}); N₂ circle 72x72 white 3 px border ("N₂" xs bold, 16 px dot top-right; class {{n2-active}} → bg White20 and dot Green400; visible {{ShowN2}}); NFC circle 80x80 Gray444 3 px border with Nfc icon 44 (visible {{ShowNfc}}); icon buttons ({{icon}} 96x96, {{active}} class when on that page, {{inert}} while curing; glyph 48, muted, Primary when active): History, Bell (Red500 when critical, Orange400 when warning; badge 32x32 Red500 circle with {{AlertCount}} 18 bold, offset top-right, visible {{ShowAlertBadge}}), Settings, Globe ({{white}} class = white glyph; {{net-down}} → DestructiveBrush; style order matters: the net-down rule comes last).

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Boot self-test, Native UI shell & theme
*Blocked by:* UI-03, UI-05, UI-06, UI-09, PLAT-04, DOM-03
*Relates to:* PROC-07, PLAT-04, PROC-06, OPS-09
*Implements:* OD-36, OD-10, OD-38, OD-37, REQ-18, REQ-21

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Ui/SCureBox.Ui.csproj}} — {{ViewModels/Pages/BootViewModel.cs}}, {{Views/Pages/BootView.axaml(.cs)}}
*Goal:* On every start show the S logo, then run seven real checks in order (door, thermistors, 405 nm LEDs, 450 nm LEDs, chamber fans, N₂ pressure sensor, API), with a flowing progress bar and per-check glyph cross-fades. All pass → move on by itself; any failure → stay with the reasons and offer Retry / Continue anyway. A planned restart skips the LED and fan tests.
*Depends on:* UI-05, UI-06 ({{IBootSelfTest}}, {{BootCheckOutcome}}), UI-09, UI-03 ({{SCureLogo}}, {{Converters.PercentToWidth}}); Application-Platform ({{PlannedRestart.Consume()}}); Domain ({{Wavelength}})
*Files to create:* {{ViewModels/Pages/BootViewModel.cs}} — {{public sealed record BootTimings(...)}}, {{public enum BootCheckStatus { Pending, Checking, Ok, Fail }}}, {{public sealed partial class BootCheckItem : ObservableObject}}, {{public enum BootPhase { Logo, Checking, Done }}}, {{public sealed partial class BootViewModel : PageViewModel}}; {{Views/Pages/BootView.axaml(.cs)}}
*Public contract:*
* {{BootTimings(int LogoMs, int FirstDelayMs, int CheckMinMs, int CheckRandMs, int DoneMs, int DoorWaitMs = 60000, int SensorWaitMs = 5000, int PollMs = 250, int N2SensorWaitMs = 20000)}}; {{Default = (1500, 300, 300, 400, 1200)}}, {{Instant = (0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1,0)}}, {{Fast = (50,20,15,0,50,300,300,10,300)}}.
* {{BootCheckItem(string label)}}: {{const int FadeMs = 260}}; {{string Label}}; observable {{Status}}, {{Detail}}, {{PendingOpacity}} (1), {{CheckingOpacity}}, {{OkOpacity}}, {{FailOpacity}}; {{IsPending/IsChecking/IsOk/IsFail/HasDetail}}; {{Reset()}}, {{SettleFades()}}.
* {{BootViewModel(INavigationService, UiSettingsStore, MachineStateStore, IBootSelfTest, BootTimings, PlannedRestart? planned = null, AlertService? alerts = null)}}; {{bool QuickBoot}}; {{ObservableCollection<BootCheckItem> Checks}}; {{int Total}}; {{const int ProgressFlowMs = 340}}; {{void SettleProgress()}}; observable {{Phase}}, {{Passed}}, {{Progress}} (0-100), {{AllOk}} (true), {{HardwareSource}}; {{IsLogo/IsChecking/IsDone/ShowFailure/ShowAllOk}}, {{int Failed}}, {{string FailureText}}, {{string Counter}} ("{Passed}/{Total}"); {{Task Completed}}, {{Task ChecksFinished}}; {{RetryCommand}}, {{ContinueAnywayCommand}} (both CanExecute = {{ShowFailure}}).
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Ctor: raise every {{settings.SerialFaults}} entry as an alert (3001 / 4003); build {{Checks}} from labels in order: "Door Closed", "Temperature Sensors", "UV LEDs 405nm", "UV LEDs 450nm", "Chamber Fans", "N2 Pressure Sensor", "API Server".
# {{OnNavigatedTo}} → {{RunAsync(showLogo: true)}} with a CTS; {{OnNavigatedFrom}} cancels it.
# {{RunAsync}}: yield first (never finish inside Navigate); reset checks, Passed 0, AllOk true, progress 0; if a {{PlannedRestart}} marker is fresh ({{Consume()}}), {{QuickBoot = true}}; wait {{LogoMs}} (only with the logo); Phase Checking; {{HardwareSource = state.HwSource}}; wait {{FirstDelayMs}}. For each check i: Status Checking; tween the bar to {{100·(i+0.7)/Total}}; run it (exceptions → Fail "The check could not run: {message}"); ensure the live dot shows at least {{CheckMinMs + random(CheckRandMs)}}; {{Detail = ok ? "" : outcome.Detail}}; Status Ok/Fail; Passed++ or AllOk=false; tween to {{100·(i+1)/Total}}. Then Phase Done, {{ChecksFinished}} completes; failures → wait for the operator; all ok → wait {{DoneMs}} and Proceed.
# Checks: Door — poll {{DoorClosed()}} every PollMs up to DoorWaitMs (60 s): closed → pass; while waiting Detail = "Close the door to continue" (null → "The door sensor is not reading"); deadline → Fail "The door is open - close it and retry" / "The door sensor is not reading". Thermistors — poll {{Thermistors()}} up to SensorWaitMs (5 s) until ok. 405 / 450 LEDs — QuickBoot → pass; door not closed → Fail "Skipped - the door is not closed"; else Detail "Lighting the LEDs..." and {{Task.Run(LedTest(Nm405|Nm450))}}. Fans — QuickBoot → pass; Detail "Spinning the fans..."; {{Task.Run(FanTest)}}. N2 sensor — poll {{Task.Run(N2PressureSensor)}} up to N2SensorWaitMs (20 s) until ok. API — {{store.ApiConnected}} else Fail "The firmware API is not answering".
# {{Proceed()}}: {{Navigate(settings.SetupComplete ? Home : Setup, replace: true)}}; {{Completed}} completes. {{ContinueAnyway}} cancels and proceeds; {{Retry}} re-runs without the logo.
# {{FailureText}} = "1 of 7 checks failed" / "{n} of 7 checks failed".
# View (bg Background, centred StackPanel spacing 40): logo phase — {{SCureLogo}} 160 + "sCure" (lg bold widest Cyan500); other phases — logo 96 at 0.9 opacity. Diagnostics panel (width 1000, visible while checking or on failure): header "System Diagnostics" (xs muted wider) + {{Counter}} (xs mono); 2 px track (Secondary) with a white bar of width {{PercentToWidth(Progress, 1000)}}; list rows (MinHeight 48): a 32x32 glyph cell with four overlaid glyphs whose opacities are the item's fade values (pending 6 px #333333 dot, checking 10 px Cyan400 dot, ok "✓" Green400, fail "✗" Red500), the label ({{check-label}}: #444444; checking Cyan400 Medium; ok #888888; fail Red500; 0.3 s BrushTransition), and the right-aligned Detail (xs; muted unless failed → destructive); {{HardwareSource}} bottom-right (xxs mono #444444). Done ok: "All systems operational" (sm semibold Green400) + "Starting sCure..." (xs muted). Failure: {{FailureText}} (sm semibold destructive) + buttons "Continue anyway" ({{secondary lg}}, Padding 40,0) and "Retry" ({{primary lg}}, Padding 56,0).
# Glyph cross-fade: each status change tweens the four opacities (260 ms) to 1 for the new status and 0 for the others; the bar tweens over 340 ms.
*Configuration:* {{BootTimings}} from DI ({{BootTimings.Default}} unless registered).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Fresh unit: the 7 checks run in order, then Setup (setup incomplete) or Home.
* An open door is waited for and the checks continue once closed; left open → door fails, both LED checks fail "Skipped - the door is not closed", Continue anyway moves on.
* A failed fan shows "Not spinning: FAN_X (n RPM)" and Retry passes after the fix.

Navigate {{CureProcess}} with {{new CureStartRequest(material, pendingPrintIds or null) { Preflight = preflight still open ? preflight : null }}} (the cure page closes the spinner once the start's own checks answered). Finally {{IsStarting = false}}.

# {{NewMaterial}} / {{EditMaterial(row)}} → {{MaterialEditorDialogViewModel.Init(material or null)}}; a true result → {{Load()}}. {{ImportCsv}} → {{ImportCsvDialogViewModel}}, then {{Load()}} always. {{ViewAll}} → {{PrintHistoryDialogViewModel}}; result → select the program named {{result.MaterialName}} (if present), remember {{result.PrintIds}} as pending print ids; more than one id and {{CanStart}} → StartCure ("Cure Together"; the cure page deletes those rows on completion).

*Goal:* Start the selected program on {{IRecipeRunner}} when the page opens, render {{RecipeStatus}} + {{MachineState}} on every 1 Hz tick (header with run state and overall progress, status bar, a centred carousel of phase cards), issue Pause / Resume / Abort / Skip, and keep the client-side supervision: door-open countdown, heater sensor fault (9010/9001), frozen reading (9006), fan failure, LED panel not heating, temperature stall (7004), completion with report build + USB export, runner error / external abort.
*Depends on:* UI-03 ({{PhaseCard}}, {{StatusPill}}), UI-05, UI-09, UI-15; Application-Process ({{IRecipeRunner.Start(Material, string runId, string? serial)/Pause/Resume/Abort/SkipStep/GetStatus}}, {{RecipeStatus}} {RunId, State, Phase, StepIndex, StepElapsedSec, StepRemainingSec, TotalElapsedSec, EstimatedTotalSec, TargetTemp, Process, Message, ErrorCode}, {{ICureController.AckDoorAbort/OpenDoor/SetFanOverride}}), Domain ({{ProgramEstimator.EstimateProgram/EstimateStepSeconds/EstimateCoolSeconds/AmbientC/DefaultNitrogenSeconds}}, {{RecipeStateMachine.NitrogenSec}}, {{ErrorCodes}}), Application ({{ICureRunStore}}, {{IPhaseTimingStore}}, {{ICureReportBuilder}}, {{ISystemService}}, {{IPrintHistoryStore.GetAll/ReplaceAll}}, {{ErrorRegistry}}); Native UI dialogs ({{DoorOpenDialogViewModel}} ({{Init()}}, {{Tick()}}, {{Dismiss()}}), {{HeaterFaultDialogViewModel}} ({{Init(HeaterFaultWhen, detail, showRetry, stopLabel, frozen)}} → bool retry), {{FanFailDialogViewModel}} ({{Setup(FanFailKind.Fan|Led, FanFailWhen.Running, items)}} → bool continue), {{TemperatureWarningDialogViewModel}} ({{Init(target, current)}} → bool continue), {{PauseDialogViewModel}} ({{Init(chamberTemp)}} → bool), {{PauseOverlayViewModel}} ({{Init(phaseName)}} → bool continue), {{AbortDialogViewModel}} ({{Init(chamberTemp)}} → bool yes), {{CureCompleteDialogViewModel}} ({{Init(material, totalSec, steps)}}, {{ReportMessage}}) → bool open door, {{MessageDialogViewModel}}, {{PreflightDialogViewModel.Finish()}})

*Public contract:*
* ctor {{(IRecipeRunner, ICureController, MachineStateStore, AlertService, IDialogService, INavigationService, UiSettingsStore, ICureRunStore, IPhaseTimingStore, ICureReportBuilder, ISystemService, IPrintHistoryStore, ErrorRegistry, TimeProvider, ILogger<CureProcessViewModel>)}}.
* {{ObservableCollection<PhaseCardViewModel> Phases}}, {{StallDetector Stall}}, {{LedHeatCheck LedCheck}}, {{string? RunId}}, {{RecipeStatus? Status}}, {{Task? ReportTask}}, {{IReadOnlyList<string> FanOverrides}}, {{Task StartTask}}.
* Observable: {{MaterialName}}, {{MaterialText}}, {{StepText}} ("0/0"), {{ActivePhaseIndex}} (−1), {{OverallProgress}}, {{OverallPercentText}} ("0%"), {{StatusBadge}} ("Starting"), {{StatusMain}} ("Initializing..."), {{StatusDetail}}, {{BadgeDone}}, {{BadgeN2}}, {{BadgeRamp}}, {{BadgeOutline}} (true), {{ShowArrow}}, {{ArrowGreen}}, {{HardwareError}}, {{IsRunning}}, {{IsPaused}}, {{IsComplete}}, {{IsFailed}}, {{ReportMessage}}.

* {{CureProcessView}}: {{static readonly TimeSpan SwipeGrace = 4 s}}; {{Tween Slide}}; {{void CenterActive(bool animate)}}; {{static double SidePadding(double viewport, double cardWidth)}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{OnNavigatedTo(p)}}: {{CureStartRequest}} → material, pending print ids, preflight dialog; bare {{Material}} also accepted. Subscribe store Updated. No material → log, close preflight, nothing starts. Else {{MaterialText = "— {name}"}}; run steps = material steps minus Nitrogen steps unless {{settings.NitrogenMode}}; estimates with {{ProgramEstimator.AmbientC}} and nitrogen seconds ({{DefaultNitrogenSeconds}} when nitrogen mode else 0): total → {{_estimatedTotalSec}}, per step → cards; build one {{PhaseCardViewModel(i, step, PauseAsync, AbortAsync, estimate[i])}} per step; {{StepText = "{min(1,n)}/{n}"}}; {{StartTask = StartRunAsync(material with filtered steps)}}.
# {{StartRunAsync}}: a stale {{state.DoorAborted}} is acknowledged ({{AckDoorAbort}}); new run id (Guid); serial = settings serial or null; {{Task.Run(runner.Start(material, runId, serial))}} (exception → Fail with code 6015). Page left meanwhile → close preflight, and abort a successful start. Refused → close preflight, {{HardwareError = "Hardware: {message}"}}, raise {{code ?? 6015}} with the message, {{HandleStartRefusalAsync}}. Accepted → started, reset step index/Stall/LedCheck, {{store.Refresh()}}.
# Start refusal: code in family 9001, code 9006 or message containing "thermistor" → {{HeaterFaultDialogViewModel.Init(HeaterFaultWhen.Start, message, frozen: code==9006)}}; Retry → clear banner and start again; otherwise OK-only MessageDialog Title "Hardware: {message}", Body = registry description of the code or "The hardware refused the command". Then go home.
# Every store update (ignored after leaving): status = store.Recipe if its RunId is ours else null; {{Status = status}}; null → render the status bar only. New StepIndex → remember the chamber temperature at step start, reset Stall and LedCheck. Remember the last non-"paused" phase. First status with {{State != "preflight"}} → close the preflight spinner. {{IsRunning = State=="running"}}, {{IsPaused = State=="paused"}}. Render header, cards, status bar. If not finished: "completed" → OnCompleted; "aborted" → OnAborted; "error" → OnError; "running" → Supervise.
# Header: {{StepText = "{i}/{n}"}} with i = n when completed else min(StepIndex+1, n); progress = 100 when completed, else min(100, TotalElapsedSec / (estimatedTotal > 0 ? it : status.EstimatedTotalSec) × 100); {{OverallPercentText = "{round}%"}}. {{HeaderTitle}} = "Stopped" (failed) / "Complete" / "Paused" / "Running".
# Cards: {{ActivePhaseIndex}} = last when completed else clamp(StepIndex). Card status = Completed (run completed or index < step), Active (== step), Pending. Pending: GaugeValue "" (N₂) / "0", label "SEC" / "HOLD °C", progress 0, elapsed 0, 0 %, "Waiting...". Completed: value N₂ "0"; Heating/Drying = target "{t:0.#}" (or "0"); others ""; label as pending; 100 %; "Done". Active (phase = last phase while paused):
** Heating/Drying: phase "ramping" → progress = RampProgress, value = chamber "{c:0.#}" or "--", label "RAMP °C", status "Ramping..."; else holding: progress = clamp(100 − remaining/(time·60)·100), value = MinSec(remaining), label "REMAINING", status "Heating..." / "Drying...".
** Cure/Bleacher: ramping with {{TimerMode != OnRamp}} and a temperature → like heating ramp; else countdown like holding with status "Ramping..." (on-ramp timer while ramping) or "UV curing at {i:0.#}%{ (no heat) | (no heat, vented) }..." (intensity = {{step.EffectiveUvIntensity}}).
** Nitrogen: progress = clamp(StepElapsedSec / NitrogenSec ·100), value = ceil(remaining) "0", label "SEC", status "N₂ purging...".
** Cooling: target = step temperature ?? AmbientC; start = step-start temp ?? chamber ?? target; progress = clamp((start − chamber)/max(0.1, start − target)·100); estimate = chamber known ? {{EstimateCoolSeconds(chamber, target, mode ?? Medium)}} : remaining; estimate > 0 → value "~{mm:ss}", label "EST. REMAINING"; else value chamber, label "COOL °C"; status "Cooling to {t:0.#}°C · now {c:0.#}°C" (or "Cooling to {t:0.#}°C...").
** RampProgress(chamber, target) = 0 when unknown; start = step-start temp ?? AmbientC; span ≤ 0.1 → 100; else clamp((c − start)/span·100).
** Elapsed = StepElapsedSec; {{GaugeProgress}} and DONE = progress.
# Status bar (all flags reset each time): completed → BadgeDone + green arrow, badge "Done", main "Cure complete!", no detail. Running/paused in phase "nitrogen" → BadgeN2, "N₂" / "Nitrogen Purge" / "{ceil(s)}s remaining". Running/paused in "ramping" with an active card → BadgeRamp, badge = card label, main "{chamber:0.#|--}°C → {target:0.#}°C", detail "Timer running — started with the ramp" (OnRamp) or "Timer starts at target". Running/paused/error/aborted with an active card → BadgeOutline + arrow, badge "Next", main = next card label or "Final phase", detail "({NextPhaseDescription(next)})". Otherwise outline "Starting" / "Initializing...". {{NextPhaseDescription(null)}} = "Process complete"; else join with spaces of "Hold at {t:0.#}°C" (if temperature), "Intensity {i:0.#}%" (UV kinds), "for {m:0.#} min" (time > 0).
# {{Supervise}} (running only; skipped while {{!store.ApiConnected}}): (a) door open → first time create and show a {{DoorOpenDialogViewModel}} ({{Init()}}), then {{Tick()}} once per second; return. Door closed again → {{Dismiss()}} it. (b) Any dialog open → return. (c) 9006 listed and not yet seen this occurrence → pause the runner, {{HeaterFaultDialog.Init(Running, detail, showRetry: false, stopLabel: "Stop process", frozen: true)}}, then abort. (d) 9010 (else 9001) listed with a detail matching {{TEMP_CHAMBER|heater}} (ignore case), once per occurrence → pause, {{HeaterFaultDialog.Init(Running, detail)}}; Retry → resume, else abort. (e) {{FailedFans(state)}} non-empty → pause, {{FanFailDialog.Setup(Fan, Running, fans)}}; Continue anyway → {{SetFanOverride(fan, true)}} for each and remember them, resume; else abort. (f) {{state.UvOn && state.LedChecksEnabled}} → {{LedCheck.Sample(now, state.LedTemps, state.UvIntensity, bleaching = status.Process == "Bleacher" || UvWavelength == 450)}}; failure → pause, raise one alert per cold panel ({{LedNotHeatingOf(PanelOf(panel))}} or 9004) with its panel detail, {{FanFailDialog.Setup(Led, Running, panels)}}; Continue → {{LedCheck.Override(panels)}}, resume; else abort. UV off (or checks disabled) → {{LedCheck.Reset()}}. (g) Phase "ramping" or "cooling" → {{Stall.Sample(now, chamber, phase=="cooling")}}; true → raise 7004 "No temperature progress toward {t}°C (now {c}°C)", {{TemperatureWarningDialog.Init(target, current)}}; Continue → {{Stall.Reset()}}, else abort. Other phases → {{Stall.Disarm()}}.
# {{FailedFans(state)}}: fans with {{FanHealth[fan].Status == "critical"}} not in {{state.FanOverride}} nor this page's overrides; plus every {{FAN_[A-Z]+}} name found in the details of alerts of families 9002 / 9003 not overridden.
# Pause: only when running and no dialog → {{PauseDialog.Init(chamber)}}; yes → runner Pause (Stall disarmed, LedCheck reset, {{IsPaused = r.Ok}}, refresh), {{controller.OpenDoor()}} (door released), then {{PauseOverlay.Init(active card label)}}; Continue → Resume (refusal → {{HardwareError = "Hardware: {msg}"}}), Stop → AbortNow.
# Abort: after the run ended → go home; dialog open → ignore; {{AbortDialog.Init(chamber)}}; yes → {{AbortNow()}} = finished, dismiss door dialog, {{runner.Abort()}}, clear fan overrides ({{SetFanOverride(fan, false)}}), go home. {{Skip}} (running only): {{runner.SkipStep()}}, reset Stall/LedCheck, refresh.
# Completion: finished, {{IsComplete}}, not running, clear overrides; show {{CureCompleteDialogViewModel.Init(MaterialName, TotalElapsedSec, Phases.Count)}}; in parallel {{ReportTask = Task.Run(BuildReport)}}: find the run in {{ICureRunStore.GetHistory()}}; no telemetry → skip; build/save/export via {{CureRunReporter}}; ok → (UI thread) {{ReportMessage = dialog.ReportMessage = "Saved to USB"}} (no USB → silent). # {{LoadStatic}}: SystemName, NitrogenMode, {{OfflineMode = network?.OfflineMode ?? false}}, OrganizationId, SerialNumber, {{DeviceName = settings.System.DeviceName}}, IsDev; {{system.Version()}}: SoftwareVersion = AppVersion unless empty/"unknown" (then system.json firmware), LastBoot = "dd MMM yyyy" of {{v.LastBoot ?? system.json lastBoot}} ("Unknown"-style {{Strings.Versions.Unknown}} when blank), DeviceName = {{v.EmmcSerial}} when present; on error fall back to system.json.

# Heating: slider 25..80; {{HeatingText}} = "OFF" below 30 else "{c:0}°C"; {{HeatingFraction = clamp((c − 25)/55, 0, 1)}} drives the {{TrackDim}} veil. A user change (not syncing) stamps the touch time and debounces 400 ms → {{ApplyHeatingAsync}}: < 30 → snap to 25 and {{StopHeating()}}; else {{SetTargetTemperature(round(v))}}; refused → raise {{code ?? 6015}}, snap to OFF, and for family 9001 / 9006 / "thermistor" show a destructive OK-only MessageDialog: 9006 → Title "Heater not started — temperature reading frozen", Body frozen body + hint; else Title "Heater not started — temperature sensor not reading", Body "The heater is only switched on while its temperature sensor reads. The sensor reads open (unplugged) or out of range, so the heater was not started." + "\n\n" + "Check the chamber thermistor cable and its connector on the IO board, then try again. Err 9010 is on the Alerts screen.". Sync from the machine is skipped while a debounce is pending or within 3 s of the last touch; otherwise HeatingValue = clamp(round(target), 30, 80) when {{IsHeating}} with a target ≥ 30, else 25 (so the slider shows the machine's real set point on every visit). {{EditHeating}} → NumberPad Title "Chamber Heating", 30..80 step 1 suffix "°C", preset current or 30. {{HeatingOff}} → 25.
# Fan row: slider 0..100 debounced 400 ms → {{SetFanSpeed(group, round(v))}} (refusal logged at debug). {{Test}}: {{Task.Run(RunFanTest(group.ToString()))}} with a 20 s timeout. {{ShowResult(null or empty Status)}} → FAIL, no RPM, FailLine "no answer from the machine". Else ResultOk = "OK", ResultWarn = "WARN"; RpmText "{rpm} RPM" (rpm ≤ 0 → fallback 2850 / 3050 / 2780 by group); StatusText "OK"/"WARN"/"FAIL"; not OK → FailLine = {{result.Message}} ?? (fans not OK by friendly name ({{Strings.FanFail.FanNames}}: FAN_LEFT "Left LED fan", FAN_RIGHT "Right LED fan", FAN_BACK "Back LED fan", FAN_DOOR "Door LED fan", FAN_HEATER "Heater fan", FAN_COOLING "Chamber intake fan") joined ", " + " — not rotating").
# LED test: 405 → {{RunLedTest(15, 0.8, Nm405)}}, 450 → {{(30, 0.8, Nm450)}} in {{Task.Run}} with a 120 s timeout; {{LedTestRunning}} disables both. {{AddLedResult}}: null → row ("{nm} nm", fail, "no answer"); {{Ok && Status OK/PASS}} → ("{nm} nm", "PASS"); else FAIL with label "{nm} nm — {panels}" naming results with Status FAIL (name minus " LED"; INFO panels are not failures) or just "{nm} nm". A new row replaces an older one of the same wavelength.
# Nitrogen Mode: turning on while {{N2OutOfRange}} is refused (snaps back off); otherwise {{settings.SetNitrogenMode(v)}}. The switch is enabled when on or pressure in range. NFC: {{nfc.TrySetEnabled(v, out reader)}}; NfcReaderDetected = reader.Detected; refused → raise {{code ?? 9052}} with message and revert the switch; enabled when on or a reader is present; "(no reader)" shown when none. BOFA: {{controller.SetBofaConnected(v)}} (declares a connected BOFA extractor; refusal logged). Offline ("Work Without Network"): {{network?.Choose(v)}}.
# Date & time: {{AutoSync}} change (user) → {{system.SetNetworkTime(v)}} (refusal logged). Turning auto off first copies store Now into Day/Month/Year/Hour/Minute. {{EditDatePart(part)}} → NumberPad: day 1..31, month 1..12, year 2020..2099, hour 0..23, minute 0..59 (titles Day/Month/Year/Hour/Minute). {{ManualDateTime()}} = ("yyyy-MM-dd", "HH:mm") or null when the date does not exist. {{ApplyDateTime}} → {{system.SetDateTime(date, time)}}; label "✓ Applied" / "✗ Failed" reverting to "Apply" after 3 s.

# Organization: {{LinkOrganization}} → USB file browser "Select organization CSV" → {{ApplyOrganizationCsv(file text)}}: first UUID → {{settings.SetOrganization}}, {{OrganizationId}}, clear error; none → "No valid ID found". {{SignInOrigin}} → dialog; org → {{SetOrganization(org.Id)}}. {{Unlink}} → {{settings.ResetSetup()}} and {{Navigate(Setup, replace: true)}}. {{ShowCompliance}} → ComplianceDialog; {{ComplianceLabel = "{n} control(s) active"}} with n = {{Strings.Compliance.ActiveCount}}.

Right column: Date & Time card ("Date & Time", "Auto Sync" + Toggle; auto → Date/Time/Timezone rows (mono); manual → Date: day / month / year {{piece}} buttons (1,1,1.4 widths), Time: hour / minute, Outline full {{ApplyLabel}} → ApplyDateTime); "S/N" + serial (mono); "Export Logs (USB)" + Outline full with Download → ExportLogs ({{ExportLabel}}); "Software Update (USB)" + "Update Software" (Upload); "Compliance (CRA / EN 18031)" + Outline full with ShieldCheck Green500 + ComplianceLabel; Organization card (linked: UUID box (bg Background, RadiusMd, 16 mono ellipsis), Outline Xs "Change" (Building) → LinkOrganization + 56-wide unlink button (DestructiveLine border, Unlink icon) → Unlink; not linked: Outline full "Link Organization" (Building); always Outline full "Sign in to Origin" (Globe); error 18 destructive); versions card (Software Version / Last Boot / Device rows); dev card.

Read = {{Task.Run(network.Status)}} → {{Apply}}; exception → {{StatusKnown = false}}; then {{ApiConnected = store.ApiConnected}}.

*Behaviour & rules:*

# {{ChainTemperature(steps, i)}} = temperature of the last non-Nitrogen step before i that has one, reset to null by a Cooling step. {{RunningMinimum = max(HeatMinC, chain ?? HeatMinC)}}. {{MaxCoolingTarget}} = chain known ? max(CoolMinC, chain − CoolingDropMinC) : 75.

# {{Normalize}}: renumber 1..n; Cooling → temperature clamped to [CoolMin, max(CoolMin, MaxCoolingTarget)] (default 30), Time 0, mode default Medium; Nitrogen → Temperature null, Time 0; others with a temperature → clamp to [RunningMinimum, HeatMaxFor].

MaxCoolingTarget : HeatMaxFor(process)) (Drying stays capped even after a hotter step); time [HoldMinMin, Bleacher ? BleacherHoldMaxMin : HoldMaxMin]; UV [UvMinPct, UvMaxPct]. * {{DialogViewModel<TResult>}}: private {{TaskCompletionSource<TResult>}} created with {{TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously}}; {{public Task<TResult> Result}}; {{protected abstract TResult CancelResult { get; }}}; {{protected void Close(TResult result)}} (calls {{TrySetResult}}; raises {{Closed}} only when it succeeded, so only the first close counts); {{public override void Cancel() => Close(CancelResult);}}.
* {{IDialogService}}: {{DialogViewModel? Current { get; }}} (top), {{DialogViewModel? Below { get; }}} (second from top), {{event EventHandler? Changed;}}, {{Task<TResult> ShowAsync<TResult>(DialogViewModel<TResult> dialog);}}, {{Task<TResult> ShowAsync<TDialog, TResult>(Action<TDialog>? init = null) where TDialog : DialogViewModel<TResult>;}}, {{void CloseAll(bool pageChange = false);}}.
* {{DialogService(IServiceProvider services)}}; registered {{services.AddSingleton<IDialogService, DialogService>()}}. Dialog view models themselves are NOT registered in DI; they are created with {{ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance<TDialog>(_services)}}.
* {{DialogHost}} properties: {{Dialog}} (StyledProperty {{DialogViewModel?}}), {{Below}} (StyledProperty), read-only direct properties {{DisplayDialog}}, {{HasDialog}}, {{FadeProgress}} (0..1), {{CardWidth}} (default 760), {{CardDialog}}, {{FullDialog}}, {{DockDialog}}, {{DockHeight}}; {{public bool IsFading}}; {{public void StepFade()}}; {{public static double Ease(double t) => t * t * (3 - 2 * t);}} constants {{public static readonly TimeSpan FadeDuration = 240 ms}}, {{public const int FadeSteps = 12}}.
* {{ShellViewModel}}: {{[ObservableProperty] DialogViewModel? _dialog;}} {{[ObservableProperty] DialogViewModel? _belowDialog;}} subscribed to {{dialogs.Changed}} → {{BelowDialog = dialogs.Below; Dialog = dialogs.Current;}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{ShowAsync(dialog)}}: subscribe {{dialog.Closed}} → remove it from the stack; push onto the stack; raise {{Changed}}; call {{dialog.OnShown()}}; return {{dialog.Result}}. {{Remove}} raises {{Changed}} only if the dialog was in the stack.
# {{ShowAsync<TDialog,TResult>(init)}}: create via {{ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance<TDialog>(services)}} (constructor dependencies come from DI, optional ones may be missing), run {{init}} on it (before it is shown), then {{ShowAsync(dialog)}}.
# {{CloseAll(pageChange)}}: for a snapshot of the stack, {{Cancel()}} every dialog, except when {{pageChange == true}} and the dialog's {{KeepAcrossPageChange}} is true.
# Shell: on every navigation, if {{_dialogs.Current is not null}}, call {{_dialogs.CloseAll(pageChange: true)}} (dialogs belong to the page that opened them).
# Only the top dialog is rendered. When a non-docked dialog opens over another one, the lower dialog's view is discarded and rebuilt when it becomes top again (views must keep any state they need on the view model, e.g. editor strip offset).
# DialogHost layout ({{Relayout}}) for the displayed top dialog: {{docked = top.DockedHeight > 0}}; {{fullScreen = top.DesignWidth <= 0 && !docked}}; the card shows {{Below}} when docked, nothing when full screen, else the top dialog. Card: centred ({{VerticalAlignment.Center}}), {{Width = CardWidth}} (dialog's {{DesignWidth}}, or 760 when it is ≤ 0), Padding 32, CornerRadius {{RadiusXl}}, 2 px {{RingBrush}} border, background {{PopoverBrush}} (#141414). When docked: card goes to the top with margin top 14, {{MaxHeight = max(200, 1000 - DockedHeight - 28)}}, {{ClipToBounds = true}}. Full screen: {{FullContent}} content control shows the dialog over the whole surface. Docked: {{Dock}} border at the bottom with {{Height = DockedHeight}}, background {{BackgroundBrush}}, 2 px top {{RingBrush}} border.
# Overlay: a full-size {{Border}} with {{OverlayBrush}} (#99000000). A pointer press on it calls {{Cancel()}} on the current dialog only when {{CloseOnOverlayTap}} is true; the event is always marked handled.
# Fade: when {{Dialog}} changes, {{HasDialog = dialog != null}}; if non-null set {{DisplayDialog}} and relayout; start the fade. A {{DispatcherTimer}} (interval {{FadeDuration / FadeSteps}} = 20 ms, priority Render) steps {{FadeProgress}} by 1/12 toward 1 (open) or 0 (closed); snaps to the target when within half a step; host {{Opacity = Ease(progress)}}; {{IsHitTestVisible = progress > 0}}. At target the timer stops; at 0 (closed) content is cleared ({{DisplayDialog}}, {{CardDialog}}, {{FullDialog}}, {{DockDialog}} = null, all parts hidden). If {{UiMotion.Enabled}} is false the fade is applied instantly (1 or 0). Only opacity animates (no scale / relayout of the page).
# {{Below}} change while a dialog is shown → relayout.
# Shell page blur (in {{ShellView}}): when {{HasDialog}} turns true, capture the page layer into a {{RenderTargetBitmap}} at scale {{BlurScale = 0.08}} (greyscale text AA) and show it as an {{ImageBrush}} (Stretch Fill) inside an opaque {{BackgroundBrush}} border above the page; its opacity follows {{Ease(FadeProgress)}}; dropped and disposed when the fade reaches 0. On a page change while a dialog stays up (held pre-check), re-capture after the next layout pass of the new page. While a dialog is up or fading ({{DialogIsUp}}), {{RequestBringIntoView}} events on any {{ScrollContentPresenter}} under the shell are handled (suppressed) so the page never scrolls behind the scrim.
# {{IdleService.Enabled}} (screensaver) is false while {{_dialogs.Current is not null}}.
# View resolution: {{ViewLocator.Match}} = data is {{PageViewModel}} or {{DialogViewModel}}; {{Build}} looks up {{UiPages.ViewFor(type)}}, instantiates with {{Activator.CreateInstance}} and sets {{DataContext}}; unknown → {{TextBlock "No view for {TypeName}"}}. {{UiPages.Dialogs}} maps exactly the 24 view models listed in the overview to their views. {{DialogsAreValid()}} = every key derives from {{DialogViewModel}}.
# There is no keyboard (Escape) handling in the native shell, although the base-class comment mentions Escape. OPEN QUESTION: whether Escape should cancel the top dialog (not implemented in 1.0.152).
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Awaiting {{ShowAsync}} completes with the value passed to {{Close}}; a second {{Close}} is ignored.
* Opening a dialog over another sets {{Current}} to the new one and {{Below}} to the first; closing the top restores {{Current}}.
* A docked keyboard ({{DockedHeight}} 500) over a NumberPad: card shows the NumberPad, card bottom ≤ dock top, dock top ≥ half of the shell height; {{DockHeight == 500}}.
* A keyboard with {{Docked = false}} renders in {{FullDialog}}, {{DockDialog == null}}, {{DockHeight == 0}}.
* Navigating to another page cancels all open dialogs except those with {{KeepAcrossPageChange}}.
* Overlay tap closes only dialogs with {{CloseOnOverlayTap == true}}.
* Screensaver is disabled while any dialog is open, re-enabled after {{CloseAll}}.
* Opening and closing a dialog moves neither the page nor the shell scale; the page is blurred while a dialog is open and unblurred after.
*Tests:* {{DialogDockTests}} (docked keyboard layout, screensaver suppression, non-docked full-screen keyboard), {{DialogMotionTests}} (no page movement / no shell scale change, no scroll-into-view), {{DialogBlurTests}} (still taken before fade, opaque base; dialog outliving its page gets a still of the new page), {{ShellTests.Shell_blurs_the_page_while_a_dialog_is_open_and_unblurs_after}}; a {{UiPages.DialogsAreValid()}} check.

*Goal:* One reusable confirm/info card (replaces browser {{confirm()}}): title, body, optional Cancel, OK, destructive styling. It also carries the "must be answered on purpose" mode used for the sCure Cloud DVT Start/Decline request.
*Depends on:* UIDLG-01; Native UI (Home, CureProcess, CureHistory, Settings, DevHdt pages, {{NfcJobService}}, {{RemoteConfirmPrompter}}), Dvt-Hdt (RemoteConfirm request source).

*Public contract:*
* {{public bool StayUp { get; set; }}}; {{CloseOnOverlayTap => !StayUp}}; {{KeepAcrossPageChange => StayUp}}; {{CancelResult => false}}; DesignWidth default (760).

*Behaviour & rules:*

# Setting {{CancelText = null}} makes it a single-button info dialog.
# Call sites (exact texts):
** Settings Reboot: Title "Reboot device?", Body "", OkText "REBOOT"; true → restart flow.
** Home delete program: Title {{Delete “{name}”?}}, Body "The program will be removed from this machine. This cannot be undone.", OkText "Delete", Destructive.
** Home tag job: Title "Start this job?", Body "Job: {job}\nProgram: {material}\nPrinter: {printer}\nTag: {tag}", OkText "Start", CancelText "Cancel".
** Home "Cannot Start Cure" info: Title "Cannot Start Cure", Body = "No program named “{material}” is on this machine" or "Close the door to start the cure", OkText "OK", no Cancel.
** NfcJobService unknown tag: Title "No job for this tag", Body "Tag {tag} was read, but no job on this machine was sent with it.", OK only.
** CureProcess start refused (non-thermistor) and run error (non-thermistor, not 6016): Title "Hardware: {message}", Body = error-registry description of the code or "The hardware refused the command", OK only; then go Home.
** CureHistory delete: Title "Delete this run?", Body "{material} ({date}) and its report are deleted from the machine and from sCure Cloud. This cannot be undone.", OkText "Delete", Destructive. Delete all: Title "Delete the whole cure history?", Body "All {n} runs and their reports are deleted from the machine and from sCure Cloud. This cannot be undone.", OkText "Delete all", Destructive.
** Settings chamber heating refused by thermistor ({{IsA(code, 9001)}} i.e. 9001 or 9010-9012, or 9006 / message contains "thermistor"): Title "Heater not started — temperature sensor not reading" (or frozen: "Heater not started — temperature reading frozen"), Body = Body + "\n\n" + Hint (texts in Strings.Settings HeaterFault*/HeaterFrozen*, mention Err 9010 / Err 9006), OK only, Destructive.

** RemoteConfirmPrompter (DVT from sCure Cloud): Title "DVT test requested from sCure Cloud", Body "{test}\n{detail\n}\nNothing turns on until you press Start. Press Start only if the chamber is ready and it is safe to run this test now; the test may light the UV LEDs or heat the chamber.", OkText "Start", CancelText "Decline", {{StayUp = true}}. The prompter keeps one dialog per request id; when the cloud withdraws the request it calls {{dialog.Cancel()}}; the answer is passed to {{RemoteConfirm.Resolve(id, start)}}; an exception counts as Decline.

*Project / folder:* {{src/SCureBox.Ui/SCureBox.Ui.csproj}} — {{ViewModels/Dialogs/NumberPadViewModel.cs}}, {{Views/Dialogs/NumberPadView.axaml}}
*Goal:* Numeric entry with min/max/step, optional decimals and a unit suffix; it refuses keys that would exceed the range's digit count or the maximum, and returns the clamped, rounded value (null on cancel).
*Depends on:* UIDLG-01.
*Files to create:* {{NumberPadViewModel.cs}} — {{public sealed partial class NumberPadViewModel : DialogViewModel<double?>}}; {{NumberPadView.axaml(.cs)}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{CloseOnOverlayTap => true}}; {{DesignWidth => 560}}; {{CancelResult => null}}.
* {{[ObservableProperty]}} {{string Title = ""}}, {{double Min = 0}}, {{double Max = 100}}, {{double Step = 1}}, {{int Decimals = 0}}, {{string Suffix = ""}}, {{string Entry = ""}}, {{bool Negative}} (unused by logic).
* {{AllowDecimal => Decimals > 0}}; {{MaxWholeDigits => max(1, digits of floor(|Max|))}}; {{RangeText => $"{Min:0.##} – {Max:0.##}{Suffix}"}}; {{Display => (Entry == "" ? "0" : Entry) + Suffix}}; {{Value}} = invariant parse of Entry or null; {{IsValid => Value in [Min, Max]}}.
* {{public void SetValue(double? value)}}; commands {{DigitCommand(string)}}, {{DotCommand}}, {{BackspaceCommand}}, {{ClearCommand}}, {{IncrementCommand}}, {{DecrementCommand}}, {{OkCommand}} (CanExecute = {{IsValid}}), {{CancelDialogCommand}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{SetValue(v)}}: Entry = {{Format(v)}} (rounded to {{Decimals}}, format {{"0." + '#' x Decimals}}, invariant) or ""; marks the entry "untouched" when non-empty.
# {{Digit(d)}}: start from "" if untouched or Entry == "0", else Entry; clear untouched; next = start + d; refuse if the whole part (before ".") is longer than {{MaxWholeDigits}}, or if next parses to a value > Max; else Entry = next. (So 30-80 °C takes two digits; 10-100 % three; a preloaded value is replaced by the first digit.)
# {{Dot}}: ignored if {{!AllowDecimal}}; if untouched → Entry "0."; ignored if Entry already has "."; else append "." ("0." when empty).
# Backspace removes the last char; Clear empties; both clear untouched.
# Increment/Decrement: Entry = Format(clamp((Value ?? Min) ± Step, Min, Max)); sets untouched.
# OK: {{Close(Math.Round(Math.Clamp(Value ?? Min, Min, Max), Decimals))}}.

*Goal:* The dialogs Home's Start Cure passes through: refuse with a list of critical alerts, refuse an N₂-only program when nitrogen is off, then show a spinning-fan "Running System Pre-Check" while the all-fans test runs; the pre-check can stay up across the page change until CureProcess has the run's first real status.
*Depends on:* UIDLG-01, UIDLG-08; Native UI (Home, CureProcess, {{AlertService}}, navigation); Application-Process ({{ICureController.RunFanTest}}, {{FanTestResult}}).
*Files to create:* {{CriticalAlertDialogViewModel : DialogViewModel<bool>}}, {{NitrogenOnlyDialogViewModel : DialogViewModel<bool>}}, {{PreflightDialogViewModel : DialogViewModel<FanTestResult?>}} (ctor {{(ICureController controller, ILogger<PreflightDialogViewModel> log)}}), and views {{CriticalAlertDialogView}}, {{NitrogenOnlyDialogView}}, {{PreflightDialogView}}.
*Public contract:*
* CriticalAlert: {{CloseOnOverlayTap => true}}, {{DesignWidth => 900}}, {{CancelResult => false}}; {{Title}} "Critical alert active"; {{Body}} "A cure cannot start while a critical alert is active. Handle it/them on the Alerts screen first:"; {{[ObservableProperty] IReadOnlyList<string> Lines}}; {{public void Load(AlertService alerts)}}; {{CloseDialogCommand}} → false; {{GoToAlertsCommand}} → true.
* NitrogenOnly: {{DesignWidth => 0}}, {{CancelResult => false}}; {{Title}} "Cannot Start Cure", {{Line1}} "This material contains only nitrogen purge steps, but nitrogen is not enabled on the system.", {{Line2}} "Enable nitrogen in Settings or choose a different material.", {{OkText}} "OK"; {{OkCommand}} → true.
* Preflight: {{public static readonly TimeSpan HoldLimit = 45 s}}; {{DesignWidth => 760}}; {{CancelResult => _result}} (the fan test result so far); {{Hint}} "Running System Pre-Check"; {{public bool HoldAfterTest { get; set; }}}; {{KeepAcrossPageChange => HoldAfterTest}}; {{public Task<FanTestResult?> TestCompleted}}; {{public void Finish() => Close(_result)}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# CriticalAlert {{Load}}: take at most 4 entries of {{alerts.Critical}}, each line {{"{code} — {message}"}} or {{"{code} — {message} ({detail})"}} when detail is non-blank (message from {{alerts.Registry.Message(code)}}). Layout: red AlertTriangle + Title (h2 destructive), Body, lines indented 24, buttons "Close" (outline) and "Go to alerts" (primary). Home: true → navigate to Alerts (replace: false).
# NitrogenOnly is full screen on {{Background95Brush}}: 160 px red-dim circle with 96 px AlertTriangle, Title, Line1, Line2, large primary OK. Shown when every step is Nitrogen and {{UiSettingsStore.NitrogenMode}} is false.
# Home Start Cure order: if {{_alerts.HasCritical}} → CriticalAlert; if door open → return silently; nitrogen-only check; then Preflight with {{HoldAfterTest = true}}.
# Preflight {{OnShown}} (async): {{_result = await Task.Run(() => controller.RunFanTest("all"))}} (exception → warning log, result stays null); complete {{TestCompleted}}; if not held → {{Close(_result)}}; if held → wait {{HoldLimit}} (45 s), log a warning if still open, then {{Finish()}} (so it can never hang the screen).
# Home after {{TestCompleted}}: compute failed fans; if any → {{Finish()}}, await the dialog, then show FanFail (Preflight kind, UIDLG-08); false → stop; true → {{SetFanOverride(fan, true)}} for each failed fan. Then navigate to CureProcess with a {{CureStartRequest}} whose {{Preflight}} is the still-open dialog (or null). CureProcess calls {{Finish()}} when the first status with {{State != "preflight"}} arrives, when the start fails / material missing, or when leaving the page.
# Preflight view: a 72 px cyan Fan icon with class {{spin}} rotating 0→360° in 1.4 s, infinite, linear (style animation on {{RotateTransform.Angle}}, origin 50%,50%) + Hint text.
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Start with a critical alert opens CriticalAlert; Go to alerts navigates to Alerts.
* N₂-only program with nitrogen mode off opens NitrogenOnly and does not navigate.
* Start runs the pre-flight fan test and navigates to CureProcess; the spinner stays up until CureProcess finishes it.
* Preflight view has exactly one IconGlyph of kind Fan with class "spin" and one style with one 1.4 s infinite animation with 2 keyframes.
*Tests:* {{HomeTests.Start_with_a_critical_alert_opens_the_critical_dialog}}, {{HomeTests.Nitrogen_only_material_without_nitrogen_mode_is_refused}}, {{HomeTests.Start_runs_the_preflight_fan_test_and_navigates_to_CureProcess}}, {{HomeTests.FailedFans_reads_the_fan_test_result}}, {{DialogViewModelTests.Preflight_dialog_spins_the_fan_glyph}}.

Nothing about the sign-in is stored.
*Depends on:* UIDLG-01, UIDLG-03; Native UI service {{OriginBrowserSignIn}} ({{IOriginBrowserSignIn}}, {{IOriginSurface}}, {{IOriginInput}}, {{OriginField}}, {{OriginPhase}}, {{OriginOrganization}}, {{OriginSignInResult}}; headless browser, {{config/origin.json}}); Setup and Settings pages.
*Files to create:* {{OriginSignInDialogViewModel.cs}} with {{public enum PagePointer { Down, Move, Up }}} and {{public sealed partial class OriginSignInDialogViewModel : DialogViewModel<OriginOrganization?>, IOriginSurface}} (ctor {{(IOriginBrowserSignIn origin, IDialogService dialogs)}}); {{OriginSignInDialogView.axaml(.cs)}}.
*Public contract:* {{CloseOnOverlayTap => false}}; {{DesignWidth => origin.Embedded ? 1440 : 820}}; {{CancelResult => null}}; {{Title}} "Sign in to Origin"; {{PageWidth => 1360}}, {{PageHeight => 760}} ({{OriginBrowserSignIn.ViewWidth/ViewHeight}}); {{[ObservableProperty]}} {{Bitmap? Frame}}, {{bool Busy = true}}, {{string? Error}}, {{bool Ready}}; {{HasError}}, {{ShowPage => Frame != null && !HasError}}, {{ShowStatus => !ShowPage}}, {{InWindow => !origin.Embedded}}, {{Status}} (HasError ? Error : InWindow && Ready ? Strings.Origin.InWindow : "Opening the Origin website..."); {{public Task RunAsync()}}; {{RetryCommand}} (CanExecute {{HasError}}); {{CancelDialogCommand}}; {{public void Pointer(PagePointer phase, double fx, double fy)}}; explicit {{IOriginSurface}} members {{Attached}}, {{Phase}}, {{ShowFrame}}, {{EditAsync}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{OnShown}} starts {{RunAsync()}}: Busy=true, Error=null, Ready=false; {{await origin.SignInAsync(this, cts.Token)}}; if cancelled → return; Organization → {{Close(org)}}; Error null (page went away) → {{Cancel()}}; else Busy=false, Error = r.Error (operator texts from the service: "Sign-in took too long - try again", "Origin sign-in failed - try again", "No web browser found on this machine", "Origin sign-in is not set up on this machine (config/origin.json)").
# {{Retry}} (only with an error) runs {{RunAsync}} again. {{CancelDialog}} cancels the CTS and {{Cancel()}} → null.
# Surface callbacks (background threads): {{Attached(input)}} stores the input; {{Phase(p)}} posts {{Ready = p == Ready}} to the UI thread; {{ShowFrame(jpeg)}} decodes a {{Bitmap}} (torn frame → ignored), posts swap of {{Frame}} and disposes the old one; {{EditAsync(field)}} posts to the UI thread and shows the keyboard with {{Text = field.Value}}, {{Masked = field.IsPassword}}, {{Docked = true}}, returning the keyboard text.
# {{Pointer}}: NaN coordinates (capture lost) → forget the press. Down → remember start/last, not dragged. Move with a press: if not yet dragged and |dx|+|dy| < 0.012 (TapSlop, fractions of the picture) → ignore; else dragged, {{input.Scroll(fx, fy, (last.Y - fy) * 760)}}, last = current. Up with a press: if not dragged → {{input.Tap(down.X, down.Y)}}; clear.
# View code-behind: {{PageImage}} pointer pressed/moved (only with left button pressed)/released send positions as fractions of the image bounds (event handled); {{PointerCaptureLost}} sends {{Up}} with NaN.
# Layout: header — 64 px primary-dim circle Globe icon; Title (h2) + "Only the organization is taken from your account. Nothing about your sign-in is stored on this machine." (xxs muted); "Try Again" primary (visible with error); "Cancel" outline. In-window mode: secondary box with Status, steps "1  Sign in at the Origin window", "2  Wait until your models page appears", "3  The window closes and the organization is linked", indeterminate progress bar (hidden on error), error text (red). Embedded mode: 1360x760 rounded clipped box with the page {{Image}} (Stretch Fill, visible when ShowPage) or the Status text centred.
# Results: Settings → {{SetOrganization(org.Id)}}, clears org error; Setup → OrganizationId = org.Id, file text "from Origin account {email ?? name ?? ""}".
# The screensaver does not interrupt it (dialogs suppress idle, UIDLG-01).

* The dialog waits and closes with the organization; an error shows "Try Again" and retry works; a vanished page cancels (null).
* In-window mode says where to sign in and is 820 wide.
* A short press taps the page; a drag scrolls it.
* Tapping a field opens the docked keyboard and its text goes into the field.
* Settings and Setup sign-in link the organization.

column4: CLOUD-01 Apps Script project, manifest, clasp deploy and the build-reload handshake
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, Deploy & OS image, Versioning
*Blocks:* CLOUD-02, CLOUD-07, CLOUD-19
*Relates to:* OPS-02
*Implements:* EP-01

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/appsscript.json, .clasp.json, .claspignore, Code.gs ({{PORTAL_BUILD}}, {{setup}}), Page.html ({{PORTAL_BUILD}})
*Goal:* Create the Apps Script project that hosts the portal as a public web app executing as the deployer, define the push allow-list and the deploy procedure, and give open browser tabs a way to learn that a newer build was deployed.
*Depends on:* none
*Files to create:*
* {{appsscript.json}} — manifest.
* {{.clasp.json}} — {{{scriptId: <the project id>, rootDir: "", scriptExtensions: [".js",".gs"], htmlExtensions: [".html"], jsonExtensions: [".json"], filePushOrder: [], skipSubdirectories: false}}} (script id is the project's own; do not copy).
* {{.claspignore}} — ignore everything ({{*/*}}) then re-include {{!Code.gs}}, {{!Secrets.gs}}, {{!Page.html}}, {{!appsscript.json}}, {{!ErrorRegistry.gs}}.
* {{Code.gs}} — {{var PORTAL_BUILD = '0.9.146'}}; {{function setup()}} (run once from the editor: {{book_()}}, logs the sheet URL and the configured machine names).
* {{Page.html}} — {{const PORTAL_BUILD = '0.9.146'}} (must equal Code.gs).
*Public contract:*
* Manifest: {{timeZone: "Asia/Jerusalem"}}, {{runtimeVersion: "V8"}}, {{exceptionLogging: "STACKDRIVER"}}, {{dependencies: {}}}, {{oauthScopes: [spreadsheets, script.scriptapp, drive, script.external_request]}} (full URLs {{https://www.googleapis.com/auth/...}}), {{webapp: {executeAs: "USER_DEPLOYING", access: "ANYONE_ANONYMOUS"}}}.
* {{portalDvt(...)}} returns {{build: PORTAL_BUILD}} (CLOUD-15); the page shows a "Reload" banner ({{location.reload()}}) when {{DVT.build && DVT.build !== PORTAL_BUILD}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Anonymous access is required: the CureBox and the DVT tool/runner post without a Google login; the browser authenticates through the portal's own session (CLOUD-09/10).
# {{executeAs USER_DEPLOYING}}: every Sheet/Drive/UrlFetch runs as the owner account.
# Deploy procedure (from the SKILL file {{.claude/skills/scure-cloud-ux/SKILL.md}} and the {{build_errors.py}} docstring): in {{cloud/google}}, {{npx @google/clasp push -f}} then {{clasp deploy -i <fixed deployment id> -d "<what>"}}. A push alone does not change the live site; only a deploy to the fixed deployment id (the URL the machines are configured with) does. OPEN QUESTION: the exact clasp version to use is not in code (operator notes mention a clasp 3 alpha because of the login file format).
# Bump {{PORTAL_BUILD}} in *both* Code.gs and Page.html on every change; a mismatch means the tab predates a deploy.
# Adding an OAuth scope makes the web app need re-authorization by the owner before machines can sync again (comment at Code.gs {{ownerEmail_}}); scopes must be changed deliberately. {{userinfo.email}} is intentionally not requested.
# {{.claspignore}} means only the five listed files are ever pushed; tests, generators and screenshots stay local.
# {{Secrets.gs}} is pushed (it is in the allow-list) but never committed (git-ignored).
*Look & layout:* n/a (the reload banner itself is a UI ticket, CLOUD-20..39 / CLOUD-40..59).
*Configuration:* script id in {{.clasp.json}}; deployment id kept by the operator, never in source.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* {{clasp push}} uploads exactly Code.gs, Secrets.gs, Page.html, appsscript.json, ErrorRegistry.gs.
* The deployed URL answers GET with the portal page titled "sCure Cloud" to an anonymous browser and accepts anonymous POSTs at {{/exec}}.
* With Code.gs PORTAL_BUILD ≠ Page.html PORTAL_BUILD, the DVT views show a Reload banner.
* {{setup()}} creates the data sheet on a fresh project and logs its URL.
*Tests:* none automated for deploy (label untested); {{test_page.py}} stubs {{build: '0.9.102'}} in {{portalDvt}}.
*Reference (source):* cloud/google/appsscript.json 1-17; .clasp.json; .claspignore; Code.gs 734, 1505-1510; Page.html 611, 1167-1169, 1459-1461; .claude/skills/scure-cloud-ux/SKILL.md 10; build_errors.py 1-9.

h3. Links

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Code.gs ({{cfg_}}, {{googleCfg_}}, {{execUrl_}}, {{ownerEmail_}}), build_secrets.py, Secrets.gs (generated)
*Goal:* One place that resolves every secret and setting: Apps Script script properties win, a generated {{Secrets.gs}} is the fallback, and nothing secret is ever in git.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-01
*Files to create:*
* {{Code.gs}} — {{cfg_()}} returns {{{password, keys, dvtKey, netbirdToken, netbirdPeers}}}.
* {{build_secrets.py}} — reads {{cloud/portal_secrets.local.txt}} (git-ignored) and writes {{Secrets.gs}}.
*Public contract:*
* Script properties read: {{PORTAL_PASSWORD}}, {{MACHINE_KEYS}} (JSON {{{"<machine name>": "<key>"}}}), {{DVT_KEY}}, {{NETBIRD_TOKEN}}, {{NETBIRD_PEERS}} (JSON {{{"<machine>": "<peer name>"}}}), {{GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}}, {{GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}}, {{OAUTH_REDIRECT_URL}}, {{OWNER_EMAIL}}; written by the server: {{SHEET_ID}}, {{DVT_FOLDER_ID}}, {{RACE}}, {{dvt_renames_<id>}}.
* {{Secrets.gs}}: {{var SECRETS = {"password", "machineKeys", "dvtKey", "netbirdToken", "netbirdPeers"}}} (first line comment "Generated by build_secrets.py … DO NOT COMMIT (git-ignored)").
* Source file line formats parsed by {{build_secrets.py}} (regex): {{portal password: <v>}}, {{machine key (<name>): <v>}} (repeatable), {{dvt key: <v>}}, {{netbird token: <v>}}, {{netbird peer (<name>): <v>}} (repeatable).
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{cfg_()}}: each value = script property if set, else {{SECRETS.<field>}}, else {{''}} / {{{}}}. {{MACHINE_KEYS}} / {{NETBIRD_PEERS}} that fail {{JSON.parse}} silently keep the fallback. If {{SECRETS}} is undefined the fallback is {{{password:'', machineKeys:{}}}}.
# A machine's portal *name comes from its key*: the key map is the only machine registry; a machine cannot register itself. Adding a machine = adding a key to {{MACHINE_KEYS}} (script property needs no redeploy).
# {{build_secrets.py}}: no source file → exit with "set PORTAL_PASSWORD / MACHINE_KEYS / DVT_KEY as script properties instead". No {{dvt key:}} line → mint one with {{secrets.token_urlsafe(24)}}, append it to the source file and print that it must be pasted into the DVT tool's Cloud box. Prints counts only, never values.
# {{googleCfg_()}} = {{{id, secret}}} only when both GOOGLE_* properties are set (they are never read from Secrets.gs), else {{null}}.
# {{execUrl_()}} = {{OAUTH_REDIRECT_URL}} if set else {{ScriptApp.getService().getUrl()}} ({{''}} on error).
# {{ownerEmail_()}} = {{OWNER_EMAIL}} lower-cased/trimmed; else {{Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail()}} (in production this needs the {{userinfo.email}} scope the manifest does not request, so it yields {{''}}), errors → {{''}}.
# Never write a secret value into tickets, logs, commits or Page.html.
*Look & layout:* n/a
*Configuration:* {{cloud/portal_secrets.local.txt}} (git-ignored, {{.gitignore}} 35-39), script properties as above.
*Acceptance criteria:*

* Running {{build_secrets.py}} without a {{dvt key:}} line adds exactly one to the source file; a second run reuses it.
* {{git check-ignore cloud/google/Secrets.gs}} succeeds.
*Tests:* test_code.cjs sets {{PORTAL_PASSWORD}}, {{MACHINE_KEYS}}, {{DVT_KEY}}, {{NETBIRD_*}}, {{GOOGLE_*}}, {{OWNER_EMAIL}} through a fake PropertiesService. {{build_secrets.py}} has no test (untested).

Then ensure all sheets (in order): machines, commands, reports, alerts, dvt_runs, dvt_files, dvt_catalog, dvt_requests, dvt_runners, dvt_units, users, audit. Called at the start of nearly every server function.

# Migration B (0.9.145): if {{dvt_requests}} N1 ≠ {{act}}, write {{act}} in N1 (appended, nothing moves).
# Chunking ({{CELL_MAX = 45000}}, a cell holds 50,000): split text into consecutive cells starting at the sheet's "blob" column; read with {{slice(k).join('')}}; on rewrite pad to {{max(lastColumn, needed)}} with {{''}}. An empty value still writes one {{''}} chunk.
# Rows are located by scanning ({{getLastRow()-1}} data rows), ids assigned as {{max(id)+1}} under the script lock; row deletes go highest row first.

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Code.gs ({{doGet}}, {{doPost}}), Page.html (first {{<script>}}: the Apps Script shim)
*Goal:* Route every incoming HTTP request and define the exact list of server functions the page calls, through a {{window.fetch}} shim that keeps the page's REST-style code while calling {{google.script.run}}.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-03, CLOUD-09
*Files to create:*
* {{Code.gs}} — {{doGet(e)}}, {{doPost(e)}}.
* {{Page.html}} — shim: {{tok()}} / {{setTok()}} (sessionStorage key {{scure-cloud-token}}, in-memory fallback), {{call(fn, ...args)}} → Promise over {{google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(res).withFailureHandler(rej)[fn](...)}}, {{window.scureReportHref(m, runId, download)}}, {{window.scureDvtFileHref(fileUrl, id)}}, {{reply(status, obj)}}, {{window.fetch = async (path, opts)}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{doGet(e)}} order: {{?report}} → {{serveReport_}} (CLOUD-08); {{?dvtfile}} → {{serveDvtFile_}} (CLOUD-15); {{?state}} with {{?code}} or {{?error}} → {{googleCallback_}} (CLOUD-10); else {{HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile('Page').setTitle('sCure Cloud').addMetaTag('viewport','width=device-width, initial-scale=1').setXFrameOptionsMode(ALLOWALL)}} (embeddable in Google Sites).
* {{doPost(e)}}: {{path = e.pathInfo}} trimmed of {{/}}; only {{''}} or {{api/agent/sync}} accepted, else {{{ok:false, message:'not found'}}}. Body = {{JSON.parse(e.postData.contents || '{}')}}, parse error → {{{ok:false, message:'bad json'}}}. {{key = d.machineKey || e.parameter.key || ''}}. If {{String(d.kind)}} starts with {{dvt}} → DVT branch (CLOUD-14/17) authenticated by {{cfg_().dvtKey}} ({{{ok:false, message:'bad DVT key'}}}), kinds {{dvt_run, dvt_file, dvt_delete_runs, dvt_machines, dvt_catalog, dvt_runner_hello, dvt_events, dvt_next, dvt_update}}, other → {{{ok:false, message:'unknown DVT kind: <kind>'}}}. Else machine branch (CLOUD-05/08) authenticated by the key map → {{{ok:false, message:'bad machine key'}}}.
* Shim path → server function (token = {{tok()}}; {{null}} result → status 401; {{{denied:true}}} → 403; {{ok:false}} → 400 where shown):

||fetch path (body fields)||server function||
| {{/login}} ({{password}}) | {{portalLogin(password)}} → stores token, 401 {{{message or 'Wrong password'}}} |
| {{/login/mode}} | {{portalLoginMode()}} (failure → {{{google:false}}}) |
| {{/login/google}} | {{portalLoginStart()}} |
| {{/login/poll}} ({{state}}) | {{portalLoginPoll(state)}} → stores token on {{ok}} |
| {{/logout}} | {{portalLogout(token)}} then clears token |
| {{/api/me}} | {{portalMe(token)}} |
| {{/api/users}} / {{/api/users/save}} ({{email, role, name}}) / {{/api/users/remove}} ({{email}}) / {{/api/audit}} | {{portalUsers(t)}} / {{portalUserSave(t,email,role,name)}} / {{portalUserRemove(t,email)}} / {{portalAudit(t, 100)}} |
| {{/api/machines}} | {{portalMachines(t)}} |
| {{/api/alerts?since=<n>}} | {{portalAlerts(t, since)}} |
| {{/api/dvt}} | {{portalDvt(t)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/wait?since=<v>&wait=<s>}} | {{portalDvtWait(t, since, wait)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/detail}} | {{portalDvtDetail(t)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/race}} ({{start?, units?}}) | {{portalRaceSet(t, body)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/files}} ({{ids}}) | {{portalDvtFiles(t, ids)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/unit}} ({{unit, fields}}) | {{portalDvtUnitSave(t, unit, fields)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/approve}} ({{unit, testId, runIds, who, approve}}) | {{portalDvtApprove(t, unit, testId, runIds, who, approve !== false)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/request}} ({{machine, unit, testIds}}) | {{portalDvtRequest(t, machine, unit, testIds)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/cancel}} ({{ids}} or {{id}}, {{force}}) | {{portalDvtCancel(t, ids||id, force === true)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/acted}} ({{id}}) | {{portalDvtActed(t, id)}} |
| {{/api/dvt/answer}} ({{id, value}}) | {{portalDvtAnswer(t, id, value ?? null)}} |
| {{/api/machines/<name>/commands}} ({{type, payload}}) | {{portalCommand(t, decodeURIComponent(name), body)}} |
| anything else | 404 {{{ok:false, message:'not found'}}} |

* Links: report = {{<reportUrl>?report=<runId>&m=<machine>&t=<token>[&dl=1]}}; DVT file = {{<fileUrl>?dvtfile=<Drive id>&t=<token>}}; {{'#'}} when the URL is empty.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Apps Script refuses anonymous POSTs with a path after {{/exec}}, so machines post to {{/exec}} itself; {{api/agent/sync}} is accepted for compatibility.
# Apps Script cannot read request headers, so the key travels in the body ({{machineKey}}); {{?key=}} query is an alternative.
# The DVT key can only write DVT data; a machine key can only write its own machine's data.
# Apps Script HtmlService cuts a line at {{//}} even inside a regex ({{\/\/}}); write {{\/{2}}} in Page.html (checked by test_errors_page.cjs).
# {{window.fetch}} is replaced globally, so all page network goes through the shim; there are no other server calls.
*Look & layout:* n/a
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* POST with pathInfo {{other}} → {{ok:false}}; with a bad key → {{{ok:false, message:'bad machine key'}}}; a DVT kind with a machine key → {{bad DVT key}}.
* Every row of the table above maps to an existing server function with the given argument order.
* GET with no parameters returns the page; with {{report}}/{{dvtfile}}/OAuth parameters it is routed as listed.
*Tests:* test_code.cjs ({{post()}} helper over {{doPost}}, bad key / bad path); every browser test stubs {{google.script.run}} with the same function names (CLOUD-19); test_errors_page.cjs checks no {{\//}} in Page.html.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, Cloud sync & Origin, Programs & recipes
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-03, CLOUD-04, CLOUD-06

*Relates to:* PLAT-10, API-10

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Code.gs ({{doPost}} machine branch, {{machines_}}, {{writeMachine_}}, {{commands_}})
*Goal:* Accept the periodic snapshot each CureBox posts, store it as that machine's latest state, merge its alert log, and hand back the data-only commands queued for it, marking them delivered and acknowledged.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-03, CLOUD-04, CLOUD-06
*Files to create:* {{Code.gs}} — machine branch of {{doPost}}, {{machines_(sh)}}, {{writeMachine_(sh, name, text)}}, {{commands_(sh)}}; constants {{ONLINE_SEC = 90}}, {{COMMAND_TYPES}}.
*Public contract (wire, both directions):*
* Request (from PLAT-10 {{CloudSyncAgent.Snapshot}}, application/json): {{machineKey}} (string, also sent as header {{X-Machine-Key}} which is unreadable here), {{name}} (string, ignored by the server — the name comes from the key), {{state}} {{{chamberTemp, doorClosed, isHeating, isCooling, uvOn, internetOk, counters}}}, {{programs}} (user materials), {{presets}} (built-in catalog), {{prints}} (≤ 20 print logs), {{cures}} (≤ 10 runs, no telemetry), {{alertLog}} {{[{code, message, raised, cleared}]}}, {{ackIds}} {{[command id]}}. No {{kind}} (or a kind other than {{report}} / {{delete_reports}} / {{dvt*}}) means a snapshot.
* Reply: {{{ok: true, acceptsReports: true, commands: [{id: number, type: string, payload: object}]}}}; errors {{{ok:false, message}}}.
* Commands sheet row: {{id | machine | type | payload (JSON text) | created | delivered | acked}} (times unix s).
* Command types and payloads (written by {{portalCommand}}, CLOUD-12; applied by PLAT-10): {{upsert_program}} payload = full program object; {{delete_program}} {{{id}}}; {{delete_print}} {{{id}}} (firmware 1.0.147+); {{send_print}} {{{printName, printerName, materialName, nfcTag?}}} (machine also honours optional {{duration}} minutes, {{steps}}, {{csvFile}}).
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Resolve the name: the entry of {{cfg_().keys}} whose value equals the key; none → {{bad machine key}}. {{delete d.machineKey}} (never stored).
# Under the script lock: remove {{alertLog}} from the body and merge it (CLOUD-06); write {{JSON.stringify(rest)}} to the machine's row ({{name, now_(), chunks…}}), creating the row if new. {{ackIds}} and {{name}} stay inside the stored snapshot.
# For each command of this machine with empty {{acked}}: if its id is in {{ackIds}} → set {{acked = now}}; else parse payload (bad JSON → {{{}}}), add to {{commands}}, set {{delivered = now}}. So an unacked command is re-delivered on every sync until acked.
# {{acceptsReports: true}} tells PLAT-10 it may upload reports (CLOUD-08).
# A machine is *online* when {{now - lastSeen < 90}} s (sync every 30 s by default on the old agent; PLAT-10 default interval 10 s).
# Report upload / delete kinds do not update {{lastSeen}}.
# OPEN QUESTION: the {{commands}} sheet is never pruned (acked rows accumulate forever); a cap is not in the code.
# OPEN QUESTION: {{waitLock(20000)}} throws when the lock is not obtained; the machine then receives an Apps Script HTML error page, not JSON (PLAT-10 treats it as a failed sync).
*Look & layout:* n/a
*Configuration:* {{MACHINE_KEYS}} (CLOUD-02).
*Acceptance criteria:*
* First sync from {{CureBox-1}} answers exactly {{{ok:true, acceptsReports:true, commands:[]}}} and the key text appears nowhere in the sheet.
* A queued {{upsert_program}} is returned once per sync ({{{id:1, type:'upsert_program', payload:{…}}}}) until a sync carries {{ackIds:[1]}}; then pending = 0.
* An unknown key is refused and nothing is written.
*Tests:* test_code.cjs lines 77-113 (bad key, first sync, deliver → ack, chunked snapshot).
*Reference (source):* Code.gs 39-44, 110-143, 170-202; sCureBox-CS src/SCureBox.Application/Platform/CloudSyncAgent.cs 110-158, 301-350, 400-460 (machine side, PLAT-10).
