*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Code.gs ({{newSession_}}, {{authed_}}, {{need_}}, {{portalLoginMode}}, {{portalLogin}}, {{portalMe}}, {{portalLogout}})
*Goal:* Issue and check portal session tokens, support the shared password until Google sign-in is configured, and gate every action by role with a uniform refusal and audit trail.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-02, CLOUD-11 (users / audit helpers)
*Files to create:* {{Code.gs}} — functions above; {{ROLES = ['view','service','admin']}}, {{ROLE_LABEL = {view:'Viewer', service:'Service', admin:'Admin'}}}, {{SESSION_SEC = 21600}}.
*Public contract:*
* Cache {{tok:<token>}} = {{{"e": email|'password', "m": 'google'|'password'}}}, TTL 6 h. Token = two concatenated {{Utilities.getUuid()}}.
* {{portalLoginMode()}} → {{{google: bool}}}.
* {{portalLogin(password)}} → {{{ok:true, token}}} / {{{ok:false}}} / {{{ok:false, message:'Sign in with your Google account'}}} when Google is on.
* {{portalMe(token)}} → {{null}} or {{{email, name, role, roleLabel, owner, via:'google'|'password', canService, canAdmin}}}.
* {{portalLogout(token)}} → {{{ok:true}}}.
* {{authed_(token)}} → {{null}} or {{{email, role, name, owner, via}}}; {{need_(token, role, what)}} → {{{me}}} or {{{stop}}} where stop = {{null}} (not signed in) or {{{ok:false, denied:true, message:'<what> needs <Role> access - you are signed in as <Role>. Ask an admin.'}}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Password session = admin {{{email:'', name:'Shared password', role:'admin'}}} — but only while Google is not configured; once GOOGLE_* are set every password session is invalid immediately.
# Google session: re-resolve the person on every call ({{userOf_}}), so role changes and removals take effect on the next call.
# {{need_}}: refusal is audited as {{refused}} with {{<what> (role <role>)}}; an allowed non-view action is audited with action = {{<what>}}.
# Role levels: view < service < admin. Action → role: view = all reads; service = {{portalCommand}}, {{portalDvtRequest/Cancel/Answer/Acted}}, {{portalDvtUnitSave}}, {{portalRaceSet}}; admin = {{portalDvtApprove}}, {{portalUsers/UserSave/UserRemove/Audit}}.
# Audit of password sign-in: {{signed in with the shared password}} / {{password sign-in refused}} (email '').
# OPEN QUESTION: sessions live in CacheService, which may evict entries before 6 h; no persistence fallback exists.
*Look & layout:* n/a (sign-in screen and header: CLOUD-20..39 / People: CLOUD-40..59)
*Configuration:* {{PORTAL_PASSWORD}}, {{GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}}, {{GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}}.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Wrong password → {{ok:false}}; right password → token whose {{portalMe}} says role admin, via password.
* After GOOGLE_* are set, the same token → {{portalMe}} null and {{portalMachines}} null; {{portalLogin('pw')}} → ok:false.
* A viewer calling each service action gets {{denied:true}} and a message starting with "<what> needs Service access".
*Tests:* test_code.cjs 87-91, 590-715.
*Reference (source):* Code.gs 41, 1147-1165, 1224-1269, 1336-1349.

* {{portalLoginPoll(state)}} → {{{pending:true}}} | the settled result once ({{{ok:true, token}}} or {{{ok:false, message}}}) | {{{ok:false, message:'The sign-in took too long - press Sign in again.'}}} (unknown / used up) | {{{ok:false, message:'Sign-in failed - press Sign in again.'}}} (unparsable).

Decode the ID token payload (base64url, padded) *without verifying the signature* (it arrived over TLS straight from Google).

* Sheet {{audit}}: {{time (ISO) | unix (floor) | email | action | detail (≤ 500 chars)}}.

* {{portalUserSave(t, email, role, name)}} → {{{ok:true}}} / {{{ok:false, message}}} messages: {{Write a full email address}}, {{Choose Viewer, Service or Admin}}, {{The owner is always an admin}}, {{<email> is the last admin - make someone else an admin first}}.
* {{portalUserRemove(t, email)}} → messages {{The owner cannot be removed}}, {{<email> is not on the list}}, last-admin message.
* {{portalAudit(t, limit)}} → {{{ok:true, rows:[{unix, email, action, detail}]}}} newest first; limit clamped 1..500 (default 200; the page asks 100).

# {{users_()}} cached in CacheService {{users:list}} for 60 s; every change invalidates ({{put('', 1)}}) before and after the write.
# {{userOf_(email)}}: the owner ({{ownerEmail_()}}) is always {{{role:'admin', owner:true, name: sheet name or 'Owner'}}}; else the sheet row; else null.

# Last-admin rule ({{lastAdmin_}}): when an owner is known nobody else is "last"; with no owner, an admin may not be removed or demoted if no other admin remains.
# Audit actions written: {{changed a person}} ({{<email>: <old> -> <new>}}), {{added a person}} ({{<email> as <role>}}), {{removed a person}} ({{<email> (was <role>)}}), {{signed out}}, plus those of CLOUD-09/10. {{audit_}} never throws; when rows exceed 5,500 delete the oldest 500.

*Goal:* Receive the DVT campaign data posted with the DVT key by the DVT tool and the CureBox runners: recorded runs (upsert), raw measurement files into Drive, deletions, the list of CureBoxes, and the test catalog with version guard and one-time test renames.

Row: {{unit, testId, variant, rep (default 1), runId, verdict, operator, startedAt, recordedAt=now, note, machine, values JSON (L..)}}; upsert by {{runId}}.
* {{{kind:'dvt_file', unit, runId, fileName, contentBase64, fileKind?, mimeType?}}} → {{{ok:true, fileId}}} / messages {{a DVT file needs unit, runId and fileName}}, {{a DVT file needs contentBase64}}. Mime default: {{image/png}} for {{.png}}, else {{text/csv}}. Row {{unit, runId, kind, fileName, fileId, size (bytes), uploaded}}.
* {{{kind:'dvt_delete_runs', runIds:[…]}}} → {{{ok:true, deleted}}} / {{runIds must be a list}}.
* {{{kind:'dvt_machines'}}} → {{{ok:true, machines:[names]}}} (configured keys ∪ synced machines, sorted; names only).
* {{{kind:'dvt_catalog', catalog:{version, phases:[…], tests:{<testId>:{units, runs, group, afterAll, d (detail), …}}, renames?}}}} → {{{ok:true}}} / {{{ok:true, kept:<stored version>}}} / {{a DVT catalog needs phases and tests}}.

# Drive folder {{sCure DVT files}}, id cached in script property {{DVT_FOLDER_ID}} (recreated if missing).
# Re-upload of the same {{(unit, runId, fileName)}} trashes the old Drive file and reuses the row.
# Deleting runs deletes their {{dvt_runs}} rows *and* their {{dvt_files}} rows, trashing the Drive files.
# Catalog version guard: when a stored catalog exists and {{catalogCmp_(new.version, stored.version) < 0}} the post is ignored ({{kept}}) — an un-updated runner must not put an older catalog back. {{catalogCmp_}} compares dotted numeric parts; non-numeric → equal.
# Renames: {{catalog.renames}} is a set {{{id, map:{old:new}}}} or an ordered list of sets; each set is applied once (script property {{dvt_renames_<id>}} = number moved). For runIds/testIds equal to {{old}} or starting with {{old|}} the prefix is replaced (old ids walked in ascending order) in {{dvt_runs}} (testId, runId), {{dvt_files}} (runId) and {{dvt_requests}} (testId, runIds).
# The catalog is stored as one row (row 2): {{updated = now}}, JSON chunks from B; {{dvtCatalog_}} returns it with {{updated}}.
# {{dvt_run}}, {{dvt_file}}, {{dvt_delete_runs}}, {{dvt_catalog}} bump the change version ({{bump_}}) so open DVT tabs reload.
# RunId convention used across the DVT code: {{<testId>|<unit>|<variant>|<rep>}} (see CLOUD-18 approve / open-others checks).

* A machine key cannot post a {{dvt_*}} kind.
*Tests:* test_code.cjs 165-273, 545-553.

*Goal:* Relay DVT test requests to the runner on each CureBox ({{DVT/runner/dvt-runner.cjs}}) cheaply and quickly, and record its progress, prompts, steps, results and live machine state — the portal only queues and relays; the machine's own interlocks and the at-machine Start confirmation stay in charge.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-04, CLOUD-14, CLOUD-18; DVT-05 (RemoteConfirm at the machine)
*Files to create:* {{Code.gs}} — functions above; constants {{DVT_RUNNER_ONLINE_SEC = 60}}, {{DVT_HOLD_MAX_SEC = 20}}, {{DVT_WATCH_SEC = 45}}, {{DVT_READY_FRESH_SEC = 45}}, {{DVT_REQUESTS_KEEP = 300}}, {{DVT_ACTIVE = ['queued','running','waiting','cancel_requested']}}, {{DVT_FINAL = ['done','failed','cancelled','blocked']}}.
*Public contract (POST /exec with the DVT key):*
* {{{kind:'dvt_runner_hello', machine, version?, unit?, catalog?:[…]}}} → {{{ok:true, closed:n}}} / {{the runner needs its CureBox name}}. Upserts {{dvt_runners}} row ({{machine, lastSeen, version, unit, catalog JSON (E..)}}). (The runner also posts {{dvt_catalog}}, CLOUD-14.)
* {{{kind:'dvt_next', machine, wait?: s, readiness?: object, live?: object}}} → {{{ok:true, request: null | {id, unit, testId}, watch: bool}}}.
* {{{kind:'dvt_events', machine, since?, wait?}}} → {{{ok:true, ver}}} (command counter for that CureBox).
* {{{kind:'dvt_update', id, machine?, status?, line?, prompt?, act?, runIds?, verdict?, live?}}} → {{{ok:true, cancel: bool, acted?: true, hasAnswer?: true, answer?}}} / {{no such request}} / {{that request belongs to another CureBox}}.
* Sheet {{dvt_requests}} row: {{id, machine, unit, testId, status, requested, started, finished, line, prompt JSON, answer JSON {v}, runIds JSON, verdict, act JSON}}.
* Cache keys: {{dvt_seen_<m>}} (300 s), {{dvt_ready_<m>}} {{{at, tests}}} and {{dvt_readysig_<m>}} (300 s), {{dvt_live_<m>}} {{{…live, at}}} (300 s), {{dvt_full_<m>}} (6 h), {{dvt_q_<m>}} {{'0'|'1'}} (6 h), {{dvt_cmd_<m>}} counter, {{dvt_watch}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Hello is sent only between requests, so any of its machine's requests in {{running}}/{{waiting}}/{{cancel_requested}} were cut off by a restart: close them ({{cancel_requested}} → {{cancelled}}, line {{cancelled - the runner restarted before it could stop the test}}; others → {{failed}}, line {{interrupted - the machine or its app restarted during the test; run it again}}; prompt/answer cleared, finished = now), then prune. Queued stays queued.
# {{dvt_next}}: store readiness (and bump the page version only when its JSON changed) and live state; loop: stamp {{dvt_seen_<m>}}; unless the cache says "nothing queued" ({{dvt_q_<m> === '0'}}) and the last full look is < 60 s old, do a full look under the lock (touch runner row, oldest queued request by id → status {{running}}, {{started = now}}, line {{started on the CureBox}}); answer as soon as a request is found; otherwise sleep 250 ms until {{min(max(wait,0), 20)}} s elapse, then {{{request:null}}}. {{watch}} = someone read the DVT tab within 45 s.
# {{dvt_events}}: hold up to 20 s until {{dvt_cmd_<m>}} differs from {{since}}; return the current value.
# {{dvt_update}}: under the lock; touch runner, stamp seen, cache live. {{forced}} = row already {{cancelled}} (force-stopped from the site); {{cancel = cancel_requested || forced}}. Unless forced: copy {{line}}, {{prompt}}, {{act}} when present in the body. If the stored {{act.pressed}} was set by the site → reply {{acted:true}} once and mark {{act.acked}}. {{runIds}} (strings) and {{verdict}} copied when given. A stored answer is handed over once ({{hasAnswer}}, {{answer = answer.v}}) and cleared together with the prompt. Status: forced → prompt/act cleared, status kept; final status → set, {{finished = now}}, prompt/act cleared, then prune; {{running}}/{{waiting}} → set only when no cancel is pending.
# Pruning keeps the newest 300 final requests; active ones are never pruned.
# Safety: no portal path starts hardware; the runner must obtain Start at the machine (DVT-05) before running, and runs through the machine's own API.
# OPEN QUESTION: {{dvt_update}} without {{machine}} is accepted for any request id; the runner's {{machine}} is self-declared under the shared DVT key.
*Look & layout:* n/a
*Configuration:* {{DVT_KEY}}.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* With nothing queued, consecutive {{dvt_next}} polls within 60 s read no sheet; a request queued meanwhile is returned by the very next poll.
* A held {{dvt_next}} (wait 1 s) answers empty after its hold, and returns a request queued during the hold long before it ends; {{wait: 999}} is capped at 20 s.
* {{dvt_events}} wakes on a cancel/answer/request for its own CureBox only.
* A cancel while running is reported as {{cancel:true}} and a later {{status:'running'}} does not overwrite {{cancel_requested}}.
* {{blocked}} is final: leaves the active list and is stamped finished.
* Hello closes orphaned running requests and keeps queued ones.
*Tests:* test_code.cjs 275-444, 554-589.

*Goal:* Let service users queue DVT tests on a CureBox, stop them, answer the runner's questions and confirm manual steps; let admins approve hand-made electrical-safety tests; and push "something changed" to open DVT tabs and runners within a second through version counters and long polls.

*Public contract:*
* {{portalDvtRequest(t, machine, unit, testIds)}} → {{{ok:true, queued, skipped}}} / {{choose a CureBox, a unit and at least one test}} / {{<machine> is unit <unit> - the request was for <unit>. Reload the page.}} / {{<ids> runs last - <n> other test(s) on <unit> have no result yet}}.
* {{portalDvtCancel(t, id | [ids], force)}} → {{{ok:true, stopped}}} / {{that request is not active}} / {{none of those requests is active}}.
* {{portalDvtActed(t, id)}} → {{{ok:true}}} / {{that request is not waiting for you to do anything}} / {{that step is watched by the machine itself - nothing to press}}.
* {{portalDvtAnswer(t, id, value)}} → {{{ok:true}}} / {{that request is not waiting for an answer}}. Value: {{true}} Done/Yes, {{false}} No, {{null}} Skip, or the typed value.
* {{portalDvtApprove(t, unit, testId, runIds, who, approve)}} → {{{ok:true, approved}}} | {{{ok:true, deleted}}} | messages {{only the hand-made electrical safety tests are approved from the site}}, {{no runs to approve}}, {{run <id> does not belong to <testId> on <unit>}}, {{write who approves}}.
* {{portalDvtWait(t, since, waitSec)}} → {{null}} or {{{ver}}} (string); cache {{dvt_ver}} counter.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Request: service role; once the CureBox's runner announced its unit, a request for another unit is refused (stale tab). A test with {{afterAll}} in the catalog is refused while any other test owed on that unit ({{t.units}} contains unit; owed run keys {{t.runs}} or {{['|1']}}) lacks a {{PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED|WAIVED}} run with runId {{<tid>|<unit>|<key>}}. Tests already active for that machine+unit are skipped (and duplicates in one call). New rows: {{[id++, machine, unit, tid, 'queued', now, '', '', 'waiting for the CureBox to pick it up', '', '', '[]', '']}}; then {{dvt_q_<m> = '1'}} and {{bumpCmd_(machine)}}.
# Cancel (service): queued → {{cancelled}} ({{cancelled from the site before it started}}); running + {{force}} → {{cancelled}}, prompt/act/answer cleared ({{stopped from the site (forced)}}); running without force → {{cancel_requested}} ({{stopping - the CureBox turns everything off}}). {{bumpCmd_}} for each affected machine.
# Acted (service): refuse when no {{act}} or {{act.ack === false}}; set {{act.pressed = act.acked = true}}; {{bumpCmd_}}.
# Answer (service): requires an open prompt; store {{{v}}}; line {{answered from the site - the CureBox continues}}; {{bumpCmd_}}.
# Approve (admin): only catalog group {{ELE}}; every runId must start {{<testId>|<unit>|}}. Approve writes one {{PASS}} row per run not already PASS ({{operator}} = Google name {{<email>}} or email; with the shared password the typed {{who}}, ≤ 60 chars), {{note = 'Approved on the site by <name>'}}, {{startedAt}} = ISO now, {{machine ''}}. Withdraw deletes only rows whose note starts {{Approved on the site}}.
# Change notification: {{bumpVer_()}} increments {{dvt_ver}} (6 h TTL) on every request write, DVT ingest, unit/race change and readiness change; {{bumpCmd_(m)}} increments {{dvt_cmd_<m>}} and {{dvt_ver}}. {{portalDvtWait}} stamps {{dvt_watch}} and holds up to {{min(waitSec, 20)}} s (page asks 15) until {{dvt_ver}} ≠ {{since}}; {{waitFor_}} polls every 250 ms.
# Page cadence (for reference, implemented in UI tickets): long poll {{/api/dvt/wait?since=…&wait=15}} while the DVT view is open; on change reload {{portalDvt}}; retry after 3 s on failure; safety-net refresh 8 s on DVT, 10 s elsewhere.
# Safety: requesting never actuates; the CureBox asks for Start at the machine (DVT-05).
*Look & layout:* n/a (DVT view: CLOUD-40..59)
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Requesting the same test twice while queued queues it once ({{skipped:1}}).
* A request for {{UUT-02}} on a runner that said {{UUT-01}} is refused.
* An {{afterAll}} test is refused while another test on the unit has no result.
* A force-stop closes the row at once and the runner's next update returns {{cancel:true}} without reviving it.
* A viewer's call to any of these returns {{denied:true}}; approve by a service user is denied.
* {{portalDvtWait}} returns as soon as any of the listed changes happens.
*Tests:* test_code.cjs 275-357, 401-463, 537-544, 569-580, 662-684.

h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, Cloud sync & Origin
*Blocks:* CLOUD-21, CLOUD-22, CLOUD-23, CLOUD-24, CLOUD-35
*Implements:* EP-10

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* The page talks to Apps Script only through {{google.script.run}}, but the app code calls {{fetch('/api/...')}}. A small shim at the top of {{<head>}} replaces {{window.fetch}} and turns REST-like paths into {{google.script.run}} calls. It adds the session token and returns a fetch-like response with {{status}}, {{ok}} and {{json()}}. This keeps the view code independent of Apps Script, so the browser tests can stub {{google.script.run}}.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-01..19 (server)
*Files to create:* Page.html: the first {{<script>}} block (IIFE: {{tok}}, {{setTok}}, {{call}}, {{reply}}, {{window.fetch}}, {{window.scureReportHref}}, {{window.scureDvtFileHref}}); the app script helpers {{$}}, {{api(path, opts)}}, {{flash(text)}}, {{escH}}, {{fmtAgo}}, {{fmtTime}}, {{fmtDur}}, {{fmtWhen}}, {{fmtBytes}}.
*Public contract:*
* Token: {{sessionStorage['scure-cloud-token']}}, with an in-memory fallback {{mem}} when storage throws.
* {{call(fn, ...args)}} → {{Promise}} wrapping {{google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(res).withFailureHandler(rej)[fn](...args)}}.
* Routing table (path → server function, args):
** {{/login}} → {{portalLogin(password)}}. If {{r.ok}}, store {{r.token}} and answer 200 {{{ok:true}}}; otherwise answer 401 {{{ok:false,message}}} (default message 'Wrong password').
** {{/login/mode}} → {{portalLoginMode()}}. On failure, answer {{{google:false}}}.
** {{/login/google}} → {{portalLoginStart()}}.
** {{/login/poll}} → {{portalLoginPoll(body.state)}}. On {{{ok,token}}}, store the token and answer {{{ok:true}}}.
** {{/logout}} → {{portalLogout(tok())}}, then clear the token.
** {{/api/me}} → {{portalMe(tok)}}.
** {{/api/users}} → {{portalUsers}}; {{/api/users/save}} → {{portalUserSave(tok,email,role,name)}}; {{/api/users/remove}} → {{portalUserRemove(tok,email)}}; {{/api/audit}} → {{portalAudit(tok,100)}}.
** {{/api/machines}} → {{portalMachines(tok)}}.
** {{/api/alerts?since=N}} → {{portalAlerts(tok, N)}}.
** {{/api/dvt}} → {{portalDvt}}; {{/api/dvt/wait?since=X&wait=N}} → {{portalDvtWait(tok, X, N)}}; {{/api/dvt/detail}} → {{portalDvtDetail}}.
** {{/api/dvt/race}} → {{portalRaceSet(tok, body)}}; {{/api/dvt/files}} → {{portalDvtFiles(tok, body.ids)}}; {{/api/dvt/unit}} → {{portalDvtUnitSave(tok, body.unit, body.fields)}}.
** {{/api/dvt/approve}} → {{portalDvtApprove(tok, unit, testId, runIds, who, approve!==false)}}.
** {{/api/dvt/request|cancel|answer|acted}} → {{portalDvtRequest(tok,machine,unit,testIds)}} / {{portalDvtCancel(tok, ids||id, force===true)}} / {{portalDvtAnswer(tok,id,value??null)}} / {{portalDvtActed(tok,id)}}.
** {{/api/machines/<name>/commands}} → {{portalCommand(tok, decodeURIComponent(name), body)}}.
** Any other path → 404 {{{ok:false,message:'not found'}}}.
* Status mapping: a server {{null}} means 401. {{{denied:true}}} means 403. For write calls, {{ok:false}} means 400. Everything else is 200.
* {{window.scureReportHref(m, runId, download)}} → {{m.reportUrl + '?report=<runId>&m=<m.name>&t=<token>[&dl=1]'}}, or {{'#'}} when there is no {{reportUrl}}.
* {{window.scureDvtFileHref(fileUrl, id)}} → {{fileUrl + '?dvtfile=<id>&t=<token>'}}.
* {{api(path, opts)}}:
** Always sends the JSON content-type header.
** On 401: sets {{ME=null}}, calls {{renderLogin()}} and throws {{Error('auth')}}.
** On 403: calls {{flash(d.message || 'Your access does not allow this.')}} and throws {{Error('denied')}}.
** Otherwise returns {{r.json()}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# The shim script must come before any app code. It is the first element in {{<head>}}.
# The body is parsed from {{opts.body}} as JSON. A parse error gives {{{}}}.
# {{flash(text)}} creates {{#flash}} (role=status) on first use. It sets the class {{on}} and removes it after 6000 ms. A new flash resets the timer.
# {{escH}} escapes {{& < > "}}. Every value that comes from the server must pass through {{escH}}. *OPEN QUESTION / defect:* {{machineCard}} and {{cureRows}} insert {{p.name}}, {{m.name}} and {{c.materialName}} without escaping. A rebuild should escape them.
# Formatters:
** {{fmtAgo(t)}}: 'never' when t is falsy; then {{Ns ago}}, {{Nm ago}} or {{Nh ago}}, with thresholds at 60 s and 3600 s.
** {{fmtTime}}: locale {{HH:MM:SS}}.
** {{fmtDur(s)}}: {{N s}} below 60, {{M min S s}} below 3600, otherwise {{H h M min}}.
** {{fmtWhen(t)}}: '—' when empty; {{fmtAgo}} when less than 24 h old; otherwise {{DD Mon HH:MM}}.
** {{fmtBytes}}: B, KB or MB.
*Look & layout:* n/a, except {{#flash}}: a fixed toast centred at the bottom ({{bottom:1.2rem}}; on a phone {{5.5rem}}, above the bottom bar). It is at most {{min(34rem, 100%-2rem)}} wide, inverted colours ({{background:var(--text)}}, {{color:var(--bg)}}), radius 10px, and fades in and out over .2 s.
*Configuration:* none. No secrets live in the page; the token comes from the server at runtime.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* With {{google.script.run}} stubbed, every path in the table calls the named function with the listed arguments.
* A {{null}} server answer shows the sign-in screen.
* A {{{denied:true}}} answer shows a toast with the server message, and the view stays as it was.
* The report link contains {{report=}}, {{m=}} and {{t=}} parameters, plus {{dl=1}} only for Download.
*Tests:* All test_*.cjs files inject a {{STUB}} before the page loads ({{window.google.script.run}} built from a handlers map) and so exercise the shim. See CLOUD-35.
*Reference (source):* Page.html 1-121, 406-436, 586-590, 628-630, 682-694; Code.gs 1137-1144 (doGet).

# Google mode: the page first POSTs {{/login/google}}. The card {{.login-g}} (max-width 30rem, margin 2rem auto) holds:

** {{ok}} → {{load(true)}};

   All buttons are at least 44px high.

column4: CLOUD-24 Data loading, polling cadence, busy guard, live clocks and the PORTAL_BUILD reload banner
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-20, CLOUD-23
*Blocks:* CLOUD-25, CLOUD-28, CLOUD-30, CLOUD-31

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* Keep the page fresh without ever re-rendering under the user's hands. It polls machines every 10 s, polls DVT data on the DVT-related tabs, and long-polls on the DVT tab. When the server was redeployed since the tab was opened, it shows a "This page is out of date" banner with a Reload button.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-20, CLOUD-23, CLOUD-01..19 (server: {{portalMachines}}, {{portalDvt}}, {{portalDvtWait}}, {{PORTAL_BUILD}})
*Files to create:* Page.html {{userBusy()}}, {{load(force)}}, {{loadDvt()}}, {{refreshLoop()}}, {{dvtLongPoll()}}, the 1 s clock interval, {{PORTAL_BUILD}} constant; state {{MACHINES}}, {{DVT}}, {{editing}}, {{LAST_FULL}}, {{DVT_VER}}, {{LONGPOLL_ON}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{const PORTAL_BUILD = '0.9.146'}}. It must equal {{PORTAL_BUILD}} in Code.gs, which {{portalDvt}} returns as {{build}}.
* {{MACHINES}}: the array from {{portalMachines}} (fields in CLOUD-28).
* {{DVT}}: {{{runs, fileUrl, catalog, requests, runners, units, race, now, build}}}, plus a client-added {{skew = DVT.now - Date.now()/1000}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{userBusy()}} is true when any of these holds:
** {{editing}} is set (the program editor is open);
** the focused element is an INPUT, SELECT or TEXTAREA;
** any {{[id^="job-"]}} or {{[id^="printer-"]}} field holds text (a half-filled print form).
# {{load(force)}}:
** when not forced, it returns while busy;
** it fetches {{/api/machines}}, then fetches {{ME}} lazily;
** it re-checks busy, then calls {{render()}};
** on Errors it also calls {{loadErrors()}}; on dvt, overview, compare or race it calls {{loadDvt()}}.
# {{loadDvt()}} normalises the catalog:
** tests with {{group==='ELE'}} become {{auto=false, manual=true}}, and when they list UUT-01 their units become {{['UUT-01']}} only;
** each phase's tests are sorted with a numeric-aware {{localeCompare}}.
   It then sets {{skew}} and re-renders when on dvt, overview, compare or race and not busy. On the DVT tab it fetches the detail when {{catalog.updated}} changed (CLOUD-40..59).
# Cadence:
** {{load()}} runs immediately;
** {{refreshLoop}} first fires after 4000 ms, then reschedules itself every 10000 ms (8000 ms on the DVT tab);
** on the DVT tab, a run within 9000 ms of the last full load fetches only {{loadDvt()}}; otherwise it does a full {{load()}} and updates {{LAST_FULL}};
** errors inside the loop are swallowed.
# Long poll (DVT tab only, single instance): loop {{/api/dvt/wait?since=<DVT_VER>&wait=15}}. When {{ver}} changes, call {{loadDvt()}}. On error, wait 3000 ms and retry. Stop when {{VIEW !== 'dvt'}}.
# Clocks: {{setInterval}} every 1000 ms updates every {{[data-clock]}} element's text to {{fmtClock((data-end || raceNow()) - data-clock)}}, without re-rendering. {{raceNow()}} is {{Date.now()/1000 + DVT.skew}}, so a phone with a wrong clock does not skew the race.
# Stale banner: on the Overview (and the DVT catalog card), when {{DVT.build && DVT.build !== PORTAL_BUILD}}, prepend {{<div class="dvt-prompt">}} with "*This page is out of date* - the portal was updated since it was opened." and a primary "Reload" button ({{location.reload()}}).
*Look & layout:* {{.dvt-prompt}} is the banner: a 3px amber left border (#d97706) on an rgba(217,119,6,.06) tint, padding {{.5rem .7rem}}. The Reload button is inline.
*Configuration:* {{PORTAL_BUILD}} is bumped together with Code.gs on every deploy.
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Typing in any field is never wiped by the 10 s refresh.
* When the stub returns {{build:'x'}}, the Overview shows the banner and Reload.
* A running race clock ticks once per second.
*Tests:* test_race.cjs "the running clock ticks"; all view tests stub {{build: PORTAL_BUILD}}, so no banner appears.
*Reference (source):* Page.html 407-419, 592-601, 610-616, 657-667, 1459-1461, 1804, 1935-1941, 2500-2531; Code.gs 734.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-23, CLOUD-24
*Blocks:* CLOUD-26, CLOUD-27, CLOUD-30, CLOUD-32, CLOUD-34, CLOUD-35
*Relates to:* DVT-05

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* The landing view summarises the whole DVT campaign. It starts with one sentence and one button for what needs attention now, then shows four headline numbers and eleven more numbers under a fold. It needs no CureBox chooser.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-23, CLOUD-24, CLOUD-01..19 (server: {{portalDvt}})
*Files to create:* Page.html {{dvtUnitModel(u, cat, runs, reg, requests)}}, {{dvtTestVerdict(owed, byId)}}, {{overviewNow(models, n)}}, {{overviewCard()}} (first card), {{overviewWire()}} ({{[data-now-go]}}), constants {{OV_COL}}, {{OV_DEFAULT_MIN=10}}, {{OV_STATUS_CLASS}}, {{DVT_ACTIVE_ST=['queued','waiting','running','cancel_requested']}}, helpers {{ovHours}}, {{ovToday}}, {{dvtWhen}}.
*Public contract:* The unit model returns {{{u, reg, tests:[{tid,title,phase,safety,owed,minutes,per,verdict,running}], c:{total,PASS,FAIL,BLOCKED,WAIVED,INVALID,open,doneMin,totalMin,safetyFails}, finished, complete, status, late, machine, active, remainingMin, completion, passRate, weighted}}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Units are the union of every {{catalog.tests[*].units}} and every {{DVT.units[*].unit}}, sorted.
# Per unit, tests are taken in catalog phase order, and only those whose {{units}} include the unit.
** Owed run ids are {{tid|unit|k}} for each {{k}} in {{t.runs}}, with default {{['|1']}}.
** {{minutes}} is {{t.minutes}}, or 10 when missing or ≤ 0.
** {{per = minutes / owed.length}}.
# Test verdict ({{dvtTestVerdict}}):
** all owed runs empty → {{open}};
** some empty → {{progress}};
** otherwise the first present of FAIL, INVALID, BLOCKED, WAIVED, PASS.
   {{running}} means the test has a request for this unit whose status is in {{DVT_ACTIVE_ST}}.
# Counters per owed run: {{total++}} and {{totalMin += per}}. The verdict, upper-cased, increments its own counter, or {{open}}.
** PASS, FAIL and WAIVED add {{per}} to {{doneMin}}.
** A FAIL on a safety test increments {{safetyFails}}.
** {{finished = PASS+FAIL+WAIVED}}. INVALID is neither finished nor passed.
# Status:
** 'Complete' when {{total>0}} and finished equals total;
** else 'Failures' if any FAIL;
** else 'Blocked' if BLOCKED or INVALID;
** else 'In progress' if any active request or anything finished;
** else 'Not started'.
   {{late = !complete && planEnd && today(ISO) > planEnd}}.
# {{machine}}: the registry machine; else the machine of the unit's most recent run; else the runner whose {{unit}} matches.
# Tile maths:
** completion = finished / total;
** pass rate = PASS / (PASS+FAIL);
** progress by time = doneMin / totalMin;
** remaining = totalMin − doneMin (summed over units);
** "Until the slowest unit is done" = max of the per-unit {{remainingMin}};
** critical = Σ safetyFails + BLOCKED.
   {{pct()}} shows one decimal below 10 %, otherwise an integer, and '—' when the denominator is 0.
# "What now" ({{overviewNow}}), first match wins. The runner is the online runner seen most recently. The button is {{[data-now-go=<box>]}}, which sets {{SELECTED=box}}, {{VIEW='dvt'}} and starts the long poll.
## Every unit complete → good: "The whole DVT is finished" / "Every unit has all its runs." No button.
## failed > 0 → bad: "N test run(s) failed" / "Open the DVT list to see which, and run them again after the fix." Button "See the tests".
## blocked+invalid > 0 → warn: "N run(s) is/are blocked or invalid" / "They need a look before the unit can finish." Button "See the tests".
## Any unit active → neutral: "A test is running" / "It follows live in the DVT list." Button "Follow it".
## Runner offline → warn: "The DVT runner on <box> is offline" / "Tests cannot be started from here until it is back." No button.
## N auto tests that are open or in progress and not running on the runner's unit → "N test(s) is/are ready to run on <box>" / "Nothing starts until someone presses Start at the machine." Button "Run tests".
## Otherwise: "Nothing needs your attention" / "Follow the progress below."
*Look & layout:* Order: stale banner (CLOUD-24), then the {{.now}} banner, then the card "DVT overview" with the muted subtitle "catalog <version> · N units".
* Main tiles: a 4-column grid ({{.dvt-tiles.ov-main}}, gap .6rem):
** Completion (green number);
** Passed (green);
** Failed (red when > 0);
** Test time left ({{ovHours}}: {{N min}} below 60, otherwise {{X.Y h}}, with no decimal at 600 min or more).
* {{details.more}} "More numbers": an auto-fit grid of tiles at least 130px wide:
** Machines (units), Active, Runs planned, Runs finished;
** Blocked (amber when > 0), Invalid (amber when > 0), Waived;
** Pass rate, Progress by time;
** Until the slowest unit is done, Critical issues (red when > 0).
  It ends with a muted paragraph defining completion, pass rate, time and critical issues.
* Empty or loading: card "Overview" with "Loading…" while {{DVT===null}}, or "No DVT catalog has reached the portal yet - open the DVT tool once with the cloud connected."
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria (test_overview fixture: 2 units, 3 tests; U1 has T-1 PASS, T-2 FAIL + INVALID; U2 all PASS):*
* Machines (units)=2, Runs planned=7, Runs finished=5, Completion=71 %, Passed=4, Failed=1, Pass rate=80 %, Invalid=1, Progress by time=55 %, Critical issues=0.
*Tests:* test_overview.cjs (KPI arithmetic, INVALID handling).
*Reference (source):* Page.html 199-212, 693-703, 720, 1338-1384, 1424-1487, 1497-1502.

h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-25

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* Draw each unit's tests end to end, scaled by their estimated minutes and coloured by verdict. Clicking a unit row expands one sub-row per test.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-25
*Files to create:* Page.html {{ganttSvg(models)}}, {{GANTT_OPEN}} (Set), the legend in {{overviewCard()}}, {{overviewWire()}} ({{[data-gantt]}}).
*Public contract:* {{<g class="gantt-row" data-gantt="<unit>">}}; the svg has {{aria-label="DVT Gantt chart"}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Geometry: viewBox width W=1000, left label gutter L=96, R=16, TOP=24, unit row height ROW=26, sub-row height SUB=15.
** {{maxMin = max(60, longest unit's Σ minutes)}}; {{scale = (W−L−R)/maxMin}}.
# Unit row: the label at x=6, {{▸ U1}} or {{▾ U1}}, 12px bold, {{currentColor}}.
** Each test is a rect of width {{max(1.5, minutes*scale)}} and height ROW−8, with a 0.6 stroke in {{var(--panel)}} that separates the bars.
** Fill: {{OV_COL.RUNNING}} when running, otherwise {{OV_COL[verdict]}}, otherwise {{OV_COL.open}}. Opacity .55 for open tests that are not running.
** A {{progress}} test also gets a 2px {{RUNNING}}-blue underline at half its width.
** {{<title>}} tooltip: "tid title - duration - verdict|running".
# Expanded unit: one sub-row per test. The tid label is at x=14 (10px, opacity .8). A thin rect of height SUB−5 sits at the test's cumulative offset.

h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-24, CLOUD-25
*Blocks:* CLOUD-34, CLOUD-35

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* A playful view in which every DVT unit races to finish all its owed runs. It shows a ranking with medals, a ticking clock per unit, pace, an ETA, per-test times against the estimate, the fastest unit per test, and a winner banner. Service users can set an official start and choose who takes part.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-24, CLOUD-25 ({{dvtUnitModel}}), CLOUD-01..19 (server: {{portalRaceSet}}, {{raceGet_}} → {{DVT.race = {start, units}}}, stored in script property RACE)
*Files to create:* Page.html {{raceModel()}}, {{raceChampions(model)}}, {{raceCard()}}, {{raceSet(d)}}, {{raceWire()}}, {{fmtClock}}, {{fmtMin}}, {{raceNow}}, {{RACE_OPEN}}, {{RACE_PICK}}, {{RACE_MEDAL=['🥇','🥈','🥉']}}.
*Public contract:* POST {{/api/dvt/race}} with {{{start:'now'}}}, {{{start:0}}} or {{{units:[...]}}}. The server validates units against {{^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$}} with at most 30 entries. Hooks: {{[data-race=<unit>]}}, {{#race-start}}, {{#race-reset}}, {{#race-pick}}, {{[data-race-unit]}}, {{[data-clock][data-end]}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Participants: the catalog units filtered by {{race.units}} when that list is non-empty, otherwise all catalog units.
# Per unit:
** a run counts as finished when its verdict is PASS, FAIL or WAIVED and, if there is an official start, {{dvtWhen(run) >= start}};
** {{doneMin += per}} for each finished run;
** a test is {{done}} when all its owed runs are finished, and its {{end}} is the latest finish.
# Time taken per test:
** exact: the sum of {{finished − started}} over requests with status 'done' for that test, started after the race start, in minutes;
** otherwise approximate ({{approx}}, shown with "~"): the gap since the previous done test's end, with done tests ordered by end, starting from {{begin}}.
# {{begin}} is the official start, otherwise the earliest of the unit's run times and request start times. {{finish}} is the max {{end}} once complete.
** {{elapsed = (finish || raceNow()) − begin}}.
** {{pace = doneMin / elapsed hours}}.
** {{left = totalMin − doneMin}}.
** {{eta = left/pace*3600}}, only when not complete, pace > 0 and at least 5 % done.
# Ranking:
## complete units first, by elapsed time (ascending);
## then started units;
## then by % done (descending);
## then by pace (descending).
   There is a winner only when every participant is complete; it is the first finisher.
# Champions: for each test that at least two units have done with a known time, the fastest and the second fastest.
# "Start the race" asks {{confirm('Start the race now? Every unit's clock starts together; only runs finished from now on count.')}}. "Reset the race" asks {{confirm('Reset the race? The clocks go back to each unit's first recorded run.')}}.
# A checkbox change sends the full list of checked units. After a set, {{loadDvt()}} runs and the view re-renders even if the checkbox is still focused.
# Clicking a lane toggles its test table in {{RACE_OPEN}}. The picker's open state persists in {{RACE_PICK}}.
*Look & layout:* Card "DVT race", muted subtitle "who finishes the whole DVT first".
* Banner:
* with a winner: {{.race-win}} (gold #d4a017 border on rgba(212,160,23,.14), 1.05rem) "🏆 *U2* wins · <integrator> - the whole DVT in *1 h 20 min 00 s**";
* otherwise, once started: {{.race-lead}} ({{--inset}}) "K of N finished · in front: *U** (P %)".
* Controls row:
** with an official start: muted "Race started <DD Mon HH:MM> · <ticking clock>" and, at the right, "Reset the race";
** without one: muted "No official start yet - every unit's clock runs from its first recorded run." and the primary "🏁 Start the race".
* Lane {{.race-card}}: flex row, bordered, radius 10px, pointer cursor. It contains:
** the rank cell: medal, number, 🏃 (running) or ⏳ (not started), at 1.7rem in a 2.2rem column;
** the main block: the bold unit name, a muted "integrator · machine", a 6px green progress bar at % done, and a muted .85rem sub-line:
*** complete: "finished · <fmtMin doneMin> of tests · pace N min/h";
*** running: "f/t runs · pace N min/h · about X to go";
*** not started: "t runs to do";
** the right block: {{.race-clock}} (1.15rem bold, tabular numbers), or a muted "not started".
  The overall first lane gets {{.champ}} (gold border and glow) once everyone has finished.
* {{fmtClock}}: "M min SS s", then "H h MM min SS s", then "D d H h MM min".
* {{fmtMin}}: "N min", "X.Y h" from 120 min, "X.Y d" from 2880 min.
* Expanded lane: {{table.cards}} with columns Test | Took ("~40 min", "—", or a muted "open") | Estimate | vs (green "-25 min" or red "+10 min").
* Picker (only with more than one unit): {{details#race-pick}} "Who is in the race (k of n)", with a checkbox per unit.
* Footnote explaining the clock and pace.
* Second card, "Test champions" (subtitle "fastest unit per test"): Test | Fastest (*unit* time) | Next.
* Empty: "No unit in the race." Loading/no catalog: the card "Race" with "Loading…" or "No DVT catalog has reached the portal yet."
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria (test_race fixture):*
* The order is U2, U1, U3 with 🥇 🥈 🏃. Clocks are fixed at "1 h 20 min 00 s" and "1 h 40 min 00 s"; U3's clock ticks.
* T-A took "35 min" exact (−25 min); T-B "~40 min" (+10 min).
* Once U3 finishes it gets 🥉 and the banner reads "U2 wins … 1 h 20 min".
* Start sends {{{start:'now'}}}; unchecking U3 sends {{{units:['U1','U2']}}}.
* On a phone: no sideways scroll, the clock is visible, and the lane is ≥ 44px high.
*Tests:* test_race.cjs (desktop + phone, {{--shot}} option).
*Reference (source):* Page.html 182-189, 1796-1941; Code.gs 690-728.

column4: CLOUD-31 Compare: results table across units or across the runs of one unit
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-24
*Blocks:* CLOUD-32, CLOUD-33, CLOUD-34, CLOUD-35

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* Show the recorded values of one test (and variant) side by side. The columns are either the units (latest run, or the mean of repetitions) or the runs of one unit. Each value is compared with a reference column against a tolerance, and cells that stand out are tinted amber or red.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-24, CLOUD-01..19 (server: {{portalDvt}} runs with {{values}} and {{files}})
*Files to create:* Page.html {{CMP}} state, {{cmpRuns}}, {{cmpColumns(runs)}}, {{cmpRows(cols, tol, refIdx)}}, {{cmpFmt}}, {{cmpNum}}, {{cmpIsStamp}}, {{compareCard()}} (table part), {{cmpModeSelect()}}, {{compareWire()}}.
*Public contract:* {{CMP = {mode:'units'|'runs'|'matrix', test, variant, unit, basis:'latest'|'mean', ref, tol:10, kind, col, texts:{}, loading, err}}}. Control ids: {{#cmp-test}}, {{#cmp-variant}}, {{#cmp-mode}}, {{#cmp-unit}}, {{#cmp-ref}}, {{#cmp-basis}}, {{#cmp-tol}}. Rows: {{tr.cmp-row[data-flag]}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Only runs with a non-empty {{values}} take part. The test list is the sorted unique test ids. An invalid selection falls back to the first test, first variant and first unit.
# Units mode: one column per unit in (catalog owed units ∪ units with runs), sorted.
** A unit without runs becomes a column with {{empty}}, sub-line "no results yet", shown at opacity .55, and disabled as a reference ("U4 (no results)").
** With several runs, the sub-line is "N runs (latest|mean)", otherwise {{fmtWhen}}.
** Mean: a key is averaged only when every run that has the key has a number; otherwise the latest value is used.
# Runs mode: one column per run of {{CMP.unit}}, oldest first, labelled {{r<rep>[ variant]}} with sub-line {{fmtWhen}}. The reference is always the first column.
# Row kind:
** {{stamp}} when the key matches {{/(^|_)(timestamp|time_stamp)$|^timestamp/i}};
** {{num}} when all present values are numbers;
** {{bool}} when all are booleans;
** otherwise {{text}}.
   Rows are ordered num, bool, text, stamp.
# Num rows:
** min, max, mean, {{spread = max−min}}, {{spreadPct = spread/|mean|·100}};
** deviation per cell {{(v−ref)/|ref|·100}} (the absolute difference when ref is 0);
** a cell is flagged 1 (amber) above {{tol}}, and 2 (red) above {{2·tol}}.
   Bool rows: a value different from the reference is flagged 2. Text rows: flagged 1. Stamps are never flagged.
# Tolerance: a number input (min 0.1, step 0.5). Only values > 0 are accepted.
# {{cmpFmt}}: ≥ 1000 → 0 decimals; ≥ 100 → 1; otherwise up to 3. true → 'yes', false → 'no', null → '—'.
*Look & layout:* Card h2 "Compare results", muted subtitle "<test> - <title>".
* Controls row {{.cmp-controls}} (labels muted .8rem above each select):
** Test;
** Variant (only when variants exist);
** Compare (Across units / Across runs of one unit / All units, all tests);
** in runs mode, Unit; in units mode, Reference unit plus Value of a unit (Latest run / Mean of repetitions);
** Tolerance [input] %.
* Table {{table.cmp-table}} in an {{overflow-x:auto}} wrapper:
** header "Field", then one right-aligned column per header (label, a {{badge}} "ref" on the reference, muted sub-line), then "Range" and "Spread" when there are at least 2 columns with data;
** first row "Result": a verdict pill per column (green PASS, red FAIL, amber BLOCKED/INVALID, or 'open'; '—' for empty);
** field rows: the bold key, then right-aligned values. Numbers carry a muted .75rem "+31.0 %" deviation line. Text and stamps are muted .8rem;
** tints: amber rgba(217,119,6,.16); red rgba(220,38,38,.14) in bold;
** Range "min .. max" (muted); Spread "N %", bold when above tolerance. Non-numeric rows show "differs" when flagged.
* Footnote:
** with fewer than 2 data columns: "Only one unit has results for this test - nothing to compare yet (no results yet on U4)", or the runs-mode text "Only one run of this unit recorded this test - nothing to compare yet.";
** otherwise: "K of N fields stand out: amber = off the reference by more than T % (or a text that differs), red = by more than 2T % (or a yes / no check that differs). Spread = (max - min) / mean. The reference is the chosen unit/first run."
* Empty states: "No run has recorded values yet. Once tests have results on the units, they can be compared here." (with the mode select still shown); "No recorded run for this selection."; card "Compare" with "Loading…" or "No DVT catalog has reached the portal yet."
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria (test_compare fixture):*
* Field order is {{peak, ok, comment, stamp_timestamp}}. U1 shows its latest value, 84.
* U3 at 110 is red with "+31.0 %"; U2 is not flagged. Spread is 30.4 %.
* With a 40 % tolerance, U3 is no longer flagged.
* U4 appears as "no results yet", and its reference option is disabled. With U3 as the reference, U1 shows −23.6 % in red.
* The mean basis shows 82 for U1. Runs mode gives two {{r…}} columns, oldest first.
*Tests:* test_compare.cjs.
*Reference (source):* Page.html 1519-1586, 1687-1737, 1766-1783.

h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-25, CLOUD-31

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* A grid of every catalog test against every unit, showing each verdict. Rows where the units finished with different results are highlighted, and clicking a row opens that test's comparison.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-25 ({{dvtUnitModel}}), CLOUD-31

*Behaviour & rules:*
# Columns are the catalog units, sorted. Rows follow phase order, with a phase header row (muted, uppercase, .78rem, colspan).
# Cell values:
** {{null}} when the unit does not owe the test → muted "n/a";
** {{open}} → muted "not run";
** {{progress}} → pill "partly";
** running → pill "running";
** otherwise a verdict pill coloured with {{dvtClass}}.
# A row is flagged when its set of finished verdicts (PASS, FAIL, WAIVED) has more than one member. A flagged row gets the background rgba(220,38,38,.07) and a red pill "units differ".
# Clicking a row sets {{CMP.test}}, {{variant=null}}, {{mode='units'}} and clears kind and col.
*Look & layout:* Card "Compare results", subtitle "all units, all tests", with the mode select.
* The intro line reads "N test(s) have finished with a different result on different units." or "No test has finished with different results on different units.", followed by "Click a test to compare its values."
* Header cells are centred: unit name over a muted "N % done". The first column shows the bold tid and the muted title.

* T-A reads PASS, PASS, FAIL, "not run" with flag 1.
* T-B reads PASS, n/a, n/a, n/a with flag 0.

h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, Errors & alerts
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-41
*Relates to:* PLAT-10, DOM-02
*Implements:* REQ-11

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* Show every alert raised since local midnight on any CureBox, plus any older alert that is still active, with its registry title, an optional repair-video link and how long it lasted. This is the portal's read-only alerts log. It is filtered by the CureBox chooser and the search box.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-20..39 (shell), CLOUD-41, server {{portalAlerts}}
*Files to create:* Page.html: {{loadErrors()}}, {{errorsCard()}}, {{errTitle}}, {{fmtTime}}, {{fmtDur}}, global {{ERRORS}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{GET /api/alerts?since=<unix s>}} maps to {{portalAlerts(token, since)}}.
** Returns an array, newest first: {{{machine, code, raised, cleared|null, message, title, videoUrl}}}.
** Returns {{null}} when not signed in; the shim turns that into 401.
* The server returns rows with {{raised >= since}} *or* {{cleared == null}}.
* Sheet {{alerts}} columns: {{machine, code, raised, cleared, message}}. It is written by the machine sync (PLAT-10); one row per machine + code + raised time.
* Page state: {{ERRORS}} ({{null}} = loading).
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Entering the section: the Errors button sets {{VIEW='errors'}}, *forces {{SELECTED='all'}}*, renders, then calls {{loadErrors()}}. {{load()}} also calls {{loadErrors()}} on every refresh tick while {{VIEW==='errors'}} (10 s cadence, shell).
# {{since}} is the browser's local midnight: {{Math.floor(midnight/1000)}}.
# Filters:
** CureBox: when {{SELECTED !== 'all'}}, keep only {{e.machine === SELECTED}}.
** Search: the trimmed, lower-cased {{SEARCH}} must appear in machine, {{String(code)}}, the title or the message.
# Title: {{e.title}}, else {{CODE_TITLES[code]}} (a built-in fallback for 6016, 7004, 9001–9007, 9050–9052), else {{'Error ' + code}}.
# Status:
** Active ({{cleared == null}}): a red pill {{active · <fmtDur(now - raised)>}}.
** Cleared: muted text {{cleared HH:MM:SS · lasted <fmtDur(cleared - raised)>}}.
** {{fmtDur}}: below 60 s it is {{N s}}; below 1 h it is {{M min S s}}; otherwise {{H h M min}}.
# Video link: only when {{videoUrl}} matches {{^https?:\/{2}}}. Write the regex with {{\/{2}}}, never {{//}}: Apps Script's HTML service cuts a line at {{//}}, even inside a regex.
# The machine message is HTML-escaped; the title is escaped with {{escH}}.
# Choosing a CureBox chip while on Errors switches to {{VIEW='machines'}} (shell {{pick}}).
# The page never re-renders while {{userBusy()}} is true.
*Look & layout:*
* One card.
* {{h2}} "Errors today", followed in muted normal weight by "{{N raised}} · {{M still active}}" (the second part only when M > 0).
* Table {{class="cards"}} with the columns Time (HH:MM:SS) | Machine | *Code* (bold) | Error | Status.
** The Error cell ({{class="wide"}}) shows the bold title, then a link "▶ Video" ({{a.vid}}: 0.78rem, 600 weight, blue #2563eb, opens in a new tab, {{rel=noopener}}), then a line break and the muted message.
* Empty: one row "No errors today" spanning 5 columns. Loading: card "Errors today" / "Loading…".
* Search placeholder (shell chooser): "Search errors / codes...".
* Phone: each error is a card. The Time is the bold title line; Machine, Code and Status carry their labels; the Error cell spans the full width.
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* A per-component code (e.g. 9011, 9022) shows its own registry title.
* A row without a title (older server) falls back to the CODE_TITLES title, e.g. 9002 → "Fan failure - system stopped".
* Only a code with a valid http(s) {{videoUrl}} shows exactly one "Video" link, with {{target=_blank}} and {{rel}} containing {{noopener}}.
* A message containing {{<no title>}} is shown literally (escaped).
* Page.html contains no {{//}} inside a regex literal.
* At 390 px each error renders as a card ({{tr}} display block, header row hidden), and the search placeholder mentions "errors".
*Tests:*
* test_errors_page.cjs (headless Chrome with stubbed {{google.script.run}}): titles, fallback, escaping, video link and the no-{{//}} lint.

*Reference (source):* Page.html 603-655 (state, CODE_TITLES, loadErrors, errorsCard), 1981, 1988, 2022-2023; Code.gs 203-258 (alerts_, saveAlerts_, portalAlerts, errorDef_); test_errors_page.cjs 1-62.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocks:* CLOUD-43, CLOUD-45, CLOUD-46, CLOUD-47
*Relates to:* DVT-10

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* Keep the DVT tab current within 1–2 s of any change (runner update, queued request, new result) while sending as little data as possible. The test descriptions (~100 KB) are fetched once per catalog version, and an open tab is told to reload after a deploy.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-20..39 (shell); server {{portalDvt}}, {{portalDvtDetail}}, {{portalDvtWait}}.
*Files to create:* Page.html: {{loadDvt()}}, {{loadDvtDetail()}}, {{dvtLongPoll()}}, the DVT branch of {{refreshLoop()}}, state {{DVT}}, {{DVT_DETAIL}}, {{DVT_DETAIL_AT}}, {{DVT_DETAIL_BUSY}}, {{DVT_VER}}, {{LONGPOLL_ON}}, {{PORTAL_BUILD}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{GET /api/dvt}} → {{portalDvt(token)}} returns {{{runs, fileUrl, catalog, requests, runners, units, race, now, build}}}:
** {{runs[]}}: {{{unit, testId, variant, rep, runId, verdict, operator, startedAt, recordedAt, note, machine, values{}, files[{name, kind, size, id}]}}}. {{runId}} = {{testId|unit|variant|rep}}.
** {{catalog}}: {{{version, updated, phases[{id, name, gate, tests[testId]}], tests{testId: {title, group, units[], runs[], minutes, safety, auto, manual, afterAll, hasDetail}}}}}, without detail ({{stripDetail_}}).
** {{requests[]}} (newest 200): {{{id, machine, unit, testId, status, requested, started, finished, line, prompt, verdict, runIds, act}}}.
** {{runners[]}}: {{{machine, lastSeen, online, version, unit, readiness|null, live|null}}}. {{online}} = seen within 60 s; {{readiness}}/{{live}} are dropped when older than 45 s.
* {{GET /api/dvt/detail}} → {{portalDvtDetail(token)}} returns {{{updated, tests{testId: detail}}}}. The detail fields are {{purpose, rationale, safetyPlan[], equipment[], preconditions[], dependencies[], steps[], criteria, note, bench, kind, prompts[]}}.
* {{GET /api/dvt/wait?since=<ver>&wait=15}} → {{portalDvtWait}} returns {{{ver}}}. The server holds the call until the version changes or at most 20 s ({{DVT_HOLD_MAX_SEC}}).
* Every {{portalDvt}}/{{portalDvtWait}} call marks the tab as watched (cache {{dvt_watch}}, 45 s), so the runner polls faster.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# {{loadDvt()}} fetches {{/api/dvt}}, then post-processes it:
** every catalog test with {{group==='ELE'}} becomes {{auto=false, manual=true}}, and when its units include {{UUT-01}}, {{units=['UUT-01']}};
** each phase's {{tests}} are sorted with {{localeCompare(..., 'en', {numeric:true})}};
** {{DVT.skew = DVT.now - Date.now()/1000}}.
# {{loadDvt()}} re-renders only on {{dvt}}, {{overview}}, {{compare}} or {{race}} and only when not {{userBusy()}}. On {{dvt}}, it calls {{loadDvtDetail()}} when {{catalog.updated !== DVT_DETAIL_AT}}.
# {{loadDvtDetail()}} runs one call at a time ({{DVT_DETAIL_BUSY}}). It stores {{d.tests}} and {{d.updated}}; a failure is silent (rows work without detail).
# Long poll {{dvtLongPoll()}}:
** runs only while {{VIEW==='dvt'}}, as a single instance ({{LONGPOLL_ON}});
** when the answer's {{ver}} differs from {{DVT_VER}}, store it and call {{loadDvt()}};
** on error, wait 3 s and retry;
** started when the DVT section button is pressed and at page start when {{VIEW==='dvt'}}.
# {{refreshLoop()}} on the DVT tab:
** when less than 9 s have passed since the last full load, it calls {{loadDvt()}} only; otherwise it runs a full {{load()}};
** the next tick is 8 s on DVT and 10 s elsewhere; the first tick is 4 s after load.
# Stale page: when {{DVT.build}} is set and differs from {{PORTAL_BUILD}}, the catalog card shows an amber {{.dvt-prompt}} banner: "*This page is out of date* - the portal was updated since it was opened." with a primary *Reload* button that calls {{location.reload()}}.
*Look & layout:*
* Loading state: card "DVT" / "Loading…".
* Banner: 3 px amber left border, a light amber background, and the Reload button inline.
*Configuration:* {{PORTAL_BUILD}} constant; it must equal Code.gs {{PORTAL_BUILD}}.

* with no runs at all: instructions to open the *Cloud* box in DVT/web/dvt-tool.html, paste the web-app URL and DVT key, choose the *CureBox*, and press *Sync all**.

** the CureBox's own units: its runner's {{unit}} plus units it has runs of, restricted to the catalog units;

h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* When a test is opened, show what the DVT tool shows: purpose, sample rationale, safety plan, equipment and preconditions side by side, dependencies, the numbered procedure and the pass criteria. A bench test also gets a live readiness card from the CureBox's runner, whose Run button turns on only when every check is green.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-42, CLOUD-44; DVT-08..10 (bench runner readiness on the machine side)
*Files to create:* Page.html: {{dvtDetailHtml(tid, x, runner, verdictOf)}}, {{dvtBenchCard(tid, d, x, runner, verdictOf)}}, {{DVT_KIND}}, {{DVT_CHECKS}}; wiring {{[data-dvt-run-card]}} → {{dvtGuide}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{runner.readiness[testId] = {ready: bool, rows: {machine|svc|tc08|chamber|idle: {ok: true|false|'warn', text}}}}}, as reported by the runner on its poll ({{dvtNext_}}, cached 300 s, shown while under 45 s old).
*Behaviour & rules:*
# When {{DVT_DETAIL}} is not loaded yet: "Loading the test description…".
# When the test has no detail: "The description of this test is not in the portal yet - it arrives when the DVT runner on the CureBox starts, or when the DVT tool presses *Sync all*."
# Sections, in order (each heading is a small uppercase muted {{h4}}):
** Purpose;
** Sample rationale (optional);
** Safety plan: a box with a red 3 px left border and a faint red background;
** Equipment | Preconditions as two columns ({{.dvt-cols}}, one column below 760 px);
** Dependencies: monospace chips, green "ID ✓" when that test's verdict is PASS or WAIVED, otherwise muted "ID …";
** Procedure;
** Pass criteria: a bordered box with the criteria in a code block on the inset background.
# Procedure intro:
** a bench test ({{d.bench}}) gets the readiness card;
** otherwise, when there is a {{d.note}}, a blue box shows bold "<kind label>[ · about N min]." followed by the note. Kind labels: auto → fully automatic; guided → automatic, with prompts; instrumented → automatic, instrument readings asked for.
# Procedure steps: numbered boxes ({{ol.dvt-steps}}, counter in bold red #dc2626, each step a bordered 8 px rounded box).
# Readiness card, five rows in a fixed order:
** "Machine connected";
** "DVT bench service on the machine (port 3002)";
** "Thermocouple on CH1 (at the cutout)";
** "Heater thermistor (TEMP_CHAMBER) reading";
** "Machine idle".
** Each row is a 0.8rem dot (green ok / red bad / amber warn / grey unknown), the label (min-width 21rem), and the reported text (red on a bad row).
# Run on the readiness card ({{data-dvt-run-card}}):
** enabled only when a CureBox is chosen, {{readiness.ready}}, and no active request for this test exists;
** status line: "queued - it starts when someone presses Start on the machine screen", or "everything is ready - press Run, then Start on the machine screen", or the reason.
** Reasons: "Choose a CureBox above to see its live checks." / "The DVT runner on X is not online - no live checks." / "Waiting for the first report from X…" / "Run is enabled when all checks are green".
# An offline runner shows no green or red rows (no state it does not know).
*Look & layout:*
* Readiness card {{.dvt-auto}}: blue-tinted border rgba(37,99,235,.35), 10 px radius, faint blue background; a blue note line on top, the rows, then a primary "▶ Run" and a muted status line.
* Phone: the label takes full width above its value.

h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-42, CLOUD-49
*Blocks:* CLOUD-47, CLOUD-59
*Relates to:* DVT-05

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* For the chosen CureBox and unit, show whether its DVT runner is online, which USB instruments it sees, and the queue of tests requested from the site. The panel offers Run all, Stop all, per-request Cancel / Force stop, and inline answers to the questions a run asks.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-42, CLOUD-49; server {{portalDvtRequest}}, {{portalDvtCancel}}, {{portalDvtAnswer}}
*Files to create:* Page.html: {{dvtRunPanel(u, runnable)}}, {{dvtInstruments(runner)}}, {{dvtPromptControls(r)}}, {{dvtSend(path, body)}}, {{DVT_ACTIVE_ST}}, {{DVT_REQ_LABEL}}, {{reqClass}}, {{DVT_MSG}}; wiring of {{[data-dvt-run-all]}}, {{[data-dvt-stop-all]}}, {{[data-dvt-cancel]}}, {{[data-dvt-force]}}, {{[data-dvt-answer]}}, {{[data-dvt-answer-input]}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{POST /api/dvt/request {machine, unit, testIds[]}}} → {{portalDvtRequest}}; returns {{{ok, queued, skipped}}} or {{{ok:false, message}}}.
* {{POST /api/dvt/cancel {id | ids[], force?}}} → {{portalDvtCancel(token, ids||id, force)}}; returns {{{ok, stopped}}}.
* {{POST /api/dvt/answer {id, value}}} → {{portalDvtAnswer}}. {{value}} is true = Yes/Done, false = No, null = Skip, or the typed or selected string.
* Sheet {{dvt_requests}}: {{id, machine, unit, testId, status, requested, started, finished, line, prompt, answer, runIds, verdict, act}}.
* {{prompt = {text, kind: 'yesno'|'value'|other, values?[], unit?}}}.
* {{runner.readiness._instruments = {tc08, tc08ch1, tc08ch2, ophir: {ok, text}}}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Statuses:
** active = queued, waiting, running, cancel_requested;
** labels: queued; waiting → "waiting at the machine"; running; cancel_requested → "stopping"; done; failed; cancelled; blocked → "not started";
** pill class: done = green, failed = red, cancelled = plain, others = amber.
# With no CureBox chosen (all/unassigned): muted "Choose a CureBox above to run tests on it."
# Runner state:
** online: green pill "DVT runner online" plus muted "v<version> · unit <unit>";
** otherwise: red pill "DVT runner offline · seen <when>" or "DVT runner not installed", plus "requests wait in the queue until it is online".
# "▶ Run all open tests (N)" (primary, right-aligned):
** N = auto tests that are not finished (PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/WAIVED), not waiting to run last, and not already requested;
** disabled when N = 0;
** it collects the ids of the visible {{[data-dvt-run-test]}} buttons and asks {{confirm("Queue N test(s) on X? Each one waits for Start at the machine.")}};
** then the button turns disabled "Queuing N test(s)…" and the page sends {{/api/dvt/request}}.
# "■ Stop all (N)" (danger) is shown only when active requests exist. It asks {{confirm("Stop all N open request(s) on X? A test that is running there is stopped and the machine turns everything off.")}}, then sends {{{ids, force:true}}}.
# Instruments row: label "Instruments" and chips for tc08, tc08ch1, tc08ch2, ophir (green ok / red bad / plain). When tc08, tc08ch1 or ophir is false, a red line "Not connected: a · b".
# A fixed note: "Nothing turns on until someone at X presses *Start* on its screen. Steps that need a person are asked here." The last refusal ({{DVT_MSG}}) is shown in red below it.
# Queue table {{rq-table}}: Test | Status | On the machine | (action).
** Active requests first, then the 8 most recent finished ones, for this machine + unit.
** Status cell: status pill plus a verdict pill.
** "On the machine": the muted {{line}} plus the prompt controls.
** Action cell: {{cancel_requested}} → danger "Force stop" (tooltip "Close it now - for a run the machine no longer answers for", sends force); other active → "Cancel" (turns into "Cancelling…"); finished → muted finished/requested time.
# Prompt controls (amber 3 px left-border box), headed "*The test asks:* <text>":
** {{yesno}}: Yes (primary) / No / Skip;
** {{value}}: a select of {{values}} or an input with the placeholder = unit, then OK (primary) and Skip; OK with an empty input does nothing;
** otherwise: Done (primary) / Skip.
** A clicked button disables itself.
# {{dvtSend}} posts, sets {{DVT_MSG}} to the refusal text, or '' on success, or the exception text, then always runs {{loadDvt()}} and {{render()}}.
# Role refusals come back as 403 → the shell {{flash}} shows the server message (CLOUD-57).
*Look & layout:*
* {{.dvt-runpanel}}: a bordered 10 px rounded box.
* Phone: the queue table becomes one card per request, and its buttons are full width, at least 46 px.
* Prompt buttons are at least 48 px wide at 40% each; the input takes the full width.
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* Run all queues exactly the visible runnable tests after the confirm.
* Stop all sends force with every active id.
* Force stop appears only on {{cancel_requested}}.
* A Skip answer sends {{value:null}}.
*Tests:* test_code.cjs (request queued / refused for another unit, cancel while running, a queued request cancelled before it starts, Stop all / Force stop, "blocked" is final); test_phone.cjs (queue cards).
*Reference (source):* Page.html 718-749, 1127-1163, 2063-2098; CSS 225-227, 351-357, 397-399; Code.gs 736-737, 982-1047, 1104-1122.

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* Pressing Run on a test never queues it straight away. A modal window first explains the test (purpose, safety plan, equipment, "Before you start", procedure, pass criteria) and offers a dry-run simulation. Only "▶ Queue on <CureBox>" requests it, after which the same window follows the run (CLOUD-48). See live-simulation.png and run-window.png.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-42, CLOUD-46, CLOUD-48, CLOUD-52
*Files to create:* Page.html: {{dvtGuide(tid, title)}}, {{GUIDE}} state {{{bg, tid, machine, unit, sinceId, sent, log[], sig}}}, {{dvtTitleOf(tid)}}.
*Public contract:* {{POST /api/dvt/request {machine, unit, testIds:[tid]}}} (CLOUD-46).
*Behaviour & rules:*
# The window is appended to {{document.body}}, outside {{#app}}, so re-renders and the long poll leave it alone. Only one {{GUIDE}} is current at a time.
# Body sections (from {{DVT_DETAIL[tid]}}):
* Purpose; Safety plan (red box); Equipment; *Before you start** (= preconditions); the blue note box; Procedure (numbered boxes); Pass criteria; the Simulation box (CLOUD-52).
* When the test has no detail: "The guide for this test is not in the portal yet - it arrives when the DVT runner on the CureBox starts, or when the DVT tool presses *Sync all**." In that case there is no simulation.
# Footer:
** muted on the left: "It starts only when someone presses Start on <CureBox>.";
** buttons: "Cancel" and primary "▶ Queue on <CureBox>".
# Queue pressed:
** remember {{sinceId}} = the highest existing request id for this machine + test (the server reply has no id);
** set {{sent=true}}; the button turns disabled "Queuing…"; Cancel is relabelled "Close";
** post the request.
** When the reply fails or {{queued}} is 0: re-enable the button, and show in red in the run strip either the server message, or "not queued - this test is already queued or every run of it is recorded", or {{DVT_MSG}}, or "not queued".
** Then call {{dvtGuideRefresh()}}.
# Closing:
** Esc always closes;
** Cancel/Close closes;
** a click on the dark backdrop closes only while nothing has been queued ({{!g.sent}}).
** Closing removes the key listener and clears {{GUIDE}}.
# The machine and unit are frozen at open time ({{g.machine = SELECTED}}, {{g.unit = DVT_UNIT}}).
*Look & layout (live-simulation.png, run-window.png):*

column4: CLOUD-48 Following a requested run in the guide window: status, "What to do now", I did it, questions, live machine chips, run log
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-47
*Relates to:* DVT-05, PLAT-10

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* After Queue, the guide window shows the run as it happens:
* its status and verdict, and the runner's current line;
* one plain instruction for the person: wait, press Start at the machine, do this physical step now, answer this, or nothing to do;
* the machine's live state;
* a time-stamped run log.
It also offers Stop. See run-window.png.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-46, CLOUD-47; DVT-05 (RemoteConfirm Start at the machine); server {{portalDvtActed}}, {{portalDvtAnswer}}, {{portalDvtCancel}}, {{dvtUpdate_}}
*Files to create:* Page.html: {{dvtGuideRefresh()}} (called at the end of every {{render()}} and after Queue), {{dvtGuideNow(r, g)}}, {{dvtGuideSystem(name)}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{POST /api/dvt/acted {id}}} → {{portalDvtActed}}. It is refused when there is no {{act}} ("that request is not waiting for you to do anything") or when {{act.ack === false}} ("that step is watched by the machine itself - nothing to press").
* {{act = {text, sec?, stage?{n, of, text}, ack?, acked?, label?, pressed?}}}.
* {{runner.live = {chamberTemp, doorClosed, uvOn, isHeating, heaterPwm, isCooling, at}}}, fresher than 45 s.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# The followed request is the newest one for (machine, test) with {{id > sinceId}}. None yet → amber pill "queuing…".
# Run log: append {{{time, text}}} whenever the signature {{status|line|prompt.text|act.text|verdict}} changes. The text is the status label, plus the verdict, plus one of: " - asks: <q>" (an active prompt), " - DO NOW: <act>" (an active act), or " - <line>". The log is shown newest first.
# While the focus is in an input inside the window, the strip is not redrawn, so typing is not lost.
# Top row: status pill, verdict pill, the muted line (flex), and, while active and not stopping, a danger "Stop the run" button. Stop turns into "Stopping…" and sends a non-forced cancel.
# Queue button while the run is active: disabled "Queued". Afterwards: "▶ Run again".
# "What to do now" box. It has a blue 4 px left border; it turns amber ({{.act}}) while an act is pending. Text per status:
** queued: "Wait - the DVT runner on X picks the test up within a few seconds. If it stays queued, check that the runner shows online."
* waiting: "Go to *X* and press *Start** on its screen (it asks to confirm <tid>). Check the "Before you start" list below first. Nothing turns on until Start is pressed."
** running with an act: big text (1.45rem, 800 weight, #92400e). It is followed by a monospace pill "<sec> s" when {{sec}} is a number, and muted "step n of m · <stage text>". Below it, one of:
*** {{ack===false}} → "Do it now - the machine is watching for it and goes on by itself.";
*** {{acked}} → "You pressed it - waiting for the machine to see it.";
*** otherwise a large amber button (#b45309, white, 800 weight, at least 48 px) labelled {{act.label}} or "I did it". It turns into disabled "Sent…" and posts {{/api/dvt/acted}}. Under it: "Press it the moment you have done it - the test does not go on until you do."
** running with a prompt: "The test is waiting for you - answer the question below.", followed by the prompt controls (CLOUD-46 rule 9).
** running with neither: "The test is running by itself - nothing to do. (<line>) Stay clear of the machine; keep this window open to follow it, or press Stop the run."
** cancel_requested: "Stopping - X is turning everything off."
* done: "Finished with *<verdict>**. The result is recorded in the campaign. You can close the window." (or "Finished. You can close the window.")
** failed: "The run did not complete - read the reason above, fix it, then press Run again."
** blocked: "The test could not start - the reason is above. Fix it, then press Run again."
** cancelled: "The run was stopped. You can press Run again or close the window."
# Machine status chips ({{dvtGuideSystem}}):
** Source: the runner's {{live}} when present (seconds old), else the machine's cloud-sync {{state}} (minutes old).
** Chips: online/offline; "chamber 32.4°C"; door closed (green) / door open (amber); UV on (amber) / UV off; "heating NN%" (amber) / heater off; cooling (amber) / not cooling.
** A muted tail "live · Ns ago" or "synced <ago>".
** No data at all: "<name> no status from this CureBox yet".
# Never says "nothing to do" while an act waits for the person. This rule comes from the DVT-SAF-008 timeout of 2026-10-29.
*Look & layout:*
* run-window.png: the "running" pill, the muted line "measuring point 3 of 8", and a red-outlined "Stop the run" on the right.
* Below it the white "WHAT TO DO NOW" card with a blue left bar, and inside it the amber prompt box "The test asks: Is the Kelvin probe on the door frame?" with Yes (primary) / No / Skip.
* Then the row "CUREBOX-1 STATUS" with chips (online green, chamber, door closed green, UV on amber, heater off, not cooling, "synced 2h ago").
* Then "RUN LOG" with monospace times and dashed separators.
* Phone: the instruction fits the screen width.
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* With an act "OPEN THE DOOR", {{sec}} 24 and stage 4/6:
** the headline is at least 20 px and reads "OPEN THE DOOR";
** the pill reads "24 s" and the stage reads "step 4 of 6";
** the card is amber and contains no "nothing to do";
** there is an "I did it" button at least 44 px tall.
* "I did it" is delivered to the runner exactly once.
*Tests:* test_phone.cjs (lines 200-241: act headline, sec, stage, amber, I did it); test_code.cjs ("the step the person must do now (c.act)", "'I did it': handed to the runner exactly once", "a step the machine watches by itself takes no press", "live state rides on the runner's reports").

column4: CLOUD-49 Run-from-site safety contract (Start only at the machine, roles, unit lock, run-last rule, orphan cleanup)
column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench, Safety & watchdog
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-57
*Blocks:* CLOUD-46
*Relates to:* DVT-05, PLAT-10

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html (+ server rules in Code.gs, ticketed in CLOUD-01..19)
*Goal:* Pin down the rules that make running DVT from the website safe. Queuing a test from the site never turns anything on. A person at the CureBox must press Start on its screen. Wrong-unit, wrong-role and out-of-order requests are refused, and cut-off runs do not stay "running" forever.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-46, CLOUD-47, CLOUD-57; DVT-05 (RemoteConfirm prompter on the machine), PLAT-10
*Files to create:* none new: rules and wording across {{dvtRunPanel}}, {{dvtGuide}}, {{dvtBenchCard}}, {{dvtGuideNow}}. The server side lives in {{portalDvtRequest}}, {{dvtOpenOthers_}}, {{dvtCloseOrphans_}}, {{need_}}.
*Public contract:*
* Every DVT action needs the {{service}} role: request, cancel, answer, acted. Approve needs {{admin}}.
* A refusal is {{{ok:false, denied:true, message}}} → the shim answers 403 → the page shows {{flash(message)}}.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# The page wording always states that nothing starts without Start at the machine:
** the guide footer;
** the run panel note;
** the Run tooltip;
** the Run-all confirm;
** the "waiting" instruction.
# The site writes a request with status {{queued}}. The machine's runner takes it (→ {{running}}), asks for confirmation on the CureBox screen (→ {{waiting}}, DVT-05), and only then drives outputs.
# Unit lock: when the CureBox's runner reported a unit, a request for another unit is refused: "<box> is unit <U> - the request was for <V>. Reload the page."
# Run-last ({{afterAll}}) tests:
** the page hides Run while other tests are open;
** the server refuses with "<ids> runs last - N other test(s) on <unit> have no result yet".
# No duplicates: a test already active on that machine + unit is skipped ({{skipped}} count).
# Orphans: when the runner says hello (only between requests), its {{running}}, {{waiting}} and {{cancel_requested}} requests close:
** {{failed}} with "interrupted - the machine or its app restarted during the test; run it again";
** or {{cancelled}} with "cancelled - the runner restarted before it could stop the test".
# Force stop closes a request on the site at once. A runner still on it is told to cancel on its next report, and that report cannot revive the row.
# Stop always means the machine turns everything off. The page never sends hardware commands itself; machine commands are data-only (PLAT-10).
*Look & layout:* n/a (wording listed above)
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* A Viewer pressing Run sees a flash "Requesting DVT tests needs Service access - you are signed in as Viewer. Ask an admin.", and nothing is queued.
* A stale tab requesting UUT-02 on a UUT-01 CureBox is refused.
* After a runner restart no request stays running.
*Tests:* test_code.cjs (lines 275-357, 537-580: unit refusal, afterAll refusal, orphan close, force stop); test_people.cjs ("a refused action says which access it needs").
*Reference (source):* Page.html 718-724, 834, 1158, 2066; Code.gs 965-1018, 809-833, 1020-1047, 1240-1250.

column5:
h3. Links
*Features:* Cloud portal, DVT bench
*Blocked by:* CLOUD-47, CLOUD-51

*Project / folder:* cloud/google/Page.html
*Goal:* Let an engineer rehearse a test before queuing it, inside the guide window only:
* the procedure steps light up one after another;
* the same questions as the real run are asked;
* the pass criteria are checked against made-up readings (the person's answers replace them), ending in a simulated PASS or FAIL.
Nothing is sent to the CureBox and nothing is recorded. See live-simulation.png and simulation-howto.png.
*Depends on:* CLOUD-47, CLOUD-51; catalog detail {{prompts[]}}
*Files to create:* Page.html: the Simulation box inside {{dvtGuide}}, {{dvtSimulate(bg, d, wantFail)}}, {{simAsk(out, p)}}.
*Public contract:*
* {{d.prompts[] = {text, kind: 'yesno'|'value'|other, values?[], unit?, type?: 'float'|'int'|'bool'|string, field?}}}, the questions the real run asks, in order. No server call.
*Behaviour & rules:*
# Box content:
** heading "Simulation" (purple);
** muted text: "A dry run in this window only: the steps play through, it asks you the same questions as a real run, and the pass criteria are checked against made-up readings (your answers replace them). Nothing is sent to the CureBox and nothing is recorded.";
** buttons "▶ Simulate a passing run" and "▶ Simulate a failing run";
** an output area.
# Pressing either button:
** disables both buttons and clears earlier step marks;
** plays the steps 700 ms each: the current step gets {{sim-on}} (purple border and tint), a done step gets {{sim-done}} (a green ✓ at the right), and each is scrolled into view.
# With K prompts, prompt k is asked after step {{round((k+1)·steps/(K+1))}}. The step it waits on stays highlighted.
# Question box ({{simAsk}}), headed "*The machine asks.* <text>":
** yesno: Yes (primary) / No / Skip;
** value: a select of {{values}}, or an input (number for float/int, otherwise text, {{inputmode=decimal}}) with the unit after it, then OK and Skip; Enter presses OK;
** other: Done / Skip.
** An empty OK means Skip. The answer is typed per {{type}}.
** When the answer is not skipped and the prompt has a {{field}}, the answer is stored under it.
# Then the rest of the steps play, and the page:
** parses the criteria and builds passing readings;
** for a failing run, tries leaves in random order and keeps the first broken reading that makes the whole expression false;
** overlays the person's answers;
** evaluates.
# Result:
** a table Check | Simulated reading | ✓/✗ with one row per leaf; readings are written {{name = value}}, with "(limit)" for dotted names and "(your answer)" for answered fields;
** a verdict bar "Simulated verdict: PASS" (green tint) or "FAIL" (red tint); for a failing run that no single reading can fail it adds " - no single reading can fail these criteria";
** a muted footnote "Simulation only - made-up numbers except your answers, not recorded.";
** the buttons are re-enabled.
# Unreadable criteria: "The steps played through, but the pass criteria could not be read for a simulated check (<error>)."
# Closing the window mid-run stops the simulation ({{bg.isConnected}} checks).
*Look & layout:*
* {{.dvt-sim}}: a 1px dashed purple (#a855f7) border, 10 px radius, a faint purple background, and a purple {{h4}}.
* The table is 0.88rem with monospace checks; ✓ is green bold, ✗ red bold.
* The verdict bar is bold with an 8 px radius.
* live-simulation.png shows the four numbered steps each with a green ✓, the PASS CRITERIA box, the SIMULATION box with the two buttons, a table ({{max_resistance <= 0.1}} | {{max_resistance = 0.05}} ✓; {{pe_uninterrupted == true}} | {{pe_uninterrupted = true}} ✓), and "Simulated verdict: PASS".
* simulation-howto.png is a three-panel Hebrew how-to: (1) press ▶ Run next to a test after choosing CureBox-1; (2) scroll to Simulation and press a simulate button; (3) the steps light up one by one, then the readings table and PASS/FAIL appear, nothing is sent, and Cancel exits.
*Configuration:* none
*Acceptance criteria:*
* A test with three prompts asks them in catalog order (door, input voltage, fuse).
* A passing run ends PASS.
* A failing run ends FAIL when any single reading can fail.
* No network call is made during the simulation.
*Tests:* test_sim.cjs (evaluator); test_phone.cjs line 172 ("the simulation asks the questions of the real run in order").
*Reference (source):* Page.html 823-826, 860, 945-1024; CSS 273-281.
